scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Hello!
Now ^4d4dffthe palace is hosting a banquet for the returning heroes from Vacuum^000000.
Please tell me ^4d4dffwhere the heroes who have participated in the expedition are^000000 if you know any.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
您好！
宮殿正在為^4d4dff從異世界歸來的英雄們舉辦宴會^000000。
如果您知道^4d4dff參加過遠征的英雄們在哪裡^000000，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I wonder where they are. They are so scattered that it is difficult to locate each one of them. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
不知道他們都在哪兒。他們分散各處，要一個個找到可不容易。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Oh, wait. You are...
{0}, right?
Let's see.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
哦，等等。你是...
{0}，對吧？
我看看。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I am right. You look exactly the same as the montage from the guild. Hahahaha!
My eyes are doing what they are supposed to do now, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
沒錯。你和公會給的畫像一模一樣。哈哈哈！
看來我的眼睛終於派上用場了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
It is difficult to find the freelance adventurers who don't belong to the military.
It was very difficult to find you since you are not bound to anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
要找到不隸屬於軍隊的自由冒險者可不容易。
你沒有固定去處，所以找你尤其費勁。

scripts.text: May I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Help? Sure thing!
You know that there is a banquet taking place in celebration of subjugating Morocc.
An invitation has been issued for you. But it was just impossible to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
幫忙？當然可以！
你知道宮殿正在舉辦宴會，慶祝討伐夢羅克的勝利吧？
我們已經邀請你了，只是一直找不到你。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I am sure that all the Royal Messengers of the city must be looking for with the portrait of you.
Hey, since we don't have enough time, please take this invitation for you.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
我想城裡的皇家信使都拿著你的畫像到處找你呢。
時間不多了，先收下這份邀請函吧。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
You must attend the banquet. Do you understand? ^4d4dffYou've been invited as a special guest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你必須參加宴會。明白嗎？^4d4dff你是作為特邀嘉賓被邀請的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
The people in the palace will fill you up with the details.
I am just a messenger after all.
Although the banquet will be held for quite a while, don't take too much time to get there.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
宮殿裡的人會向你說明詳情。
我畢竟只是個信使。
宴會會持續一段時間，不過你還是儘快過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Make sure to bring the invitation with you. Don't forget!
Why don't you go right now? ^4d4dffI can teleport you there now if you want^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
記得帶上邀請函，別忘了！
現在就出發如何？^4d4dff你願意的話，我可以立刻把你傳送過去。^000000

scripts.text: I'll go on my own.
scripts.translation: 我自己去

scripts.text: I'll go right away.
scripts.translation: 我馬上就去

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
You can visit the Prontera Palace.
You may show the invitation to the guard at the gate or
A servant in charge of the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你可以前往普隆德拉宮殿。
把邀請函出示給門口的衛兵，或負責宴會的侍從即可。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Since I have delivered the invitation to you, I shall wait for another one.
I hope you have a good time there, dear hero.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
邀請函已經送到了，我得去等下一位了。
祝你玩得開心，英雄。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
我這就把你傳送過去。
到了之後會有侍從接待你，到時出示邀請函就行。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Why are you still here?
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
你為什麼還在這裡？
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Send me to the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 送我去宴會廳

scripts.text: I have lost the invitation.
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了邀請函

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
What a shame! What happened?
Well, since the message that you'll be there has already been sent there,
You may not really need the invitation anyways.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
真遺憾！怎麼弄丟的？
不過，我已經通知那邊你會到場，應該不一定需要邀請函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
When you go to the palace, the servant in charge will recognize you.
Don't worry, and you may go to the palace now.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
到了宮殿，負責接待的侍從會認出你。
別擔心，現在就去吧。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Eh? What is that you have in your pocket? It looks like an invitation to me.
I may have a tiny set of eyes, but I wouldn't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
咦？你口袋裡是什麼？看起來像邀請函。
我的眼睛雖小，可不會看漏這種東西。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Since you have found your invitation, let's get going! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
既然你找到了邀請函，那就出發吧！哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
Let me teleport you there right away.
When you arrive, there will be a servant for reception. You can show the invitation then.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
讓我馬上瞬間移動你過去。
到達後，會有接待的侍從。屆時你可以出示邀請函。

scripts.text:
[Royal Messenger]
I have heard that you have attended the banquet safely.
I need to find the others and send them to the banquet as well.
scripts.translation:
[皇家信使]
聽說你順利參加了宴會。
我還得找到其他人，把他們也送去宴會。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Here comes the hero!
The Banquet Hall is inside the palace. You may follow the passage to get there.
Let me send a message for the Chamberlain to find you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
英雄來了！
宴會廳在宮殿裡面，沿著走廊過去就到了。
我通知侍從長來接你。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
You must be Sir {0}... Am I right?
You are here at last.
I've been waiting for you.
I am glad that the invitation have found you in time.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長 貝爾]
您一定是{0}大人吧？
您終於來了，我一直在等您。
很高興邀請函及時送到了您手上。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I am Chamberlain Bell Twilight. I will be at your service during your stay at the palace.
You can call me Belle.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我是侍從長貝爾·特威萊特，您在宮殿期間由我負責接待。
叫我貝爾就好。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
{0} since you have been invited as a special guest here, a separate guest room is prepared for you.
You may go upstairs and walk ^4d4dffstraight to the left corridor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
{0}，您是受邀的特別嘉賓，我們已為您準備好單獨的客房。
請上樓，^4d4dff沿著左側走廊一直往前走^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me go ahead and mall all the preparations.
Come with me, please.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我先去安排其他事宜。
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
The special guestroom is prepared this way.
It is the ^4d4dfffirst room^000000 you'll see in there.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長 貝爾]
特別客房已經準備好了。
就是裡面的^4d4dff第一間房^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
Let me tell you the story in detail after moving into the room.
Come this way.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長 貝爾]
等您進房後，我再詳細說明情況。
請往這邊走。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
Let me tell you about the detailed schedule inside.
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長 貝爾]
我進屋後再向您說明詳細日程。
請進。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain Bell]
I'll be waiting for you here in this room at all times.
You may find me when you need a help.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長 貝爾]
我會一直在這間房裡。
您需要幫助時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This is the guest room for the officially invited guest.
Since this place forbids the access of outsiders, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是正式受邀嘉賓的客房。
由於此處禁止外人進入，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You must have come a long way here. Thank you.
Since you are a special guest, you have been assigned with a room in the royal villa.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您一路辛苦了。
您是特別嘉賓，住在皇家別墅的專用客房。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I'll tell you about the schedule at all times. You can ask me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我會隨時向您說明日程，有問題儘管問我。

scripts.text: What do you mean by the special guest?
scripts.translation: 什麼是特別嘉賓？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The banquet hosted by the palace is to celebrate the return of the expedition and cherish their hard work...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
宮殿舉辦這場宴會，是為了慶祝遠征隊歸來，感謝他們的辛勞...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, more importantly, it is to fulfill the Royal Assembly.
The candidates for the throne have been evaluated before.
And heir to the throne will be determined.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
不過，更重要的是要召開皇家議會。
王位候選人已經接受過評估，
接下來將選出王位繼承人。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There is a secret ritual passed down in the palace, which is held before the official coronation. The heir will be named the king upon passing the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
宮中流傳著一項秘密儀式，會在正式加冕前舉行。繼承人通過儀式後，才會被冊立為國王。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Unless the heavens fall, the ritual will be finished safely, and Rune-Midgarts will meet the new king.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
只要不出意外，儀式就會順利完成，盧恩·米德加茲也將迎來新王。

scripts.text: What's it got to do with me?
scripts.translation: 這跟我有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I have told you just before.
There is a ritual to be held after the final decision.
You have been invited as an observer to the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我剛才說過，最終決定之後還會舉行一場儀式。
您受邀擔任這場儀式的見證人。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
It is the secret ritual of the palace to designate the king for the eternal glory of the seven royal families.
So that our new king is acknowledged by all the people of this land.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是宮廷秘儀，旨在確立新王，為七大皇族帶來永恆的榮耀。
新王也將因此得到這片土地上所有人的認可。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, since special evaluation is allowed by the Royal Assembly,
It has been decided to select a personnel recommended by each guild
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
不過，皇家議會允許特別評估，
決定從各公會推薦的人選中，

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Or a hero who made a great contribution in the expedition as the observer of this ritual.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
或從遠征中立下大功的英雄中，選出一位儀式見證人。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Consequently, you have been assigned. I have heard that you were recommended unanimously.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
因此，您獲選擔任見證人。我聽說所有人都一致推薦了您。

scripts.text: When will the ritual take place?
scripts.translation: 儀式什麼時候舉行？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
As far as I know, it is supposed to be in the final stage.
Since the late king passed away all of a sudden, the palace has been in a state of disorder.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
據我所知，儀式應該已進入最後階段。
先王突然駕崩，宮中因此陷入混亂。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Fortunately, Rune-Midgarts is supported by the seven royal families.
It is the time to welcome our new king.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
幸好盧恩·米德加茲有七大皇族輔佐。
如今正是迎接新王的時候。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Since you are invited as the observer,
You need to visit each facility and exchange greetings before attending the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
既然您受邀擔任見證人，參加宴會前請先拜訪各處，與各家族成員打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This royal villa happens to be the place where the people from each family stays when they come to the capital. All other rooms except this one are occupied by other families.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這座皇家別墅是各家族成員進京時的住處。除了您這間客房，其他房間都住著各個家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
They must have heard the news of your arrival by now.
How about ^4d4dffvisiting the Heine family near here^000000?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
他們現在一定已經聽到您到達的訊息了。
要不要去拜訪一下附近的^4d4dff海爾內家族^000000？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
In the west villa, I mean, where we are now,
There are the residences for Heine, Nerius and Walther.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我們現在所在的是西側別墅，
海爾內、內裡烏斯和瓦爾特家族都住在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
In the east across the corridor, there are residences for Wigner, Richard, Geoborg and Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
走廊對面的東側別墅，則住著維格納、理查德、喬博格和羅根堡家族。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You need to exchange greetings with the members of each families so make sure to visit them all.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
請務必逐一拜訪各家族，與他們打聲招呼。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The news of your arrival must have reached each family by now.
They must be waiting. Pay a visit and exchange greetings.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您抵達的訊息應該已經傳到各家族了。
他們都在等您，請去拜訪並打聲招呼。

They are the most blue-blooded people, not used to be kept waiting.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
他們都是出身顯赫的人物，不習慣久等。

Then, good bye.

為了維持良好關係，您最好儘快過去。

The assembly seems to take some time.

看來議會還要開一陣子。

scripts.translation: 集會似乎還要持續一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Since you have some time to spare, why don't you go enjoy the banquet in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
既然還有些時間，不妨去宴會廳參加宴會。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: Since you have some time to spare, why don't you go enjoy the banquet in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 既然您還有些空閒，不如去宴會廳享用宴席吧。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The ^4d4dffladies of the Nerius family have just asked to see you in the Banquet Hall^000000 .
{0}, you must have made a good impression.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
^4d4dff內裡烏斯家族的女士們剛才說想在宴會廳見您。^000000
{0}，看來您給她們留下了好印象。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.translation: ^4d4dff內裡烏斯家的女士們剛才請您去宴會廳見她們^000000。

scripts.text: {0}, you must have made a good impression.
scripts.translation: {0}，看來您給她們留下了很好的印象。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
到時候，宮廷魔法師會來引導你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴會。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation: 時間到了，宮廷魔法師會來帶您過去。在那之前，您可以繼續享用宴席。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
And this is some sort of reward which has been sent to you as a token of gratitude...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是送給您的謝禮...

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: And this is some sort of reward which has been sent to you as a token of gratitude...
scripts.translation: 這是送給您的謝禮，聊表感激之情……

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You can collect them and exchange with useful items.
You may get more in return for your help around the palace.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您可以收集這些謝禮，兌換實用物品。
在宮殿裡幫忙，還能獲得更多。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: You can collect them and exchange with useful items.
scripts.translation: 您可以收集這些謝禮，兌換實用的物品。

scripts.text: You may get more in return for your help around the palace.
scripts.translation: 您在宮殿裡幫忙的話，還能獲得更多謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There must be someone ^4d4dffnear the Crusader's Office who would exchange^000000 them.
If you have some time, pay a visit.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
^4d4dff十字軍辦事處附近應該有人負責兌換^000000。
有空的話可以去看看。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: There must be someone ^4d4dffnear the Crusader's Office who would exchange^000000 them.
scripts.translation: 十字軍辦公室^4d4dff附近應該有人可以用它們兌換物品^000000。

scripts.text: If you have some time, pay a visit.
scripts.translation: 有空的話就去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
到時候，宮廷魔法師會來引導你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴會。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text: When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation: 時間到了，宮廷魔法師會來帶您過去。在那之前，您可以繼續享用宴席。

scripts.text: [Belle]
scripts.translation: [貝爾]

scripts.text:
[Belle]
If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
如果你去宴會廳，^4d4dff一定要找到內裡烏斯家族的人^000000。

scripts.text: If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000
scripts.translation: 去宴會廳時，^4d4dff一定要找到內裡烏斯家族的人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Belle]
When the time comes, the Court Mage will come to guide you. You may enjoy the banquet by then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
到時候，宮廷魔法師會來引導你。在那之前，你可以先享受宴會。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
If you go to the Banquet Hall, ^4d4dffmake sure to find the people from the Nerius family.^000000
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
如果你去宴會廳，^4d4dff一定要找到內裡烏斯家族的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Oh, how was the banquet?
The banquet is supposed to last long since it is held to welcome all the returning heroes from Ash-Vacuum...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
哦，宴會怎麼樣？
這是為歡迎從異世界歸來的遠征英雄舉辦的，宴會會持續一陣子...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
By the way, the Court Mage has visited just before.
The Court Magician will be back soon after visiting other families.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
對了，宮廷魔法師剛才來過。
他拜訪完其他家族後很快就會回來。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There... Is the magician.
The Court Mage will give you the details.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
啊，魔法師來了。
宮廷魔法師會向您說明詳情。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You are back.
There has been a message for you.
It says 'There will be an important meeting. Please wait until then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您回來了。
有訊息留給您：
“稍後將召開重要會議，請耐心等候。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You will be notified as soon as everything is settled.
Please enjoy the banquet until then.'
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
一切安排妥當後會立刻通知您。
在那之前，請盡情享用宴會。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
This is about it.
Apart from it, well, I am not supposed to be curious about this kind of things...
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
大致就是這樣。
至於其他事...我不該對這種事情太好奇...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
However, ^4d4dffI saw the court doctors and priests moving fast to the Heine family^000000.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
不過，^4d4dff我看到宮廷醫生和牧師匆忙趕去了海爾內家族那邊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
They seemed to be in a hurry. Do you know what has happened?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
他們看起來很著急。你知道發生了什麼嗎？

scripts.text: This is a difficult question for me to answer...
scripts.translation: 這個問題對我來說很難回答...

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I am sorry that I asked.
Well, there is one more news.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
抱歉，不該問的。
對了，還有個訊息。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The lady of the ^4d4dffNerius^000000 family has invited you to have a cup of tea with her.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
^4d4dff內裡烏斯家族的女士^000000邀請您去喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
She asked me to let her know as soon as you come. Shall I send her a message now?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
她讓我在您回來後立刻通知她。現在要我傳話嗎？

scripts.text: I'll visit her now.
scripts.translation: 我現在就去拜訪她

scripts.text: I'll visit her later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再去拜訪她

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您準備好後告訴我，我再通知她。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我這就去傳話。
告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Would you accept the invitation from the Nerius family now?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您現在要接受內裡烏斯家族的邀請嗎？

scripts.text: I'll visit her now.
scripts.translation: 我現在就去拜訪她

scripts.text: I'll visit her later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再去拜訪她

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me know when you are ready.
I'll send her the message then.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您準備好了請告訴我。
到時我會給她發訊息。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Let me send the message now.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我現在就給她發訊息。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
The Nerius family stays in the second room from this room.
The room next to the room of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
內裡烏斯家族住在這裡過去第二間房，
就在海爾內家族隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I have sent the message that you would visit them soon. You may go there anytime.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
我已經通知他們您很快會過去。您隨時可以前往。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There has been a request from the Heine family to meet you.
They asked you to visit the Heine family as soon as you come back.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
海爾內家族想見您。
他們希望您回來後儘快去拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Oh, you are back!
Let me call the Mage.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
哦，您回來了！
我去叫那位魔法師。

scripts.text: What is that about?
scripts.translation: 那是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Court Mage Nillem opened the door and left right away.
Saying, 'Where are you?' {0} The magician must be looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
宮廷魔法師尼勒姆開門後就匆匆離開了。
他喊著“你在哪裡？”{0}看來那位魔法師正在找您。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
I am at your service.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
隨時為您效勞。

scripts.text: Call Nillem
scripts.translation: 叫尼勒姆

scripts.text: What is the next thing on the schedule?
scripts.translation: 接下來有什麼安排？

scripts.text: Please prepare some refreshments.
scripts.translation: 請準備一些茶點

scripts.text: Call Convenience Service
scripts.translation: 呼叫便利服務

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Shall I call the Court Mage for you?
Wait a second.
I have just sent a message. The magician will arrive here soon.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
需要我為您叫宮廷魔法師嗎？
請稍等。
我剛發了訊息，他很快就會到。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
There is no special invitation for today.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
今天沒有特別的邀請。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here are some chamomile tea and ginger cookies. They will help you take a rest and get recovered from fatigue.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是洋甘菊茶和薑餅，可以讓您休息一下、緩解疲勞。
您喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You seemed hungry, so I have prepared some afternoon tea, scones and clotted cream.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
看您似乎餓了，我準備了下午茶、司康餅和凝脂奶油。
您喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here are some chocolate and cinnamon-flavored rooibos tea for refreshment.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是巧克力肉桂風味的路易波士茶，可以提神。
您喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here is some cold milk with citron jelly and cream. It is a sweet and sour drink.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是加了檸檬果凍和奶油的冰牛奶，酸甜可口。
您喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Here is some strong mint tea mixed with milk and chocolate chips. A great after-meal treat.
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
這是加了牛奶和巧克力豆的濃薄荷茶，很適合作為餐後飲品。
您喜歡嗎？

scripts.text: ^4d4dff All HP and SP are recovered!
scripts.translation: ^4d4dffHP和SP全部恢復！

scripts.text:
[Belle]
Which service should I call for you?
All calls are available, but additional charge may apply to each service.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
需要為您呼叫哪項服務？
各項服務都可以呼叫，但可能需要額外付費。

scripts.text: Kafra
scripts.translation: 卡普拉

scripts.text: Giant Beast Manager
scripts.translation: 巨獸管理員

scripts.text: No need.
scripts.translation: 不需要

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You want the Kafra Service.
Let me make a call right away.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您要呼叫卡普拉服務。
我這就聯絡他們。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
You need a Giant Beast Manager.
Let me make a call right away.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
您要呼叫巨獸管理員。
我這就聯絡他。

scripts.text:
[Belle]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾]
明白了。

scripts.text: I am managing the Dragons and Griffons for the Rune Knights and Royal Guards.
scripts.translation: 我負責管理盧恩騎士和皇家衛士的龍與獅鷲。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you for calling me. Shall I bring a Griffon for you?
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
感謝您呼叫我。要我為您牽來一隻獅鷲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you for calling me. Shall I bring a Dragon for you?
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
感謝您呼叫我。要我為您牽來一隻龍嗎？

scripts.text: Use
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
明白了，那我先走了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Griffon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您得先學會騎乘獅鷲。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Dragon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您得先學會騎乘龍。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經在騎乘獅鷲了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經在騎乘龍了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already riding something else.
You need to take off the ride to ride a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經騎著其他坐騎了。
要騎獅鷲，請先下坐騎。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already riding something else.
You need to take off the ride to ride a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經騎著其他坐騎了。
要騎龍，請先下坐騎。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hello. This is Kafra Service.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
您好，這裡是卡普拉服務。
請問有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Use Cargo Service
scripts.translation: 使用貨運服務

scripts.text: Use Cart Service
scripts.translation: 使用手推車服務

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry, dear customer.
You need to raise the novice skill level to 6 or higher to use the cargo service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，親愛的顧客。
貨運服務需要初心者技能“倉庫使用”達到6級以上才能使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You don't have enough money.
The Cargo Service costs 50 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
您的Zeny不足。
貨運服務需要50 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let me open the warehouse for you.
Thank you for using Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
我這就為您開啟倉庫。
感謝您使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am sorry,
The Cart Service is available for Merchant classes only.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，
手推車服務僅限商人系職業使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You are already equipped with a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
您已經裝備了手推車。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can use the cart after learning the 'Push Cart' skill.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
學習“手推車使用”技能後，您才能使用手推車。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.
Would you use it?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
手推車服務需要800 Zeny。
要使用嗎？

scripts.text: Use
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You don't have enough money, dear customer.
The Cart Service costs 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，親愛的顧客，您的Zeny不足。
手推車服務需要800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you for using Kafra Service as always.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
感謝您一如既往地使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, it's you, darling! I've been waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，是你呀，親愛的！我等你好久了！

scripts.text: Darling...
scripts.translation: 親愛的...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, I am sorry that I was overly excited.
Exploring through the fissure of dimensions to uncover the secret of the palace...!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
啊，抱歉，我太激動了。
探索次元裂縫、揭開宮殿的秘密...！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
No mage would say no to that! No wonder I am excited!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哪個魔法師會拒絕這種機會啊！我當然會興奮！

scripts.text: By the way, why did you choose me?
scripts.translation: 順便問一下，你為什麼選我？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, because a royalty is picky and useless...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，因為皇室成員既挑剔又沒用...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
See, the current head of the family and the heir are not supposed to do anything dangerous.
So are the heirs to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看，現任家主和繼承人都不應該從事任何危險的工作。
王位繼承人也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Did you see Peter in bed?
......No harm should be done to him, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到彼得躺在床上了嗎？
...不過你知道，不能讓他受到任何傷害。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Not this, not that... After removing all those things, there aren't many left for the aristocrats other than paper work and socializing.
What can they do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這個不行，那個也不行...把這些都排除之後，貴族們能做的也就只剩文書工作和社交應酬了。
他們還能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Moreover, it doesn't suit me to take care of them. Hahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
而且，照顧他們也不適合我。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: And, why are you working as a Court Mage.
scripts.translation: 那麼，你為什麼要在宮廷當魔法師呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
For the stability and high income-
The palace has paid the tuition during my study in Eclage as well! How generous!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
為了穩定的工作和豐厚的收入——
而且我在埃克拉珠求學時，學費也是宮廷出的！真慷慨啊！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Ahem. Anyways, it has all been prepared.
Since the distortion appeared in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, I installed the gate there.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
咳。總之，一切都準備好了。
王室的過去記憶出現了扭曲，所以我在那裡設定了傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
From now on, you can ^4d4dffcome to the Past Memories of the Royal Family right away^000000, or...
Right. Let me give you the ^4d4dffmillion Nillem call ticket^000000.
My treat!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
從現在起，你可以^4d4dff直接前往王室的過去記憶^000000，或者...
對了，給你一張^4d4dff尼勒姆百萬召喚券^000000。
我請客！

scripts.text: The... Million Nillem call ticket?
scripts.translation: 那...尼勒姆百萬召喚券？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes. You can call me anytime via this Chamberlain here if you wan to see me!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
沒錯。想見我的話，隨時可以通過這位侍從長叫我過來！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll be here immediately like a flash of lightning-
Well, then, shall we get going?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我會像閃電一樣立刻趕到——
那麼，我們要出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go now!
scripts.translation: 現在就走！

scripts.text: I need to make some preparations.
scripts.translation: 我需要做一些準備

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, let me know when you are ready.
If I don't show up, come to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 right away.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
準備好之後告訴我。
如果我沒來，就直接前往^4d4dff王室的過去記憶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
You know how to get there.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你知道怎麼去的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, close your eyes...
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那就閉上眼睛...
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, then, let's go to the Past Memories of the Royal Family!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，那我們去王室的過去記憶吧！

scripts.text: Move to the Past Memories of the Royal Family
scripts.translation: 前往王室的過去記憶

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I like how you refuse so flatly
May I hang out here for a while since I am already here?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我就喜歡你這麼幹脆地拒絕。
反正我已經來了，可以在這兒待一會兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, close your eyes...
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那就閉上眼睛...
一！

scripts.text: I hear voices from somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我聽到某處傳來聲音。

scripts.text: I happen to eavesdrop on a fishy conversation.
scripts.translation: 我無意中聽到了一段可疑的對話。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I get to see you again. {0}.
Chamberlain must have been a great messenger.
I saw you coming this way right away.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
又見面了，{0}。
侍從長真是個出色的信使啊。
我一眼就看見你往這邊來了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was surprised when you were introduced as a special guest. You seem to be more extraordinary than I have thought.
You were introduced as...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
聽說你被介紹為特別嘉賓時，我很驚訝。你比我想像中還要出眾。
你被介紹成...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But it is true.
This banquet is for the heroes like you.
You should be proud.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過這確實是真的。
這場宴會就是為你這樣的英雄舉辦的。
你應該感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That's right!
No one will stop you from hanging out with us. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
沒錯！
沒人會阻止你和我們來往，記得常來玩。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Since there are only us around here, we can loosen up a little...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這裡只有我們，放鬆一點也無妨...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hahaha.... I'll make sure the words don't get out.
Did you hear, Crux?
My sister wants to hang out quietly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈...我會替你保密的。
克魯克斯，你聽見了嗎？
我妹妹想和大傢俬下聚聚呢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I mean, my ladies?
What do you mean by...?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我是說，兩位小姐？
您這是...？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You know that I am on your side, my lady, right?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
您知道我是站在您這邊的，女士，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, don't make me laugh.
I know you have come here to spy on us this time.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
噢，少逗我笑了。
我知道你這次是來監視我們的。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
No! No, please!
...Oh? Isn't that Lord Heine?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
不！不是的，請聽我解釋！
...咦？那不是海爾內家的領主嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, you are right? Nyhill! This way!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦，你說得對！尼希爾！這邊！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You don't have to scream like that, Skia.
{0} is here too.
Indeed, you won't be mistaken when you hang out with the people of the Nerius family.
Good decision.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，不用喊那麼大聲。
{0}也在這裡。
看來和內裡烏斯家族的人待在一起，確實不會認錯人。
你做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia and Lord of the Heine family.
Since when did you call each other by the first name?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞和海爾內家的領主。
你們什麼時候開始直呼彼此的名字了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum, we exchanged greetings earlier in the corridor.
The Heine residence is next to that of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯，我們剛才在走廊裡打過招呼。
海爾內家的宅邸就在內裡烏斯家族宅邸的旁邊。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
It was refreshing, and I am grateful to you.
And...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
剛才那感覺很新鮮，我很感激。
還有...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
{0}, I visited your room to give you my apology, but you had already left for the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}，我本想去你房間向你道歉，可你已經去了宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Earlier...
I was rude to you out of impulse.
Please forgive me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
剛才...
我一時衝動，對你無禮了。
請原諒我。

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Haha... Hahaha... Poor Lord Nyhill, what a pity.
He has not been selected as the heir to the throne...
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的女子]
哈哈...哈哈哈...可憐的尼希爾領主，真叫人惋惜。
他沒能被選為王位繼承人...

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Oh, well! Who are these?
Aren't they the Nerius sisters who are from that famous family led by a woman?
Lord, are you even going to ditch your own household for the Nerius family?
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的女子]
哎呀，這幾位是誰？
這不是那個由女性當家的名門望族——內裡烏斯家的姐妹嗎？
領主大人，您這是要拋下自己的家族，投奔內裡烏斯家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
I am not telling a lie. Am I?
You are not welcome in your own family anyway. Why don't you flirt with a lady here to change your life?
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
我可沒說謊，對吧？
反正你在自己家族裡也不受待見，不如和這裡的哪位小姐調調情，換個活法？
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Oh, my! My lord, I didn't know you could get angry.
That's right. You better get angry and show your emotions...
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
哎呀，領主大人，沒想到您也會生氣呢。
沒錯，您就該生氣，把情緒都表現出來...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
...I don't know which family you are from, but you need to strop.
If you keep insulting my lady, I won't let it pass.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
...我不知道您是哪家的，但請您適可而止。
若您繼續侮辱我家小姐，我絕不會坐視不管。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hold it, Crux.
You shouldn't regard me on the same level as the coarse thing who doesn't even know what she is talking about.
I don't tend to bear a grudge against the Heine family for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
克魯克斯，住手。
別把我和這個連自己在說什麼都不知道的粗俗之人相提並論。
我不會因此遷怒海爾內家族。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Isn't it right? Violeta Collette Heine?
I understand your feelings for the lord, but your behavior will just bring disgrace to your family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
是這樣嗎？薇奧萊塔·科萊特·海爾內？
我理解您對領主的情感，但您的行為只會給您的家族帶來恥辱。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You do what you please if you want to damage his reputation.
However, you should keep us, the Nerius family, out of the mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你要是想敗壞他的名聲，儘管去做。
但請別把我們內裡烏斯家族牽扯進來。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
That is true.
Violeta. I will let it slide this time. You should get back now.
Or, I'll have to punish you in the name of the family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
確實如此。
薇奧萊塔，這次我就不追究了。你現在回去吧。
否則，我只能以家族的名義懲罰你。

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Well, I'll get back.
Since things have turned out this way, you better go to join the Nerius family, then! He!
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
哼，那我走就是了。
既然如此，你乾脆加入內裡烏斯家族好了！哼！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
How does the story go that way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
事情怎麼會發展到這一步？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am sorry, I apologize for her bad manners.
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
抱歉，請原諒她的失禮。
...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
You keep saying sorry.
But you didn't do anything wrong, Nyhill.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你一直在道歉。
但你並沒有做錯什麼，尼希爾。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, Skia. You don't understand.
Whether willing or not, as the head of the family, every fault of the family becomes his burden.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞，你不明白。
無論願不願意，身為家主，家族的每一件錯事都得由他承擔。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
She is right. I bear the name of Heine, and I am in the position to take care of every matter which comes with the family.
Whether willing or not...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
她說得對。我揹負著海爾內之名，就有責任處理家族的一切事務。
無論我願不願意...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Skia, it is the same for you. You sometimes have to become a shadow yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，對你來說也是如此。有時候，你也必須成為一道影子。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
However, I didn't know you have been treated like that by the members of your own family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過，我沒想到你竟然被自己家族的成員這樣對待。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I must have interrupted the joy of the banquet. I should get going.
I hope we get to share more stories sometime.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我打擾大家享受宴會了，該告辭了。
希望以後有機會再和你們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Not at all. Let us give you the official invitation next time.
Please don't turn down then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
怎麼會呢。下次我們會正式邀請你。
到時候可別拒絕哦。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
How can I turn down the invitation from the next head of the Nerius family?
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我怎麼會拒絕內裡烏斯家族下一任家主的邀請呢？
那麼...回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Hum...
Umm...
Skia, can I take a look at the drink you got?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...嗯...
那個...
斯基亞，我能看看你拿的飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And, Crux.
Go dig out the Chamberlain who has given us the drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
還有，克魯克斯。
去把給我們倒酒的那位侍從長找出來。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
No one can fool my eyes like this.
{0}, you take a look too.
Doesn't something seem strange to you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
沒有人能這樣欺騙我的眼睛。
{0}，你也來看看。
你不覺得有什麼奇怪的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Well, you do seem to talk a little casually now...
scripts.translation: 嗯，你現在說話隨意多了...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not used to talk in the formal form.
I tried to be courteous to you since you are a special guest. But I'd rather bite my own tongue than keep talking that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不習慣用那種正式的語氣說話。
因為你是特別的客人，所以我試著對你客氣一點。但我寧願咬斷自己的舌頭，也不願繼續那樣說話。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, shaking. He is shaking!
Crux, did you see? Nyhill's steps shook.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦，他在搖晃！他在搖晃！
克魯克斯，你看見了嗎？尼希爾走路都搖搖晃晃的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The champagne is supposed to be as light as fruit juice.
He must have not been drunk on that.
I think there must be something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
那香檳明明淡得像果汁一樣。
他不可能是喝那酒喝醉的。
肯定有問題。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Don't you think something funny is about to happen now?
Oh, how suspicious.
Since it seems suspicious, let's get back now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
你不覺得要出什麼有趣的事了嗎？
哎呀，真可疑。
既然這麼可疑，我們就先回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Eh? Are you going off like that?
What if he is sick? What if he passes out on the way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
誒？就這樣走了嗎？
萬一他生病了怎麼辦？萬一他在路上暈倒怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If you are curious, you may follow him.
I am well taken care of by Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你好奇的話，可以跟上去看看。
有克魯克斯照看我就行。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, hero?
Would you follow him first?
If I follow him like this, everyone will find me strange.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
英雄，你願意先跟上去看看嗎？
要是我就這麼跟過去，大家會覺得很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I'll be after you quietly.
Spica never jokes about something like that.
There must be something.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會悄悄跟在你後面。
斯皮卡不會拿這種事開玩笑。
肯定有問題。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看來我別無選擇

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
尼希爾一定已經離開宴會廳了。
他應該是去了皇家別墅。我們往那邊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Iwine.
How are you enjoying the banquet?
I am a little nervous since it's my first time to attend a banquet like this...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
艾溫。
宴會玩得開心嗎？
我還是第一次參加這種宴會，有點緊張...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Not that I have never been to a banquet...
How can I explain?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
也不是說我從沒參加過宴會...
該怎麼說呢？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You don't have to explain.
It is just a family matter.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你不用解釋。
這只是家裡的事。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Right.
Please excuse my babbling.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
是啊。
抱歉我說了這麼多。
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I get to see you again. {0}.
Chamberlain must have been a great messenger.
I saw you coming this way right away.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
又見到您了，{0}。
看來大臣的傳話很有效。
我一眼就看到您朝這邊過來了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was surprised when you were introduced as a special guest. You seem to be more extraordinary than I have thought.
You were introduced as...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
聽說您是特別貴賓時，我很驚訝。您似乎比我想像中還要出色。
他們介紹您時說……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But it is true.
This banquet is for the heroes like you.
You should be proud.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過這確實是真的。
這場宴會就是為您這樣的英雄舉辦的。
您應該為此自豪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That's right!
No one will stop you from hanging out with us. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
沒錯！
沒有人會阻止您和我們來往。請常來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Since there are only us around here, we can loosen up a little...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這裡只有我們幾個人，倒是可以稍微放鬆一下……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hahaha.... I'll make sure the words don't get out.
Did you hear, Crux?
My sister wants to hang out quietly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈哈……我會替你保密的。
你聽到了嗎，克魯克斯？
我妹妹想安靜地和大家相處呢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I mean, my ladies?
What do you mean by...?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
您是說，兩位小姐？
這是什麼意思……？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You know that I am on your side, my lady, right?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
小姐，您知道我一直站在您這邊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, don't make me laugh.
I know you have come here to spy on us this time.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哦，別逗我笑了。
我知道你這次是來監視我們的。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
No! No, please!
...Oh? Isn't that Lord Heine?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
不！不是的，小姐！
……咦？那不是海爾內大人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, you are right? Nyhill! This way!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦，真的耶！尼希爾！這邊！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You don't have to scream like that, Skia.
{0} is here too.
Indeed, you won't be mistaken when you hang out with the people of the Nerius family.
Good decision.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，不用喊這麼大聲。
{0}也在這裡。
和內裡烏斯家族的人來往果然不會錯。
您做了個明智的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia and Lord of the Heine family.
Since when did you call each other by the first name?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞和海爾內家的大人。
你們什麼時候開始直呼彼此的名字了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum, we exchanged greetings earlier in the corridor.
The Heine residence is next to that of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯，我們剛才在走廊上打過招呼。
海爾內家的宅邸就在內裡烏斯家隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
It was refreshing, and I am grateful to you.
And...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那讓我耳目一新，我很感謝您。
還有……

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
{0}, I visited your room to give you my apology, but you had already left for the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}，我本想去您的房間向您道歉，但您已經前往宴會廳了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Earlier...
I was rude to you out of impulse.
Please forgive me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
之前……
我一時衝動，對您失禮了。
請原諒我。

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Haha... Hahaha... Poor Lord Nyhill, what a pity.
He has not been selected as the heir to the throne...
scripts.translation:
[醉酒的女人]
哈哈……哈哈哈……可憐的尼希爾大人，真令人惋惜。
他沒能被選為王位繼承人……

scripts.text:
[Drunk Woman]
Oh, well! Who are these?
Aren't they the Nerius sisters who are from that famous family led by a woman?
Lord, are you even going to ditch your own household for the Nerius family?
scripts.translation:
[醉酒的女人]
哎呀，這些人是誰？
她們不就是那個由女性領導的名門內裡烏斯家的姐妹嗎？
大人，您該不會要拋下自己的家族，投靠內裡烏斯家吧？

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
I am not telling a lie. Am I?
You are not welcome in your own family anyway. Why don't you flirt with a lady here to change your life?
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
我說的又不是假話，對吧？
反正你在自己家裡也不受歡迎，何不在這裡找位女士調情，改變一下人生？
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Oh, my! My lord, I didn't know you could get angry.
That's right. You better get angry and show your emotions...
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
哎呀！大人，真沒想到您也會生氣。
沒錯，就該生氣，把情緒都表現出來……

scripts.text:
[Crux]
...I don't know which family you are from, but you need to strop.
If you keep insulting my lady, I won't let it pass.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
……我不知道您來自哪個家族，但請您適可而止。
若您繼續侮辱我家小姐，我絕不會坐視不管。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hold it, Crux.
You shouldn't regard me on the same level as the coarse thing who doesn't even know what she is talking about.
I don't tend to bear a grudge against the Heine family for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
住手，克魯克斯。
別把我和這種連自己在說什麼都不知道的粗俗之人相提並論。
我不會因此遷怒海爾內家。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Isn't it right? Violeta Collette Heine?
I understand your feelings for the lord, but your behavior will just bring disgrace to your family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
您說是吧，薇奧萊塔·科萊特·海爾內？
我理解您對那位大人的感情，但您的行為只會給家族蒙羞。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You do what you please if you want to damage his reputation.
However, you should keep us, the Nerius family, out of the mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果您想損害他的名譽，儘管隨您。
不過請別把我們內裡烏斯家捲進這場鬧劇。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
That is true.
Violeta. I will let it slide this time. You should get back now.
Or, I'll have to punish you in the name of the family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
確實如此。
薇奧萊塔，這次我就不追究了。你現在回去吧。
否則我只能以家族的名義懲罰你。

scripts.text:
[Violeta]
Well, I'll get back.
Since things have turned out this way, you better go to join the Nerius family, then! He!
scripts.translation:
[薇奧萊塔]
好吧，我回去就是。
既然事情變成這樣，你最好乾脆加入內裡烏斯家吧！哼！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
How does the story go that way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
怎麼會變成這樣？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am sorry, I apologize for her bad manners.
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
很抱歉，她舉止失當，我代她向您道歉。
……

scripts.text:
[Skia]
You keep saying sorry.
But you didn't do anything wrong, Nyhill.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你一直在道歉。
可是你並沒有做錯什麼，尼希爾。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, Skia. You don't understand.
Whether willing or not, as the head of the family, every fault of the family becomes his burden.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞，你還不明白。
無論願不願意，身為家主，家族的一切過錯最終都會成為他的負擔。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
She is right. I bear the name of Heine, and I am in the position to take care of every matter which comes with the family.
Whether willing or not...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
她說得沒錯。我揹負著海爾內之名，也肩負著處理家族一切事務的責任。
無論願不願意……

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Skia, it is the same for you. You sometimes have to become a shadow yourself.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，你也一樣。有時你也必須親自成為影子。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
However, I didn't know you have been treated like that by the members of your own family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過我不知道你在自己的家族裡竟然受到這樣的對待。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I must have interrupted the joy of the banquet. I should get going.
I hope we get to share more stories sometime.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我一定打擾了宴會的興致，該告辭了。
希望以後還能和各位聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Not at all. Let us give you the official invitation next time.
Please don't turn down then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
完全沒有。下次我們會正式邀請您。
到時候請別拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
How can I turn down the invitation from the next head of the Nerius family?
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我怎麼會拒絕內裡烏斯家下一任家主的邀請呢？
那麼……告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Hum...
Umm...
Skia, can I take a look at the drink you got?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
……嗯……
那個……
斯基亞，我能看看你的飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And, Crux.
Go dig out the Chamberlain who has given us the drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
還有，克魯克斯。
去把給我們送飲料的大臣找出來。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
No one can fool my eyes like this.
{0}, you take a look too.
Doesn't something seem strange to you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
沒人能這樣騙過我的眼睛。
{0}，您也看看。
不覺得有什麼地方不對勁嗎？

scripts.text: Well, you do seem to talk a little casually now...
scripts.translation: 你現在說話確實隨意了些……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not used to talk in the formal form.
I tried to be courteous to you since you are a special guest. But I'd rather bite my own tongue than keep talking that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不習慣那種正式的說話方式。
因為您是特別貴賓，我才努力對您客氣些。不過要我一直那樣說話，還不如咬舌頭算了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, shaking. He is shaking!
Crux, did you see? Nyhill's steps shook.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
哦，他在發抖！他在發抖！
克魯克斯，你看到了嗎？尼希爾的腳步搖晃了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The champagne is supposed to be as light as fruit juice.
He must have not been drunk on that.
I think there must be something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
香檳本該像果汁一樣清淡。
他不可能是喝那個喝醉的。
我覺得一定有問題。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Don't you think something funny is about to happen now?
Oh, how suspicious.
Since it seems suspicious, let's get back now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
您不覺得好像要發生什麼有趣的事了嗎？
哎呀，真可疑。
既然這麼可疑，我們現在就回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Eh? Are you going off like that?
What if he is sick? What if he passes out on the way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦？就這樣走了嗎？
萬一他病了呢？萬一路上昏倒了怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If you are curious, you may follow him.
I am well taken care of by Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你好奇的話可以跟上去。
有克魯克斯照顧我就行。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, hero?
Would you follow him first?
If I follow him like this, everyone will find me strange.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
英雄大人，您能先跟上去看看嗎？
我這樣跟著他，大家會覺得我很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I'll be after you quietly.
Spica never jokes about something like that.
There must be something.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會悄悄跟在您後面。
斯皮卡從不開這種玩笑。
一定有問題。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看來我只能這麼做了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
尼希爾一定已經離開宴會廳了。
他應該是去了皇家別墅。我們往那邊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
尼希爾一定已經離開宴會廳了。
他應該去了王室別墅，我們也往那邊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Bad things seem to keep happening.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
壞事似乎接二連三地發生。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are here to enjoy the banquet, right?
Have you visit all other families?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你是來參加宴會的，對吧？
其他家族你都拜訪過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
It is almost impossible to meet them usually. What a great chance you have to be able to visit them officially.
They are even waiting for you...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
平時你很難見到他們，這次能正式拜訪，機會難得。
他們甚至已經在等你...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
What a successful debut to the society!
Do not miss the chance when you have it.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
多麼成功的社交首秀啊！
有機會就不要錯過。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You never know what would happen!
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你永遠不知道會發生什麼！

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I get to see you again. {0}.
Chamberlain must have been a great messenger.
I saw you coming this way right away.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
又見到您了，{0}。
看來大臣的傳話很有效。
我一眼就看到您朝這邊過來了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was surprised when you were introduced as a special guest. You seem to be more extraordinary than I have thought.
You were introduced as...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
聽說您是特別貴賓時，我很驚訝。您似乎比我想像中還要出色。
他們介紹您時說……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
But it is true.
This banquet is for the heroes like you.
You should be proud.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過這確實是真的。
這場宴會就是為您這樣的英雄舉辦的。
您應該為此自豪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That's right!
No one will stop you from hanging out with us. Please visit us often.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
沒錯！
沒有人會阻止您和我們來往。請常來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Since there are only us around here, we can loosen up a little...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
這裡只有我們幾個人，倒是可以稍微放鬆一下……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hahaha.... I'll make sure the words don't get out.
Did you hear, Crux?
My sister wants to hang out quietly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哈哈哈……我會替你保密的。
你聽到了嗎，克魯克斯？
我妹妹想安靜地和大家相處呢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I mean, my ladies?
What do you mean by...?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
您是說，兩位小姐？
這是什麼意思……？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You know that I am on your side, my lady, right?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
小姐，您知道我一直站在您這邊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, don't make me laugh.
I know you have come here to spy on us this time.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哦，別逗我笑了。
我知道你這次是來監視我們的。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
No! No, please!
...Oh? Isn't that Lord Heine?
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
不！不是的，小姐！
……咦？那不是海爾內大人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, you are right? Nyhill! This way!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦，真的耶！尼希爾！這邊！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You don't have to scream like that, Skia.
{0} is here too.
Indeed, you won't be mistaken when you hang out with the people of the Nerius family.
Good decision.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，不用喊這麼大聲。
{0}也在這裡。
和內裡烏斯家族的人來往果然不會錯。
您做了個明智的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia and Lord of the Heine family.
Since when did you call each other by the first name?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞和海爾內家的大人。
你們什麼時候開始直呼彼此的名字了？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum, we exchanged greetings earlier in the corridor.
The Heine residence is next to that of the Nerius family.
