scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，你也一樣。有時你也必須親自成為影子。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
However, I didn't know you have been treated like that by the members of your own family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過我不知道你在自己的家族裡竟然受到這樣的對待。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I must have interrupted the joy of the banquet. I should get going.
I hope we get to share more stories sometime.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我一定打擾了宴會的興致，該告辭了。
希望以後還能和各位聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Not at all. Let us give you the official invitation next time.
Please don't turn down then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
完全沒有。下次我們會正式邀請您。
到時候請別拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
How can I turn down the invitation from the next head of the Nerius family?
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我怎麼會拒絕內裡烏斯家下一任家主的邀請呢？
那麼……告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Hum...
Umm...
Skia, can I take a look at the drink you got?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
……嗯……
那個……
斯基亞，我能看看你的飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And, Crux.
Go dig out the Chamberlain who has given us the drink.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
還有，克魯克斯。
去把給我們送飲料的大臣找出來。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
No one can fool my eyes like this.
{0}, you take a look too.
Doesn't something seem strange to you?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
沒人能這樣騙過我的眼睛。
{0}，您也看看。
不覺得有什麼地方不對勁嗎？

scripts.text: Well, you do seem to talk a little casually now...
scripts.translation: 你現在說話確實隨意了些……

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not used to talk in the formal form.
I tried to be courteous to you since you are a special guest. But I'd rather bite my own tongue than keep talking that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不習慣那種正式的說話方式。
因為您是特別貴賓，我才努力對您客氣些。不過要我一直那樣說話，還不如咬舌頭算了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Oh, shaking. He is shaking!
Crux, did you see? Nyhill's steps shook.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
哦，他在發抖！他在發抖！
克魯克斯，你看到了嗎？尼希爾的腳步搖晃了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
The champagne is supposed to be as light as fruit juice.
He must have not been drunk on that.
I think there must be something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
香檳本該像果汁一樣清淡。
他不可能是喝那個喝醉的。
我覺得一定有問題。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}.
Don't you think something funny is about to happen now?
Oh, how suspicious.
Since it seems suspicious, let's get back now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}。
您不覺得好像要發生什麼有趣的事了嗎？
哎呀，真可疑。
既然這麼可疑，我們現在就回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Eh? Are you going off like that?
What if he is sick? What if he passes out on the way?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
咦？就這樣走了嗎？
萬一他病了呢？萬一路上昏倒了怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If you are curious, you may follow him.
I am well taken care of by Crux.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你好奇的話可以跟上去。
有克魯克斯照顧我就行。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, hero?
Would you follow him first?
If I follow him like this, everyone will find me strange.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
英雄大人，您能先跟上去看看嗎？
我這樣跟著他，大家會覺得我很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I'll be after you quietly.
Spica never jokes about something like that.
There must be something.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會悄悄跟在您後面。
斯皮卡從不開這種玩笑。
一定有問題。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看來我只能這麼做了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Nyhill must have left the Banquet Hall.
He must have headed to the Royal Villa. Let's go that way.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
尼希爾一定已經離開宴會廳了。
他應該去了王室別墅，我們也往那邊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Hum? You are still here. I thought you went after the lord from the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嗯？你還在這裡。我以為你去跟海爾內家的領主了。

scripts.text: Didn't you go back to your room?
scripts.translation: 你不是回房間了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I was just giving my sister a push in the back.
I was curious how Skia would react.
...Aren't you following him?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我只是在背後推了妹妹一把。
我很好奇斯基亞會有什麼反應。
...你沒跟上去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have a hunch that something big is about to happen.
You better go after the lord to make sure he is OK.
I have advised you as so, remember.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我總覺得要出大事了。
你最好跟上那位領主，看看他有沒有事。
我剛才已經提醒過你了，記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I don't like how things have been going these days.
...I guess I am about to stop holding it down.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我不喜歡最近發生的這些事。
...我想我快要忍不住了。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't mind me.
I am just a bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
別在意我。
我只是個保鏢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I get to see you again.
The lady has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
又見到你了。
女士一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I am thinking about the order given by the lady.
I need to be apart from her to look into it...
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我在琢磨小姐交代的事。
我得暫時離開她身邊去調查一下...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Frankly, it makes me feel uneasy leaving her alone.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
說實話，讓她一個人待著讓我很不安。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I am not a child, you know.
Or do I remind you of your daughter running along the river bank?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我又不是小孩子。
還是說，我讓你想起了在河岸邊跑來跑去的女兒？

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Daughter?
Hahaha. That is funny.
But you don't look your age to be honest.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
女兒？
哈哈，真有意思。
不過說實話，你看起來比實際年齡小。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
You can be attacked by the kids again.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
你隨時可能再次被那些孩子襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
He! Who can top you?
You shouldn't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
嘿！誰能比得過你？
你不用為我擔心。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
I guess we won't be able to return to the head house anytime soon.
Well, this actually could be a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
看來我們短時間內回不去主宅了。
嗯，這其實可能是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Who's there?
{0}...?
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...誰在那裡？
{0}...?
你怎麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Am I drunk?
My head hurts.
...I feel dizzy...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...我喝醉了嗎？
頭好痛。
...好暈...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...Oh... I felt tipsy and asked a chamberlain to guide me to somewhere I can take a rest.
......Umm...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...噢...我有點醉了，就讓侍從長帶我去能休息的地方。
...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
He told me it was light champagne...
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他說那是淡香檳...
...

scripts.text: Has anything happened to you?
scripts.translation: 你發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I don't remember.
I believe there was a guest here...
By the way, what brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我不記得了。
我記得這裡剛才有位客人...
對了，你怎麼會來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, it is almost the time, so...
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯，時間差不多了，所以...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I see. I guess all the preparation must have been made by now.
I will be damned if I waste more time here.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這樣啊。看來準備工作應該都完成了。
我可不能繼續在這裡浪費時間。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I should get back now.
Phew... Fortunately, my head is clearing up.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我該回去了。
呼...幸好頭腦清醒多了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Well, then. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那麼，失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Whoa! He is fast.
Well, hero. Shall we get back too?
I'll see you again soon though.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
哇！他動作真快。
好了，英雄，我們也該回去了吧？
我們很快會再見的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
The Court Mage must have arrived by now.
You should go back to your room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
宮廷魔法師應該已經到了。
你該回房間了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Do you want to take a look at the material?
It is still here since I haven't taken it away.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你想看看那份資料嗎？
我還沒收起來，它還在這裡。

scripts.text: The document is the royal record about the Room of Consciousness.
scripts.translation: 這份檔案是關於“意識之室”的皇家記錄。

scripts.text: There are several blank pages in-between.
scripts.translation: 中間有好幾頁是空白的。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Read the text written above.
Yes, it's here.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
讀一下上面的文字。
對，就是這裡。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^4d4dffOnly the ones who know the truth can read this.^000000
See?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
^4d4dff只有知曉真相的人才能讀懂這段文字。^000000
看到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Considering the time which has passed, there must be no one who knows this truth left now.
In other words, this part will remain a mystery forever.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
過了這麼久，如今應該已經沒有知曉這個真相的人了。
也就是說，這部分內容將永遠是個謎。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
That's why Archduke Stoltze gave up and left.
Since you have seen this, let me put this back in place.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
所以斯托爾茨大公才放棄並離開了。
既然你已經看過，我就把它放回原處。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Oh, you are here.
Archduke Grantz has been waiting for you for a while.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
噢，你來了。
格蘭茨大公已經等你一會兒了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
My family has been managing the Past Memories of the Royal Family for generations.
No wonder since it is the exclusive scriptorium for the royal family.
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
我的家族世代負責管理王室的“過去記憶”。
這裡是王室專用的抄寫室，難怪會由我們家族負責。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
It has not been long since I took over this position so I am not really that used to this.
I never expected to be visited by these many archdukes...
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
我接任這個職位還沒多久，所以還不太熟悉。
沒想到會有這麼多大公爵來訪...

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff這是紀念活動。
只有隊長才能進行紀念活動。請先組隊再試。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, did you see? We are the last ones entering.
Others must have entered already.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，你看到了嗎？我們是最後進來的。
其他人應該已經進去了。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 現在進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，來得太晚也不行啊...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum? I don't know what is going on. We don't seem to be able to enter now.
It is a secret area which is made to open upon showing magical power.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯？我也不清楚怎麼回事。我們現在似乎進不去了。
這是個秘密區域，必須展現魔力才能開啟。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's wait until it stabilizes.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等它穩定下來再說吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下一個區域的門已經開啟了！
好了，我們進去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Has anything happened in there?
What on earth...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
裡面出什麼事了嗎？
到底怎麼回事...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It is nothing that I should know and nowhere I should be part of. But still, I am curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這不是我該知道的事，也不是我該參與的地方。但即便如此，我還是很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
The movement of magical flow seems peculiar.
...I wonder if it is my imagination that the gate looks unstable.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
魔力流動似乎有些異常。
...這扇門看起來不太穩定，難道是我的錯覺？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, this is troublesome.
There seems to be a problem with the gate now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎呀，真麻煩。
這扇門現在似乎出了點問題。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Use of magic is restricted in this area. All I can do is to activate the gate here...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這個區域限制使用魔法。我能做的只有啟動這裡的門...

scripts.text: Where you are going with this...
scripts.translation: 你打算拿這個做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, I mean...
You should get out here on foot.
Well, since things have turned out this way.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，我的意思是...
你得從這裡步行出去。
事已至此，也只能這樣了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffHere is the material what the archduke has seen earlier.^000000
{0}, why don't you take a look too?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff這是大公剛才看過的資料。^000000
{0}，你也看看吧？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, not that I am curious about it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，也不是說我對它有多好奇。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Just out of curiosity.... No, I mean ardor for study. Haha...
...Yes? Let's take a look... Make sure to share what is in there with me-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我只是好奇...不，我是說，出於求知慾。哈哈...
...是嗎？那就看看吧...看完記得告訴我裡面寫了什麼-

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你不好奇嗎？
你現在和大公在這裡，圖書管理員肯定會給你看的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我會想辦法重新啟用這扇門的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't you curious?
Since you are out here with the archduke, the librarian would show it to you with no doubt, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你不覺得好奇嗎？
既然你和大公在一起，圖書管理員肯定會把它展示給你的，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I'll try to find a way to reactivate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我會想辦法重新啟用這扇門的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
...Oh well. ^4d4dffOnly open to the ones who know the truth^000000...
Argh, what a waste.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...算了。^4d4dff只有知曉真相的人才能開啟^000000...
唉，真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, it is no use to stick around here.
I could cut the air with a knife earlier. Let's get out now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
繼續待在這裡也沒用。
剛才的氣氛簡直劍拔弩張。我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I took a look at the gate.
Has there been a big explosion of magic inside before?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我檢查了一下這扇門。
剛才裡面是不是發生過大規模的魔力爆發？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I sense some sort of magical distortion, which is similar to...
The ^4d4dffCrack of Dimension^000000!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我感覺到一種魔力扭曲，和...
^4d4dff次元裂縫^000000很像！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we make a gate of dimension here?
That would be fun too.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們能在這裡開個次元之門嗎？
聽起來也挺有意思。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Right.
Since the gate has become useless...
Let's walk out of here.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
對了。
既然這扇門已經沒用了...
我們走出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the crusader there?
He manages the entrance.
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到那邊的十字軍了嗎？
他負責管理入口。
他會帶你出去。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Although there are direct gates installed in the palace for convenience,
There are passages you can walk directly in.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
雖然宮殿裡設定了直達傳送門，方便大家通行，
但也有可以步行通過的通道。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is one of the rare chances to use the secret passage.
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
能用上秘密通道的機會可不多。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, shall I get ready?
Come here! ^4d4dffDimension Warper MkII^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，準備好了嗎？
過來吧！^4d4dff次元傳送器 MkII^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, let's go, dear customer.
I wonder what we are going to see this time!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，親愛的顧客，我們出發吧。
真想知道這次會看到什麼！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We haven't solved all the secrets yet!
Well, we have to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
謎團還沒解開呢！
好了，我們該回去了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's finish it off this time!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這次就把事情徹底解決！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing?
Go grill the librarian to dig out the truth!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你還愣著幹什麼？
快去追問圖書管理員，把真相問出來！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What did we go through all the trouble for?
Look, there is Archduke Grantz.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們費了這麼大勁是為了什麼？
看，格蘭茨大公在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffThe Heine family will get the approval to enter the 'Past Memories of the Royal Family'^000000, right?
We will see each other more often from now on then.
Haha, this must be what others call the destiny-¡?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff海爾內家族會獲准進入“王室的過去記憶”^000000，對吧？
以後我們就能經常見面了。
哈哈，這大概就是別人說的命運吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing?
Let's go see ^4d4dffDuke Friedrich to check if the approval has been issued!^000000
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你還愣著幹什麼？
我們去找^4d4dff弗里德里希公爵，確認許可是否已經簽發！^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Today, we are going on a secret journey together again!
Hahaha. You'd better get excited!
I'll let you travel in the first class!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
今天我們又要一起秘密旅行了！
哈哈哈，期待一下吧！
我會讓你坐頭等艙！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, let's go, dear customer.
What would be waiting for us today?
I guess this would end up a failure again, though.
Hahaha-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，親愛的顧客，我們出發吧。
今天有什麼在等著我們呢？
不過我猜這次大概又會失敗。
哈哈哈——

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有隊長才能進入副本「祝福儀式」。^000000

scripts.text: You can move to where the ritual of blessing is held.
scripts.translation: 可以前往舉行祝福儀式的地點。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... This gate is only activated temporarily so that it doesn't last long.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯...這扇門只能暫時開啟，維持不了多久。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Ritual of Blessing].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有隊伍首領才能進入MD [祝福儀式]。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, well, the movement of magic seems uneasy.
Hum, shall we try again later?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
唉，魔力流動似乎不太穩定。
嗯，要不要過會兒再試？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
The gate to the place where the ritual is held is not activated officially.
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
通往儀式舉行地點的門還沒有正式啟動。
請稍等。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThis is an event proceeding through memorial.
Only the party leader can enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff這是紀念副本。
只有隊長才能進入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Would you go out through the passage?
There is another overwatcher where I am about to send you.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
要從這條通道出去嗎？
我將送你去的地方還有另一位守望者。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Don't be surprised and you may go out with his help.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
別驚訝，之後可以在他的幫助下離開。

scripts.text: Go out now.
scripts.translation: 現在出去

scripts.text: Go out later.
scripts.translation: 稍後出去

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
I will send you anytime when you need it.
Just don't waste too much time here.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
你需要時，我隨時可以送你出去。
不過別在這裡逗留太久。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Let's me guide you right away,
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
我這就帶你過去。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Did you find out anything?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
有什麼發現嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him what you have seen.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你看到了什麼

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
...........Did such thing happen?
There has been a record of the disaster in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
...竟然發生了這種事？
普隆德拉有關於那場災難的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I didn't know that the Imir Heart in the Room of Consciousness was stolen by the Valkyrie!
Why wasn't such a thing recorded?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我竟不知道瓦爾基里偷走了意識之室裡的伊米爾之心！
為什麼這件事沒有記錄下來？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Can you read the document now then?
If what you have seen is true, the seal would be broken.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那你現在能讀懂這份檔案了嗎？
如果你看到的屬實，封印應該已經解開了。

scripts.text:
When you touch the blank page of the book Kronecker has given you,
The text shows up with a glow.
scripts.translation: 當你觸碰克羅內克給你的書頁時，空白頁上泛起光芒，文字隨之顯現。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff......
Due to the battle of the Valkyrie, the Imir Heart sealed in the Room of Consciousness disappeared.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff...
瓦爾基里之戰後，封存在意識之室裡的伊米爾之心不知所蹤。

scripts.text:
I was terrified that the symbol of legitimacy held by the royal family had been gone.
I am afraid that we wouldn't be able to see the light of Terra Gloria in the coronation.
scripts.translation:
王室所持有的正統象徵竟然消失了，我深感恐懼。
我擔心加冕時，泰拉格洛麗亞將無法綻放光芒。

scripts.text:
The problem would occur from the next coronation.
The people of the kingdom will be disheartened and worried about their future if the blessing of the earth is not given to the crowning of the king.
scripts.translation:
問題會從下一次加冕典禮開始。
如果國王加冕時得不到大地的祝福，王國人民必定會灰心喪氣，對未來憂心忡忡。

scripts.text:
I consulted Varmunt the Great Sage about this.
He told me he could help and installed something in the Room of Consciousness.
scripts.translation:
我就此事諮詢了大賢者瓦爾蒙特。
他說可以幫忙，便在意識之室裡安裝了某種裝置。

scripts.text:
I was surprised to see what was installed there reacting with Terra Gloria.
It delivered enough magical power to Terra Gloria's Star of Blessing,
scripts.translation:
我驚訝地發現，那裡的裝置竟與泰拉格洛麗亞產生了共鳴。
它向泰拉格洛麗亞的賜福之星輸送了足夠的魔力，

scripts.text: And Terra Gloria could give the blessing of the earth as usual.
scripts.translation: 於是泰拉格洛麗亞得以照常賜予大地祝福。

scripts.text:
Everything was all right.
Even if it was by the fake Imir Heart.
scripts.translation:
一切都順利解決了。
儘管那顆伊米爾之心是假的。

scripts.text:
Terra Gloria, our beautiful crown.
In the blessed crown, there remained a piece of Imir Heart which has been guarding Prontera for generations.
scripts.translation:
泰拉格洛麗亞，我們美麗的王冠。
這頂受祝福的王冠中，留存著一片伊米爾之心，世世代代守護著普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
It is enough.
It would be enough for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
這樣就足夠了。
對我們的後代而言，這也足夠了。

scripts.text:
Therefore, I wish no one else ever read this record,
And seal it with a condition which cannot be met.
scripts.translation:
因此，我不希望這份記錄再被其他人讀到，
便以一個無法達成的條件將它封印。

scripts.text:
If one of our descendants happen to read this record,
Make sure to guard Terra Gloria.
It is the last piece of Imir Heart left to us.^000000
scripts.translation:
如果我們的後代中有人讀到了這份記錄，
請務必守護泰拉格洛麗亞。
這是留給我們的最後一片伊米爾之心。^000000

scripts.text: That's it...
scripts.translation: ...就是這些

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Am I going to be killed now?
I think I have just found out all the secrets of the royal family.
Aren't you going to execute me?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我現在就要被滅口了嗎？
我想自己剛剛聽到了王室的所有秘密。
你們不打算處決我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
..............Hum...
If you want, I will fulfill your wish.
But not now.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
...嗯...
你若執意如此，我會滿足你的願望。
不過不是現在。

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
Then... How about me?
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
那...我呢？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
If you say another word, I'll hang you with my own hands.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
如果你再多說一個字，我就親手把你吊死。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am surprised.
It means that we can bring a ^4d4dfffake Imir Heart^000000 or
The real piece of Imir Heart to replace what has been destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
真令人吃驚。
這意味著我們可以拿^4d4dff偽造的伊米爾之心^000000，
或真正的伊米爾之心碎片，替換掉被毀壞的部分。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The real problem is Terra Gloria...
It has been one of a kind to begin with.
Since it was made by crafting a small piece fallen from the heart...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
真正棘手的是泰拉格洛麗亞...
它本就是獨一無二的存在。
畢竟它是用從伊米爾之心上脫落的一小片碎片製成的...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Should we negotiate with the cooperation in Schwarzwald?
Wait a minute.
.....
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們要不要和施瓦茨瓦爾特的合作方協商？
等等。
...

scripts.text: What should I do now?
scripts.translation: 我現在該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am sorry to keep you waiting while I collect my thoughts.
Thank you for your work.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
抱歉讓你久等，我得整理一下思緒。
謝謝你的協助。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
May I ask you a favor?
Would you keep on visiting that place with Nillem?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
可以請你幫個忙嗎？
請繼續和尼勒姆一起去那個地方。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Although we are going to discuss about it in the official meeting, I don't think the result would be different.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
雖然我們會在正式會議上討論此事，但我想結果不會有變。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Please guard Imir Heart there or bring it to us!
We don't keep our hope too high, but it would worth the try, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
請守護那裡的伊米爾之心，或者把它帶回來！
我們不敢抱太大希望，但總值得一試，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Please.
I'll get the approval for you to visit the Past Memories of the Royal Family everyday.
Please get the task from Frietz... I mean Friedrich.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
拜託了。
我會批准你每天前往王室的過去記憶。
請去找弗里德里希領任務...我是說，弗里德里希。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is a shame, but you are the only hope left for us.
We are counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
很遺憾，你是我們僅存的希望了。
拜託你了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffFrom now on, you can get daily quests related to the past Room of Consciousness from Friedrich Stoltze.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff從現在起，你可以向弗里德里希·施托爾策領取與過去的意識之室有關的每日任務。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kronecker G. Heine]
Then, I'll entrust the matter regarding this place to you and Nillem.
For the sake of the royal family's legitimacy...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克·G·海涅]
那麼，這裡的事情就交給你和尼勒姆了。
為了維護王室的正統性...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker G. Heine]
Please carry out this mission in secret.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克·G·海涅]
請秘密執行這項任務。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
We have been waiting for you because...
We wonder ^4d4dffif you have ever told anyone about the ritual^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
我們一直在等你...
想確認你^4d4dff有沒有把儀式的事告訴別人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Only few people know about the Past Memories of the Royal Family and the Ritual of Blessing...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
知道王室的過去記憶和祝福儀式的人寥寥無幾...

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You need to make it more clear.
Just say it.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
把話說清楚點。
直說吧。

scripts.text: Am I a suspect here?
scripts.translation: 我是這裡的嫌疑人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Ah, it is....
That you are the only outsider who know about it, and there has been no precedent...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
啊，是這樣...
你是唯一知曉此事的外人，而且之前從未發生過這種情況...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I don't believe so.
The hero doesn't even know the existence of the Past Memories of the Royal Family and where it is.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我不這麼認為。
那位英雄甚至不知道王室的過去記憶，更不知道它在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
We only have told to observe the ritual after the Royal Assembly is completed.
Never mentioned about where it would be held or how.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們只聽說王室集會結束後要去觀禮。
沒人提過儀式在哪裡舉行，也沒說具體流程。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I understand how upset you all are due to this sudden incident.
But, please don't suspect an innocent person.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我理解這起突發事件讓大家很不安。
但請不要懷疑無辜的人。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
That must be...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那一定是...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
How troublesome.
Have you seen this document before?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
真麻煩。
你以前見過這份檔案嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
What is it?
We are in the middle of something important.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
怎麼了？
我們正忙著處理要緊事。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
No matter is more important than this!
It has already happened. We need to prepare for the future.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
沒有什麼比這更重要！
事情已經發生，我們得為以後做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
However, ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is gone...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
可是，^4d4dff泰拉格洛麗亞^000000不見了...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It disappeared when we were taking care of fallen Peter.
I guess those intruders must have taken it during the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們照料受傷的彼得時，它就不見了。
那些入侵者大概是在爆炸時把它拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And about the Star of Blessing... They said...
It was ^4d4dfffake^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
還有賜福之星...他們說...
那是^4d4dff假的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It must refer to the piece of Imir Heart.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那應該是指伊米爾之心的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am sorry to interrupt but I have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
抱歉打斷一下，我有件事要告訴你們。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...It is important. I was about to tell you about the cause of all these.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...這件事很重要。我正想告訴你們這一切的起因。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
The cause of the incident?
You mean you know who have told the secret?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
這起事件的起因？
你是說，你知道是誰洩露了秘密？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
The one who told about the ritual...
Was me.
...So...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
洩露儀式訊息的人...
是我。
...所以...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Please punish me for my fault.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
請懲罰我，讓我為自己的過錯負責。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What are you talking about? Nyhill!
Why did you...!
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
你在說什麼？尼希爾！
你為什麼要...！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe it was me.
I have this piece of memory talking to someone while I was drunk.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我想應該是我。
我記得自己喝醉後和某人說過話。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I believe it is how the story got out.
I am deeply ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
訊息大概就是這樣洩露出去的。
我深感羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Oh my... Was it the lord of the Heine family...
Although us, the Walther family did not attend the Royal Assembly, we won't sit back and watch this matter!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
天哪...是海爾內家的領主嗎...
沃爾特家雖然沒有參加王室集會，但絕不會對此袖手旁觀！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ha, I have heard what people say about you. You really don't seem to be able to do anything right.
Why did you do such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
哼，我聽過別人怎麼議論你。你果然什麼事都辦不好。
為什麼要做這種事？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Did you want to be a king so badly?
Peter is a member of your own family!
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你就這麼想當國王嗎？
彼得可是你的族人！

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
........Phew...
It is not that...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...呼...
不是那樣的...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Speak for yourself.
I need to know how useless you are.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
你只代表你自己。
我倒想看看你究竟有多無能。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have nothing to say about it.
However...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
對此我無話可說。
不過...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I am a Heine, one of the seven royal families of Rune-Midgarts.
I didn't do such a thing on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我是海爾內家族的一員，也是盧恩·米德加茲七大王族之一。
我並非有意做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Are you sure that you didn't do it to avenge for losing your position as a candidate for the throne?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你確定自己不是因為失去王位候選資格，才故意報復嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have told you that it isn't true!
..........
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我已經說過那不是真的！
...

scripts.text: Wait, may I interrupt?
scripts.translation: 請允許我插句話

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Please, do so. I am sorry about my bad manners earlier.
...Do you know anything about this, dear guest?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
請說。剛才是我失禮了。
...這位貴客，您知道事情的經過嗎？

scripts.text: Tell them about the thing happened in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation: 把宴會廳裡發生的事告訴他們

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
...Did such thing happen?
A person who looks like a scientist and drug...
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
...真的發生過這種事？
一個像科學家的傢伙，還有藥物...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If it is true, Lord Heine must have not done such a thing on purpose.
Someone must have taken advantage on him according to a plot...
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果此事屬實，海爾內領主肯定不是故意的。
一定是有人設局利用了他...

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Do you have a proof?
You didn't just come up with the story to help him out, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你有證據嗎？
你不是為了替他開脫才編出這套說辭吧？

scripts.text: Lady Nerius will testify...
scripts.translation: 內裡烏斯小姐會作證...

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
...Hum... The ladies of the Nerius family have seen it too?
We need to call for a meeting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
...嗯...內裡烏斯家的小姐們也親眼看到了？
我們得召集大家開會。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Hey, Grantz. What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
格蘭茨，你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Even if it was true, he still has acted so carelessly.
I cannot let it slide.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
就算事情屬實，他也太過輕率。
我不能就這樣算了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is difficult for me to say, but it could have been deemed as a treason.
What a shame. I have nothing to say about it.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
雖不願這麼說，但這可能會被視為叛國。
真遺憾，我無話可說。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
This has brought disgrace to the name of Heine.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
這讓海爾內家族蒙羞了。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Nyhill, you sentence you to disciplinary confinement for a while.
You shouldn't contact with anyone other than the ones you must see.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
尼希爾，現判你禁閉一段時間。
除了必要接觸的人，不得與任何人來往。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And about disappeared ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000
And destroyed Star of Blessing, we need to come up with a solution.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
至於失蹤的^4d4dff泰拉格洛麗亞^000000，
以及被毀的賜福之星，我們必須想辦法處理。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
It will be a long discussion.
Let me convene a meeting right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
這事恐怕要談很久。
我馬上召集會議。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
那我們回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Ian Walther]
Let me fill you in with the details after proceeding with a discussion with my family.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·沃爾特]
等我和家族商議完，再把詳情告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Wait, it is not ready yet.
Do not touch that.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等等，還沒準備好。
別碰那個。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let me connect the gap in the dimension by force.
The gap might be invisible, but it still is a crack.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
讓我強行接上次元裂隙。
裂隙或許看不見，但它確實存在。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It will be connected to the time when a big event has taken place.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
它會連線到重大事件發生的那個時刻。
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: I am ready!
scripts.translation: 我準備好了！

scripts.text: I am not ready!
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, don't be such a drag.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，別磨磨蹭蹭的。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, sweet dreams!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那麼，祝你做個好夢！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, we did it.
I don't know when, but it is the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哦，成功了。
我不知道這是哪個年代，但這裡就是^4d4dff王室的過去記憶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, I have to give it a twist to get to the place we want to go.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
不過要去我們想去的地方，還得稍微調整一下。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can I?
Hahaha, of course I can!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我能做到嗎？
哈哈，當然能！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It is the first time for me to do this.
But let me twist the dimension like this.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我還是第一次這麼做。
就這樣扭轉維度吧。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Connect the spaces by force!
Well, let's see what has happened here.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
強行連線空間！
好了，看看這裡發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Are you ready?
Talk to me when you are ready-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
準備好了嗎？
準備好了就來找我——

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff這是紀念活動。
只有隊長才能進行紀念活動。請先組隊再試。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then let's go and take a look what has happened in the Room of Consciousness.
Since I am connecting the twisted time and space once more by force,
I may have to use my full power to maintain this!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們去看看意識之室發生了什麼吧。
我現在要再次強行連線扭曲的時空，
可能得使出全力才能維持住！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Please, come back alive and well-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
一定要平安回來——

scripts.text: Connect now.
scripts.translation: 立即連線

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，來得太晚也不行啊...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh... It doesn't work well.
Wait, phew... Let me collect my strength again...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
噢...不太順利。
等等，呼...讓我再積蓄一下力量...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
... I'll make it work, wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...我會讓它成功的，稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下一個區域的門已經開啟了！
好了，我們進去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
You are here now!
This place has been chaotic since you were gone.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你回來了！
你不在的時候，這裡一直亂成一團。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the exit over there?
Haha, that gate leads to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你看到那邊的出口了嗎？
哈哈，那扇門通往普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
And...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
還有...

scripts.text: Then?
scripts.translation: 然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Prontera is being destroyed by the undead army-!
Right now! It is just a hot mess out there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
普隆德拉正遭到亡靈大軍襲擊——！
就是現在！外面亂成一團了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I mean, why don't we go to watch the unknown past of Prontera,
Since we are already here?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
既然我們都到這裡了，何不去看看普隆德拉那段不為人知的過去？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have been digging around a little, and I guess we can come here anytime when we want...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我稍微調查了一下，感覺我們以後想來隨時都能來...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, this could be one of the parallel worlds, but we have nothing to lose anyway.
Why don't we go take a look?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，這裡也可能是某個平行世界，不過反正我們也沒什麼損失。
要不要去看看？

scripts.text: If you insist.
scripts.translation: 如果你堅持的話

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I knew you would! I have been right about you!
What are you waiting for! Let's go out there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我就知道你會答應！我果然沒看錯你！
還等什麼？快出去看看！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Aren't we heading out?
Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
還不出發嗎？
走吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，要不要現在整理一下思路？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意識之室裡原本放著的東西^000000應該是...
嗯，這肯定和現在^4d4dff襲擊普隆德拉的亡靈大軍^000000有關。
它肯定是^4d4dff被他們帶走了^000000，沒錯吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 沒錯

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們能阻止這件事嗎？
或者把它帶走？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我想上級會命令我們這麼做。
無論如何都要想辦法辦到。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也許吧，不過這只是我的猜測。
意識之室裡的東西被拿走了，對吧？
可王室的人似乎一直在不知情的情況下舉行儀式。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他們肯定做了什麼，或者那東西已經回來了...
這或許符合解讀^4d4dff王室的過去記憶^000000封印內容的條件...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是說，只有知曉真相的人才能讀？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
沒錯。如果這就是解開封印的關鍵真相，
那我們就帶回了一條重要情報。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們既沒保護住，也沒帶走那樣東西...
但我們已經知道真相了。這樣就能解開檔案的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
王室的秘密逐漸揭開，我們也能拼出缺失的線索。
哈哈哈，而你就是這一切的關鍵人物，親愛的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 別叫我親愛的！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
怎麼了？
反正從今以後我們天天見面，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，我們回去吧？
我們這次的任務暫時完成了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
回去吧！
在不屬於我們這個時代的地方待太久，可沒什麼好處。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，準備好！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hahaha, I like this place now.
My darling, what do you want me to do now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈哈，我現在喜歡上這裡了。
親愛的，接下來想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text: Connect to the Room of Consciousness
scripts.translation: 連線意識室

scripts.text: Return
scripts.translation: 返回

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As you wish!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
如你所願！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Did you get the mission from the Heine family?
It doesn't seem like it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你從海爾內家族接到任務了嗎？
看起來還沒有。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hey, this really is hard work!
Let's go there when we are on a mission, OK?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎，這活兒可真累！
等有任務的時候再去那邊，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you see the dark circles under my eyes?
I'll do whatever you like to do, but!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
看到我眼下的黑眼圈了嗎？
你想做什麼我都可以陪你，不過...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is too much.
We cannot change the past event too much.
Those people must have learned it by now.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這也太過分了。
我們不能過度改變過去發生的事。
他們現在應該已經知道了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, I guess it would be no use explaining it...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，我看解釋也沒什麼用了...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It would have been better if they didn't know about it at all.
This may end up another torture for them, tut tut...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
要是他們從一開始就不知道就好了。
這恐怕又會成為他們的折磨，嘖嘖...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Therefore, since I am a dedicated public official!
I open the gate when there is a mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
所以，身為盡職的公務員！
只要有任務，我就會開啟傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Why?
Because I am tired-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
為什麼？
因為我累了——

scripts.text:
^4d4dffIt is an event which proceeds as a memorial.
Only the party leader can proceed with a memorial event. Try again after forming a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff這是紀念活動。
只有隊長才能進行紀念活動。請先組隊再試。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then let's go and take a look what has happened in the Room of Consciousness.
Since I am connecting the twisted time and space once more by force,
I may have to use my full power to maintain this!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們去看看意識之室發生了什麼吧。
我現在要再次強行連線扭曲的時空，
可能得使出全力才能維持住！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Please, come back alive and well-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
一定要平安回來——

scripts.text: Connect now.
scripts.translation: 立即連線

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha, it is not good either when it is too late...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈，來得太晚也不行啊...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh... It doesn't work well.
Wait, phew... Let me collect my strength again...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
噢...不太順利。
等等，呼...讓我再積蓄一下力量...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
... I'll make it work, wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
...我會讓它成功的，稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa! The gate to the next area has been activated!
Well, let's get in there!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇！通往下個區域的門開啟了！
好了，我們進去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Ha, since our work here is done, you shall go and report to Archduke Stoltze, right?
Ha, ha, this it for today-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈，我們在這裡的工作已經完成了，你該去向斯托爾茨大公彙報，對吧？
哈哈，今天就到這裡——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Phew, it was difficult to maintain it. It was very difficult.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
呼，維持這東西真不容易。太費勁了。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... I am afraid it would be difficult.
Even for a genius magician like yours truly, there is a certain limit. I am a human after all.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯...恐怕不行。
就算是我這樣天才的魔法師，也有做不到的事。畢竟我也是人。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Connecting multiple dimensions is not as easy as it sounds.
Please cut me some slack!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
連線多個次元可不像說起來那麼簡單。
多體諒一下嘛！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let me do this when the raging magical flow is stabilized-????
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
等狂暴的魔力流穩定下來，我再試著做——？？？？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum... Shall I clear the surroundings a little?
Wait, I'll get ready.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯...要不要先清理一下週圍？
等等，我準備一下。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
It won't take long. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
不會花太久，請稍等。

scripts.text:
The uneasy flow of magical power can be sensed near the twisted space.
The gap connected by force disappeared after serving its duty.
scripts.translation:
扭曲空間附近能感覺到魔力流動不穩。
強行連線的裂隙完成使命後便消失了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Room of Consciousness].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有隊長才能進入副本「意識之室」。^000000

scripts.text: You can move to the place where the piece of Ymir Heart was in the past.
scripts.translation: 可以前往過去伊米爾之心碎片所在之處。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要進入

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum, I have just torn and connected these spaces by force.
Such thing is possible since I am a genius!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，我剛才強行撕開並連線了這些空間。
因為我是天才，這種事當然辦得到！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can enter MD [Room of Consciousness].^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有隊伍隊長才能進入MD [意識之室]。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, well, the movement of magic seems uneasy.
Hum, shall we try again later?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎，魔力流動似乎不太穩定。
嗯，要不要過會兒再試？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Hum, is it too difficult to connect it by force?
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
嗯，強行連線是不是太難了？
請稍等。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThis is an event proceeding through memorial.
Only the party leader can enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff這是紀念副本。
只有隊長才能進入。^000000

scripts.text: More than a half of this document is edited in black.
scripts.translation: 這份檔案超過一半都被塗黑了。

scripts.text: Keep reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text:

Suspect: ����(Prisoner No.: 243AD265)

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
Hey, you! I have been looking for you!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
喂，就是你！我一直在找你！
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
主廚一直在等你。他現在火冒三丈！
快去廚房！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
主廚一直在等你。他現在火冒三丈！
快去廚房！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
我忙得團團轉！
最近見的人太多，連熟面孔都快認不出來了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am sorry about the misunderstanding.
I have been badgered by the Head Chef too much... Haha...
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
抱歉讓你誤會了。
主廚最近把我催得太緊了...哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
I am living in a whirl of business!
I have been seeing too many people these days that I am even confused about the familiar faces now.
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師]
我忙得團團轉！
最近見的人太多，連熟面孔都快認不出來了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
Hey, you! I have been looking for you!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[皇家廚師]
喂，你！我一直在找你！
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef]
The Head Chef has been waiting for you. He is enraged now!
Go to the kitchen now!
scripts.translation:
[皇家廚師]
主廚一直在等你，現在已經大發雷霆了！
快去廚房！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊！
那位特別助廚什麼時候才來？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
When will this special's assistant chef arrive here?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊！
那位特別助廚什麼時候才來？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Of course!
The food for the banquet is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
當然！
宴會的菜餚堪稱完美！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
More!
More!
More!
Much more!
I want to satisfy the guests!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
還要！
還要！
還要！
多得多！
我要讓客人們盡興！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I can't just let go of the banquet of my life this fabulously!
It should be more fabulous!
No, much more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
人生中這麼盛大的宴會，我可不能就此滿足！
還要更盛大！
不，要盛大得多！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Hum...
I won't be satisfied if it was not miraculously luxurious and superlatively fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
嗯...
不做到極盡奢華、無比華麗，我可不會滿意！

scripts.text:
[Royal Chef Apprentice[Royal Chef]
Head Chef!
We have a guest for you, Head Chef...
scripts.translation:
[御用廚師學徒]
主廚！
有位客人來找您...

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You are late!
How can you be so late when we don't even have a second to spare!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你來晚了！
我們一秒鐘都耽擱不起，你怎麼能遲到！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I would have placed you in the Poring Range for a week!
But today is a special day. So I'll punish you later!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我本來該把你關進波利牧場一週！
不過今天情況特殊，懲罰先記著！

scripts.text: Ask about the situation.
scripts.translation: 詢問情況

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
It is not the most important thing now!
Let's stop talking and make the banquet more fabulous!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在這不是最要緊的！
別說廢話了，讓宴會變得更盛大！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Go to the empty spot and get prepared to cook!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
去空著的料理臺，準備開始烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Once you prepare a piece of Griffon meat... You need to pour the sauce... What?
The sauce... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
先準備一塊獅鷲肉...然後淋上醬汁...什麼？
醬汁...咦？

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Wait a minute!
The sauce is gone! Unbelievable!
We cannot do anything without the sauce!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
等一下！
醬汁不見了！怎麼會這樣！
沒有醬汁就什麼也做不了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
You! The new assistant!
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
你！新來的助廚！
去找醬汁大師東方牡蠣，把醬汁拿來！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在！快！
快點！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Isn't the sauce ready?
Go get the sauce from Oriental Oyster the sauce master!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
醬汁還沒拿來嗎？
去找醬汁大師東方牡蠣，把醬汁拿來！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now! Quick!
Hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在！快！
快點！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Oh!
This exquisite taste made by the master!
It is perfect!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
噢！
大師調變的醬汁，味道真精妙！
完美！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在開始烹飪！
去空著的位置準備好。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在開始烹飪！
去空著的位置準備好。

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now, you can bring this to the kitchen. That is the only thing left to do!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在把這道菜送到廚房就行了，只剩這一步！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
What are you waiting for!
Run to the dining room with this dish!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
還等什麼！
端著這道菜跑去餐廳！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
A Royal Chef must be able to fill the empty plates as fast as possible!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
御用廚師必須儘可能快地把空盤子填滿！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhh!
The mind for cooking!
The mind of the queen!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊啊啊！
烹飪的意志！
女王的意志！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
With the blazing spirit of mine!
I'll make the best dish!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
憑著我熊熊燃燒的熱情！
我要做出最棒的菜！

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你的物品欄裡東西太多了。
請整理物品後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Arghhhhh!
I am sorry!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊啊啊！
真抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I thought you were the new assistant chef who was supposed to come. I am sorry about all the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我還以為你是那位新來的助廚。給你添了這麼多麻煩，真抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I have scolded the one who has brought you, hero. Please forgive us!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
我已經訓過那個把你帶來的人了，英雄。請原諒我們！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
However, you really seem to have a true talent in cooking!
Grilled Griffon!
It was delicious!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
不過，你的廚藝真的很有天賦！
烤獅鷲！
真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
I hope to be able to cook with you again!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
希望下次還能和你一起做菜！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
This is not the time!
Rush to the dining room before the food goes cold!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
現在不是說這個的時候！
趁菜還沒涼，趕緊送去餐廳！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Haha, I've been waiting for you!

[主廚]
哈哈，我一直在等你！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Let's not waste time and start cooking now!
Go to the empty spot and get prepared.

[主廚]
別浪費時間，現在開始烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Argh!
Take a rest now!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
啊！
現在休息一下！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
If I push you too hard, I would be in trouble!

[主廚]
要是把你累壞了，我可就麻煩了！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
As each dish has the best moment to tastes it, each person has the best time to engage in cooking!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
每道菜都有最佳賞味時刻，每個人也都有最適合下廚的時候！

scripts.text:

You there!
You are getting in the way!
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
喂！
別擋路！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
Now... then!
Today's main dish is the Grilled Griffon with the special sauce. The crust should be crunchy while the inside is juicy!

我在那邊的樓梯上見過他。
他...他忙得很，我沒能和他說上幾句話...

scripts.text:
[Magi]
It... It was great!
Whoa...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
那...那太棒了！
哇...

scripts.text:
[Magi]
Ah...
Mark must be...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
啊...
馬克一定是在...

scripts.text:
[Magi]
I met him on the stairs over there.
He... He was busy that I couldn't talk to him much...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
我在那邊的樓梯上見過他。
他...他忙得很，我沒能和他說上幾句話...

scripts.text:
[Magi]
...I guess it was no accident; it was inevitable...
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
...我想這不是巧合，而是命中註定...

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Yo! Who's this!
{0}!
Nice to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
喲！這不是...
{0}！
好久不見！

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
What a great banquet?
The food is delicious as well!
{0}, have you tried the Grilled Griffon!
It was awesome!
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
這宴會真棒！
食物也很好吃！
{0}，你嘗過烤獅鷲嗎？
太美味了！

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Yo! Who's this!
{0}!
Nice to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
喲！這不是...
{0}！
好久不見！

scripts.text:

The food is delicious as well!
{0}, have you tried the Grilled Griffon!
It was awesome!
scripts.translation:

這宴會真棒！
食物也很好吃！
{0}，你嘗過烤獅鷲嗎？
太美味了！

scripts.text: Tell him about Tamarin.
scripts.translation: 告訴他塔馬林的事

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Eh?
No wonder he wasn't coming back!
Since he often goes missing, I didn't give it much thought.
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
咦？
難怪他一直沒回來！
他經常失蹤，我也就沒多想。

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Since Mark is working here as well. Why don't we ask him?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
既然馬克也在這裡工作，要不問問他？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Oh, I was caught by his brother.
I was dragged here by force...
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
哦，我被他哥哥抓住了。
我是被硬拖到這裡來的...

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
I think I have seen Mark...
Where.... Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
我好像見過馬克...
在哪裡...到底在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Magi, where did we see Mark?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
瑪姬，我們在哪裡見過馬克？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Since Mark is working here as well. Why don't we ask him?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
既然馬克也在這裡工作，要不問問他？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Oh, I was caught by his brother.
I was dragged here by force...
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
哦，我被他哥哥抓住了。
我是被硬拖到這裡來的...

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
I think I have seen Mark...
Where.... Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
我好像見過馬克...
在哪裡...到底在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Magi, where did we see Mark?
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
瑪姬，我們在哪裡見過馬克？

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Did you hear?
Mark is on the stairs. Go up there and see him.
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
你聽見了嗎？
馬克在樓梯上，去上面找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Dyu]
Haha!
How unlucky is Mark for working in the banquet held for the heroes!
scripts.translation:
[迪尤]
哈哈！
可憐的馬克，居然要在為英雄舉辦的宴會上工作！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈啊——！
這是怎麼回事...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈啊——！
這是怎麼回事...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh...{0}, is that you?
I wondered if you would come since the heroes from all over the places were supposed to attend the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哦...{0}，是你啊？
聽說各地的英雄都會來參加宴會，我還以為你也會來呢。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Are you enjoying the banquet...
...Wait! You appear to be...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
宴會玩得開心嗎...
...等等！你看起來像是...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
No way!
{0}, did that happen to you too?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
不會吧！
{0}，你也遇到那種事了？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
When I was looking around to find more food for Dyu, someone took me to the Head Chef and made me work there!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我正四處找食物給迪尤吃，卻被人帶到主廚那裡，硬留下來幫忙了！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
They were so busy preparing for the banquet that I had no time to explain... And I ended up...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
大家忙著準備宴會，我根本沒機會解釋...結果就變成這樣了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haha... They were just so busy that I couldn't just quit working...
Haha... Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈哈...他們實在忙得不可開交，我也不好撂挑子不幹...
哈哈...哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I think it is too late for me...
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想我已經來不及脫身了...
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If you find Dyu in the Banquet Hall, please tell him that I won't be able to go back with food since I am too busy.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
如果你在宴會廳遇到迪尤，告訴他我忙得走不開，沒法帶食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I think it is too late for me...
Hahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想我已經來不及脫身了...
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If you find Dyu in the Banquet Hall, please tell him that I won't be able to go back with food since I am too busy.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
如果你在宴會廳遇到迪尤，告訴他我忙得走不開，沒法帶食物回去。
哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...Phew, that is my sister.
Well then.{0}, why don't you come with me to enjoy the banquet...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...呼，那是我妹妹。
好了，{0}，要不要跟我去宴會廳逛逛...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...我們還是先把手頭的活做完吧！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should bring the used dishes to the kitchen.
It would take less time if we do it together. Let's finish it and go eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我得把用過的餐具送去廚房。
一起做會快些，做完就去吃點好吃的！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess we should finish what we have been doing!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...我們還是先把手頭的活做完吧！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should bring the used dishes to the kitchen.
It would take less time if we do it together. Let's finish it and go eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我得把用過的餐具送去廚房。
一起做會快些，做完就去吃點好吃的！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hum... What am I supposed to do next...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯...我接下來該做什麼來著...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Whoa...{0}, thank you.
Now I have some room to breathe...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哇...{0}，謝謝你。
我現在總算能喘口氣了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh... It was just impossible for me to quit...
When I was about to leave after reporting to the Head Chef, I was caught by Mark' brother.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
唉...我根本沒法辭職...
我向主廚彙報完，正準備離開，就被馬克的哥哥抓住了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I guess it would make my life much easier if I just give up.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想，乾脆認命的話，日子也許會好過些。

scripts.text: A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation: 一道看起來十分美味的烤獅鷲。

scripts.text: Place the dish carefully on the surface.
scripts.translation: 小心地把這道菜放在臺面上。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Haaaaaaa!
What is going on...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哈啊——！
這是怎麼回事...

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你的物品欄裡東西太多了。
請整理物品後再試。 -

scripts.text:
Place the dish carefully on the surface.
A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation:
小心地把盤子放在桌上。
一道看起來十分美味的烤獅鷲。

scripts.text: A tasty-looking Grilled Griffon.
scripts.translation: 一道看起來十分美味的烤獅鷲。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hello.
You must be the hero whom everyone talks about.
I am honored to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你好。
你一定就是大家常說的那位英雄吧。
幸會。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Are you invited to the banquet?
This place is not the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你是受邀來參加宴會的嗎？
這裡不是宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You must be {0} whom everyone talks about.
Thank you for visiting us.
I am Spica of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
想必你就是大家常說的{0}吧。
謝謝你來。
我是內裡烏斯家的斯皮卡。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I am Skia.
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我叫斯基亞。
很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
And he is my bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這位是我的保鏢。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
My name is Crux Findel.
I am learning swordsmanship in the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
我叫克魯克斯·芬德爾。
正在內裡烏斯家族學習劍術。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother, the current head of the family, is supposed to be here.
However, since many heroes like you,{0}, are said to attend this banquet,
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們的母親，也就是現任家主，本該親自到場。
不過聽說像你這樣的英雄，{0}，也會來參加宴會，

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother let us come here to meet and learn from them.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
所以母親讓我們來和各位見面，向大家學習。

scripts.text: Where is the candidate for the throne?
scripts.translation: 王位候選人在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Oh, you must be invited as the observer to the ritual...
I see.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
哦，你是受邀來觀禮的...
明白了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Erich is in the royal library.
I guess he could be looking for blueprints of some sort which interest him.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
埃裡希在皇家圖書館。
他可能在找感興趣的設計圖吧。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Nerius is not interested in the throne.
Erich didn't have to participate in the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
內裡烏斯家族對王位沒興趣。
埃裡希也不必參加王室集會。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since he is just a candidate merely for effect, he must be doing what he wants to do now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
既然他只是個名義上的候選人，現在肯定在做自己想做的事。

scripts.text: Why aren't you interested in the throne?
scripts.translation: 你們為什麼對王位沒興趣？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
It is one of the characteristics of the Nerius.
The family is led by women for generations. Therefore, we turn out more queens than kings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
這是內裡烏斯家族的傳統。
我們家族世代由女性領導，所以女王比國王多。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
If Erich hasn't come forth, one of us, Skia and I would have been elected as a candidate for the queen.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
如果埃裡希沒有出面，我和斯基亞其中一人就會被選為女王候選人。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Our mother didn't like it.
That's why Erich became a candidate for the throne. Poor cousin...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
母親不希望那樣。
所以埃裡希才成了王位候選人。可憐的表兄...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I guess that's enough information about our family.
Have you exchanged greetings with all other families?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
關於我們家族，大概就說到這裡。
你和其他家族的人都打過招呼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Since freedom doesn't come often for us, I tend to enjoy it as much as possible.
So...
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們難得有機會自由行動，所以我想盡量享受一下。
所以...

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Why don't you enjoy it with us?
I believe the lord of the Heine family would make a good friend too.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
要不要和我們一起逛逛？
我覺得海爾內家的領主也會是個不錯的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia, my beloved twin.
You need to learn to speak more elegantly.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞，我親愛的雙胞胎妹妹。
你得學著說話優雅一點。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Anyways, what I want to say is that
the Nerius family is always open to you,{0}, so please visit us
anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
總之，我想說的是，內裡烏斯家族隨時歡迎你，{0}。
想來的時候儘管來。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
其他家族應該也準備得差不多，馬上要出發了。
我們還有點時間。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，要不先回房間等訊息？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
要是還沒拜訪完其他家族，不如趁現在去看看？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess other families must be ready by now and about to move soon.
We may have some time to spare.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
其他家族應該也準備得差不多，馬上要出發了。
我們還有點時間。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
{0}, why don't you go back to your room and wait for the message?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
{0}，要不先回房間等訊息？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
We must get prepared for the Banquet now. We need some time to dress up.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我們得為宴會做準備了，還要花些時間打扮。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Why don't you go visit other families if you have not visited them all?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
要是還沒拜訪完其他家族，不如趁現在去看看？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I'll send you a formal invitation to make up for this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
為了彌補這次失禮，我會正式邀請你的。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I have heard the story briefly from Skia.
Lord Nyhill must have a constitutional weakness for alcohol.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞簡單跟我說過了。
尼希爾大人似乎天生不勝酒力。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are not hiding anything, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你沒隱瞞什麼吧？

scripts.text: I saw someone suspicious.
scripts.translation: 我看到一個可疑的人

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are lying.
I have to let the elders know about this anyway.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你在撒謊。
不管怎樣，我都得把這件事告訴長老們。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I wonder if the old folks would hear me out though.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
不過，那些老人家會聽我說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia told me something similar to that.
Crux didn't find out much.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞也跟我說了類似的事。
克魯克斯沒查到多少線索。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I guess some shady characters must have mixed in with the bunch of temporary employees hired for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
看來有些可疑人物混進了宴會臨時僱來的員工裡。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...Anyways, I guess we have to warn the elders about this.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...總之，我們得提醒長老們。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Sorry about all the trouble.
How unlucky of you to be involved in this mess.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
給你添麻煩了，真抱歉。
你可真倒霉，捲進這種事裡。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I am not doing well either.
The royal family is focusing on finding out who is pulling the strings.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我這邊也不太順利。
王室正全力調查幕後黑手。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
...All they can do is to sort out the puppets infiltrated into the palace.
But it is better than doing nothing.
Now... then.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
...他們目前只能清查潛入宮中的內應。
不過總比什麼都不做強。
那麼...

scripts.text: Where is Skia?
scripts.translation: 斯基亞在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Spica]
She went to hang out with Lord Nyhill!
I don't know what she sees in the pretty boy with no substance.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
她去找尼希爾大人了！
真不懂她看上那個華而不實的帥哥哪一點。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Could it be...
Could it be that?
Is she enchanted by his looks?
Crux, you answer me!
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
難道...
難道是...
她被他的外表迷住了？
克魯克斯，你說呢！

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Wha... What? Well...
It sounds plausible...
By the way, Lord Nyhill is under probation so he is not supposed to leave his room.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
什...什麼？嗯...
聽起來倒也有道理...
對了，尼希爾大人正在接受觀察，按規定不能離開房間。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Well, I stand corrected. She went to visit Nyhill in his room.
...Isn't it the same thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
好吧，我說錯了。她是去尼希爾房間探望他。
...這不還是一樣嗎？

scripts.text: Crux, cheer up...
scripts.translation: 克魯克斯，振作一點...

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Oh, are you leaving now?
It sure is wise of you to leave before the lady's head explodes.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
哦，你要走了嗎？
趁小姐還沒發火就離開，真是明智。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Crux]
Don't mind me.
scripts.translation:
[克魯克斯]
不用管我。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
We'd better move now since the situation doesn't look good.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
情況不妙，我們最好現在就離開。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
You are rather slow-footed.
It has been a while since I got the message that you came back.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
你動作真慢。
我收到你回來的訊息已經有一會兒了。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
I invited you for no special reason.
Since they keep calling for meetings to discuss what has happened during the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
我請你來沒什麼特別的原因。
他們一直在開會，討論儀式期間發生的事。

scripts.text:
[Spica]
There comes lord of the Heine family.
You seem to move around rather freely considering that you are under confinement.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
海爾內家的領主來了。
你明明被禁閉著，行動倒挺自由。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...?
{0}, I have something to tell you.
And about the confinement, it is OK as long as I stay in the western wing of the royal villa...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...?
{0}，我有件事要告訴你。
至於禁閉，只要我待在皇家別墅西翼就沒問題...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
By the way, Skia? What are you doing?
.......
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
對了，斯基亞？你在做什麼？
...

scripts.text:
[Spica]
Skia?
She is not here now.
scripts.translation:
[斯皮卡]
斯基亞？
她現在不在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Oh, this must be it.
The shadow duty.
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
哦，原來如此。
這是影子職責。
到底怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
...How could you tell at a glance?
I am busted.
Am I a bad actress?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...你怎麼一眼就看出來了？
被你識破了。
我的演技很差嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Even if you are twins, you don't look exactly the same.
I just noticed certain differences.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
即使是雙胞胎，也不可能長得一模一樣。
我只是發現了一些細微差異。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Really? I am flattered though.
I am glad that you have been looking at me, not Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
真的嗎？你這麼說我很高興。
很高興你看的是我，而不是斯皮卡。

scripts.text: Why are you in that outfit?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼穿著那身衣服？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... It is to protect Spica who will be the head of the Nerius family.
Sometimes, I stand forward instead of Spica.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯...這是為了保護將成為內裡烏斯家主的斯皮卡。
有時候我會代替她出面。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
While my sister learned what the head of the family must know from our mother,
I learned to hide and fight.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
姐姐跟著母親學習家主必須掌握的知識，
而我學的是潛行和戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
That is why people call me the shadow princess.
It is my first time attending an official event in the light.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
所以大家叫我影子公主。
這是我第一次光明正大地參加正式活動。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Anyways, I am filling in for Spica who has left to run some errands now.
I need to show how she is attending the royal banquet with grace.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
總之，斯皮卡出去辦事了，我暫時替她出席。
得表現得像她一樣優雅地參加王室宴會。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Thanks to Lady Spica, I get to move around as much as I can now...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
多虧斯皮卡小姐，我現在總算能自由活動了...

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
When will she come back?
The meeting of the representatives has been over...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
她什麼時候回來？
代表會議已經結束了...

scripts.text: What brought you here?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼會來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
I have come to deliver you the message that there is a mission for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我來通知你，有個任務要交給你。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
To be exact, I volunteered since I heard that you were visiting the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
準確地說，我是聽說你要拜訪內裡烏斯家族，才主動請纓的。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
It must be about the incident during the ritual, right?
What does the hero have to do with the royal family's business?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
一定是儀式期間那件事吧？
英雄為什麼要插手王室的事務？

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Well, you can ask Spica later.
She was there in the meeting, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
詳情之後可以問斯皮卡。
你知道，她當時也在會場。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
This conversation is getting too long.
Please go meet my grandfather and father first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
聊得有點久了。
先去見我的祖父和父親吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
They must be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他們應該在等你。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hum... I see. I shall ask Spica to fill me in with the details when she comes back.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯，我知道了。等斯皮卡回來，我再問她詳情。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Then, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
那我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
{0}, please come to see me again later!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
{0}，稍後記得再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I have to wait for Spica's return and change clothes.
I cannot leave now.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我得等斯皮卡回來，再換回自己的衣服。
現在還不能離開。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What would happen when I get out like this and encounter Spica on the way?
We will be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我要是穿成這樣出去，路上碰到斯皮卡怎麼辦？
那就麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
What are you doing here, you punk?
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你這小子在這裡做什麼？
趁我還沒叫人把你拖出去，趕緊滾！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
How did you get in here.
Only the people with permission are allowed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你是怎麼進來的？
只有獲准的人才能進這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Get out of here now before I call someone to drag you out!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
趁我還沒叫人把你拖出去，趕緊滾！

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you the hero invited to the banquet? The Royal Assembly to be exact.
Nice to meet you. I am ^0000cdIan Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你就是受邀參加宴會的英雄？準確地說，是參加王室集會的那位吧。
幸會，我叫^0000cd伊恩·沃爾特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Although ^0000cdthe Walther family doesn't participate in the Royal Assembly^000000, we are attending the banquet as one of the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
^0000cd沃爾特家族雖然不參加王室集會^000000，
但仍會以七大王族之一的身份出席宴會。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
This is the ^0000cdheir of the Walther family, Isenhonor^000000. He is my nephew.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
這位是^0000cd沃爾特家族繼承人伊森霍納^000000，
也是我的侄子。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He will be the head of the family as he attains adulthood this year. As of now, I am in charge of the family business.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他今年成年後就會成為家主。現在由我負責家族事務。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
How do you do? I am ^0000cdIsenhonor Walther^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你好，我是^0000cd伊森霍納·沃爾特^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why aren't you participating in the Royal Assembly when there is the heir?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然有繼承人，你們為什麼不參加王室集會？

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I wonder of you know this, ^0000cdthe candidate from our family was involved in an unfortunate incident^000000 in the ^0000cdprevious Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我想你聽說過這件事：^0000cd我們家族的候選人在一次事件中遭遇不幸^000000，那是在^0000cd上屆王室集會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
^0000cdIsenarm^000000 who was the candidate for the throne acted violently all of a sudden. ^0000cdHe ended up being killed by the heir of the Geoborg family^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
^0000cd當時的王位候選人伊森阿姆^000000突然暴起，
^0000cd最後被格博格家族的繼承人殺死了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
After discussion, our family decided not to take part in the ^0000cdRoyal Assembly^000000 this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
商議之後，我們家族決定這次不參加^0000cd王室集會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
...

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Well then. I hope you enjoy the banquet. The banquet is held for you after all.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
那麼，希望你能玩得盡興。畢竟這場宴會是為你舉辦的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Thank you for sparing me some time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。謝謝你抽空接待我。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Long time no see, Ian.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好久不見，伊恩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Why are you here? I thought we agreed ^0000cdnot to see each other ever again after the previous Royal Assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你怎麼來了？我們不是說好，^0000cd上次王室集會後就再也不見^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I remember that, but the heir of your family has been busy these days.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
我記得。不過你們家的繼承人最近一直在忙著調查。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He has been digging around so much that the story has reached me.
No one seems to pay much attention, but you never know.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他四處打聽的事已經傳到我耳朵裡了。
雖然好像沒人太在意，但誰知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I told Isenhonor to ^0000cdstop investigating about his brother's death^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
我已經叫伊森霍納^0000cd別再調查他哥哥的死因^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
He should. It would get us both in trouble if the fact that ^0000cdwe were going to kill the imperial candidate of the Geoborg family^000000 leaks out.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
他最好聽你的。要是^0000cd我們打算殺害格博格家族王位候選人^000000的事洩露出去，我們兩家都會惹上麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
No one knows about it, you know.
The ^0000cdplan was ruined ^000000as Isenarm was killed while acting violently.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
這件事沒人知道。
^0000cd計劃已經失敗了^000000，伊森阿姆在暴走時被殺了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
I am sorry about your heir.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
你們家失去了繼承人，我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
I don't care who becomes the heir as long as he leads the family well.
I don't understand why Isenarm who has behaved so well acted that way though...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
只要能帶領家族走好，誰當繼承人我都不在乎。
只是我不明白，一向表現出色的伊森阿姆為什麼會突然那樣...

scripts.text:
[Ian]
He must have sensed something to act like than when he was about to be elected as the king... There is no way to find out now...
Geoborg has been silent as well ever since, I hear.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
他快要當選國王時，肯定察覺到了什麼才會那樣做...現在也無從查證了...
聽說格博格家族從那以後也一直保持沉默。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Yes, the word has it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
是啊，聽說是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Since Isenarm was killed by Geoborg, ^0000cdthe Walther family has been excluded from the Royal Assembly^000000 this time.
He was a great boy. It is a shame since he was the perfect candidate for the throne.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
伊森阿姆死在格博格家族手上後，^0000cd沃爾特家這次被排除在王室集會之外^000000。
他是個好孩子，本來是王位候選人的最佳人選，真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
The important thing is that as long as we both keep silent, the truth will remain unknown forever.
Then, I guess we will never see each other again.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
只要我們都守口如瓶，真相就會永遠埋沒。
那我們以後大概不會再見了。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Make sure to warn your heir not to dig around the incident, no more.
If it gets out, my family can deny it.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
警告你的繼承人，別再調查這件事。
事情要是敗露，我的家族可以撇清關係。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
However, you Ian will be in trouble as the same member of the family since there is no witness or proof left now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
不過，伊恩，你也是同謀。如今沒有證人或證據，你也會惹上麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you threatening me?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
你在威脅我？

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Shh... You'd better keep your voice down. Your heir may hear you.
I mean, we should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
噓...小聲點，你的繼承人可能會聽見。
我是說，我們得謹慎些。

scripts.text:
[Man from the Richard]
Well, I cannot be absent for so long anyway. Let me head back now.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的男子]
好了，我也不能離開太久，先回去了。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Argh... How dare...!
I shouldn't have worked with him in the first place. I lost my poor nephew for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
可惡...竟敢...！
我一開始就不該和他合作，結果白白害死了我可憐的侄子。

scripts.text:
[Ian]
Are you enjoying the banquet?
I hope you enjoy the banquet since it is held for you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
宴會玩得開心嗎？
這場宴會是為你舉辦的，希望你能盡興。

[Man from the Richard]
Long time no see, Ian.
scripts.translation:
[理查德家的人]
好久不見，伊恩。

[Ian]

沒人知道這件事。
伊森阿姆行事魯莽，結果喪命，^0000cd計劃也因此失敗了^000000。

聽說喬博格家從那以後也一直保持沉默。

伊森阿姆死在喬博格家手上之後，^0000cd沃爾特家這次被排除在王室集會之外^000000。
