scripts.translation:
[伊恩]
可惡……竟敢……！
我一開始就不該和他合作。可憐的侄子白白丟了性命。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納·沃爾特]
你行李不少啊，拿得動嗎？
看起來又多又重。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor Walther]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納·沃爾特]
要不要先精簡一下行李？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You must be an adventurer. Thank you for visiting this gloomy place.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你是冒險者吧？謝謝你來這個冷清的地方。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The representative of our family is over there. I hope you have a good time then.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我們家族的代表在那邊。祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Isenhonor]
What are you doing here? The Banquet Hall is over there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你在這裡做什麼？宴會廳在那邊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was sorry that I didn't get the time to talk to you then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，剛才沒機會和你說話。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What story? You mean the story of my brother being killed for his violent behavior? You seemed to hear it so eagerly. I hope you don't believe that bullshit.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
什麼事？你是說我哥哥因暴走而被殺的事？你好像聽得很起勁。希望你別信那些鬼話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, well...

[Isenhonor]
I cannot believe that my brother has acted violently. Even if he did, there must have been a ^0000cdreason.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我不相信哥哥會突然暴走。即使他真的那樣做了，也一定有^0000cd理由。^000000

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother, he must have done it for something. No one knows the truth, but people seem to believe the gossip.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
哥哥肯定是有原因才那樣做的。沒人知道真相，可大家似乎都相信流言。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you want to clear the name of your brother, you can investigate on your own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想替你哥哥洗清罪名的話，可以自己去調查。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am trying. But ^0000cdthe elders of my family don't want me to dig out the dishonorable incident^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我正在查。可是^0000cd家族長老不希望我繼續追查這樁醜聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Also, it is impossible to meet ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
而且，我也見不到^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wouldn't he meet you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他不肯見你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
No. any access to him is blocked.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
不，所有接觸他的途徑都被封鎖了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
The ^0000cdGuardian Knight^000000 and ^0000cdErnst Geoborg^000000 are the only people who know what has happened that day. However it is impossible to meet them. I don't know where to begin...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
只有^0000cd守護騎士^000000和^0000cd恩斯特·格博格^000000知道那天發生了什麼，可我根本見不到他們。我都不知道該從哪兒查起...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A Guardian Knight? Did your brother have a Guardian Knight?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守護騎士？你哥哥有守護騎士？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Yes. Each member of the Walther family has a Guardian Knight. Our family is in overseas trade so that we often travel by ship.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
是的，沃爾特家族的每位成員都有守護騎士。我們家做海外貿易，經常要乘船出行。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you know, the sailors are not a gentle bunch and we tend to carry money with us so that we are often threatened. We all have to bring Guardian Knights with us.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你也知道，水手可不好惹，而且我們常帶著錢，容易被人盯上。因此每次出門都得帶上守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is your Guardian Knight then, Isenhonor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你的守護騎士呢，伊森霍納？

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I am sick of Guardian Knights since my brother's Guardian Knight abandoned my brother and ran away. I don't want to call them Guardian Knights.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
哥哥的守護騎士拋棄他逃走了。從那以後我就不喜歡守護騎士這個稱呼。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What should I call a Guardian Knight who betrays the master and runs away?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
背叛主人、臨陣脫逃的守護騎士，還算什麼守護騎士？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it would be a good idea to start from your Guardian Knight. Since they worked together as Guardian Knight, he must know something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如先從你的守護騎士問起。既然他和你哥哥共事過，應該知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Well, when I asked, he told me he knew nothing. If he did, he must have told me before I even asked.
They were pretty close and often exercised together.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我問過他，他說什麼都不知道。要是知道，他早該主動告訴我了。
他們以前關係很好，還經常一起訓練。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Oh, well, since they were so close, he could have tried to defend his friend.
Why didn't I think of that...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
哦...既然他們那麼要好，他可能是想替朋友辯護。
我怎麼沒想到...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me talk to him now. If I hear anything, it would be a good thing. Even if I don't get to hear anything it would still count as a try.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我去和他談談吧。問出線索最好，就算什麼都沒問出來，也算試過了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Why would you go through such trouble?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你為什麼要為這事費這麼大勁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I have a hunch. As an adventurer, my instinct says that there must be something going on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有種預感。作為冒險者，我的直覺告訴我這件事另有隱情。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Do all the adventurers count on their hunch like that? This could be dangerous. It is no matter to approach with a hunch.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
冒險者都這麼憑直覺行事嗎？這很危險。不能只憑預感就貿然行動。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is why it is called an adventure. Adventurers where the adventures are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是冒險的意義。冒險者就是要去冒險。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我不懂。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You may call it a needless meddling out of curiosity. However, I cannot neglect anyone in distress.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以說我只是好奇，才多管閒事。但我不能對陷入困境的人袖手旁觀。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I appreciate your help though. I am desperate enough to accept your favor. However, I don't think you wouldn't hear much from the Guardian Knight though.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我很感激你願意幫忙。我已經走投無路，只能接受你的好意了。不過我覺得守護騎士那裡也問不出什麼。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
If you want to meet him anyway, go to ^0000cdour manor in the south of Alberta^000000. He must be there.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
如果你還是想見他，就去^0000cd艾爾貝塔南邊的沃爾特家宅邸^000000找他。他應該在那裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我先去了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, how did your meeting with the Guardian Knight in Alberta go? Not that I expect too much...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
冒險者，你在艾爾貝塔見到守護騎士了嗎？雖然我不抱太大希望...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
However, still, I have hoped to hear good news from you...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
不過，我還是希望能聽到好訊息...

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Adventurer, you are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
冒險者，你回來了。怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I have something for you...
Oh? Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我有東西要給你...
咦？放哪兒去了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I must have left it back. Let me go bring it for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我大概落在那邊了。我去取來給你。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are back. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
你回來了，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I told him the story of meeting the Guardian Knight of Isenarm and the conversation with him.
scripts.translation: 我把與伊森阿姆的守護騎士會面、以及和他交談的內容都告訴了伊森霍納。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ^0000cdletter^000000.

[Isenhonor]
Well, this indeed is the seal of our family, and it is my brother's handwriting.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
嗯，這確實是我們家族的印章，而且筆跡也是我哥哥的。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
As you said, my brother's Guardian Knight must have not betrayed my brother.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
正如你所說，我哥哥的守護騎士應該沒有背叛他。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
My brother indeed must have done such a thing for a reason.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
哥哥做那種事，一定有他的理由。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess this is all I can do you now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在能做的也就這些了。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I understand. I should take on from here. Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我明白了。接下來就交給我吧。謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Please come back anytime when you need the help of the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
以後需要沃爾特家族幫忙，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
You are a valuable guest for us, the Walther family, from now on, dear adventurer. I'll help you anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
親愛的冒險者，從今以後你就是沃爾特家族的重要客人。只要你開口，我隨時願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Based on the piece of information you have brought me, I am collecting other information too. It is not enough year, but I believe that I can unveil the truth someday.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
根據你帶來的線索，我也在繼續蒐集情報。現在的線索還不夠，但我相信總有一天能查明真相。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I called Simon from Alberta. I need to gather all the help I can get now.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
我已經聯絡了艾爾貝塔的西蒙。現在能爭取的助力，我都會爭取。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
I will see you again when the truth is revealed.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
等真相揭曉時，我們再見。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I am looking for the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor. Where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在找伊森霍納的守護騎士。你知道他在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am his Guardian Knight. What's the matter? Has anything happened to him?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我就是他的守護騎士。怎麼了？主人出事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I shouldn't have stayed behind. Is he all right?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我不該留在這裡的。主人沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Kidnapping? Injury? Robbery? Fall? What is it? Oh, I should go there now...!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
被綁架了？受傷了？被搶了？摔倒了？到底怎麼了？我現在就趕過去...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. Isenhonor is all right. Nothing happened. I am here to ask you something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點，伊森霍納沒事，什麼也沒發生。我只是想問你一些事。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Phew, I guess it wasn't my lord who called me. I am still glad that I is OK.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
呼...看來不是主人叫我回去。知道他沒事，我也就放心了。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
What are you going to ask me? Well, who are you by the way?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你想問什麼？對了，你是哪位？

scripts.text: [I told him the conversation with Isenhonor in the palace briefly.]
scripts.translation: [我簡要告訴他，我在宮中與伊森霍納交談的內容。]

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Oh, sorry about that. I am ^0000cdSimon Walther Marshall^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
噢，失禮了。我叫^0000cd西蒙·沃爾特·馬歇爾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I don't know the whereabouts of ^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000 who used to be the Guardian Knight of Isenarm, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
很遺憾，我不知道^0000cd凱恩·沃爾特·沃克^000000在哪裡。他曾是伊森阿姆的守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You both have Walther in your names. Is there a special reason for it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們的名字裡都有“沃爾特”，有什麼特別的緣由嗎？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Every knight belongs to the Walther who is assigned to a member of the Walther family is given the name, Walther.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
沃爾特家族會給派給家族成員的騎士冠上“沃爾特”之名。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
The name gives a sense of belonging. Also it gives us the pride to have been recognized as excellent knights.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
這個名字讓我們有歸屬感，也讓我們為自己獲認可、成為優秀騎士而自豪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right. By the way, did you say that you know nothing about Kain Walther Walker?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。對了，你剛才說不知道凱恩·沃爾特·沃克的下落？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
No, I don't.
However...
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
是的，我不知道。
不過...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However...?

[Simon]
I heard a ^0000cdstrange gossip^000000 from some of the knights there when I escorted Isenhonor to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我護送伊森霍納去宮殿時，聽那裡的騎士說起一條^0000cd奇怪的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
They heard ^0000cda pickpocket locked in the basement of the palace^000000 babbling about how he had seen a person from the Walther family in a foreign country.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
他們聽說^0000cd有個被關在宮殿地下室的扒手^000000胡言亂語，說自己在國外見過沃爾特家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
However, no family member left the country due to the royal banquet. It was strange to hear that. I think that person could be ^0000cdKain^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
可是因為王室宴會，家族裡沒人出國。聽起來確實蹊蹺。我想那人可能是^0000cd凱恩^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I wanted to investigate myself considering the importance of the matter. But Isenhonor ordered me to go back to Alberta so I had to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
這事很重要，我本想親自調查。可伊森霍納命令我回艾爾貝塔，我只好回來了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The pickpocket in the underground prison?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
地下監獄裡的扒手？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Yes. I don't know his real name, but he is called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 in the underworld.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
對。我不知道他的真名，不過黑道上都叫他^0000cd大腳怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Minor offenders like pickpockets are usually locked in this other place. But that guy was caught pickpocketing in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
扒手之類的小罪犯通常關在別處。不過那傢伙是在阿魯納菲茲偷竊時被抓的。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Due to diplomatic issues, we have taken his custody and locked him in the underground prison.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
因為外交方面的原因，我們接管了他，並把他關進地下監獄。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
That guy seems to have a lot of information from all over the continent. Even when his words about seen the person of the Walther family wasn't true, I felt that I could get useful information from him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
那傢伙似乎知道大陸各地不少事。即使他說見過沃爾特家族成員是假的，我也覺得能從他那裡打聽到有用的訊息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whether the information he has is true or not, I would rather go visit him. Thank you for the information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
無論他的情報是真是假，我都想去見見他。謝謝你告訴我這些。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Please say hello to my master when you get back to the palace. Tell him that I will be guarding this place well.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
回宮後請替我向主人問好。告訴他我會好好守著這裡。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
And, let him know that he can call me anytime. I would gladly go there to guard him.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
也告訴他，隨時都可以召我回去。我很樂意回去保護他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll let him know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我一定轉告他。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Have a safe trip then!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
祝你一路順風！

scripts.text:
[Simon]
How did your visit to the prison go?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你去監獄探望得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
You can go see the convict called ^0000cdBigfoot^000000 locked in the ^0000cdUnderground prison of the palace^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
你可以去見見被關在^0000cd宮殿地下監獄^000000的犯人^0000cd大腳怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Didn't you hear anything else from Isenhonor? Please extend my greetings to him when you go to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
伊森霍納沒告訴你別的事嗎？你去普隆德拉時，麻煩代我向他問好。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Dear adventurer! At last, Master Isenhonor called me! I am happy that I can guard my lord nearby.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
親愛的冒險者！主人伊森霍納終於召我回去了！能在主人身邊守護他，我太高興了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Glad to hear that. Then what are you doing here now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那太好了。你現在在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I am waiting for the ship to Izlude. I will rush to the ship when it comes here.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我在等去依斯魯得島的船。船一來我就立刻上船。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I have a lot of questions for you, but I guess I'd better hear the story from my master. Then dear adventurer, have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
我有很多事想問你，不過還是聽主人親口講比較好。親愛的冒險者，祝你一路順風！

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
What if anything happens to my master while I am gone...
Shall I leave for Prontera now?
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
我離開期間，萬一主人出了什麼事...
我要現在就去普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
No, he will be mad at me.
He will call me someday. Let's wait here.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
不行，他會生氣的。
他總有一天會召我回去，就在這裡等吧。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
Just a little more.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
What a fine day. However, the house feels to empty and lonely.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
今天天氣真好。不過宅邸裡空蕩蕩的，怪冷清。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? Is this the manor of the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，這裡是沃爾特家族的宅邸嗎？

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Yes, it is. What brought you here. Since everyone has left for Prontera, you cannot meet the master now.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
是的。請問您找誰？大家都去普隆德拉了，現在見不到主人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isenhonor has sent me here to meet the Guardian Knight.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
伊森霍納派我來找守護騎士。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Oh, really? He has been waiting for Isenhonor's call so much! I am happy for him.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
哦，真的嗎？他一直盼著伊森霍納召他回去呢！真替他高興。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Simon, the Guardian Knight of Isenhonor is near the ^0000cddock^000000 where the ship leaving for ^0000cdIzlude^000000 is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
伊森霍納的守護騎士西蒙就在^0000cd碼頭^000000附近，那裡停著開往^0000cd依斯魯得島^000000的船。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
He is waiting there to go to Prontera as soon as possible when Isenhonor calls him.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
他正在那裡等著，只要伊森霍納一召喚，就馬上動身去普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Go to where the ship to Izlude is anchored.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
去停靠著依斯魯得島航船的碼頭找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Mahatra Mornen, the butler of the Alkish family, I cannot take his arrogance anymore.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
阿爾基什家的管家瑪哈特拉·莫倫，我真受不了他的傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They only own a manor. And they call themselves as the best family in Alberta? What do they think of the Walther family!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
他們不過有一棟宅邸，竟敢自稱是艾爾貝塔最好的家族？他們把沃爾特家族當什麼了！

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
They cannot even make eye contact when they meet us.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
他們見到我們時，連正眼都不敢瞧。

scripts.text:
[Butler for the Walthers]
Our master is just too gentle to leave them alone. How classless.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特家的管家]
主人就是太寬厚了，才會放過他們。真沒教養。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
炸雞、烤土豆、啤酒、新鮮乳酪...唉...被關在這種地方，我現在特別想吃這些平常菜。
誰要是給我帶來，我就娶誰。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified!
But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
啊！又來了！嚇死我了！
不過被關在這裡反而安全。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Fried chicken, baked potato, beer, fresh cheese... Ha.... I crave those ordinary dishes now that I am locked in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
炸雞、烤土豆、啤酒、新鮮乳酪...唉...被關在這種地方，我現在特別想吃這些平常菜。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I would marry anyone who brings them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
誰要是給我帶來，我就娶誰。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Argh! Not again! I am terrified! But I would be safe as long as I am locked in here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
啊！又來了！嚇死我了！不過被關在這裡反而安全。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bigfoot?

[Bigfoot]
Oh no! I won't eat that! I don't want to have another bite of that pigs feed! I may not be a gourmet, but my tongue hasn't been decomposed or anything!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不要！我才不吃那個！我再也不想吃豬食了！
我雖然不是什麼美食家，但舌頭還沒壞掉呢！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me something I can eat! I know that I am locked in the prison, but I deserve to eat something edible!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
給我帶點能吃的東西來！
我知道自己在坐牢，但也該吃點像樣的東西吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There must have been a misunderstanding. I am not the warden here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你誤會了，我不是獄卒，是專程來找你的。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You are now? I am relieved to hear that. The food here just sucks.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
是嗎？那我就放心了。
這裡的伙食實在太糟了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Who are you by the way? You look like an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
對了，你是誰？看起來像個冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, it is not important. You are here to ask me something, right? You know nothing in this world is free.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
算了，這不重要。你是來問我事情的吧？
要知道，這世上可沒有免費的午餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What do you want?

[Bigfoot]
Get me out of here.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
把我弄出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It would be beyond my ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這可超出我的能力範圍了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't be such a perfectionist. You must be of a high rank to come down here, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
別這麼較真。能來這裡的人，地位肯定不低吧？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, I understand. I knew it was a difficult favor to ask anyway.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嗯，我明白。本來就知道這請求很難答應。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I didn't think you would let me out. I just got it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我沒指望你真能放我出去，剛才只是隨口說說。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, you turned it down so firmly. You could at least pretend to consider or think about it.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不過你拒絕得也太乾脆了吧？至少裝作考慮一下也好啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you really want then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你到底想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Money of course. The price depends on the information you want.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
當然是錢。你想要什麼情報，價格就不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't offer a monthly installment plan. I only take cash. I only accept currencies older than 2 years. I'll spend it meaningfully when I get out here in the future.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我不接受分期付款，只收現金。而且只收兩年以上的舊鈔。等我哪天出去，再好好花掉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have much money, but I know where to spend it. I guess I should turn down the deal. Goodbye then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒多少錢，不過知道該把錢花在哪。看來這筆交易談不成了，再見。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey! Don't take the joke too seriously. Don't your friends call you stubborn?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
喂，別把玩笑當真啊！你朋友是不是都嫌你太固執？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I knew it. You give up too easily. You are still young, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我就知道，你這麼快就放棄了。你還年輕呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
說重點吧。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Well, you remind me of something...
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
嗯...你倒讓我想起一件事...

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Yes! Bring me fried spicy dumplings and green salad! That's right! Bring me that.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
對了！給我帶炸辣餃和蔬菜沙拉！沒錯，就要這個。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I cannot eat the horrible food here much so I keep thinking about the food out there.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
這裡的飯菜太難吃了，我吃不下，所以一直想著外面的美食。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What I crave the most is that. Would you do this for me at least? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我最想吃的就是這個。至少這點小忙你能幫吧？^0000cd三份炸辣餃和一份蔬菜沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that. Wait for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我去準備。等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to tell me to wait. I cannot go anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不用叫我等，我又不能到處亂跑。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Wait, you stop there for a moment.
I don't smell the greasy dumplings and fresh salad at all.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
等等，先停一下。
我完全沒聞到炸辣餃和新鮮沙拉的香味。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you bring the food? ^0000cdThree fried spicy dumplings and one green salad!^000000
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你把食物帶來了嗎？^0000cd三份炸辣餃和一份蔬菜沙拉！^000000

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I won't talk before you bring them to me! Check again and bring them!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你把食物帶來之前，我什麼都不會說！再檢查一下，帶過來！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I smell it! This smell! Take out what you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我聞到了！就是這個味道！把你帶來的東西拿出來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are.

[Bigfoot]
Oh, my love. I'll enjoy every bite of it. Well, ask me the question now.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
啊，我的最愛！我要好好享用每一口。好了，問吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you saw a person of the Walther family in a foreign country. Where did you see him? How did you know that he was from the Walther family?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說你在國外見過沃爾特家族的人。你在哪裡見到他的？又怎麼知道他是沃爾特家的人？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, you wanted to know that. As you know, it is rare to see seafarer Walthers in other places of Rune-Midgarts, except Alberta and Prontera.
They are good at hiding their identities other than those who are well known.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
哦，你想問這個啊。你也知道，除了艾爾貝塔和普隆德拉，在盧恩·米德加茲其他地方很少見到沃爾特家的航海商人。
除了那些名人，他們都很會隱藏身份。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
However, I saw the distinctive symbol of the family in ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不過，我在^0000cd維因斯^000000看到了他們家族特有的徽記。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Veins? Who did you see there? And how?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
維因斯？你在那裡看到了誰？怎麼發現的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't know who he is. I was working as always. You know you have to work to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我不知道他是誰。我當時照常幹活嘛。你也知道，人總得謀生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是說扒竊？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to be so specific about it. Don't you want to hear the story? Well, don't worry. I do have a sense of honor. I'll keep my promise to you who has brought me the dumplings.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不用說得那麼直白嘛。你還想不想聽後面的事？放心，我還是講信用的，會遵守對帶炸辣餃給我的人的承諾。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, I found a shabby man who seemed so defenseless in the market there. His wallet was fat. So I took it and went off.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
總之，我在市場上看到一個看起來毫無防備的寒酸男人。他的錢包鼓鼓的，我就順手拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I opened the wallet in a secluded corner of the market. He turned out to be quite loaded. And I found an ^0000cdold letter^000000 in there. The one stamped with the ^0000cdseal^000000, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
我在市場偏僻的角落開啟錢包，發現那人相當有錢，裡面還放著一封^0000cd舊信^000000。就是蓋著^0000cd家族徽章^000000的那種信。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The fact that he had the letter doesn't prove that he was a person from the Walther family.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
光憑他有那封信，還不能證明他是沃爾特家族的人。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, I am getting there. After checking what was in the wallet, I was going to call it a day. I had earned enough.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
喂，我這就說到重點了。翻完錢包，我本來打算收工，因為已經賺夠了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Then, that shabby man appeared.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
就在那時，那個寒酸男人出現了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
I don't have to tell you the rest of the story, right? Whoa... I thought I was fighting three men at the same time. His fist was like...! Phew... When he was punching me, I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
剩下的不用我多說了吧？天哪...我當時以為自己在同時對付三個人。他的拳頭簡直像...！呼...他揍我的時候，我看到了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
There was a hidden ^0000cdsword^000000 under his cloak. The ^0000cdhandle was engraved with the symbol^000000. You see, well. Do you believe my story now?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
他的斗篷底下藏著一把^0000cd劍^000000，^0000cd劍柄上刻著那個徽記^000000。怎麼樣，現在相信我了吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you manage to see that when you were beaten up so bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你都被打成那樣了，是怎麼看清的？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, have some faith. Don't you know what I do for living?
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
喂，要有點信心啊。你不知道我是靠什麼吃飯的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean pickpocketing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是說扒竊？

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Hey, don't be so specific, please!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
喂，別說得這麼直白！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Anyways, my profession required a sharp eye to catch whatever is significant at a glance. That's how I thrive in this field.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
總之，這行得眼尖，一眼就要看出關鍵。靠這本事，我才能混下去。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
When I see a person, I need to identify the position of the wallet, any weapon in possession, the target's wits and how fast the target can run in a moment. This job required such a special quality.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
見到一個人，我得立刻判斷他的錢包在哪、有沒有武器、反應快不快、跑得有多快。幹這行就得有這種本事。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
You don't have to believe me, but you can trust my professional skill.
Well, you must have hidden your money inside the belt and your shoes. Nice work. Those are tough spots to steal from.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不必相信我，但我的專業眼光可不會錯。
嗯，你把錢藏在腰帶和靴子裡了吧？藏得不錯，這些地方確實不好下手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I guess I can trust your skill.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我相信你的眼力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways, it sure seems suspicious. Thank you for your information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，事情確實很可疑。謝謝你提供情報。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Don't you need anything else? I want to have some dessert now.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
你不問別的了嗎？我現在想吃點甜品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. This is enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用了，這些就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Oh, no! Dessert! My dessert!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
不！甜品！我的甜品呢！

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
What is it? Did you change your mind?
Do you want more information? I'd really like to have some Mastela Fruit Wine.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
怎麼了，改變主意了？
還想知道更多嗎？我好想喝瑪絲黛拉果酒。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Did you forget where to go?
You should go to ^0000cdVeins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
忘了要去哪兒了嗎？
去^0000cd維因斯^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Bigfoot]
Bring me some dessert when you come back!
scripts.translation:
[大腳怪]
回來的時候記得帶點甜品！

scripts.text:
[K]
You seem to carry a heavy burden.
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你行李看起來很重。
要不要精簡一些？

scripts.text:
[K]
I want to go back...
There again...
scripts.translation:
[K]
我想回去...
回到那裡...

scripts.text:
[K]
Who are you? Why are you staring at me? Are you after my wallet too?
It hasn't been long since I sent a person who stole my wallet to the prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你是誰？為什麼盯著我看？也想偷我錢包嗎？
我才剛把偷錢包的人送進監獄。

scripts.text:
[K]
I guess no such information is shared among the pickpockets. Get lost if you don't want to be sent to prison.
scripts.translation:
[K]
看來扒手之間也不會互通情報。要是不想進監獄，就趕緊滾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are quite quick-tempered, aren't you.
^0000cdKain Walther Walker^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你脾氣真暴躁。
你就是^0000cd凱恩·沃爾特·沃克^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
I don't know such name.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我不認識這個人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The one who betrayed his master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個背叛了主人的人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Who... Who are you? Reveal yourself!
Why are you telling me such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你...你是誰？報上名來！
為什麼跟我說這些？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
People say that. I don't buy it though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都這麼說，但我不相信。

scripts.text:
[K]
Why don't you believe it? Why? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[K]
你為什麼不相信？為什麼？你知道些什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are the one who knows the truth, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
凱恩·沃爾特·沃克，知道真相的人是你。

scripts.text:
[K]
Tell me. Who are you? Do you know anything about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
說吧，你是誰？你知道伊森阿姆之死的真相嗎？

scripts.text:
[K]
Your life depends on your answer. I have enough reason to kill you since you know who I am.
scripts.translation:
[K]
你的回答會決定你的生死。既然你知道我的身份，我有充分理由殺你。

scripts.text:
[K]
Well, tell me.
Who are you? How did you find me? And what do you know about the death of Isenarm?
scripts.translation:
[K]
好吧，說吧。
你是誰？怎麼找到我的？你知道伊森阿姆之死的什麼內情？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am asked to investigate the death of Isenarm by Isenhonor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受伊森霍納所託，調查伊森阿姆的死因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While carrying out the investigation, I got the information that you would be here. I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
調查時我打聽到你在這裡，所以特地來見你。

scripts.text:
[K]
Isenhonor? At last, he is in action!
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍納？他終於開始行動了！

scripts.text:
[K]
Oh, please excuse my bad manners. I am sorry. Please forgive my earlier behavior.
scripts.translation:
[K]
啊，剛才失禮了。對不起，請原諒我剛才的態度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's OK. It wouldn't hurt to be careful, Kain Walther Walker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係，小心一點也好，凱恩·沃爾特·沃克。

scripts.text:
[K]
I cannot use the name, Walther, anymore.
When a star disappears, its satellite shall lost its name too. Even worse, I am a sinner who haven't been able to my star.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我已經不能再用“沃爾特”這個姓了。
星辰消失，追隨它的衛星也會失去名字。更何況，我是個連自己的星辰都沒能守護好的罪人。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is Isenhonor investigating the death of Isenarm? I will do my best to help him by his side.
scripts.translation:
[K]
伊森霍納在調查伊森阿姆之死？我願盡全力協助他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet. Isenhonor wants to know the truth behind his brother's death, but he is not in the position to carry out the investigation due to the circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還沒有。伊森霍納想查明哥哥死亡的真相，但受到各種限制，無法親自調查。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's why I, who is relatively free to move around, am is doing the research for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以由行動比較自由的我代他調查。

scripts.text:
[K]
Is that so... Then what can I do to help you? I'll do whatever I can do to reveal the truth.
scripts.translation:
[K]
這樣啊...那我能幫什麼忙？只要能查明真相，我什麼都願意做。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can tell me what happened when you were with Isenarm. Why you disappeared before Isenarm's death, why you are here and all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
告訴我你和伊森阿姆在一起時發生了什麼。你為什麼在他死前離開，又為什麼會在這裡，諸如此類。

scripts.text:
[K]
In fact I know nothing about his death myself. However, he ^0000cdsent me here with a mission^000000 before incident broke out.
scripts.translation:
[K]
事實上，我也不知道他是怎麼死的。不過，事發前他^0000cd派我去執行一項任務^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
When I was going to go back after completing the mission, he sent me a lot of money and a ^0000cdletter^000000. It said ^0000cdnot to return to Rune-Midgarts^000000.
scripts.translation:
[K]
我完成任務準備回去時，他寄來一大筆錢和一封^0000cd信^000000。信上說^0000cd不要回盧恩·米德加茲^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then?

[K]
I heard the news of his death after few days. I wanted to go back, but I couldn't because of his last order. I couldn't even be there by his side...
scripts.translation:
[K]
幾天後我聽說他死了。我想回去，卻不能違揹他的遺命，甚至沒能陪在他身邊...

scripts.text:
[K]
After a long time, I heard the rumor about the violent behavior which caused Isenarm to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
過了很久，我才聽說伊森阿姆因為突然暴走而被殺的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[K]
And also the story of the Guardian Knight who betrayed his master...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
還有那個背叛主人的守護騎士的傳聞...

scripts.text:
[K]
When I became a wanted man, I wanted to back and tell the truth. However, the letter said ^0000cdnot to return no matter what^000000. I couldn't let down the last order given by my master.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
我成了通緝犯後，也想回去說出真相。可是信上寫著^0000cd無論如何都不要回來^000000。師父最後的命令，我不能違背。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess Isenarm didn't want you to be involved. If anything happened to him, you would have been the one in the biggest trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想伊森阿姆是不想讓你捲入其中。萬一他出了什麼事，你也會惹上大麻煩。

scripts.text:
[K]
Ha... Perhaps... I didn't think of that... Here are the ^0000cdletter and sword Isenarm^000000 has give me.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
哈...也許吧...我之前沒想到...這是^0000cd伊森阿姆給我的信和劍^000000。

scripts.text:
[K]
Please give them to Isenhonor. I hope they help him recover his brother's honor.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
請把它們交給伊森霍納。希望這能幫他恢復哥哥的名譽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Keep the sword. The sword is like the life of the knight. I believe Isenarm would want you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
劍就留給你吧。劍對騎士來說就像生命一樣重要，我想伊森阿姆也希望你留下它。

scripts.text:
[K]
Then, have a safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
那麼，祝你一路順風。

scripts.text:
[K]
Did you deliver the letter and the words to Isenhonor well?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
你順利把信和我的話轉達給伊森霍納了嗎？

scripts.text:
[K]
Please let him know that I am ready to devote my life if he needs my help.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩]
請告訴他，只要他需要我，我隨時願意為他獻出生命。

scripts.text:
He is lying in bed, deeply wounded.
It doesn't seem that he is in the state to talk.
scripts.translation:
彼得躺在床上，傷勢很重。
看起來他現在無法交談。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
How disrespectful of you to enter without permission.
Get out of here now.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
未經允許就闖進來，太無禮了。
馬上出去。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please, calm down.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
請冷靜。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Why don't you enjoy the banquet?
Nyhill went to the Banquet Hall too.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你不去參加宴會嗎？
尼希爾也去了宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He didn't make a good first impression, but he is not a bad kid...
He is just...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼希爾給人的第一印象不太好，但他不是壞孩子...
他只是...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Well, I guess I shouldn't talk more.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我還是不多說了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here at last.
The archduke has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你總算來了。
大公一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem said he would visit your room after making all preparations. You may wait in your room.
We are counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆說，一切準備好後會去你房間找你。你可以先回房等候。
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I have heard the story from my father.
I have received the approval for you to access the Past Memories of the Royal Family freely.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我從父親那裡聽說了。
我已經批准你自由出入王室的過去記憶。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Let's talk about the Past Memories of the Royal Family tomorrow
Since you must be tired going through all the trouble today.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
王室過去記憶的事，我們明天再談吧。
你今天經歷了這麼多，想必很累了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Are you going back to that place?
Nillem has told me.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你又要去那裡嗎？
尼勒姆跟我說過了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That it is difficult for him to connect multiple times since he is just a human after all.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
畢竟他只是個普通人，很難一次又一次地連線多個次元。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I appreciate your efforts for the royal family.
But don't push yourself too hard.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
很感謝你為王室出力。
但別太勉強自己。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are here, just in time.
Are you going there again today?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你來得正好。
今天還要去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I see.
...Oh, do you know what Nyhill is doing?
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我明白了。
...對了，你知道尼希爾在做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
.....Never mind.
He must be staying quietly since he has been sentenced to disciplinary confinement.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...算了。
他既然被判了禁閉，應該正乖乖待著吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Sorry about all the trouble.
I hope it works this time.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
抱歉又要麻煩你。
希望這次能有所進展。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Please save the piece of Ymir Heart from Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
請從瓦爾基里手中奪回伊米爾之心碎片。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
...I know it is almost impossible to change the past.
But there is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...我知道改變過去幾乎不可能。
但我們別無他法。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We need to try everything we can do.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
能嘗試的辦法，我們都得試一遍。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
While you are on a mission down there, we are proceeding with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你在下面執行任務時，我們也會繼續調查。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We are searching for the lead to the intruders.
Let's play our parts well.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我們正在尋找入侵者的線索。
大家都做好自己的工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Nillem must be waiting for you.
Please do your best as always.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
尼勒姆應該在等你。
一如既往，拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You are back.
Is it the same this time?
I suppose so.
But, I really don't think all the efforts will go wasted.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
你回來了。
這次也沒什麼變化嗎？
我想也是。
不過，我不認為所有努力都會白費。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Thank you very much.
Someday, when you need the power of our family,
We will be on your side no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
非常感謝。
將來你需要海爾內家族的力量時，
無論發生什麼，我們都會站在你這邊。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
That is all we can give you for now as the reward.
I am sorry that we cannot offer you more.
I'll make sure there is no inconvenience to you while living in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
目前我們只能給你這些作為謝禮。
抱歉沒法提供更多。
我會確保你在宮裡生活得舒適。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
See you tomorrow then.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
明天見。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
You must be the returned hero invited to the banquet.
This banquet is for you. Please enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
您一定是受邀參加宴會的那位歸來英雄。
這場宴會是為您舉辦的，請盡情享用。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Haha... The archduke must be very angry.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
哈哈...大公一定很生氣吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I have participated in the Royal Assembly, but I wonder if it has been the right decision.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我參加了王室集會，但不確定這是否是正確的決定。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I tried to do this for everyone, but it seems to cause trouble.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我本想為大家做些事，沒想到反而惹了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
People tells me that I am a strong candidate in this, but I cannot be so sure.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
大家都說我是有力的候選人，可我自己並沒有把握。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I keep thinking about what a great responsibility it is, how harder I should try and all...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我一直在想，這責任有多重大，我還得多努力才能勝任...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Not that I can step back now. I guess all I can do is to do my best.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
不過現在也不能退縮了。我想只能盡力而為。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have never allowed your visit.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我可沒允許你來。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I am busy.
Please come back later
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我很忙。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
...It was a shame to cause such a scene
In front of a guest.
I apologize on the behalf of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
...在客人面前鬧出這種場面，實在失禮。
我代表海爾內家族向您道歉。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Let me introduce myself.
I am the current head of the Heine family, Friedrich Stoltze Heine.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
容我自我介紹。
我是海爾內家族現任家主，弗里德里希·施托爾策·海爾內。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
This is the former head of the family, Archduke Grantz, my father.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
這位是家族前任家主、我的父親格蘭茨大公。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
My name is Kronecker Grantz Heine.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我叫克羅內克·格蘭茨·海爾內。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich Stoltze]
This is Peter Heine the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希·施托爾策]
這位是海爾內家的彼得，王位候選人。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Nice to meet you.
It has turned out this way.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高興認識您。
事情竟然變成了這樣。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
The one who has left the room, making a fool of himself, is my son, Nyhill.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
剛才出醜離席的是我的兒子尼希爾。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He is a lineal family member of the Heine family.
But he still acts like a child like that.
Please excuse his bad manners.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他是海爾內家族的直系成員。
但還像個孩子似的胡鬧。
請原諒他的無禮。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Let him do whatever he pleases.
We cannot take care of him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
隨他去吧。
我們管不了他了。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
...Archduke, please don't be too harsh on Nyhill.
In fact, Nyhill was supposed to be the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
...大公，請別對尼希爾太苛刻。
其實原本該由尼希爾成為王位候選人。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am just a collateral member of the family after all...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
畢竟我只是家族的旁支...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Stop it there. There is no need for more words.
Nyhill doesn't have what it takes to be the king.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
夠了，不必再說。
尼希爾沒有當國王的資質。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
He doesn't have any elements to meet the legitimacy of the family. He cannot be chosen as the candidate.
He doesn't even know where he stands but still seems so hungry for power.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
他不具備海爾內家族繼承正統性的條件，不能成為候選人。
他連自己的身份都認不清，卻還渴望權力。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
It doesn't seem that way...
He must have been disheartened since his right has been neglected.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
事情似乎並不是那樣...
自己的權利被忽視，他一定很受打擊。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The right of the Heine family is everything which comes with the name of Heine.
Nyhill has everything.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
海爾內家族的權利，伴隨著海爾內之名而來。
尼希爾什麼都不缺。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Why doesn't that child realize it?
It is not appropriate to talk about the family matter in front of the guest.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那孩子為什麼就是不明白？
在客人面前談家事不合適。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Sorry about that.
Phew... I wonder what we have done to deserve a punk like that in the family.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
抱歉。
唉...我們到底造了什麼孽，家裡才會有這種朽魔。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have heard that you are the one who would attend the ritual.
Gratefully enough, the next king might be from the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
聽說你會出席儀式。
說不定下一任國王就會出自海爾內家族，真是萬幸。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
In the Royal Assembly earlier in which the candidates for the throne were tested...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
在之前的王室集會上，王位候選人接受了考驗...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Isenarm of the Walther family who happened to be the strongest candidate of all threatened other candidates all of a sudden.
Ernst of the Geoborg family had to execute him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
瓦爾特家族的伊森阿姆原本是最有力的候選人，卻突然威脅其他候選人。
格博格家的恩斯特只好將他處決。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
It seemed that Ernst was going to be named the next king, but he abruptly resigned.
...I guess he obeyed the will of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
恩斯特本來要成為下一任國王，卻突然退位了。
...我想他是遵從了女王的意願。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Due to the course of events, the Royal Assembly would be held again.
This time, Peter will participate as the representative of the Heine family.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
因此，王室集會將再次舉行。
這次由彼得代表海爾內家族參加。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And that Nyhill is so jealous of him now.
How low can he be?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
尼希爾現在嫉妒他。
真是卑鄙。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Hum... He actually is not a bad kid unlike his earlier words.
He has never acted to bring disgrace to the name of Heine.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
嗯...他其實不是壞孩子，不像他說話時那樣。
他從沒做過有損海爾內家族名譽的事。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I am not trying to defend him because he is my son.
Nyhill, he is just...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我不是因為他是我兒子才替他說話。
尼希爾他只是...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Don't try to speak for him. His incompetence is a sin.
Great magical power runs in the Heine for generations.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
別替他辯解。他的無能就是罪過。
強大的魔力世代流淌在海爾內家族的血脈中。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
There is a reason that he is called Mijeria.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
他被稱作“米傑莉亞”是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Don't be overly curious of our family matter.
Phew... I guess I will see you again later.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
別太好奇我們家族的事。
唉...之後再見吧。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The Royal Assembly will be over soon, and the ritual will be carried out when the final decision is made.
Enjoy the banquet until then and participate in the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
王室集會很快就會結束，最終決定作出後便會舉行儀式。
在那之前，請盡情參加宴會，到時也請出席儀式。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
It wouldn't long before Royal Assembly is over.
We have to prepare for it. Sorry that we cannot spend more time with you.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
王室集會很快就要結束了。
我們得去做準備。抱歉不能再多陪你。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Go visit other families if you have not visited them all.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
如果你還沒拜訪完其他家族，不妨去看看。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The Royal Assembly will be over soon.
As we expected, Peter seems to be a strong candidate.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
王室集會快結束了。
看來彼得確實是個很有力的候選人。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
How are you enjoying the banquet?
As soon as the Royal Assembly is completed, we will move to proceed with the final ritual...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
宴會還盡興嗎？
王室集會一結束，我們就要開始最後的儀式...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I'll send you a Court Mage.
Enjoy the banquet and go back to your room in time.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我會派宮廷魔法師去找您。
請盡情享用宴會，記得按時回房間。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I have been waiting for you.
Although I feel reluctant to reveal somewhat embarrassing part of the royal family to you,
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我一直在等您。
雖然不太願意讓您知道王室這些不光彩的往事，

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It was the royal family of Rune-Midgarts who let you observe the ritual anyway.
And you were the one who fought the intruders during the incident...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
但畢竟是盧恩·米德加茲王室邀請您來觀禮的。
而且事發時，也是您擊退了入侵者...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Without preamble,
Those intruders must have been after the^4d4dff piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我就直說了，
那些入侵者一定是衝著^4d4dff伊米爾之心碎片^000000來的。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We didn't know what was in the Room of Consciousness was ^4d4dffa fake piece of Imir Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們不知道意識之室裡的是^4d4dff假的伊米爾之心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We searched through the records of ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 for the record of that part.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們查閱了^4d4dff王室的過去記憶^000000，試圖找到相關記錄。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
We couldn't find any.
The only lead we got was a riddle.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
什麼也沒找到。
唯一的線索只是個謎題。

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是說，只有知曉真相的人才能讀懂？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
You must have seen it in the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
You are more cunning than I have thought of you.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
您一定是在王室的過去記憶中看到了那句話。
看來您比我想像中更敏銳。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What should we do to find out the truth?
We would have to go back in the time to the past.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們該怎麼查明真相？
看來只能回到過去。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Frietz, how did it go?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
弗里德里希，情況如何？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I found a Court Mage who specialized in that field.
He said that ^4d4dffhe sensed a huge twist of magical force in the Past Memories of the Royal Family, and we could depend on him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我找到了一位精通這方面的宮廷魔法師。
他說^4d4dff自己在王室的過去記憶中感受到了巨大的魔力扭曲，讓我們儘管交給他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He will bring the result soon.
He said he would connect the crack of the dimension by force.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他很快就會有結果。
他說要強行接上次元裂隙。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
He acts rather imprudently, but he is said to be quite skilled...
And you know him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
他做事雖然魯莽，但聽說本領很高...
而且您也認識他。

scripts.text: Is he Nillem?
scripts.translation: 是尼勒姆嗎？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
You seem to know him too.
You're right.
I want you to pair up with Nillem for this mission.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
看來您也認識他。
沒錯。
這次任務我希望您能和尼勒姆搭檔。

scripts.text: Me? Why?
scripts.translation: 我？為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
I'd like know that myself.
That Nillem pestered me to let him work with you.
...I tried my best not to slay him.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我也想知道。
是尼勒姆纏著我，非要和您搭檔。
...我已經盡力忍住沒殺他了。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
The Past Memories of the Royal Family is a special place which can be accessed by the royal families and few other people.
We cannot risk getting more people involved in this to keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
王室的過去記憶是個特殊的地方，只有王族和少數人能進入。
為了保守秘密，我們不能讓更多人捲入。

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
Sine you have already experienced the crack of dimension...
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
既然您之前經歷過次元裂隙...

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
We didn't have any other choices.
We will reward you handsomely. Please help us out.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
我們也別無選擇。
我們會給您豐厚的報酬，拜託了。

scripts.text: If you say so...
scripts.translation: 既然你這麼說...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Them, it's settled.
We will send Nillem to your room as soon as he is ready.
You may pair up with him for the mission.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那麼，就這麼定了。
尼勒姆準備好後會去您的房間找您。
這次任務就由你們搭檔完成。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
And this is what has been given to the ones contributed to the royal family.
You have received it once when you went down there right after you came to the palace. Do you remember?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
這是給為王室出過力之人的獎勵。
您剛來宮殿時下去過一次，那時也領過，還記得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It must be useful to people like you.
I hope it helps.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
這東西對您應該有用。
希望能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
The magician called Nillem will find you.
You may wait in your room.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
尼勒姆會去找您。
您可以在房間等他。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is too early to lose our hope.
I believe you will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
現在放棄還太早。
我相信您能辦到。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你行李很多啊，沒問題嗎？
看起來又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
要不要精簡一些？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The Roegenburg welcomes adventurers with various experiences, but it is somewhat early for us to work with you.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
羅根堡歡迎經驗豐富的冒險者，不過現在還不是與您合作的時候。
希望以後能再見。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
How could you come in here?
Nobody can come into this place if you are not a staff. Please go outside.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你怎麼進來的？
非工作人員不得進入，請出去。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Hello, adventurers. I am honored you have visited the ^0000cdRoegenburg^000000. I am ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你好，冒險者。歡迎造訪^0000cd羅根堡^000000。
我是^0000cd馬克西米利安·羅根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
We are one of seven royal families that found the kingdom and have work hard for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我們是建立王國的七大王族之一，一直為盧恩·米德加茲王國效力。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, the heir of our family, is supposed to participate in the royal assembly. How about seeing him?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
^0000cd赫爾穆特·羅根堡^000000是我們家的繼承人，也會參加王室集會。要見見他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hello, I am ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你好，我是^0000cd赫爾穆特·羅根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I'm invited to this banquet. {1} It is nice to see you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是受邀來參加宴會的。{1}很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am honored to see the hero who defeated Morocc. Please enjoy your time while you are in the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
見到擊敗夢羅克的英雄，我深感榮幸。您在羅根堡期間，請盡情享受。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you have time, how about seeing the rest people of the Roegenburg?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
有時間的話，要不要見見羅根堡家族的其他人？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Brother, it will be helpful to listen to the story of the family from ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
哥哥，聽^0000cd沃爾夫·羅根堡^000000講講家族的事，應該會對你有幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is a good opportunity, of course.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好啊，這確實是個好機會。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Did you see the children of the Roegenburg? They look like babies, but now when I see them in the palace, I am pleased that they are almost grown up.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
您見過羅根堡家的孩子們了嗎？他們看起來還小。不過現在在宮裡見到他們，發現都長大了，我很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
You met Helmut already. It will be helpful to you if you meet the second son, Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
您已經見過赫爾穆特了。再見見二兒子沃爾夫，對您也會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
He is in charge of all matters of the Roegenburg instead of the first son who is busy for participation in the royal assembly and protection of the border. You will hear lots of interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
大兒子忙著參加王室集會、保衛邊境，所以家族事務都由他處理。你們會聊到不少有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The Roegenburg is proud that we are descents of Wilhelm, the national hero, and contributed to the foundation and development of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
羅根堡家族是民族英雄威廉的後裔，為盧恩·米德加茲王國的建立與發展出過力，我們深以為榮。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Therefore, we hoped that the children could grow into decent adults, but they were raised without their parents' care and now they tend to behave rudely and act as they want.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我們本希望孩子們能成長為體面的人，可惜他們從小缺少父母照顧，現在行事粗魯、任性妄為。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you feel uncomfortable when you talk with them, please understand kindly.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
如果和他們交談時覺得不自在，還請多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
They are the children who will lead the family, but they are going different from what the Roegenburg aims for.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
他們將來要領導家族，卻走上了與羅根堡理想相反的道路。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The first son stays on the front, risking his life everyday and the second is doing business, which is against the family tradition.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
大兒子每天冒著生命危險留在前線，二兒子卻去經商，這與家族傳統背道而馳。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The third son would leave the house and hang out on the back street, but we cannot continue to employ some to monitor him all the times.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
三兒子離家出走，在後街遊蕩。我們也不能一直派人盯著他。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But the youngest, Agnes, has grown as good girl and I am happy when I think of her.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
不過，小女兒阿格妮絲已經長成了懂事的好孩子。想到她我就很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ah, I am sorry to talk too much on our family. I have become talkative as I get old.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
啊，抱歉說了這麼多家族的事。年紀大了，話也變多了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please forgive me grumbling and forget this old man's complaints.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
請原諒我發牢騷，別把這個老頭的話放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Myer, Myer...
I cannot believe that Myer did that.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
邁爾，邁爾...
我不敢相信邁爾會做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
He spread the bad rumor about the family but I think he did it because he is desperate.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
他散佈了家族的壞話，不過我想他也是走投無路才這麼做的。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have let the children do as they want but I wanted to avoid a war.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我曾放任孩子們隨心所欲，只希望能避免戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But I know it is unlikely that Helmut becomes a king and so leave them to do as they like.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
但我知道赫爾穆特當上國王的希望不大，所以就由著他們去了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
However, I would like to leverage this opportunity to collect the capabilities of the family members to protect the family.
Opportunities are found in times of crisis.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
不過，我想借此機會集結家族成員的力量，保護家族。
危機中也藏著機遇。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please bring Helmut. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
請把赫爾穆特帶來。他應該在^0000cd靠近修瓦爾茲巴爾德邊境的檢查哨^000000，負責巡邏隊。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Welcome adventurer. Did you have a safe travel?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
歡迎，冒險者。旅途還順利嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I cannot see Helmut. Did he refuse to come?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我沒看到赫爾穆特。他不肯來嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he left a message for two of you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他給你們兩位留了話。

scripts.text: [Told Maximilian and Wolf about Helmut's will and the successorship]
scripts.translation: [我把赫爾穆特的心願和繼承權一事告訴了馬克西米利安和沃爾夫。]

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I knew something when Helmut left, but I didn't expect that he would give up the successorship.
But if that is what Helmut wants, I don't object to it.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
赫爾穆特離開時，我就隱約察覺到了，但沒想到他會放棄繼承權。
不過既然這是他的意願，我不會反對。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
This fact will be announced as soon as the royal assembly and banquet are finished. Wolf, now you should lead our family. I hope this will not be a burden to you.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
等王室集會和宴會結束，我們就會公佈此事。沃爾夫，以後家族就由你來帶領了。希望這不會成為你的負擔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have taken a firm attitude that you never showed before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你剛才表現得很堅定，和平時不太一樣。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Once I tried to move the children as I want and failed. Since then I left them to do as they like. But now I know.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我曾試圖讓孩子們按我的想法行事，卻失敗了。從那以後，我便放手讓他們自己做主。但現在我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I realized that a new age needs children. I will work for the family and country in the way the children wants to do.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我明白新時代需要年輕人。我會用他們自己的方式，為家族和國家效力。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I seem to have forced my way to Helmut and people in the family.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我好像一直在勉強赫爾穆特，也給家裡人添了不少壓力。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
There is something rather than a war to have influence up to every corner in the continent.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
除了戰爭，還有別的方式能讓影響力遍及整片大陸。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
As Myer said, I am looking for other approaches and I will.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
正如邁爾所說，我會繼續尋找別的出路。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, if you don't mind, won't you deliver my will to ^0000cdMyer^000000?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，如果方便的話，能替我把心意轉達給^0000cd邁爾^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
That I have given up wars and am looking for better solution and that if he can, visit the family and see the people.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
告訴他我已經放棄戰爭，正在尋找更好的解決辦法。如果他願意，歡迎來家裡看看大家。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am willing to do so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很樂意。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Please deliver the story of Helmut to Myer.
He must be somewhere in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
請把赫爾穆特的訊息轉達給邁爾。
他應該在普隆德拉某處。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
歡迎回來，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, did you deliver the message to Myer? what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，你把話轉達給邁爾了嗎？他怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He said it is good to give up wars. Myer has a lot of trust in you. He said he would help you as much as he can, if you need his help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
轉達了...中間雖然發生了些事，不過結果還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I want him to visit us more than to help me.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
比起幫我，我更希望他能常來家裡看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, he also said he would come after the banquet is finished.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，他還說宴會結束後就會過來。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Well I am happy that our relationship will improve.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
太好了，我很高興我們的關係能有所改善。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Once, we were the closest friends, but the relationship became awkward after he left the family.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
曾經，我們是最好的朋友，但在他離開家族後，關係就變得尷尬了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Anyway, I think we have to make preparation to welcome him seriously.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
總之，我們得認真準備，正式迎接他回來。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I am glad that now everything has found its place. I have been worried a lot.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
看到事情都已各歸其位，我很高興。我之前一直很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
All theses things are thanks to you. I feel safe now that everyone has their right places and will work hard for the family and country.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
這一切都多虧了您。如今大家各司其職，都願意為家族和國家盡力，我總算安心了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer. Thank you very much for helping my family. I have been thinking how I can reward you for your contribution, but cannot find anything that is comparable to the magnitude of thank.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
親愛的冒險者，非常感謝你幫助我的家族。我一直想報答你的付出，卻想不出什麼禮物能回報這份恩情。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
However at least to express my mind, I have prepare a small present. Please take it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
不過，為了表達我的心意，我準備了一份小禮物。請收下。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you need a help from the Roegenburg, come to use anytime. The gate of the Roegenburg is always opened to you.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
如果你需要羅根伯格家族的幫助，隨時來找我們。羅根伯格家族的大門永遠為你敞開。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I wanted to thank you always. Thanks to your contribution, my family is returning to safety.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
我一直想向你道謝。多虧了你的幫助，我的家族正在恢復安寧。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
It seems that my family had no problem, but inside the wall, we didn't have trust in one another and were not mixed.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
表面上看，我的家族似乎沒什麼問題，但家族內部彼此缺乏信任，也未能融洽相處。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But now we are getting along. Thank you very much again.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
但現在我們相處得很好。再次非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes Roegenburg]
Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲·羅根伯格]
嗯，你好像帶了很多行李。要不要清理一些？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Hello, nice to meet you.
Did you visit to see my grandfather?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你好，很高興見到你。
你是來探望我祖父的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If so, he is over there. You can find him there.
Then, have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
如果是的話，祖父就在那邊。去找他吧。
那麼，祝你玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Did you see my brothers?
If you don't, make sure to see Wolf and have talk with him.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你見到我哥哥們了嗎？
如果還沒見到，一定要去找狼聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Nowadays, he shares many works with my grandfather and he has a lot to talk with you.
So the time for me to talk with him is quite reduced though.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
最近，他和祖父一起處理了許多事務，也有很多話想跟你說。
這樣一來，我能和他說話的時間就少多了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
The banquet has started but I haven't yet found any body who I go with.
Originally Wolf is supposed to go with me, but it is canceled as he became busy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
宴會已經開始了，可我還沒找到舞伴。
原本狼說要陪我去，但他臨時忙起來，只好作罷。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If he had told me earlier he cannot go, I wouldn't have refused all those proposals.
Myer said he would go with me, but I am afraid he may leave as wind anytime.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
如果他早點告訴我不能陪我去，我就不會拒絕其他人的邀請了。
邁爾說願意陪我去，可我擔心他隨時會像風一樣溜走。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I don't want anything big...
When we were young, we played together. They read me books.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我不求什麼盛大的場面...
小時候，我們總在一起玩，哥哥們還會給我讀書。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I still like the best the books that my brothers read me.
Those princes and princesses in those books were all my friend.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我最喜歡哥哥們讀給我的那些書。
書裡的王子和公主，都是我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Recently I read a story on a knight who sacrifices himself for a lady.
In the story, the lady handed a pretty handkerchief to the knight.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
最近讀到一個故事，講一位騎士為一位女士犧牲自己。
故事裡，女士把一條漂亮的手帕交給騎士。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Then, I realized that what I had lacked.
It was a pretty handkerchief.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
然後我才意識到自己缺少什麼。
一條漂亮的手帕。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So I carry lots of pretty handkerchiefs so that I can hand them to my knight anytime.
But there is no one for me to hand my handkerchiefs to...
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
所以我隨身帶著許多漂亮的手帕，隨時準備遞給我的騎士。
可我卻沒有可以送手帕的騎士...

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Did you see him too?
He came with Myer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你也見到他了嗎？
他是和邁爾一起來的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
He is so handsome. I wonder what family he is from.
I am sorry that I left so early that I couldn't talk with him at all. I asked Myer who he is, but he didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
他長得真帥。不知道他來自哪個家族。
真遺憾，我走得太早，完全沒能和他說上話。我問邁爾他是誰，可他沒告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer?
Wolf is looking for you. Do you have an appointment with him?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者？
狼在找你。你和他有約嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Why don't you visit Wolf?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你不去看看狼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
He is my brother, but he and other brothers are so childish.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
他是我哥哥，但他和其他哥哥們都很孩子氣。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Go out to the street in Prontera and ask 5-year old children, even they know the answer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
去普隆德拉的街上問問吧，就連五歲的小孩都知道答案。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
They are overlooking something bigger due to their personal desires. Of course, I also hate them and want to take revenge, but it does not solve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
他們只顧個人慾望，忽略了更重要的事。當然，我也討厭他們，想要報復，但那解決不了問題。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If they had thought about how the citizens of the kingdom can live more happily, they would not have acted like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
如果他們能想想如何讓王國的市民生活得更幸福，就不會那樣做了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Anyway, let's wait and see, as they are trying to think like adults.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
總之，先等等看吧，畢竟他們也在試著像大人一樣思考。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I feel safe that my grandfather stays with me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
但祖父陪在我身邊，讓我感到安心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You seem to have come to see my brothers? but there is no one in the house.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你好像是來看我哥哥們的？但家裡沒人。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
In a long time, we were together, but they left and I am lonely again. It is nice that they don't fight one another any more.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
過了很久，我們才又團聚，可他們一離開，我又孤單起來。至少他們現在不再彼此爭鬥了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, welcome back.
Pearls? soft hairs? Have you brought them?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎回來。
珍珠？柔軟的毛髮？你帶回來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are.
Am I too late?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給您。
我來得太晚了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Not yet? OK. We have still time.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
還沒？沒關係，我們還來得及。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You forget what I asked didn't you? ^0000cdThey are three {0} and 50 strands of {1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你忘了我讓你帶什麼了嗎？^0000cd是3個{0}和50根{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Please don't be late!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
請不要遲到！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
No! you have brought all of them. I'm so happy!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
不！你全都帶來了。我好開心！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'll take pearls to the jeweler, the best jeweler. They are so pretty!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我要把珍珠帶去給最好的珠寶商。它們真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'll send soft hairs too. I wonder what they will turn into.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
柔軟的毛髮也要送去。不知道會變成什麼樣子。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, I need a handkerchief. There are so many things to do and I'm so busy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
啊，我還需要手帕。要做的事情太多了，我好忙。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh, I would like to thank you for working hard for me. Here you are.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
哦，我想謝謝你為我這麼辛苦。給你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
And Can I ask you to get more? I am afraid that cloth is not sufficient.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
還有，能請你再帶一些嗎？我怕布料不夠。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess so. I will help you to the best of my ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想是的。我會盡力幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
You really understand me. I'm so happy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你真懂我。我好開心。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank you very much
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
See you tomorrow. Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
明天見。祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, welcome back. You are a great person. I think you have obtained all, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎回來。你真是個好人。我想你應該都拿到了吧。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
If not, I will be really sad. I'm skipping meals to wear the pretty dress. So I'm so sensitive now.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
如果沒有的話，我會很難過的。為了穿漂亮的裙子，我都在節食呢。所以現在我很敏感。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry but I forgot what I should get.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我忘了該拿什麼了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh, it's disappointing! I thought you would have a good memory as an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
哦，真讓人失望！我還以為作為冒險者，你的記憶力會很好呢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, I'm sorry. I got angry suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
啊，對不起。我剛才突然發火了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
As I told you before. I didn't eat meals these days. Please forgive my misbehavior. Did yo get what I asked?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
就像我之前說的，這幾天我都沒怎麼吃東西。請原諒我的失態。你拿到我讓你找的東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
^0000cd15 pieces of {0}, 30 {1}, and 10 {2}^000000. I'll make a pink dress that is softer than flower petal.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
^0000cd15個{0}，30個{1}，還有10個{2}^000000。我要用它們做一條比花瓣還要柔軟的粉色裙子。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Then, please get them for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
那麼，請幫我拿到它們吧。

如果沒有的話，我會很難過的。為了穿漂亮的裙子，我都在節食呢。所以現在我很敏感。

scripts.text:

Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些是你想要的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Let me see.... Yes! they are what I wanted. You are the best.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
讓我看看...對！就是這些！你真是最棒的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It is very soft. Softer than the pink flower petals. If I make a flower with theses, the dress will feel like a flower.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
摸起來真柔軟，比粉色花瓣還柔軟。用這些做成花朵裝飾，裙子穿起來就會像花朵一樣輕盈。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, Thank you very much. This is a small token of my sincerity.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，非常感謝你。這是我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Can I ask you to bring more? I need lots of dresses.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
能再請你帶些材料來嗎？我還想做更多裙子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Or your brother started fight again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

I need your help desperately!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

我急需你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
What ?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Why do you prepare to fight?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你為什麼要準備戰鬥？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It is not light that.
Fighting is not all about living.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I heard from Myer that he is sorry that he cannot come with me to the banquet. He said that he would send a handsome guy as my partner instead him.
and that I should prepare to go with him.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我聽說邁爾很抱歉不能陪我去參加宴會。他說會派一位英俊的男士代替他做我的舞伴，
讓我做好準備和他一起去。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, you should!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Yes!!!

scripts.text:
[Agnes]

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

it is a ^0000cdpearl^000000! elegant and gentle gloss! Valuable jewel coming from pains!

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I would like to use pearls to make a necklace and bracelet. You can get pearls from monsters. Can you get them for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然可以

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 這會很困難

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it will be difficult to get pearls. It is really difficult. It is beyond my ability. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得弄到珍珠會很困難。真的很難。這超出了我的能力範圍。很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Yes... I know it will be very difficult. If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
是的...我知道這非常困難。如果你改變主意了，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank god. I was afraid that you would refuse it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
謝天謝地。我還以為你會拒絕我呢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I carry this to the banquet whatever I wear. And can ask you do me a favor one more?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
To produce good cloth, good threads are necessary. To extract good threads, ^0000cdsoft hair^000000 is the best. Would you get soft fur for me too?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is not difficult.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這並不難。

scripts.text:

I think ^0000cd3 {0} ^000000are enough and 50 strands of {1}^0000cdare required^000000.

[Agnes]

scripts.translation:

我宴會的成敗就掌握在你手中了。我會盡我所能，讓它成為有史以來最棒的宴會之一。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, what are you doing here?
Did you come for my dress?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，你在這裡做什麼？
你是來找我做衣服的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I'm still making the dress using what you got for me.
I'll decide what to make next after completing this.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
但我還在用你幫我弄到的材料做衣服。
做完這件之後，我再決定接下來做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Thank you for visiting but I am sorry that I cannot help you.
Would you come back later in the afternoon?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
謝謝你的光臨，但很抱歉我現在幫不了你。
你下午晚些時候再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer. Thanks for coming. I thought all day of what dress to make. I cannot decide still.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，謝謝你來。我整天都在琢磨該做什麼裙子，可到現在還是拿不定主意。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
A golden dress shining brighter than the sun? Or a sliver dress shining more gentile than the moon? Or a dress greener than tree leaves?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
是比太陽更閃耀的金色禮服？還是比月亮更溫柔的銀色禮服？亦或是比樹葉更翠綠的禮服？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, how can I fit the pearl necklace and look nice with my partner?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
啊，我該怎麼搭配那條珍珠項鍊，才能和舞伴相得益彰呢？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I have made a decision!!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我決定了！！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I like a black dress that reminds of dark night. A dress so elegant and beautiful that makes people to admire in silence.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我喜歡讓人聯想到深夜的黑色禮服。一件如此優雅美麗的禮服，讓人只能靜靜地欣賞。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]

scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你曾經直視過燃燒的太陽嗎？我相信你沒有。太陽的光芒會刺痛直視它的人的眼睛，讓人無法再看。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I would like to make a fairy dress! A dress so shining in golden light that anyone should admire it.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我想做一件仙子般的禮服！讓它在金色光芒中閃耀，人人見了都會讚歎。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I was thinking of how I can emphasize my pearl necklace.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我一直在想怎麼突出我的珍珠項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Flower! It a flower! Large and shining jewels are too common here in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
花！我要做成花朵！宮殿裡大而閃亮的寶石已經太常見了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I prefer the soft pink dress other than young flower petal blooming on a large field. To be like that, I think I need a very soft silk cloth.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我更喜歡柔和的粉色禮服，就像廣闊田野上綻放的花朵一樣。要做出那種效果，我想需要非常柔軟的絲綢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
In the banquet, if my soft dress widens like young flower petal, the place will be full with fragrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
宴會上，我那柔軟的裙襬若能像花瓣般綻開，整個大廳都會充滿芬芳。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
The width of the skirt should be as wider as possible. The dress will look like a flower petal shaking every time I move.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
裙襬應該儘可能寬大。這樣每次我移動時，禮服都會像花瓣一樣搖曳。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, Would get me ^0000cd{0}^000000? ^0000cd15 pieces^000000 will do.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，能幫我弄到^0000cd{0}^000000嗎？^0000cd15個^000000就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I also need herbs used to dye the cloth. ^0000cd30 {0} and 10 {1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我還需要用來染布的草藥。^0000cd30個{0}和10個{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I see a dress in you hands that look like a flower petal.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我看到你手裡那件禮服了，樣子像花瓣一樣。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I want to be a flower in the banquet hall. I want to make people to admire me like a flower that fascinates with delicate fragrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我想成為宴會大廳裡最亮眼的那朵花，讓大家像欣賞一朵散發著淡淡香氣的花一樣，為我著迷。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I'm going to use flowers to make a corsage. Please get me some flowers. No common flowers. I heard that rare flowers can be obtained in a far foreign country.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我要用鮮花做一朵胸花。請幫我找些花來，不要普通的花。我聽說遙遠的異國有稀有花卉。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I saw those flowers once. They were so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我曾經見過那些花。它們非常美麗。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, please get me ^0000cd5 {0}, 5 {1} and 5 {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，請幫我弄到^0000cd5個{0}，5個{1}和5個{2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
My beautiful corsage is up to you!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我那美麗的胸花就拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Yesterday, when I was thinking watching the night sky, I found that stars were twinkling.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
昨天，當我仰望夜空時，我發現星星在閃爍。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It was so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off them.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
它們太美了，讓我移不開目光。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
What I ask you today is....
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我今天想請你幫忙的是...

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Start dust.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
星塵。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Imagine that star dusts are gently scattered on a beautiful dress. You won't be able to take your eyes from them.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
想像一下，把星塵輕輕灑在漂亮的禮服上。那一定讓人移不開目光。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I will be the brightest star in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我將成為宴會上最亮的星。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So please get me ^0000cd5 {0}^000000. I think that amount of star dusts can decorate the entire dress.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
請幫我找^0000cd5個{0}^000000。我想這些星塵足以裝飾整件禮服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Don't forget. My shining dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
別忘了。我那閃耀的禮服就託付給你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Cloth is sufficient, but the problem is decoration. I heard that there is something called fairy's wing.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
布料已經夠了，可裝飾還沒著落。我聽說有種東西叫“仙子之翼”。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
It will make a dress as elegant as fairy and on which I can work lightly. The thought alone makes you fascinated?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
用它裝飾的禮服會像仙子一樣優雅，穿起來也很輕盈。光是想想就讓人著迷呢。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Every time I step, the luxury lace will flutter, making people to imagine a fairy waling in the wood. The dress will make me better.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
每走一步，華麗的蕾絲都會隨之飄動，讓人彷彿看見仙子漫步在林間。這件禮服一定會讓我更加出眾。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Of course, I will not attach them as they are. I know a person who will modify them properly.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
當然，我不會直接把它們縫上去。我認識一位能妥善改造它們的人。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, Please get me ^0000cd5 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，請幫我弄到^0000cd5個{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
My fairly-like dress is up to you hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我那仙子般的禮服就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
But I wonder how many people lost their eyes after watching the sun directly. Why do people watch that burning fire? What is it?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
不過我很好奇，有多少人直視太陽後失去了視力。人們為什麼要看那團燃燒的火呢？那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer. I want to have that burning fire.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者。我想要那團燃燒的火。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I heard that there is the ^0000cdhot hair^000000 that looks burning but not hot at all, though the name sounds contradictory.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我聽說有一種^0000cd熱發^000000，雖然名字聽起來自相矛盾，但它看起來像在燃燒，實際上卻一點也不燙。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I will use it to make a beautiful shawl. As soon as I enter the banquet hall, I will be able to give a strong impression.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我要用它做一條美麗的披肩。當我走進宴會廳時，一定能給人留下強烈的印象。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Please get me ^0000cd20 strands of {0}^000000.

[Agnes]
My beautiful shawl burning like the sun is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我那如太陽般燃燒的華麗披肩就託付給你了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
I should make a dress that is as far and mysterious as a dark night.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我該做一件像深夜般深邃神秘的禮服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
