I will go around the banquet hall like a sleek cat, concealing everything underneath the black dress.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我要像一隻矯健的貓，在宴會廳裡穿梭，把一切都藏在黑色禮服之下。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
To do so, I think I need ^0000cd20 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
為此，我想我需要^0000cd20個{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
This will be beautiful dress without a decoration.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
這將是一件無需裝飾的美麗禮服。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, my black night-like dress is up to your hands.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，我那如黑夜般的禮服就託付給你了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hello.
I am Helmut Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你好。
我叫赫爾穆特·羅根堡。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you want to listen to the story of my family, see my ^0000cdgrandfather^000000 who is over there.
He will explain better than me.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
如果你想聽聽我們家族的故事，可以去找那邊的^0000cd祖父^000000。
他比我更會講。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Did you see my brother, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000?
He is in charge of all household matters helping our grandfather while I am away here on the front.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你見到我的兄弟，^0000cd沃爾夫·羅根堡^000000了嗎？
在我前線駐守期間，他負責協助祖父處理家中所有事務。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you want to know about the Roegenburg, it will be a quality time.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
想了解羅根堡家族的話，和他聊聊一定很愉快。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am glad that I come back home and can see the family members.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我很高興能回到家，見到家人們。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But when I think of the front threatened by the monster, I feel heavy-hearted. Of course, I believe that my men are doing well to protect the territory.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
但一想到前線正受到魔物的威脅，我就感到心情沉重。當然，我相信我的部下們正努力保護著這片領土。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I want to run back to them as soon as the banquet is finished.
This place is somewhat stuffy to me.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
宴會一結束，我就想立刻回去找他們。
這裡對我來說有點沉悶。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Dear adventurer, hello.
I am ^0000cdKalbern^000000 and a chamberlain of Helmut.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
親愛的冒險者，你好。
我是^0000cd卡爾貝恩^000000，赫爾穆特的侍從長。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I served Helmut in a harsh front in the border area. Now I am in Prontera, the capital city of Rune-Midgarts and I cannot adapt to this situation
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
我曾陪赫爾穆特駐守邊境艱苦的前線。如今到了盧恩·米德加茲的首都普隆德拉，我反而有些不適應。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I also lose my nerve when I see noble people and royal family in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
看到宮殿裡的貴族和皇室成員時，我也會感到緊張。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I didn't recognize when I served Helmut on the front but here, he seems a little away as I feel that he is the heir of a royal family.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
在前線跟隨赫爾穆特時，我還沒意識到這一點。到了這裡，才真切感受到他身為王位繼承人的身份，覺得他離我遠了些。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
He treated solders and working children equally. So everybody liked him and followed him.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
他平等對待士兵和隨軍的孩子，因此大家都喜歡他、願意追隨他。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I also thank him for accepting me after my parents were killed by the monster.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
父母被魔物殺害後，是他收留了我，我一直很感激。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
To repay his kindness, I begged him to serve him and I am staying with him...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
為了報答他的恩情，我苦苦請求他讓我留下侍奉他...之後便一直跟在他身邊。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I have nothing to do for Helmut except bring him some beer.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
在這裡，除了給赫爾穆特送點啤酒，我沒什麼事可做。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I wish that the banquet is finished and go back early.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
我希望宴會快點結束，好早點回去。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
But, I don't mean that I don't want him to become a king.
I am just uncomfortable to be here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
但這並不意味著我不希望他成為國王。
我只是在這裡感到不自在。

scripts.text:
[Wolf Roegenburg]
Well, you seem to have lots of luggage. How about removing some?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫·羅根堡]
嗯，你看起來行李很多。要不要卸下一些？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Thank you for visiting the Roegenburg.
Won't you see my grandfather and patriarch of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdMaximilian Roegenburg^000000?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
感謝你來訪。
要不要去見見我的祖父，也是羅根堡家族的族長，^0000cd馬克西米利安·羅根堡^000000？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
He enjoys talking with adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
他喜歡和冒險者交談。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, it is a honor to have you in the Roegenburg.
I am the second son of the Roegenburg, ^0000cdWolf Roegenburg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，您能造訪羅根堡家族，是我們的榮幸。
我是羅根堡家的二兒子，^0000cd沃爾夫·羅根堡^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
To carry on the will of Wilhelm Roegenburg, a national hero, we, at the Roegenburg, are making lots of efforts to protect honor, justice and traditions.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
為了繼承國民英雄威廉·羅根堡的遺志，我們羅根堡家族正努力維護榮譽、正義與傳統。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Since the foundation of Rune-Midgarts, lots of people from the Roegenburg have made contribution to the country and this is our pride.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
自盧恩·米德加茲建國以來，羅根堡家族為國家的貢獻不計其數，這也是我們的驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Currently ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000, who is an excellent candidate for the throne, is participating in the royal assembly. Did you see him?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
目前，作為王位繼承人的有力競爭者，^0000cd赫爾穆特·羅根堡^000000正在參加皇家議會。你見到他了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I saw him just before. Who is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我剛才見過他。他是誰？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Dear adventurer, it is nice to see you. I am ^0000cdAgnes Roegenburg^000000 and the youngest of the four of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
親愛的冒險者，見到你很高興。我是^0000cd阿格妮絲·羅根堡^000000，羅根堡家四兄妹中最小的一個。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Do you have a partner to go with to the banquet? I have no one to go with. No one takes my fancy.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你有伴一起去宴會嗎？我沒有。沒有誰讓我看得上眼。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Agnes, don't say that. it is not appropriate. We are telling the adventurer of the story of the Roegenburg...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
阿格妮絲，別這麼說。這樣很不合適。我們正在向冒險者講述羅根堡家族的故事...

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Now, will my prince come with me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
好了，我的王子殿下，你要跟我走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Ah, Myer, brother! brother!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
啊，邁爾，哥哥！哥哥！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Thanks for coming at the right time. Dear adventurer,
This is ^0000cdMyer Roegenburg^000000 and he is the third son of the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
謝謝你及時趕到。親愛的冒險者，
這位是^0000cd邁爾·羅根堡^000000，他是羅根堡家的三兒子。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I was away for a long time and have just came back. It is right, isn't?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我離家很久了，剛回來。是這樣吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, about half. I heard that ^0000cda war manic and a peddler would join hands and participate in the royal assembly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，差不多吧。我聽說^0000cd一個戰爭狂人和一個商販要聯手參加皇家議會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
So I came back for a short stay. I heard that the relationship between brothers was not close but has suddenly deeper. I cannot be out.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
所以我才回來小住一陣。聽說兄弟們原本關係不太親近，最近卻突然親密起來。我可不能錯過。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What your language. ^0000cdEven though you go outside and hang out with low fellows,^000000 you don't have make the place where you live a dirty back street.
You didn't think that I am ignorant of the fellows that you hang out with, did you?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你說話真難聽。^0000cd你出去跟那些下等人鬼混也就算了，^000000可別把家裡弄得像髒亂的後街。
你以為我不知道你平時都跟誰來往嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Of course I know that grandfather and you sent people to monitor me. They were so awkward and all other fellow knew it.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我當然知道祖父和你派人監視我。他們做得太拙劣了，其他人都看得出來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
My noble brother doesn't like my way of speaking?
If we join hands and ^0000cdHelmut becomes a king^000000,^0000cdthe whole country will ^000000turn into a back street except the palace. Isn't it better to hear it now to reduce the shock you will have later?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我高貴的哥哥不喜歡我的說話方式？
如果我們聯手，^0000cd赫爾穆特成為國王^000000，^0000cd整個國家除了皇宮^000000都會變成後街。現在告訴你，總比以後讓你受到衝擊要好，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, you may not hear as you will stay at home and calculate the money you will make from wars.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，你可能聽不進去，因為你只會待在家裡計算戰爭能賺多少錢。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are unbelievably rude. I told you should call me politely.
Until when are you going to act like that?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你簡直粗魯得令人難以置信。我告訴過你要禮貌地稱呼我。
你還要這樣多久？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Stop all of you! We have gathered here for fight. This is a banquet for the adventurer. We shouldn't do this in front of the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你們都住口！我們聚在這裡不是為了吵架的！這是為冒險者準備的宴會，不該當著他的面鬧成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Especially you lack dignity. What would the adventurer think of us?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
尤其是你，太失禮了。冒險者會怎麼看我們？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes, you are right. I think I am the unwelcome guest. I'd better leave. Agnes, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
是的，你說得對。我覺得自己是個不受歡迎的客人。我最好離開。阿格妮絲，我稍後回來。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Oh my god, I forgot. I have to make preparations!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
天哪，我忘了！我得去準備了！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Sorry for this unpleasant situation. I never meant to do so. Apologies if you feel uncomfortable. Myer made rude remarks as he came back in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
抱歉讓您遇到這種不愉快的情況。我本無意如此，如果您感到不適，請見諒。邁爾是因為很久沒回來，才說了些失禮的話。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I will tell him to make a polite apology to you later. Actually he is different from what you saw. Please understand kindly.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
稍後我會讓他向您正式道歉。其實他和您看到的並不一樣，請多多包涵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is ok with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係，我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
By the way, dear adventurer, can you do me a favor if you have time?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
順便問一下，親愛的冒險者，如果您有空的話，能幫我一個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, pleas go ahead.

[Wolf]
I hope you will visit the Wigner and bring a thing from ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
希望您能去一趟維格納家族，從^0000cd艾薩克·維格納^000000那裡取一樣東西。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Originally, I should do that, but I think I need to talk with Myer seriously. So I would like to do that for me...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
本來該由我去，可我得和邁爾好好談談。所以想請您代勞...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
So, please do it for me. Of course, you may refuse it. But I wonder I can find a reliable person like you.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
所以，拜託您幫我辦這件事。當然，您也可以拒絕。不過，像您這樣可靠的人可不常見。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a test to find that I am reliable.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是在測試我是否可靠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Ah, no it is not. If you feel unpleasant, I am sorry. I just don't have reliable person.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
啊，不，不是的。如果您覺得不舒服，我很抱歉。我只是沒有可以信賴的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok. Go to the Wigner and ask Isaac Wigner for the thing that you requested. Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。去維格納找艾薩克·維格納，拿你要的東西。是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes. right.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
是的，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Walk along the ^0000cdcorridor. The Wigner is in the last room^000000.
Find Isaac and bring the thing I requested.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
沿著^0000cd走廊^000000走，維格納就在最後的房間。
找到艾薩克，把我需要的東西帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I am very sorry to cause inconvenience to you.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
非常抱歉給您添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, how is it going? I see you have nothing. It seem that you haven't brought it yet.
You just go to the ^0000cdWigner and bring a thing from Isaac^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，進展如何？我看您手裡沒東西，看來還沒取回來。
您只需要去^0000cd維格納^000000，從艾薩克那裡取東西即可。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, did you bring the thing? Oh, you have brought it. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，您拿到東西了嗎？哦，您帶回來了。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Oh, the box's lock is protected by ^0000cdpassword^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
哦，這個盒子的鎖設有^0000cd密碼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The first cell has a number ^0000cd1^000000 and the next four cells are empty and you should enter numbers into them.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
第一個格子裡有數字^0000cd1^000000，後面四個格子是空的，您需要填入數字。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Hmm.. This is simple. This perfectly ^0000cdbeautiful box is a hint^000000... The answer is always included in the question.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
嗯...這很簡單。這個^0000cd精美的盒子本身就是提示^000000...答案一直藏在問題裡。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Looking at the answer, it really seems that the Wigner people love ^0000cdnumers and gold^000000. Will you try to solve it too?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
從答案來看，維格納家族似乎很^0000cd喜歡數字和黃金^000000。您也來試著解開密碼吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How come you ask me to decipher the password. And isn't it a secret thing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼讓我來破解密碼？這難道不是機密嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Because you are reliable person. Just do it for fun.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
因為您是值得信賴的人。就當是玩玩吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, I think the answer is this:
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，我認為答案是這個：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
1618. It stands for 1.618 which is the golden ratio.
Well it sounds too easy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
1618，代表1.618，也就是黃金比例。
嗯，聽起來倒是很簡單。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... It is not the answer.
I think I need some time for contemplation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這不是答案。
我需要時間思考一下。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But what is inside is not easy.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
但裡面的東西可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The thing put in the small bottle in the box will change the dynamics of combats and wars, though it is in a testing stage.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
盒子裡那隻小瓶所裝的東西，儘管還在測試階段，卻可能徹底改變戰鬥乃至戰爭的局勢。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are a reliable person as I expected.
I was sorry when I asked you to do me a favor. We will reward you generously.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
您果然值得信賴。
之前請您幫忙，實在過意不去。我們會給您豐厚的報酬。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is OK. there is message from Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。艾薩克有訊息要我轉告。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is that?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
什麼訊息？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Recently, there is a ^0000cdrumor^000000 circulating in Prontera about the Roegenburg and Helmut Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近，普隆德拉流傳著關於羅根堡和赫爾穆特·羅根堡的^0000cd謠言^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was not a good rumor. He asked me to inspect it and check if it is true.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那不是好謠言。他讓我去調查一下，看看是否屬實。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
A rumor about you? I didn't know about it... Rumor.....
I need to check it, but there is no person we count on...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
關於我的謠言？我一點也不知道...謠言...
我得去查清楚，可眼下沒有能託付的人...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Excuse me, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
打擾了，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Can you do me a favor again? I cannot do it myself, as there could be a problem when I do it myself.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
能再請您幫我一次嗎？我不方便親自去，可能會惹出麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
All staff I can have trust in are doing other jobs and I have no person except you.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我信任的職員都在忙別的事。現在除了您，我找不到可以託付的人。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You can get information easily traveling around and what is more important is that I can trust you.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
您四處走動，打聽訊息很方便。更重要的是，我信任您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it is not easy but....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這可不容易，不過...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
If you are busy, you may refuse it. I am sorry that I ask you to do me a favor. My brother came back suddenly and it drives me out of my mind and busy.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
如果您忙，可以拒絕。抱歉又來麻煩您。我哥哥突然回來，弄得我心煩意亂，忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that is a thing I can do. Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，這是我力所能及的事。那我們很快再見。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I don't know how to thank you. It is the most accurate to hear the rumor from children. I heard that children gather in a ^0000cdlarge open space^000000 in Prontera..
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
真不知道該怎麼感謝您。孩子們的訊息通常最準確。我聽說普隆德拉的^0000cd大廣場^000000上聚集著不少孩子...

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Then, see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
那麼，我們很快再見。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is the rumor about Roegenburg that is circulating in Prontera.
I didn't know there is a rumor about our family circulating
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
普隆德拉最近在傳什麼關於羅根堡家族的謠言？
我竟然不知道家族裡出了傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I had to start gather information earlier. I couldn't because I was busy due to others.
I didn't expect at all that a rumor will be circulating.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我本該早點打聽訊息，可之前忙著處理其他事。
完全沒想到會有謠言傳開。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I cannot wait to know what rumor is circulating about our family.
Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我迫不及待想知道大家在傳我們傢什麼。
那我們回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Hi, you look a little tired.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
嗨，你看起來有點累。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, do I? I had to do some errands to find the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，是嗎？為了尋找傳聞，我跑了不少地方。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Oh, I am sorry about that. I should have done that.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
哦，抱歉。我應該早點去做的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Rumor? what rumor? I like such thing very much.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
傳聞？什麼傳聞？我很喜歡這類事情。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I really want know about it too.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我也很想知道。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I am sorry to make you tired. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
抱歉讓你這麼辛苦。你找到什麼線索了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I found the rumor and it was pretty specific. Can I tell about it here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我打聽到了，傳聞說得很具體。我可以在這裡說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes, it is ok. If the rumor is about our family, everyone has to listen, so that we can gather and develop a solution.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
可以。如果傳聞是關於我們家族的，大家都該聽聽，這樣才能一起商量對策。

scripts.text: [I changed the rumor I got from children to a relatively softer version and told them.]
scripts.translation: [我把從孩子們那裡聽來的傳聞稍稍修飾了一下，換成比較委婉的說法，然後告訴了他們。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
These days everybody talks about the rumor. I think it will spread throughout Rune-Midgarts as well as Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
最近大家都在談論這個傳聞。我想它不僅會在普隆德拉，還會傳遍盧恩·米德加茲。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
The rumor is....very.... specific and malicious. It must be circulated on purpose by someone who knows the circumstances of my family.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
這傳聞...說得非常...具體，而且充滿惡意。一定是瞭解我們家情況的人故意散佈的。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Do yo mean the bad guy is one of us? OMG! this is very serious!
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你是說，散佈謠言的人就在我們當中？天哪！這下可嚴重了！

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yes. ^0000cdMyer^000000? How much are you going to disgrace our family?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
是的。^0000cd邁爾^000000？你還要讓我們家族蒙羞到什麼程度？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, as much as needed?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，需要多少就多少？

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Myer, did you really do that?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
邁爾，你真的做了那種事？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Myer did that?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
是邁爾做的？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Myer, is this true? Did you spread the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
邁爾，這是真的嗎？是你散佈的謠言？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You collected small kids and played a leader. Did you have lots of fun?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你召集了一群小孩子，還扮演首領。你玩得很開心吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you see what those little kids did for this time? You believe that only the upper class can exert influence on the common people, don't you? You must be so stupid.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你們沒看見那些孩子這次做了什麼嗎？你還以為只有上層階級才能影響平民？真夠愚蠢的。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
How far are you going to go?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你到底要鬧到什麼地步？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well, I asked for help church friends, merchant friends and back street friends. Everyone said they would be willing to help me, when I told them I need help.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我找了教會裡的朋友、商人朋友，還有後巷的朋友幫忙。我一開口說需要幫忙，大家都答應了。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I wonder how you can deal with invisible enemy.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我倒想看看，你打算如何應對看不見的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I don't understand why you spread such a rumor and do all these things.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我不明白你為什麼要散佈這種謠言，還要做這些事。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
No, in fact, I think I know very well. It is because of your immature sympathy and you want to spoil my plan!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
不，其實我很清楚。你只是出於幼稚的同情心，想破壞我的計劃！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Plan? what plan? war plan? the plan to drive innocent people to the battle field? A means that will realize your ambicous plan?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
計劃？什麼計劃？發動戰爭的計劃？把無辜的人趕上戰場的計劃？這就是實現你野心的手段？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are too young to understand why your brothers want to realize our plans.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你還太年輕，無法理解為什麼你的兄弟們想要實現我們的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
^0000cd14 years ago^000000, we could do nothing though we were the top family. We felt a feeling of helplessness. Have you ever felt that?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
^0000cd14年前^000000，儘管我們是頂級家族，卻無能為力。那種無助感，你體會過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
^0000cdA noble family is not so good as it looks^000000. You are just playing a leader on the back street and spoiling our plan entirely!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
^0000cd貴族家族並沒有表面看起來那麼好^000000。你不過是在後巷扮演首領，完全破壞了我們的計劃！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Your plan is to develop the power of the family and unify the continent. Then what? what will you have. Achievement? Revenge?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你們想擴張家族勢力、統一大陸。然後呢？你們究竟想得到什麼？成就感，還是復仇？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
As you know, such as thing causes another pain. We were raised without a parent. But we didn't fall because we had a family and we were rich.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你也知道，這種事只會給別人帶來更多痛苦。我們從小沒有父母，卻沒有被擊垮，因為我們還有家人，也有財富。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And we had brothers ^0000cdto depend on^000000. Think how we did to comfort one another? There are not many people that are so lucky as we were.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我們還有^0000cd可以互相依靠的兄弟^000000。想想我們是怎樣彼此扶持的？世上沒有多少人像我們這樣幸運。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
There are so many people who has no one to depend on, no place to lie their bodies, or no money to buy a piece of bread. People are dying everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
有太多人沒有可以依靠的人，沒有安身之所，甚至買不起一片面包。到處都有人在死去。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
The world you and Helmut are dreaming is only for ^0000cdthe satisfaction of a few persons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你和赫爾穆特夢想的世界，只會^0000cd滿足少數人的私慾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Yo are too ideal. Small sacrifice is a must to achieve a bing goal.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你太理想化了。想成就大事，總得有人付出犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Sacrifice for the goal? Do you think I don't know the reason you are helping Helmut.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
為了目標而犧牲？你以為我不知道你幫助赫爾穆特的真正原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
When Helmut participated in the Royal Assembly, I didn't care about it. Anyway he is naive and doesn't know how to acquire likeability and credibility from others.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
赫爾穆特參加皇家議會時，我根本沒放在心上。他天真得很，不懂如何贏得別人的好感與信任。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
The wish that Helmut could end up as just a wish, but since you started to support Helmut ambiguously, everything has changed.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
赫爾穆特想當國王，原本不過是一廂情願。可自從你開始含糊地支援他，一切都變了。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Helmut and you look like a good brothers, but Wolf, I know that you want to make money from wars and
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
赫爾穆特和你看起來兄弟情深，可沃爾夫，我知道你想從戰爭中牟利，

scripts.text:
[Myer]
even though Helmut becomes a king, he is just a figurehead and you will exert power ^0000cdover our family and kingdom^000000. won't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
就算赫爾穆特當上國王，也不過是個傀儡，而你會^0000cd掌控我們的家族和王國^000000。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
What is our family proud of? Name? Fame? they are useless outside the country. And now they are not so high as before.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我們家族有什麼值得驕傲？姓氏？名聲？出了國門就一文不值。如今它們也不如從前顯赫了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But look at the Wigner. Wherever they go whatever they do, people bow their heads in front of their gold.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
可看看維格納家族。無論他們走到哪裡、做什麼，人們都會向黃金低頭。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
To whoever has gold. I want that power. I want ^0000cdreal power^000000 rather powerless fame.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
誰掌握黃金，誰就擁有力量。我想要的就是這種力量。我想要^0000cd真正的權力^000000，而非徒有虛名。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You want to build a kingdom that you want rule as you want. What if Helmut fails to be a king? What would you do then?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你想建立一個由你隨心所欲統治的王國。如果赫爾穆特沒能當上國王，你該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You will run into a limit as the second son of the Roegenburg, can you give up your ambition?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
作為羅根堡家的次子，你遲早會遇到阻礙。到那時，你還能放下野心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway life is short. What moves people is heart, not money or power.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，人生苦短。打動人心的是真心，而不是金錢或權力。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Heart? Does it work on ^0000cdthose guys^000000?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
真心？那對^0000cd那些人^000000有用嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You didn't know you can approach them in a different way
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你只是不知道，還可以換一種方式接近他們。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
You are better than I expected. You are grown up and I know you will not cry any more in front of me. So stop talking nonsense and play outside.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你比我預期的要好。你長大了，我知道你不會再在我面前哭了。所以別再說廢話了，出去玩吧。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Watch your mouth. I cannot be nice to you forever.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
管好你的嘴。我不可能永遠對你好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you do nothing, I do nothing. I hope I will live on the back street as happy ^0000cdJonathan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
只要你不動手，我也不會動手。我希望能像^0000cd喬納森^000000一樣，快樂地生活在後街。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
But you are developing a murder weapon as new business item with the Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
可你正在和維格納家族合作，把殺傷性武器開發成新的生意。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
How can people trust you when your family does not trust you? I cannot trust you! And I told you to stop treating me as a child!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
當你的家族都不信任你時，人們怎麼能信任你？我無法信任你！而且我告訴過你，別把我當小孩！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Both of you,
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你們兩個，

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Stop! What the hell are you fighting? Didn't all of us want to live happier than anybody?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
住手！你們到底在爭什麼？難道大家不都想過得比誰都幸福嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
So, everybody pursues happiness in their own ways. Helmut had found it on the front. Wolf on the money. And Myer on the street.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
所以，每個人都在以自己的方式追求幸福。赫爾穆特在戰場上找到了它，狼在金錢中找到了它，而邁爾在街頭找到了它。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Isn't it enough? Do you need something bigger? Cause? Revenge? War?
Everyone is fighting in this family and losing important thins. Still you want a war?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
這樣還不夠嗎？還要追求什麼更大的目標？理由？復仇？戰爭？
這個家裡人人都在爭鬥，結果失去了重要的東西。你們還想發動戰爭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
What do we really want? Well, if we can be happy by fighting, it is good!. But it is not. We have fought too long.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
我們真正想要的是什麼？如果爭鬥能帶來幸福，那倒也罷了。可事實並非如此，我們已經鬥得太久了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
All of you, Helmut, Wolf and Myer.
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
你們所有人，赫爾穆特、狼和邁爾。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Everybody calm down. It is not nice to raise our voices.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
大家都冷靜一下。大聲爭吵是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Agnes is right. Both of you, please stop fighting.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
阿格妮絲說得對。你們兩個，請停止爭吵。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
...Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
...失禮了。

scripts.text:
[Agnes]
Myer! where are you going? Are going to leave the family again?
scripts.translation:
[阿格妮絲]
邁爾！你要去哪裡？又要離開家族了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
What do you think. I totally agree with Agnes. I think we have fought one another too long.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你們怎麼看？我完全贊同阿格妮絲。我覺得我們已經彼此爭鬥太久了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
But we have to keep in mind that revenge brings revenge in return and violence brings violence in return.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
但我們必須記住，復仇只會招來復仇，暴力也只會引來暴力。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Do you know why I have been quiet though I lost my son and daughter-in-law.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
你們知道嗎？我失去了兒子和兒媳，卻一直沒有采取行動。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Because revenges does not make a difference. Revenge is another type of violence that only gives a temporary satisfaction.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
因為復仇改變不了什麼。復仇只是另一種暴力，只能帶來短暫的滿足。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The dead never comes back. Your parents would not want you to take revenge.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
逝者無法復生。你們的父母也不會希望你們去復仇。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have let you do as you want to do, but this time I hope that you will follow what Agnes said. I want to avoid wars if possible.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
過去我一直讓你們按自己的想法行事，但這次我希望你們聽阿格妮絲的。如果可以，我想避免戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
......
Excuse me too.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
...
失禮了。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Lord Helmut! where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
赫爾穆特大人！您要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't want to break in, but many people are afraid of wars,
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不想打斷你們，不過很多人都害怕戰爭，

scripts.text:
[{0}]
including children. It would be better if a war didn't break out, but nothing is good if unrest and feat last long.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們也一樣。最好別讓戰爭爆發，但動盪和恐懼持續太久，對誰都沒有好處。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Ah, I am sorry that you saw
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
啊，讓您看到這一幕，真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Apologies for making you uncomfortable. I am sorry again but can you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
抱歉讓您感到不自在了。再次向您致歉，但能請您幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think we need to inform ^0000cdWigner^000000 of the rumor. Please wait a while.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
我覺得我們需要向^0000cd維格納^000000通報這個傳聞。請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: [Wolf prepares documents for a while and seal it in an envelope.]
scripts.translation: [沃爾夫準備了一會兒檔案，然後把它封進信封。]

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Please deliver this document. Sorry again. I cannot find time as I have much to do suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
請幫我送交這份檔案。再次抱歉，我手頭突然有很多事要處理，實在抽不出時間。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I'll come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不客氣。我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Did you deliver the document to Isaac? I should have done it myself, but I got busy suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
你把檔案交給艾薩克了嗎？本該我自己去送的，但突然忙了起來。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I thought about many thins after I heard from Agnes. To do those things, I cannot waste a minute.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
聽了阿格妮絲的話後，我想了很多。為了把這些事辦妥，我一刻也不能耽擱。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Then see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, thank you very much. Was Wigner offended?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
親愛的冒險者，非常感謝。維格納生氣了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He understood everything. He believes that Wigner will find a new item as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他完全理解。他相信維格納會盡快找到新的物品。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It is very good that he understands what I want. I think I have to start a new business at least not to disappoint Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
他能理解我的想法真是太好了。我想我必須開始一項新業務，至少不能辜負維格納的期望。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You will not give up the desire to do business huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你並沒有放棄經商的想法啊？

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It fits me surprisingly. Working is rewarding and enjoyable. Besides, I can show my only ability, not as Roegenburg's ability.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾夫]
這份工作意外地適合我。工作既有回報又讓人愉快，而且我能展現自己的本事，而非家族的力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, your brothers must be busy. Myer and even Helmut....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便問一下，你的兄弟們一定很忙吧。邁爾，甚至赫爾穆特...

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Helmut has left for the front without saying anything. Myer also has left home. I think they felt something from what Agnes said.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
赫爾穆特什麼也沒說就去了前線。邁爾也離開了家。我想他們是從阿格妮絲的話中察覺到了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
If you allow, I would like ^0000cdclear up misunderstanding of my family^000000 in the rumor. Do you have time?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
如果您願意，我想^0000cd澄清謠言中對我們家族的誤解^000000。您有空嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我有時間。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The rumor is true, except the part that a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
除了戰爭會爆發這一點外，傳聞都是真的。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Let me tell you an old story. The parents of the four children gave a birth to Agnes and left for a neighboring country for resting.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我給您講一段往事吧。四個孩子的父母生下阿格妮絲後，便前往鄰國休養。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
They were attacked by the monster there.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
他們在那裡遭到了魔物襲擊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In the holiday resort? Now the monster appears even in the holiday resort?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在度假勝地？難道連度假勝地也會出現魔物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
It was a remote but safe place. But for an unknown reason, the monsters attacked in group.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
那裡雖然偏僻，但很安全。不知為何，魔物成群結隊地襲擊了那裡。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The reason remains unknown, but they guess that the monsters came down to the town, chased by subjugation.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
原因至今不明，不過人們猜測，魔物是被討伐隊一路追趕，才逃到鎮子附近的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
When we arrived at the site, the area was closed and no access was allowed, though my son and daughter-in-law was inside.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
當我們趕到現場時，該區域已被封鎖，禁止任何人進入，而我的兒子和兒媳就在裡面。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
We met with managers, but they blocked completely heavily armed foreigners like us.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我們去找了當地負責人，但他們嚴加戒備，完全不肯放我們這些全副武裝的外國人進去。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I understand that. An armed force of a foreign country was crossing the border and I was not sure what the armed force would do. They have no choice but stop them.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我理解他們的做法。當時有外國武裝力量正在越境，我不確定他們會做什麼。他們別無選擇，只能阻止我們。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
So, we tried to get into the closed zone and contact many people while time passed.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
於是我們一邊設法進入封鎖區，一邊四處求人幫忙，可時間一分一秒地過去了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
At the end, we had to provide lots of money as bribe before we can dispatch mercenaries into the resort, but my son and daughter-in-law had been already killed.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
最後，我們花了大筆錢打點，才讓僱傭兵進入度假區。可那時，我的兒子和兒媳已經遇害了。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Actually, they were alive just before they were found. But, the access was delayed and they had to die in pains.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
其實他們被發現時還活著。只是救援遲遲未到，他們最終才在痛苦中死去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
聽到這些我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I didn't tell the children about the attack, but I had to confess the death of their parents.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我沒有告訴孩子們關於襲擊的事，但我不得不向他們坦白父母的死訊。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
So losing beloved ones, my children and I came to live together.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
失去摯愛後，我便帶著孩子們一起生活。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I grew the children to live up to the name of Roegenburg.
But actually what they need was education, but warm heart.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我想把孩子們培養成足以繼承羅根堡家名的人。
可實際上，他們需要的不是嚴苛的教育，而是溫暖的關懷。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I didn't know that and I was only strict on them.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我當時並不知道這一點，只是對他們很嚴厲。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The children couldn't stand any more and one day they left as a token of resistance.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
孩子們再也忍受不下去，有一天便離家出走，以此表示反抗。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
The children are unwilling to talk about those days. But I am sure that what they heard and saw in those days affected them.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
孩子們不願談論那段日子。但我確信，他們在那期間聽到和看到的事情影響了他們。

[{0}]
怎麼影響的？

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Helmut trained himself. When he was grown up, he left to the border. Wolf suddenly declared that he would make money.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
赫爾穆特開始刻苦訓練，成年後就去了邊境。狼則突然宣佈要經商賺錢。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I tried to stop him saying that there should no merchant in my family, but he was so stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我試圖阻止他，說我們家不應該有商人，但他非常固執。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
After coming home, Myer was doing well for a while. But he left us with a note. Only Agnes has been growing well without a problem.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
邁爾回家後有一陣子表現得不錯，但後來留了張字條就離開了。只有阿格妮絲一直健健康康地長大。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. I see each of them has their own stories! The rumor is spread with something concealed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此，每個人都有自己的故事！傳聞裡果然另有隱情。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Yes, Myer said he would handle the rumor and so the rumor will disappear. Can I ask you to do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
是的，邁爾說他會處理這件事，謠言很快就會平息。能請您幫我一個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please go ahead.

[Maximilian]
I am worried that ^0000cdHelmut left without a word^000000, as there are many eyes watching him. He is the heir of our family.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我很擔心^0000cd赫爾穆特不告而別^000000，因為有很多人在盯著他。他是我們家的繼承人。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I hoped that he would stay for the time being, but I am sad that he left all of sudden.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我原本希望他能暫時留下來，但很遺憾他突然離開了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, my job is to bring him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，我的任務就是把他帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Yes. He must be in the ^0000cdcheckpoint near the border with Schwarzwald^000000. He is responsible for the patrol party.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
是的，他應該在^0000cd靠近修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國邊境的檢查站^000000。他負責帶領那裡的巡邏隊。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
And when you come back, use this. You can return to Prontera instantly.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
回來時用這個吧，可以立刻傳送回普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think I was closer to brothers than now, to Helmut and Myer.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
比起以前，我覺得自己和赫爾穆特、邁爾兩位兄弟親近多了。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Agnes was our favored child in the family. She was the only little sister.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
阿格妮絲是我們家最受寵的孩子。她是家裡唯一的小妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
But sometimes I wonder why we have become this estranged.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
可有時我也會納悶，我們怎麼會變得這麼疏遠。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Well, I think it is because we have came to become different and we also have different ideas on what is right. I understand to some extent.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我想是因為我們各自變了，對是非也有不同的看法。不過，我多少能理解。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
It was quite a shock when Myer left home. He just left without a word, though he was very close to me.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
邁爾離家出走時，讓我很震驚。他什麼話都沒說就走了，儘管他和我很親近。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Since then, I think, I started to find what I can. I cannot stand the thought that I am the only one who are not developing.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
從那以後，我就開始尋找自己的方向。我無法忍受自己成了唯一沒有進步的人。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
When a human feels an empty space, he/she tends to fill it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
人一旦覺得心裡空了一塊，就總想找東西把它填滿。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think I am going to continue to go around to find it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我想我會繼續四處尋找它。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Dear adventurer, thanks to you, I feel that my brothers and I have become closer.
My brothers and I didn't know how to be bent and were about to be broken.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
親愛的冒險者，多虧了你，我覺得兄弟們和我又親近起來了。
我們都不懂得變通，差點就彼此決裂。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
I think these experiences make us more friendly and developing.
We were apart a long time and all have forgotten it.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
我想這些經歷讓我們更加親近，也各自有所成長。
我們分開太久，都忘了曾經的情誼。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
From now, I am going to lead my family, helping my grandfather.
If you visit us from time to time, I will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
今後我會協助祖父，帶領家族向前。
你要是常來看我們，我會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Please come back to us, if you need a help.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
如果你需要幫助，記得回來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
It feels good that I come home for a long time.
It is a little suffocating though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
離家這麼久，終於回到家，感覺真好。
不過還是有點喘不過氣。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, this house goes well without me. I don't worry about the family, but I am only worried about my grandfather, as he is quite old.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，這個家沒了我也照樣運轉。我不擔心家裡，只是放心不下年邁的祖父。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Now I am home and it seems that Helmut, Wolf, and Agnes have been all good.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
現在回到家，看來赫爾穆特、狼和阿格妮絲都過得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
I think it is great, though a little disappointing.
It is stupid to think like this, as I left home.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
我覺得這樣挺好，雖然心裡有點不是滋味。
畢竟當初是我自己離家出走的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
停！你們兩個都別說了。聽你們講這些，我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我有個問題。你們有什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我有一個。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受這個請求。你的問題是什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
我想皇家議會和宴會一定有不少故事。我現在人在首都，想了解這裡的氣氛，覺得該聽聽這些。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
讓我來講！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？如果你想要報酬，我可以給你。糖果？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你給糖果作為報酬？太傻了。我們不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你最好別提報酬。我母親告訴我不要接受陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你們不想要糖果的話，想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要。重要的是，你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
資格？你在說什麼？他有時候說話很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我只信他三成。要是他總能猜中，世界早就毀滅二十多次了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這謠言真有那麼危險嗎？我剛才聽的時候一點也沒察覺。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這取決於你想聽什麼樣的八卦。價值越高，風險就越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
這八卦有這麼危險嗎？我剛才聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你難道知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
艾倫的話只能信三成。要是他總是說對，世界早就毀滅二十多次了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼辦？告訴我。你們到底想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於到了談生意的時候！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我喜歡漂亮的東西！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！僅此而已！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你們在說什麼。請慢慢說，詳細一點？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你知道^0000cd狂暴米諾斯^000000吧？
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。抓一隻回來，就能證明你夠強。它的力量值是^0000cd33^000000！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。這樣就夠了嗎？我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下。你不聽我們說話嗎？你說過要給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走啊。我們可是一個團隊！看到我們三個總在一起玩，還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道我也得照你們說的做...？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下我的朋友。照他們說的做。如果不做，你就會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我明白了。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都會穿漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也想要漂亮的衣服！我想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我會讓我母親給我做的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，好吧，你們想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
按我的身高，大概需要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。那麼，小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加茲王國全部歷史的書。它在皇家圖書館裡，我從來沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進入宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我弄來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想讓我偷它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你以為我是什麼人？幫我借來就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。^0000cd狩獵33只狂暴米諾斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從皇家圖書館借一本盧恩·米德加茲王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我會等著你的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們想要的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
讓我看看。對！就是這些！真漂亮，也好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然，我是特地按你們的要求帶來的。你之前說要給的報酬，不會只是說說吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
不！不！我是真的想要！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有，這是你要的書。又大又重，我只借到其中一卷，其他幾卷都被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你。我終於可以讀了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃濃的血腥味。沒錯，你獵殺了那些狂暴米諾斯。你果然是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我把它們全都獵殺了。現在該告訴我那個珍貴的故事了吧。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室。赫爾穆特·羅根堡。如果他成為國王，整個大陸將被捲入戰爭的漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲整片大陸，痛苦的哀號將響徹四方！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是正在流傳的傳聞嗎？我還是不明白其中意思。誰能給我解釋一下？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。如果赫爾穆特·羅根堡成為國王，戰爭就會爆發。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這也太簡單了。能再詳細說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
哎呀！你們兩個在說什麼呢？還是讓我來解釋吧。事情是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根堡當上國王...對了，你們聽過羅根堡家族的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四兄妹遇害^000000的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不知道。以前從未聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
這也只是傳聞啦。不過我敢肯定是真的。總之，我聽說他們訪問外國時遭人殺害，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
赫爾穆特·羅根堡因此深受打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上奔波。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他確實在戰場上游蕩。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我想這和皇家議會有關。這就是最近流傳的版本。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
^0000cd據說^000000，赫爾穆特一旦當上國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動戰爭統一大陸。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
羅根堡家的二兒子則在四處經商，為戰爭籌集資金。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎麼知道得這麼詳細？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
大家都知道。這裡到處都是關於這件事的議論。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我爸媽很擔心，怕赫爾穆特當上國王后發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，誰也不想打仗。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他以外。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些。這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
如果你還有問題，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你的書！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢可不會送人出門。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要什麼嗎？不過你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想問問關於羅根堡家族傳聞的事。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
關於他們家族沒什麼新訊息。沒新鮮事，就等於死氣沉沉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我想找出最初告訴你們這件事的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰開始散佈這個謠言的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是。他的祖父托我給他帶個口信。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
他們明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，情況沒那麼簡單...不過，也差不多吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
這真的很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，確實奇怪。有時候，家人之間也不方便見面，只能請人代為傳話。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你得拿出更有說服力的憑據...

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！我們有客人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
親愛的冒險者，是什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要找到最初散佈謠言的人，就得先找到傳聞的源頭。不過我沒想到你也在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來看我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。你的家人托我給你帶個口信。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
邁爾？^0000cd你的名字叫邁爾^000000嗎？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你明明說只要叫你喬納森就行。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過可不太好應付。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你是喬納森·邁爾？還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我一聲！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我有很重要的話要跟他談。你們是要捂住耳朵，還是暫時迴避一下？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是閉不上的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我想聽。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
快點！他們有重要的事要談。大家，把耳朵捂起來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
真乖。談完我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我的耳朵已經閉上了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊。那就談吧。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
啦啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
是啊，所以我才留在這裡，觀察、教導並引導他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這也是我力所能及的事。對了，口信是什麼？

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經放棄繼承權，另外兩位兄弟也放下了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
那太好了。他們是讓我引以為傲的兄弟。最值得慶幸的是，^0000cd狼改變了主意^000000。跟他爭來爭去實在太煩人了。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
狼總要看到事情塵埃落定才肯罷休。不過從某種角度來說，這也挺好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，可他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，很抱歉讓你看到了我們家裡這麼不愉快的一面。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間吵吵鬧鬧很正常。我也...

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我得回家一趟。以前家裡總讓我心煩，不過這次應該會很有意思。請告訴家人，我工作期間會留在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
還有，告訴他們宴會結束後我會回家看看。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
也請告訴阿格妮絲，很抱歉我不能陪她參加宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
要是需要我幫忙，儘管來找我。我會盡全力幫你。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you want business with us? But we don't meet with anybody.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
來找我們談生意？不過我們可不見外人。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
We are not easy people anybody can speak to.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我們可不是誰都能隨便搭話的人。
回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Today, the wind is cold and smells rotten. I feel that something has happened.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
今天的風又冷又帶著腐臭味。我感覺好像發生了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah, sorry, I couldn't clean myself for a few days.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，抱歉，我好幾天沒洗澡了。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是嗎？我倒覺得他們在考驗我。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是這樣嗎？我覺得他們是在考驗我。
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是這樣嗎？我覺得他們是在考驗我。
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
[Allen]
Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是這樣嗎？我覺得他們是在考驗我。
[艾倫]
還想聽更多嗎？那就得證明你有更可靠的資格。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
[Allen]
He has come with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是這樣嗎？我覺得他們是在考驗我。
[艾倫]
他空手而來。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is it so? I feel that they are testing me.
[Allen]
The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
是這樣嗎？我覺得他們是在考驗我。
[艾倫]
戰爭的威脅已經消失，亂世英雄也就無從誕生。黑暗在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
He has come with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
他是空著手來的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
沒有憑據，就別想聽到有價值的訊息。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你怎麼能這麼說！你一定忘了該帶什麼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12塊柔軟的絲綢布料^000000，^0000cd一本盧恩·米德加茲王國史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有...^0000cd替艾倫獵殺33只狂暴米諾斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
裡面混了件奇怪的事，不過有什麼關係...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
