Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
想聽更多？那就得拿出更有力的憑據。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是召喚鮮血的儀式！是毀滅與黑暗的儀式！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
請離開。我們會處理他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The threat of war has disappeared. Hero in the time of turbulence is not born. Darkness calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭威脅已經消失了。亂世英雄也就無從誕生。黑暗在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
請離開。我們會處理他的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天氣真好。
宮殿裡的宴會正熱鬧著呢。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are happy as their business prospers when palace purchases lots of goods in large volumes. I will tell them to buy me a book tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[金]
宮殿大量採購物資，父母的生意興隆，他們可高興了。明天我就請他們給我買本書。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
End of today's diary.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今日日記結束。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It is a good weather today.
The banquet is in full swing in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[金]
今天天氣真好。
宮殿裡的宴會正進行得如火如荼。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
They will be all destroyed when a bloody day comes.
Why are we recording those vain things?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
血腥之日一到，一切都會被毀滅。
我們為什麼要記錄這些無聊的瑣事？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Because records remains forever.
If you record today, someone in the future will read them and remember us.
scripts.translation:
[金]
記錄會一直儲存下去。
把今天記下來，將來就會有人讀到，也會記得我們。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也終將歸於虛無。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也將歸於虛無。
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也將歸於虛無。
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
[Jin]
I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也將歸於虛無。
[金]
我很喜歡你帶來的書，雖然它又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也將歸於虛無。
[金]
咦？怎麼空手回來了？我們說的東西呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Human comes from nothing and goes to nothing.
[Jin]
Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
人從虛無中來，也將歸於虛無。
[金]
喬納森把你借的書還回來了，還另外借了兩冊給我。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？怎麼空著手？我沒看到我們托你帶來的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因為我們是小孩才看不起我們嗎？我最討厭這種人了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喂，你不是那種人吧？看起來不像啊。你只是忘了該帶什麼，對不對？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12塊柔軟的絲綢布料^000000，^0000cd一本盧恩·米德加茲王國史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有...^0000cd替艾倫獵殺33只狂暴米諾斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
裡面還夾了件奇怪的要求，不過有什麼關係...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我正在讀你給我的書，雖然它又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的夢想是成為歷史學家。我想走遍米德加爾特，發掘那些被遺忘的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
