^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation:
[金]
喬納森已經把你借的書還回去了，還另外借給我兩卷。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.
scripts.translation:
[金]
喬納森真棒！將來我要成為像喬納森那樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
公主們的禮服一定又漂亮又閃亮！我真希望能穿上好多漂亮裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
Are you having a beautiful day today too?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你好啊，唱歌的小鳥和漂亮的花朵。
你們今天也過得愉快嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
Why don't I have normal person around me?
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又開始了。
我身邊怎麼就沒有一個正常人呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Are you talking to me?
If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你是在跟我說話嗎？
要是的話，你成功了，我聽得一清二楚。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我可不是能被平庸束縛的人。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我不該被平庸束縛。
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我不該被平庸束縛。
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我不該被平庸束縛。
[金]
咦？怎麼空手回來了？我們說的東西呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Harriet]
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我不該被平庸束縛。
[哈麗雅特]
請把這塊布交給我媽媽，讓她給我做衣服。
我媽媽做的衣服可漂亮了！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我拒絕平庸。
我不該被平庸束縛。
[哈麗雅特]
喬納森說戰爭威脅已經消失了。那可真讓人安心。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？怎麼空著手？我沒看到我們托你帶來的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因為我們是小孩才看不起我們嗎？我最討厭這種人了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喂，你不是那種人吧？看起來不像啊。你只是忘了該帶什麼，對不對？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12塊柔軟的絲綢布料^000000，^0000cd一本盧恩·米德加茲王國史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
還有...^0000cd替艾倫獵殺33只狂暴米諾斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
裡面還夾了件奇怪的要求，不過有什麼關係...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子們，你們好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回來了。這些是你們要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你們兩個都住口！聽你們說話我頭都暈了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又來了。還需要更多嗎？不管怎樣，你能來真好。我得把書還回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我看看。沒錯，就是這些。好漂亮，好柔軟！我真的可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想問你一件事。你知道什麼有趣的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打聽羅根伯格家的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然是因為你們想要，我才把東西帶來的。那你之前說的話只是隨口說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這是任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
家族沒有新故事？沒有故事就等於死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要這些！謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來打聽新傳聞的。我是來找那個告訴你們這個故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你的書。又大又重。我只借到這一冊，其他幾冊都已經被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我知道一個。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我接受委託。你想問什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是誰散佈了這個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你，我終於能讀到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
為什麼？你要去抓那個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
你身上有濃重的血腥味。沒錯，你打倒了瑪約羅瑟斯。你是個強大的戰士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說戰爭故事、王室傳聞之類的。
王室集會或宴會應該有不少傳聞吧。我現在身處首都，為了瞭解這裡的氣氛，想聽聽這些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父請我轉告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我全都打倒了。現在讓我聽聽那個故事吧——那個價值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那個故事！我們都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
明明是一家人，為什麼不能見面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰爭，王室，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格。如果他成為國王，大陸就會被捲入戰爭漩渦。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
讓我來說！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那樣……唔……對，差不多就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
黑暗將席捲大陸，痛苦的哀嚎將響徹整片大陸！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我也知道這個故事，但不確定該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個傳聞正在流傳嗎？可我不明白它是什麼意思。有人能幫我解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼？你想要報酬的話，我可以給你。糖果怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不過有時即使是家人也很難見面，只好請人互相傳話。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很簡單。赫爾穆特·羅根伯格一旦成為國王，就會爆發戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果當報酬？太傻了吧，我們又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這次你需要更有力的資格證明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……這也太簡單了。請再解釋詳細些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你最好別提報酬。我媽媽說過不能收陌生人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啊，他來了！喬納森！有客人來了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
呃啊！你們兩個在說什麼呀？我來解釋吧。傳聞是這樣的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我們不是正在聊天嗎？那你想要什麼？不要糖果的話。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
如果赫爾穆特·羅根伯格成為國王……啊，對了，你聽過羅根伯格家的傳聞嗎？特別是^0000cd四個孩子死亡的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
報酬對我來說不重要，重要的是你有沒有資格聽這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
冒險者，歡迎光臨。你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
資格證明？他在說什麼啊？有時候他說話真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散佈傳聞的人，就得先找到傳聞的來源。不過我沒想到你會在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
這也只是傳聞，不過我覺得是真的。總之，我聽說他們遭到了謀殺，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要報酬。只要給我合適的報酬，什麼都可以告訴你。先說說你能給什麼吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你是來找我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
他們出訪外國時，赫爾穆特·羅根伯格受到了沉重打擊，從那以後就一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我給你帶句話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒想騙你們。不過你們倒是很坦率地說出了想要什麼。一開始我還因為你們是孩子而小看了你們。
好吧，我給你們報酬。至於資格證明，聽個傳聞還需要資格嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，他確實一直在戰場上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
這要看你想聽什麼傳聞。價值越高，風險也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想是因為王室集會吧。這就是現在正在流傳的那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
那個傳聞有這麼危險嗎？我聽的時候完全沒感覺到。金，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
邁爾？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
^0000cd據說^000000赫爾穆特一旦成為國王，就會入侵殺害他父母的國家，發動統一大陸的戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾倫說的。他的話只能信三成。要是他每次都說對，世界早就毀滅二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
羅根伯格家的次子正在經商籌集戰爭資金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
邁爾是誰？^0000cd你的名字是邁爾嗎^000000？喬納森·邁爾？邁爾·喬納森？你不是讓我叫你喬納森嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我該怎麼做？告訴我，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得還挺詳細？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你以前見過這些孩子，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
大家都知道了，這個傳聞在這裡傳得沸沸揚揚。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
終於要談生意了！太好了！我喜歡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他們很可愛，不過也挺難應付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你是喬納森·邁爾，還是邁爾·喬納森？告訴我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很擔心。他們害怕赫爾穆特會成為國王並發動戰爭。
其實大家都很不安，沒人喜歡戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
漂亮的東西我都喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
孩子們，我要和他談一件非常重要的事。你們能捂住耳朵，或者先離開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
戰場上的鮮血在呼喚我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
驗證資格！就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽不懂你在說什麼。能不能慢慢詳細地告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想聽。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
很簡單，證明你的實力。我想你應該知道^0000cd瑪約羅瑟斯^000000吧。
那是個肌肉發達的惡魔。打倒它來證明你的強大吧。實力標準是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
好了！他們要談重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起來。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也討厭戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。這樣夠了嗎？我很快就回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
乖孩子。談完以後我給你們甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們告訴我這些故事，這正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我已經把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
以後還有問題的話，隨時來找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不聽我們說話了嗎？你說過會給報酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你們聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
謝謝你把書帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
你不能只聽艾倫說完就走。我們是一個團隊！看到我們三個一起玩，你還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你們說的做嗎……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們既可愛又聰明，真想知道他們長大後會是什麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
我不會丟下朋友不管。照他們說的做吧，不然你會失去資格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沒錯，所以我才來這裡照看、教導並帶領他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來如此。那你們想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我想要漂亮的絲綢布料！聽說宮殿裡會舉辦宴會，公主們都穿著漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
嗯，這只是我力所能及的事。對了，家裡託了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的絲綢布料^000000！我要讓媽媽給我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告訴邁爾，赫爾穆特已經讓出了繼承權，他的兩個兄弟也放棄了戰爭。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
太好了。他們是我引以為傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃爾夫改變了主意^000000。和他爭論實在令人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二塊^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
沃爾夫總要親眼確認一切才肯罷休，不過從某種角度來說也不算壞事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很簡單。小傢伙，你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
你可能不信，但他是家裡我最喜歡的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本記載盧恩·米德加爾特王國全部歷史的書。它在王立圖書館裡，我從沒讀過。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
啊，總之，很抱歉讓你聽到了我們家這些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身邊沒有人能進宮殿，書店也不賣這本書。請幫我拿一本來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之間爭吵很常見。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
總之，我想我該回家看看了。雖然家裡的事一直很煩人，不過這次應該會很有意思。請轉告家人，我會一邊工作一邊在這裡幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你瘋了嗎？你把我當成什麼人了？幫我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
再告訴他們，我會在宴會後去看望他們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只瑪約羅瑟斯、收集12塊柔軟的絲綢布料，並從王立圖書館借來盧恩·米德加爾特王國史^000000。我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
請再幫我向阿格妮絲道歉，就說我不能陪她去宴會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會轉告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾倫]
男子漢不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈麗雅特]
我會等你回來！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
需要我幫忙就來找我，我一定盡全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喬納森說戰爭的威脅已經解除了。真是讓人鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
親愛的冒險者？你怎麼來這裡了？這裡很危險，剛才有魔物下來。快離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒事。我已經習慣了每天被魔物攻擊的生活。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
By the way what has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我忘了您是位了不起的戰士，剛才失禮了，請見諒。
對了，您怎麼會來這裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來接赫爾穆特大人回去。您的祖父很擔心您，說您在這個關鍵時刻卻離家在外。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我不回去。^0000cd我屬於這裡，前線^000000。請這樣告訴我的祖父。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But everybody is worried about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是大家都為您擔心。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我不會回去。長大後，我一直怨恨那些眼睜睜看著我父母死去的人。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我曾以為，只有建立起強大到讓別人不得不追隨的力量，才是正確的道路。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
所以我的目標是統一大陸，讓自己的勢力遍及每個角落。為此，我不斷訓練自己。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
但聽了邁爾和阿格妮絲的話，我意識到自己追求的道路會給別人帶來悲傷和不幸。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
所以我決定^0000cd放棄這場會把人們捲入戰爭漩渦的統一戰爭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我應該留在這裡。在這裡，我可以^0000cd更安全地保護更多人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
考慮到我們家族的地位，我會配合王室議會所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
不過我希望由狼來領導一切。王室議會結束後，請告訴狼，我會^0000cd把繼承人的位置讓給他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
狼需要大量的力量。我會留在這裡保護我們的人民。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
這樣一來，狼就不會再執意發動戰爭，邁爾也不必再那樣犧牲自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我明白了。我會把您的話轉告給您的祖父。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Yes. thank you. Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
是的，謝謝。請多保重。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我應該留在這裡。
請告訴祖父：^0000cd我放棄戰爭，並把繼承人的位置讓給狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
如果你這樣做，狼就不會堅持戰爭，邁爾也不會再那樣犧牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我感覺到大地在震動。
攻擊很快就要來了，我得做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Give shout of concentration!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
一起高喊口號！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Louder!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
再大聲點！！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
We!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我們！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I am very happy that I came back here.
Now I've got something to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
很高興能回到這裡。
現在我也有了自己的職責。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
赫爾穆特大人放棄統一戰爭，真是太好了。
我不懂什麼統一大業，只希望不要再有戰爭。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
我想留在這裡，幫助赫爾穆特大人守護大家平靜安穩的生活。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
I think I should prepare something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
赫爾穆特大人應該快渴了。
我去準備些喝的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
謝謝你特地來傳話。要不是你，我也不會聽到今天這些話。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
打打殺殺...我也不想看到那樣。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.
scripts.translation:
[邁爾]
他們是我的家人，比任何人都更親近我。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Man]
Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
There are may eyes around.
scripts.translation:
[普通男子]
噓！你最好別跟我說話。
周圍到處都是眼線。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
激戰之後好好休息，是快速恢復實力的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族採用各種訓練方式，休息也是其中最重要的一環。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族歷代家主訓練後也會充分休息。這麼平常的事，就不多說了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
接下來的訓練同樣會很艱苦。您最好現在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
訓練結束後，誰都會想繼續大展身手。不過，那時候正該好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我看您已經躍躍欲試了。看來該開始下一階段的訓練了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您好。侍從長告知我您會來，我一直在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這裡是理查德家族的宅邸。這個家族一直掌握著王國的軍事力量。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc
scripts.translation:
[管家]
久仰大名，{0}。您是平定夢羅克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉佔用您這麼多時間。房間裡，家族繼承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
請允許我為您引路。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這裡是理查德家族的房間。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族繼承人波正在休息。請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
房間裡，家族繼承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Have you met the next head of the family?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您見過家族繼承人了？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果家族繼承人要見您，{0}，請...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！剛才失禮了。沒什麼，請別放在心上...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我從家族繼承人波那裡聽說，您打算嘗試理查德戰鬥訓練計劃。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
目前的訓練對您來說可能太難了。建議先打好基礎，再開始訓練。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我從家族繼承人波那裡聽說，您打算嘗試理查德戰鬥訓練計劃。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的訓練方式和其他訓練計劃不同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您之前應該一直是靠單獨獵殺魔物來訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
從現在開始，您可以針對特定種類的魔物訓練，例如人形、動物、昆蟲、魚類、植物、惡魔、天使、不死、無形和龍族。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
與其說一百句話，不如揮一劍來得有效。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good. Are you ready now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
很好。您準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯，似乎出現了無法解決的問題。請再試一次。如果問題仍然存在，請截圖併發送給管理團隊。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Please select a training program to try.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
請選擇一個訓練計劃進行嘗試。

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Human
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-人類

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Animal
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-動物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Insect
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-昆蟲

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Fish
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-魚類

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Plant
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-植物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Devil
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-惡魔

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Angel
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-天使

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Immortal
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-不死族

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Intangible
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-虛無

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Dragon
scripts.translation: 戰士修行-龍類

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 human monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的人形魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 animal monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的動物魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 insect monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的昆蟲魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 fish monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的魚類魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 plant monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的植物魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 demon monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的惡魔魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 angel monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的天使魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 Immortal monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的不死魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 nothing monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的無形魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 dragon monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這項訓練要求擊殺50只等級不低於140的龍魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Would you try this training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要嘗試這項訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Try.
scripts.translation: 嘗試

scripts.text: Do not try.
scripts.translation: 不嘗試

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...您不喜歡這項訓練的內容嗎？沒關係，可以換一個訓練專案。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
即使覺得訓練對您的等級來說很輕鬆，也不要掉以輕心。祝您順利...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Congratulations on completing the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
恭喜您完成訓練。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
堅持訓練下去，終會達成您的目標。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
這是為完成訓練準備的獎勵，請收下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
感謝您參加我們的訓練，這也讓理查德家族受益。請別有壓力。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You are participating in the training. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您正在參與訓練。有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: About the way of training
scripts.translation: 關於訓練方式

scripts.text: About the goal of training
scripts.translation: 關於訓練目標

scripts.text: Give up the training.
scripts.translation: 放棄訓練

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
對待訓練應當如同對待實戰一樣！在訓練期間切勿掉以輕心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族一直關注如何培養出更優秀的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族的前任家主之一認為，針對特定魔物的訓練方式存在侷限性。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
前任的前任家主...哦，先說明一下，他只是退休了，並沒有去世。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...言歸正傳...他想出了一種訓練方法，可以根據學員等級或魔物種類來調整訓練內容。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Well... The training began like that...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...訓練就是這樣開始的...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
訓練的目標...說簡單也簡單，說難也難。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
最顯而易見的目標無疑是變強。如果我還年輕，我也會這樣回答。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
不過，我認為訓練的目標是保護身邊的人。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal may be different for each warrior.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
對於每位戰士來說，目標可能都不盡相同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我不會阻止您放棄。不過您要知道，到目前為止的訓練進度不會保留到下一輪。

scripts.text: Do not give up.
scripts.translation: 繼續訓練

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 放棄訓練

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智的決定。對待訓練應當如同對待實戰一樣！在訓練期間切勿掉以輕心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Too bad. If you finished the training, you must have been able to reap the benefit of hard work.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遺憾。如果您完成了訓練，本可以收穫辛勤努力的成果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遺憾。如果您堅持完成訓練，就能收穫努力的成果了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒險者？看來你現在需要更加刻苦才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I'd like to take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒險者？看來你還得再努力些。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是被邀請到宮殿的冒險者。我現在正在休息。請去門口找管家預約時間。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
That is the way to do it in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在宮殿裡就是這樣辦事的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是在討伐黑暗之王時立下大功的冒險者。宮裡也流傳著你的事蹟。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
尤其是我們，理查德家族，對你的事蹟非常感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you want to know why?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你想知道原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，就算你不想聽，我也要把我想說的說清楚。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
其實你並不是自願來這裡的。我敢肯定，是那位大人召見了你。我能理解。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒險者也許不太關心宮廷事務，但理查德家族負責掌管盧恩·米德加茲王國的軍隊。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我們也培養了許多優秀的戰士。哼！我突然有點好奇。你聽說過理查德家族的戰士嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，沒見過

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哈哈，我想“理查德”這個名字在冒險者中也是很有名的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哎呀，我是不是有點自吹自擂了？理查德家族還得更加努力才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
算了，這不重要，就此打住吧。我好久沒說這麼多話了，口渴了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Shall we take a rest before proceeding?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在繼續之前，我們要不要休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，那我就說說理查德家族為什麼對你感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
眾所周知，理查德家族培養出了傑出的戰士。我們有一套系統化的訓練體系來支援這一點。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我雖然不太喜歡這種訓練，但我相信這是基於家族經驗的有效訓練方案。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
請仔細聽，因為我馬上要說到重點了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想冒險者對此不太關心。不過這次討伐黑暗之王時，有不少王室成員參與其中，我從他們那裡聽說了你的事蹟。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
聽到你的功績後，我心裡冒出一個問題：如果讓一位自由自在的冒險者參加嚴格的訓練體系，會發生什麼？我很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
如果你這樣一位著名的冒險者願意幫助我們，我很樂意支付一筆可觀的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我覺得這是一個很有吸引力的提議。你願意挑戰理查德家族的戰士訓練體系嗎？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我願意試試

scripts.text: I decline.
scripts.translation: 我拒絕

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
看來這個提議對你沒有吸引力。很抱歉，等你改變主意時再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
太好了！我喜歡你果斷的決定，也欣賞這種挑戰精神。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
讓我告訴管家這件事。你可以通過他來進行訓練。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
不要小看那位將指導你訓練的管家。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
他本身就是理查德家族的一員。他是一位傑出的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想知道你對訓練的獎勵是否滿意。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
目前我很難給出更高的報酬。就把它當作一份兼職來做吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你可能覺得這是理所當然的。不過你訓練得越多，理查德家族得到的好處也越多，我們願意為此付報酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哦！你一定正在參加訓練。那麼，你覺得訓練怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我年輕時也參加過這種訓練。這讓我想起了美好的舊時光。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
這裡有各種訓練專案，請選一個參加。冒險者通常都會選擇自己熟悉的專案。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
當你放鬆警惕時，意外就會發生。請務必時刻保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我認為對戰士來說，最重要的是挑戰精神。挑戰自我，邁向更高境界...這才是關鍵。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
以前普隆德拉的酒館裡很流行一首《戰士之歌》。最近聽不到了，真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]

scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你喜歡賭博嗎？那種緊張感，難道不像身處戰場的戰士嗎？

There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

請把證件和隨身物品放在桌上，然後面朝牆站好...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It is for the safety of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
這是為了女王的安全。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
你在女王身邊是為了保護她，而不是無禮地趕走客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 馬丁]
宮裡都亂成這樣了，還抱著這種悠哉的想法，怎麼保護女王！

scripts.text:

We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation:
[保鏢 傑拉德]
帝國法令期間，我們也只能照辦！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...
scripts.translation:

如今的帝國法令簡直就是...

scripts.text:

I don't know why but Scarlet and Lidion have been on bad terms for a long time.

However, they both have such strong personalities.
scripts.translation:

他們年紀相仿，本來應該能成為朋友...

這大概是雅哈一族的特徵吧。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
我們喬博格家族是建立這個王國的特里斯坦一世的後裔，世世代代都誕生過許多國王和騎士。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
In the first Royal Assembly which was held, the forth prince Ernst was elected as a candidate. However, he has given up his position in the Royal Assembly this time due to several incidents.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
第一次皇家議會上，第四王子恩斯特當選王位候選人。但因為發生了幾件事，他這次放棄了候選資格。

scripts.text: What do you mean by several incidents?
scripts.translation: 您說的幾起事件是指什麼？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh... It slipped my tongue.
It is a little difficult to tell you about those incidents.
I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
哦...是我失言了。
那些事不太方便向您透露。
就當我沒說過吧。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您來到這裡，但我能告訴您的並不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
如果您還有問題，可以問問傑拉德和馬丁。
我還有緊急公務，不能多陪您了，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您來到這裡，但我能告訴您的並不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
如果您還有問題，可以問問傑拉德和馬丁。
我還有緊急公務，不能多陪您了，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You mean Prince Ernst?
Well?
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
您是指恩斯特王子？
是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He comes here to say good morning and either helps me the work or does other things.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
他每天早上都會來向我請安，有時幫我處理公務，有時做些別的事。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Ever since the banquet started, he has been carrying his work to somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
自從宴會開始，他就把公務帶到別處處理了。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He could be somewhere in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凱瑟琳·D·喬博格]
他可能在宴會廳的某個角落。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Haven't you met Prince Ernst yet?
He just stopped by and went out again...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
您還沒見過恩斯特王子嗎？
他剛才來過，又出去了...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am worried about the representative of our family wandering around like this.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
看到我們家族的代表這樣四處奔走，我很擔心。

scripts.text: Tell her about what you have heard.
scripts.translation: 告訴她你聽到的傳聞

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh...
Dear hero, please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
哦...
親愛的英雄，別太在意那些傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
It is a problem that we, the Geoborg family, should get over ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
這是我們喬博格家族必須自己克服的問題。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
The ink pad of the highest quality to be used in the royal debate room?
It is the clerk who writes down everything. Why are they buying luxury item that no one will ever use...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
要在皇家議事廳用最高階的印臺？
記錄員負責記下所有內容，為什麼要買這種沒人會用的奢侈品...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I have enough dresses to last my lifetime. Why do they keep making them...
A cutback!
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
我的裙子多得一輩子都穿不完，為什麼還要一直做...
必須削減開支！

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Hum.. Trade request from Marol Kingdom...
I should dispatch an envoy to take care of it soon...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳·D·喬博格女王]
嗯...馬羅爾王國提出了貿易請求...
得儘快派特使去處理...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，有什麼可以幫您的嗎，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，有什麼可以幫您的嗎，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於喬博格家族的事

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Heh!
Is there no one around here who is curious about me?
Everyone who ever talks to me talk about that!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
哼！
就沒人對我本人感興趣嗎？
每個來找我說話的人都只談那個！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Don't be startled.
It is a joke.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
別被嚇到了。
這是個玩笑。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
As you know, the Geoborg family is the descendant of...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如你所知，喬博格家族是...的後裔。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tristan I who have founded the kingdom!
Is there anyone who doesn't know the story in this kingdom?
Dear Lady Jaha.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
是建立這個王國的特里斯坦一世！
這個王國裡還有誰不知道這段歷史？
雅哈女士。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·喬博格！
您怎麼會在宴會廳？您身體一定不舒服吧。
您應該在您的宅邸裡休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
