我可不能放任雅哈家族的女士對喬博格家族的歷史一知半解，還裝作很瞭解。怎麼能安心休息？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·喬博格！
您怎麼會在宴會廳？您身體一定不舒服吧。
您應該在您的宅邸裡休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我不能冒讓雅哈家族的女士假裝瞭解喬博格家族的風險。我不能就這樣休息。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Phew, that old jerk!
He is younger than me and always tries to preach!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
唉，那個老頑固！
明明比我年輕，卻總愛教訓我！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Well... For that reason, the Geoborg family will retire to a quiet life for a while as soon as the Royal Assembly is over.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
哦！
嗯...所以，皇家議會結束後，喬博格家族會暫時退下來，過些清靜日子。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I really hope that Catherine doesn't suffer from sorrow anymore.
That's why I fully support such decision!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我真希望凱瑟琳別再受苦了。
所以我完全支援這個決定！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
不過恩斯特王子不見蹤影。
我這個姨媽可是大老遠趕來安慰可憐的外甥呢！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
姐姐說自己很忙，把我趕到宴會廳來了。我也找不到外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你在宴會廳遇到恩斯特，請告訴他來這裡一趟。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
不過，恩斯特王子卻不知去向。
他的姨媽可是大老遠趕來安慰他那可憐的外甥的，你知道嗎！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我姐姐把我趕到了宴會廳，說她在忙。我也找不到我外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你在宴會廳遇到恩斯特，請告訴他來這裡一趟。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
請整理你的背包並再試一次。-

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Haven't you found him yet?
Should I ask Catherine?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢！
你還沒找到他嗎？
我應該問問凱瑟琳嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
That expression on your face... You must have heard what people say.
There must have been no good stories in particular...
Please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
看你的表情...你肯定聽到那些議論了。
大概也沒聽到什麼好話...
別太在意那些流言。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Ernst must have been hiding from such whispers as well.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
恩斯特肯定也在躲避這些閒言碎語。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Well, I guess he needs some rest.
You hero, cheer up and enjoy the banquet!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
好吧，我想他需要休息一下。
英雄，振作起來，好好享受宴會吧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
What a waste to let the banquet end like this!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
讓宴會這樣結束，真是浪費！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, hero!
Are you having a good time?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
噢，英雄！
你玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you have some time to spare, please tell me some fun stories from your adventure.
I am sick of listening to Lidion's nitpicking.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
如果你有空，給我講講冒險時遇到的趣事吧。
我已經聽膩了利迪翁的挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, is one of the seven royal families, but we are the creme de la creme for producing the highest number of kings in the history.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我們喬博格家族是七大王族之一，也是歷史上誕生國王最多的家族，堪稱王族中的翹楚。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
In fact, we are settled in Prontera, the center of the Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
我們的家族紮根於盧恩·米德加茲的中心——普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Despite the series of unfortunate events regarding the princes after the death of King Tristan III,
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
特里斯坦三世國王去世後，王子們接連遭遇不幸，

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Prince Ernst Geoborg was elected as the most regnant candidate in the last Royal Assembly. It shows just influential the Geoborg family is.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
而恩斯特·喬博格王子在上一次皇家議會上當選最有希望繼位的候選人。這足以證明喬博格家族的影響力。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
He has given up from the position.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
他已經放棄候選人的身份了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What?
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I said!
Prince Ernst gave up his position as the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
我說！
恩斯特王子已經放棄王位候選人的身份了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What a nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
真是胡鬧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
You didn't know!
You must have been separated from the outside world for too long!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
哦！
你不知道嗎？
你一定和外界隔絕太久了！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！
我絕不會讓那個小子...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
小子？
即使你是家族長老，他終究還是王子。你應該對他以禮相待。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！
我絕不會讓那個小子...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗·雅哈]
小子？
即使你是家族長老，他終究還是王子。你應該對他以禮相待。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tut...
Letting anybody in like this... The dignity of the palace has fallen down to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·喬博格]
真是的...
就這樣任由任何人進出...宮殿的威嚴都蕩然無存了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Did you hear the story?
The skeleton of King Tristan III has been found.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
你聽說了嗎？
特里斯坦三世國王的骸骨被發現了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Oh my!
Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
天哪！
真不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
It is a secret. Don't tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
這是秘密，別告訴任何人。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
...So the princes must have been poisoned...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
...所以那些王子一定是被毒死的...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
What on earth!
Well, in the last Royal Assembly...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
怎麼會這樣！
說起來，上次皇家議會的時候...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Ha!
He has given up the royal authority like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
哈！
他就這樣放棄了王權！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Doesn't he even care for the people of his family?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
他連自己的族人都不關心了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Your voice is too loud!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
你的聲音太大了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
No...
I didn't say anything wrong.
Did I?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
不...
我又沒說錯。
是吧？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How can he decide such a major issue as he wants?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
這麼重大的事情，他怎麼能想怎麼決定就怎麼決定？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I knew it. He has been hanging out with that punk from the third-rate family too long...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
我就知道。他和那個三流家族的小子來往太久了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
So is the queen who is handling all the matters of the palace now?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
那麼現在是王后在處理宮裡的事務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
She hasn't showed her presence to the public so far...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
她至今都沒有公開露面...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How foolish it is to give up the regal power like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
就這樣放棄王權，真是太愚蠢了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I won't ever let go of such power!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
我可絕不會放棄這樣的權力！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Hey, you!
Not anyone can have such power.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
喂，你！
這種權力可不是誰都能擁有的。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Why not?
I am free to dream!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
為什麼不行？
我有做夢的自由！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Is the Geoborg family cursed?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
喬博格家族是受詛咒了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Shh!
You shouldn't say such a thing so easily!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃細語]
噓！
這種話可不能隨便說！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
The women in the line here are so scary.
They curse, push and fight...
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
這裡排隊的女人真可怕。
她們又罵又推，還會打架...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you just go back then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你乾脆回去不就好了？

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
Are you telling me to go back when Jurgen is right inside of the door?
I won't!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
尤爾根就在門裡面，你居然叫我回去？
我才不回去！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I won't go before seeing the elegant and luminous presence of him!
I have come here from Payon to meet Jurgen!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
不親眼見到他優雅而耀眼的身姿，我絕不離開！
我可是從斐揚專程趕來見尤爾根的！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Who was it? Who pretended to be close to Katrin and went along with her? Come out here! We have made a pact not to stand out!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
是誰？是誰假裝和卡特琳親近，還跟著她混進來的？快出來！我們明明約好不引人注目的！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Jurgen treats us all the same. We should have a sense of fair play.
Who ever it was, turn yourself in!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
尤爾根對我們一視同仁。我們也該公平競爭。
不管是誰，快出來承認！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
I won't let anyone monopolize Jurgen! The heaven may forgive, but I won't!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
我不許任何人獨佔尤爾根！老天或許會原諒你，我可不會！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen belongs to all of us! No one should have him to oneself! I won't let anyone to do that!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
尤爾根屬於我們所有人！誰也不能獨佔他！我絕不允許這種事發生！

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
It is no use getting a ticket number... It is just too difficult to wait for my turn.
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
拿到號碼牌也沒用...等到我都不知要排到什麼時候。

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
When will Jurgen come out?
When will be my turn to see him?
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
尤爾根什麼時候出來？
什麼時候才輪到我見他？

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
There! If you are a newbie, don't be so naive and try to fit in here!
scripts.translation:
[單身女子]
喂！新來的就別這麼天真，以為能輕易混進這裡！

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
[Bachelorette]
Hey, don't you push me there! Stand in the line. Isn't it your first time here to see Jurgen?
scripts.translation:
[單身女子]
[單身女子]
喂，別推我！好好排隊。你是第一次來見尤爾根嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you lady! Don't push!
Stay in the line!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
喂，那位女士！別推人！
排好隊！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
There was this lady who was carried out with a broken ankle from pushing!
It is all for your own good!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
剛才有位女士因為推搡被抬了出去，腳踝都摔斷了！
這也是為你們好！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Ha, I am already feeling tired as always.
I didn't know that women were so strong before.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
哈，我還是一如既往地累。
以前真不知道女人們這麼有勁。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
I started yesterday and realized why the people who had worked here before quit.
Despite being with so many ladies here, I am not happy at all.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
我昨天才來這裡工作，這才明白之前在這裡工作的人為什麼會辭職。
雖然身邊有這麼多女士，我卻一點也高興不起來。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
As you see, there are no guards guarding the doord to other family's residences.
However, there are too many infiltrators to the Wigner residence who get in there to see Jurgen. Now the door is guarded at all times.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
你看，通往其他家族宅邸的門都沒有衛兵把守。
可是，想闖進維格納宅邸見尤爾根的人太多了，所以現在這裡一直有人看守。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, be quiet there!
It is too noisy that Jurgen cannot take his beauty rest!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
喂，那邊安靜點！
吵得尤爾根都沒法好好休息了！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
It is not for my sake, but for Jurgen.
It would make you sad if Jurgen is unable to sleep, right? So be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
我不是為了自己，是為了尤爾根。
要是尤爾根睡不好，你也會難過吧？所以安靜點！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, wait there! Stop there!
Aren't you the one who has infiltrated the room before? You don't have to run hiding your face! Come back here!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
喂，站住！別跑！
你是不是之前潛入過房間的那個人？不用遮著臉逃跑，給我回來！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
She went off again. She sure is fast.
I am glad that my own sister doesn't come to a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
她又跑了。真夠快的。
還好我妹妹不會來這種地方。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
When I applied to become a guard, I wanted to keep the palace safe with my own hands...
Never did I know that I would end up here...
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
當初我申請當衛兵，是想親手守護宮殿的安全...
沒想到最後竟然被派到這種地方...

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you! There! Stand in the line! Stop there! You shouldn't block the way!
If you keep doing that, I'll stop you from coming here!
scripts.translation:
[強壯的衛兵]
喂，你！那邊那個！排好隊！站住！別擋路！
再這樣，我就不讓你進來了！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, although I respect your hard work going through all the obstacles and hardships, it is still a little too early for you to be here.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，我很敬佩你一路克服重重困難來到這裡，但現在還不是你來的時候。
希望之後還能見到你。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Who are you?
Only the people with permission can enter this place. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你是什麼人？
只有得到許可的人才能進入這裡。請離開。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome to the Wigner family. My name is ^0000cdLevuiere Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎來到維格納家族。我叫^0000cd勒維埃爾·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I am honored by your visit while you are attending the banquet held for you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，您專程參加為您舉辦的宴會，還抽空來拜訪我，我深感榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
This banquet carries more meaning than celebration since the Royal Assembly is conducted at the same time. Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
這場宴會不只是慶祝活動，因為皇家議會也在同時舉行。您聽說了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There is a candidate from our family who participates in the Royal Assembly as well. Would you like to meet him?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們家族也有人參加皇家議會。您想見見他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
She is the lady of the Wigner house, ^0000cdCatherine Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
她是維格納家的女主人，^0000cd凱瑟琳·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
How do you do? Please make yourself at home while you are staying with us, the Wigner family. Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您好。您在維格納家做客期間，請儘管把這裡當成自己家。如果有任何不便，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We, Wigners, will support as much as possible for your convenience, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
親愛的冒險者，我們維格納家會盡力為您提供方便。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor too if you have the time, dear adventurer. You are always welcome.
Where is ^0000cdJurgen^000000 now?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
親愛的冒險者，有空也請來我們的宅邸坐坐，隨時歡迎您。
^0000cd尤爾根^000000現在在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你在找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There you are! Dear adventurer, this is the ^0000cdheir of the Wigner family^000000, and the ^0000cdcandidate for the throne^000000 participating in the Royal Assembly this time.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你來了！親愛的冒險者，這位是^0000cd維格納家族的繼承人^000000，也是這次參加皇家議會的^0000cd王位候選人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hello. My name is ^0000cdJurgen Wigner^000000. It is very nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你好，我叫^0000cd尤爾根·維格納^000000。很高興認識你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home here. If you need anything or find anything inconvenient, please let us know anytime.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請在這裡儘管把這裡當成自己家。如果需要什麼，或覺得有任何不便，隨時告訴我們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your hospitality.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你們的款待。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那麼，失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Tut, I am worried that he lacks sociability. He would have to meet a lot of people as the heir of the house, you know. Dear adventurer, please excuse my son's discourtesy.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
唉，我擔心他不太擅長交際。作為家族繼承人，他以後得和很多人打交道。親愛的冒險者，請原諒我兒子的失禮。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you like to meet our children? They have been excited to meet the hero who defeated Morocc in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果時間允許，您願意見見我們的孩子嗎？他們一直很期待見到那位在宴會上擊敗夢羅克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then please make yourself at home and take a look around, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
那麼，親愛的冒險者，請隨意參觀，四處看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home and take your time looking around here.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，請把這裡當成自己家，慢慢參觀吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you please tell our children the stories of your adventures? It would be an invaluable experience for them.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果您有空，可以給我們的孩子講講冒險故事嗎？這對他們來說會是無比珍貴的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then, have a restful time.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
那麼，請好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, did you meet the children? I would love to have some tea with you and listen to your stories if you are available.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，您見過孩子們了嗎？如果您有空，我很想和您喝杯茶，聽聽您的故事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
We like to hear the stories of adventurers very much.
Those adventures are valuable experiences that money cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們很喜歡聽冒險者講述他們的經歷。
那些冒險是金錢買不到的寶貴經驗。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children have observed their manners though. We must have spoiled them for that they sometimes act so imprudently.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知道孩子們有沒有注意禮儀。他們有時會那麼魯莽，想必是我們太寵他們了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I am trying to warn them a little these days, Please excuse their behaviors if they have done anything rude to you.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
最近我一直在提醒他們。如果他們有哪裡冒犯了您，還請多包涵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. Jurgen seemed to have grown since my last visit.
Katrin and Isaac impressed me as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不會的。尤爾根看起來比我上次來時成熟了不少。
卡特琳和艾薩克也讓我印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have been too easy on them.
We are ashamed that we were not prepared properly for the Royal Assembly last time.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我們對他們太寬容了。
上次皇家議會時準備不足，我們實在慚愧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
It is not important whether he becomes the king or not.
If he is a king material, he will be. If not, he doesn't have to be the king. I don't want to stress him out for that.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
他能不能當上國王並不重要。有國王的資質，自然會成為國王；沒有的話，也不必勉強。我不想因此給他壓力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't you have any ambitions? What a glory would it be if we turn out a king from our family of our generation!
Since our ancestors founded this kingdom, we deserve to produce a king.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您就沒有一點野心嗎？如果我們這一代能出一位國王，該是多大的榮耀！
我們的祖先既然建立了這個王國，我們也理應為王國誕生一位國王。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
The king is a hollow position. It only comes with responsibilities?
Haven't I told you before? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
國王不過是個虛位，伴隨它的只有責任。
我以前不是跟你說過嗎？你忘了？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If our family turns out a king, much of our fortune will be spent. Once, our family has really suffered from it.
Near the king, there are always a swarm of pesky flies.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
如果我們家族出了國王，就得耗費大量財富。我們家曾經因此吃過大苦頭。
國王身邊總圍著一群討厭的蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know, it could be the exact opposite.
It may reinforce our family.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您知道嗎，也可能恰恰相反。
這或許能增強我們家族的勢力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Now there are Katrin and Isaac who can back up Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
現在還有卡特琳和艾薩克可以輔佐尤爾根。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Hum... Isaac.
Thinking of him makes me confident.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
嗯...艾薩克。
一想到他，我就有信心了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must trust Isaac quite a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來您很信任艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Oh, we must have left you out of the conversation, dear adventurer.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
哎呀，親愛的冒險者，看來我們把您晾在一邊了。
真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I have been enjoying the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係，我很享受這段談話。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Now that you mention it, how do you find our third child, Isaac?
He is the most Wigner-like one among the children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
說起來，您覺得我們的第三個孩子艾薩克怎麼樣？
在幾個孩子中，他最有維格納家族的風範。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
While Jurgen is interested in the looks, he doesn't really care for money or the throne...
If Katrin was a son, I would have gladly leave everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
尤爾根很在意外表，卻不怎麼在乎金錢或王位...
要是卡特琳是個男孩，我會很樂意把一切都交給她。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Fortunately, the third child who used to be a mischievous boy has grown up to be suitable for the name of Wigner.
Not that the other two are inadequate.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
幸好，那個曾經調皮搗蛋的三兒子已經長大成人，配得上維格納這個姓氏了。
當然，另外兩個孩子也並非不夠格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白您的意思。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Nevertheless, don't talk like that in front of the children. It is not good to favor a child.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不過，請別在孩子們面前這麼說。偏袒其中一個孩子可不好。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
As a member of the Wigner family, one must be able to cope with criticism.
They should be able to determine what's right upon listening to the words of other people. Also, they need to be able to deal with the hard truths.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
維格納家族的人必須學會面對批評。
他們要能聽取別人的意見、判斷是非，也要能接受殘酷的事實。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please don't talk like that in front of the children.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
請別在孩子們面前這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I never talk to them like this you know.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
你知道的，我從來不會這樣對他們說。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Anyways, Isaac seems busy doing something these days. Do you know what he is doing?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
對了，艾薩克最近好像一直在忙。你知道他在做什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I heard that he is doing something with the third son of the Roegenburg family. You don't need to worry about Isaac. He knows how to take care of himself.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我聽說他在和羅根堡家族的三公子一起做事。別擔心艾薩克，他知道怎麼照顧自己。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Arghhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000

[Catherine]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000 Has something happened to my baby? I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
^0000cd卡特琳？^000000我的寶貝出什麼事了？我得趕緊過去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You two stay here. It might be dangerous. Let me go take a look first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們兩個留在這裡，可能會有危險。我先過去看看。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Has something happened to our child, I mean, Katrin?
Shouldn't I go down there myself?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
我們的孩子出事了嗎？我是說卡特琳。
我不該親自下去看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous. Please wait here for a minute.
I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那裡可能有危險。請在這裡稍等片刻。
我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎回來。
我問過孩子們發生了什麼事，但他們沒有告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
他們是不是瞞著我什麼不好的事...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒有，他們沒瞞您什麼。您不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那請告訴我到底是怎麼回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然他們決定不告訴您，那就不該由我來說。
我還有些事要辦，先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, you seem busy.
Is it about what our children have asked you?
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，您看起來很忙。
是在處理孩子們拜託您的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我們決定不再追問了。
孩子們雖然已經長大，我們卻還是總把他們當小孩子一樣寵著...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
總之，如果您需要幫助，隨時告訴我。
也謝謝您幫助我們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, I have heard the story from the children.
They didn't go into all the details, but I heard that they owed you a huge favor.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，我已經聽孩子們說了這件事。
他們沒講太多細節，不過我聽說他們欠了您一個大人情。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The children are getting along so much better these days.
Not that they were on bad terms, but now they seen to care for one another more. I am so glad.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
孩子們最近相處得融洽多了。
他們以前關係也不差，但現在似乎更關心彼此了。真讓人高興。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You seem to be the messenger of luck to our family.
It is our family tradition to keep a person like you close and treat well.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
您似乎是給我們家帶來好運的人。
按照家族傳統，我們會親近並善待像您這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
We would be honored to have you as a guest to our home.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
宴會結束後，請來我們的莊園做客。
能邀請您來家裡，我們深感榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hello, dear adventurer. Welcome!
We are honored by your visit to the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您好，親愛的冒險者，歡迎！
維格納家族很榮幸能迎來您的拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
As the lady of the house I would make your stay as pleasant as possible.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
如果您在這裡遇到任何不便，請告訴我。
作為女主人，我會盡力讓您住得舒適。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You may talk to the head of the family standing next to me. His name is Levuiere Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您可以和我身旁的家主談談。他叫勒維埃爾·維格納。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Have you met our children? Having a conversation with you would be an invaluable experience for our children, dear adventurer.
They haven't been through any trouble growing up so we feel that they lack in various life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
您見過我們的孩子了嗎？親愛的冒險者，能和您交談，對他們來說會是寶貴的經歷。
他們成長過程中沒遇到過什麼波折，所以我們覺得他們缺少各種人生閱歷。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Since I am married to a man from the family which has founded this country, I want to raise my children worthy of the name. However, my husband is not interested in fame and power.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我既然嫁給了這個國家的建立家族，就想把孩子培養得配得上這個姓氏。可我丈夫對名聲和權勢並不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I feel very sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
對此我深感抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
However, I tend to let our children to whatever they want to do, which makes me wonder if I have spoiled them...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不過，我總是讓孩子們想做什麼就做什麼，現在不禁懷疑自己是不是太寵他們了...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I'd like to hear your stories for that.
It is always a great joy to listen to the stories of the people who have gone through a lot of experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我也想聽聽您的故事。
聽有豐富閱歷的人講故事，總是令人開心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
What if anything has happened to my baby, Katrin?
I'd better I go down there myself.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
我的孩子卡特琳是不是出什麼事了？
我還是親自下去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous, please wait here for a minute.
Let me go down there and see what has happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那裡可能有危險，請在這裡稍等片刻。
我下去看看發生了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I hope everything is OK.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
希望一切平安無事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
我問過孩子們發生了什麼事，但他們沒告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
他們是不是瞞著我什麼不好的事...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒有，他們沒瞞您什麼。您不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
那請告訴我到底是怎麼回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然他們決定不告訴您，那就不該由我來說。
我還有些事要辦，先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children haven't bothered you much. Although we are very curious, we have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知道孩子們有沒有給您添麻煩。雖然我們很好奇，但已經決定不再追問了。
他們都長大了，我們卻還是忍不住把他們當小孩子寵著...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
總之，如果您需要幫助，隨時告訴我。
也謝謝您幫助我們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
For some reason, our children have become very close to one another.
I think it is all thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
不知為何，孩子們最近變得親密多了。
我想這都要歸功於您。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
Please give us the opportunity to treat you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
宴會結束後，請來我們的莊園坐坐。
親愛的冒險者，請讓我們有機會好好款待您。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你帶的行李好像很多，沒問題吧？
看起來又多又大。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
要不要先收拾掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you a fan of mine? Did you make an appointment? If you are a guest of mine, why don't you go see my father over there?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是我的粉絲嗎？預約了嗎？既然是我的客人，怎麼不去那邊見見我父親？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am glad that you are still here. Sorry about my bad manners earlier. I wanted to have more conversation with you. However, if I make any mistakes while I talk in front of my mother, I get scolded.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，很高興你還在這裡。剛才失禮了，抱歉。我本想和你多聊一會兒，可在母親面前說錯話的話，我就會捱罵。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not that she would be harsh on my, but it still kind of bothers me so I had to leave. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她倒不會對我太嚴厲，但我還是會有點在意，所以只好先離開了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, since you are already here, may I introduce my family to you? This elegant lady here is my sister, ^0000cdKatrin Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，既然你已經來了，我可以向你介紹家人嗎？這位優雅的女士是我的姐姐，^0000cd卡特琳·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't call me your sister, but the first daughter of the Wigner family in this occasion.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這種場合別叫我姐姐，應該稱呼我為維格納家的長女。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I am honored to meet you. I hope you have a restful stay with the Wigners.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，很榮幸見到你。希望你在維格納家住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This is my brother, ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這是我的弟弟，^0000cd艾薩克·維格納^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
He is the youngest child of the Wigner family. Unlike my sister and I who are not interested in the family business, he is a prodigy who will shine the name of the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他是維格納家最小的孩子。我和姐姐都對家族事業沒興趣，而他是個天才，將來一定能讓維格納家族揚名。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hello? I am Isaac Wigner. What a trouble you are going through to visit a boring family like this. I hope you have fun here if you can...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你好？我是艾薩克·維格納。讓你特地跑來拜訪我們這個無聊的家族，真是辛苦了。希望你在這裡玩得開心...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Isaac, I have warned you about such manner of speaking before.
You are also being disrespectful to Jurgen who has just introduced you. Are you going to put us all to shame?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
艾薩克，我以前就提醒過你，說話要注意禮貌。
你剛才對介紹你的尤爾根也很不敬，難道想讓我們全家蒙羞嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a joke, just a joke! Sister, you are so inflexible.
In a dreary atmosphere like this, this adventurer deserves to laugh a little, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我只是開個玩笑，開個玩笑！姐姐，你也太死板了。
氣氛這麼沉悶，總得讓這位冒險者笑一笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are not being funny but disrespectful to the guest. Dear adventurer, please excuse the bad manners. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這不是幽默，而是對客人的不敬。親愛的冒險者，請原諒他的無禮。實在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, I want to go home as soon as possible. This place is too narrow and gloomy.
I would like to be in the Banquet Hall at least.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
對了，我想盡快回家。這裡又窄又陰暗。
至少讓我待在宴會廳吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There must be a lot of people who want to see me. I am obliged to show my face.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
一定有很多人想見我，我有義務露個面。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
My presence will light up the dark palace, you know. I should entertain the bored people there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我的光彩能照亮這座昏暗的宮殿，你知道的。我應該去招待那些無聊的人。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are insulting the Royal Assembly. You need to do your best. Royal Assembly is more sacred that you think.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你這是在侮辱皇家議會。你必須認真對待。皇家議會比你想像的更加神聖。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't forget that you are one of the candidates for the throne who will lead the kingdom with the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
別忘了，你是王位候選人之一，將來要和七大家族一起領導王國。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It means that you shouldn't act like a child. I have told you not to take the weight of your responsibility and duty so lightly.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
所以別再像個孩子一樣。別把自己的責任和義務看得這麼輕。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Of course, I know that well. That's why I have tidied up my looks and fixed my hair perfectly.
I tried not to loosen up, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
當然，我很清楚。所以我才整理好儀容，把頭髮打理得一絲不亂。
我可沒有鬆懈哦。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to be able to groom yourself up well to take care of greater matters.
Of course, I am well-prepared.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
想要承擔更重要的事務，就得先把自己打理得體面。
當然，我已經準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Would you like to see my new cape?
It goes with the color of my eyes. It would definitely brighten up the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
想看看我的新斗篷嗎？
它和我的眼睛很相配，一定能讓宮殿更加亮眼。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, there he goes again. I should get going now. Dear adventurer, I would like to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
他又開始了。我先走一步。親愛的冒險者，希望稍後還能見到你。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, not again. Dear adventurer, you should be used to this to have a conversation with my brother at our home.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
唉，又來了。親愛的冒險者，想在我們家和我弟弟交談，你得先習慣這一套。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I guess that is it for today. If you are not busy, ^0000cdwhy don't you go have a cup of tea with our parents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，今天就到這裡吧。如果你不忙，^0000cd不如和我們的父母喝杯茶^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My parents love to hear the stories of adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的父母很喜歡聽冒險者講故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a good idea. Please excuse me then.
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好主意，那我先失陪了。
[尤爾根]
我們的^0000cd父母^000000在那邊，他們想和你聊聊。
對了，門外有很多人在等嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他們都在等我。不過逐一接見他們也挺累的。
用美貌守護世界和平，可真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我們的^0000cd父母^000000在那邊，他們想和你聊聊。
對了，門外有很多人在等嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
他們都在等我。不過逐一接見他們也挺累的。
用美貌守護世界和平，可真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that my sister has lost something. I couldn't understand her words since she was in such a hurry.
Would you please ask her what it is about?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐好像丟了什麼東西。她剛才太著急，我沒聽清楚。
能幫我問問是怎麼回事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whatever she has lost, it must be very valuable to her. I feel that she'd better get someone to help her to find it.
Well, then she would be scolded by our father though...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不管她丟了什麼，對她來說一定很重要。我覺得最好找人幫她一起找。
不過這樣一來，父親可能會責罵她...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I wonder if you can look into it as fast and quietly as possible.
My sister's fate depends on your hands.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你能不能儘快、悄悄地查清楚？
我姐姐的命運就掌握在你手裡了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that she may drop dead if she doesn't find whatever she has lost.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
要是找不到丟的東西，她可能會急得昏過去。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you are here. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了。情況怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Everyone has seen it there, but no one has seen it taken.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒有。大家都看見它在那兒，卻沒人看到是誰拿走的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about the one who has taken it? Oh, right, the one who has taken it wouldn't say so.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那拿走東西的人呢？哦，對了，拿走的人當然不會承認。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, people seem to have a strange prejudice about Katrin. I know the words they say are not true, but you'd better to something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，大家似乎對卡特琳有些奇怪的偏見。我知道他們說的不是真的，但你最好想辦法處理一下。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What do you meant?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, please don't take it wrong. Some people have said that Katrin may have done it to draw attention or they cannot trust Katrin.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別誤會。有些人說卡特琳是為了引人注意才這麼做的，也有人說不信任她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What a nonsense! Phew... This is exactly why I have told her to open her heart to others and talk more...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
真是一派胡言！唉...所以我才一直勸她敞開心扉，多和別人交流...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why should I do that? I don't care about the people who don't know me well anyway.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我為什麼要那樣做？我本來就不在乎那些不瞭解我的人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, when did you come back?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，你什麼時候回來的？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I came here just a minute ago. However, I heard what you said. So, do you think it's my fault to hear such things?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我剛回來。不過我聽到了你們說的話。所以，你覺得別人這麼說是我的錯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You are to blame to a certain level. Look at me. I always to treat others with all my hearts. They all love me for that.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這件事你也有一定責任。看看我，我總是全心全意地對待別人，所以大家都喜歡我。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Do you think people like you for your attitude?
Don't you remember the trouble that all the family members have been through because of your attitude issue during the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你以為大家喜歡的是你的待人方式嗎？
你不記得皇家議會時，因為你的態度問題，全家人都惹上了多少麻煩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If it is not my attitude, then for what?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
如果不是因為我的態度，那是因為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you mean that it is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是說因為我的長相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Can you deny it? Since you were young, when you are doing nothing, no, even when you are rude, people have been nice to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你能否認嗎？從小到大，你什麼都不用做——不，就算你態度惡劣，大家也會對你很好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They all smiled at you to please the pretty-looking heir of the Wigner family, the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
他們都對你笑臉相迎，只為了討好維格納家族那位英俊的繼承人、王位候選人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You say that is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是說大家喜歡我只是因為長相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Looks have played an important role. You cannot deny it. Looks are part of your talent, right?
Especially, in our family. You should know it by now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
長相確實起了很大作用，你無法否認。外表也是你的天賦之一，對吧？
尤其是在我們家，你應該早就明白了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even if it's all for my looks, have I ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
就算大家都是因為我的長相才喜歡我，我又什麼時候希望事情變成這樣的？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Even when I am not doing anything wrong, I am always compared to my handsome brother, and bad rumors follow me. Do you think I have ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
就算我沒做錯什麼，大家也總拿我和英俊的哥哥比較，關於我的壞話也總是傳個不停。你覺得我想這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That's why you need to open up to others and act nice...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
所以你才應該敞開心扉，對別人友善一點...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
The best way not to cause misunderstanding is to be silent. When I don't talk, I don't make a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
避免被誤解的最好辦法就是沉默。不說話，就不會說錯話。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That doesn't always work. About what happened today, you know. Even when you were silent...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沉默也不總是有用。就像今天的事，你明明什麼都沒說...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am already doing my best! You know what? The darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light! It is just like me next to you! I have been trying!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我已經盡力了！你知道嗎？最深的陰影總在最耀眼的光芒旁邊，就像我站在你身邊一樣！我一直都在努力！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, people don't see who I really am! What else should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
可大家根本看不到真正的我！我還能怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Both of you should calm down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們兩個都先冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes. Whatever it is, you'd better calm down. I could hear you yelling at each other from the other end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
沒錯，不管發生什麼，你們都該冷靜點。我在走廊那頭都聽見你們吵架了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our family is supposed to have a reputation to keep, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們家不是很重視名聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What you have ruined last time is about to be recovered now, brother.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哥哥，你上次搞砸的事，現在總算要挽回了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
......

[Isaac]
By the way, ^0000cdisn't it your box^000000, sister? It was on the table while there are a bunch of people hanging out. I kept it not to get it lost.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
對了，^0000cd姐姐，這不是你的盒子嗎^000000？剛才它放在桌上，周圍又有很多人。我怕它丟了，就先替你收起來了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This... ^0000cdWas it you who had taken it^000000?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這個...^0000cd是你拿走的嗎^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You should have let me know when you were taking it. Do you know how much trouble I have been through for this?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你拿走時應該告訴我一聲。你知道我為找它吃了多少苦頭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wait, this is unfair! No? I have taken it with me for your sake, sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
等等，這不公平吧？姐姐，我把它帶在身上也是為了你好啊。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You know how our father gets furious if anything goes missing in our house!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你知道父親發現家裡有東西不見時會多生氣！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
He would go on and on about how we don't need a person who cannot manage even a small thing in the Wigner family and how management skill is the greatest virtue of our family... Just think about it scares me.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
他會一直唸叨，說維格納家族不需要連小事都管不好的人，還說管理能力是家族最大的美德...光是想想就讓我害怕。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What is in there? Why did you fuss about it so much?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
裡面到底是什麼？你為什麼這麼在意？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
There is nothing which is considered valuable by others in it. However, it is the most precious thing to me. Look.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
裡面沒有別人眼中的貴重物品，但對我來說卻是最珍貴的東西。你們看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
A note?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
一張紙條？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
A diary?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
日記？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is better to avoid a futile conversation. If you don't talk, you don't make mistakes. However, there are moments that you want to be honest with yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
與其進行徒勞的交談，不如保持沉默。不說話就不會犯錯。可是，有時人還是想對自己坦誠。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
This diary has been capturing the moments that I want be true to myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這本日記記錄了那些我想對自己坦誠的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Nevertheless, I still am mistaken by others even I stay quiet. I guess silence has not been the best policy after all. Since I have my diary back, I should get going.
Dear adventurer, please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
即使我保持沉默，別人還是會誤解我。看來沉默終究不是最好的辦法。既然日記已經找回來了，我該走了。
親愛的冒險者，給您添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, I...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，我...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
That's all right now. I'll forget it all. You don't have to care about it either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
沒關係，就當什麼都沒發生吧。你也不用放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
She walks so fast. What was it all about?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
她走得真快。剛才到底怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It's all because you have taken the box without a word... Phew... Well, long story short, our sister is upset.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
都怪你一聲不吭就拿走了盒子...唉...簡單來說，姐姐生氣了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Argh! Why is she upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
啊？她為什麼生氣？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is complicated. I guess there are some bad rumors about her out there.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
說來話長。我想外面流傳著一些關於她的壞話。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I have heard about it before. However, I thought you would take care of it since it is mainly your fault.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，我以前聽說過。不過我以為你會處理，畢竟主要是你的錯。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You knew about that? Why didn't you tell me about it?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你知道這件事？為什麼不告訴我？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Even if I did, you wouldn't have taken it seriously. It is true that you were born with that blessed looks.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
就算告訴你，你也不會當回事。你確實天生就有一副令人羨慕的好相貌。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why the people around you have looked up to you. Not that our parents have been hard on us. No wonder you have grown up to be so carefree.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
所以周圍的人都仰慕你。倒不是父母對我們不好...難怪你長大後這麼無憂無慮。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you picking up a fight with me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是在找我吵架嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
No, listen to me. I am telling the truth here. No hard feelings.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不是，聽我說。我只是在講實話，別介意。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Due to your superlative looks, we have been quite disadvantaged, growing up.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
因為你長得太出眾，我們成長過程中一直很吃虧。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Do you remember what our sister has said? How the darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light? It is true.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你還記得姐姐說的嗎？最深的陰影總在最耀眼的光芒旁邊。她說得沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I don't get it. Beauty is a good thing. Everyone likes it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我不明白。長得好看是好事，大家都喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The people who see it may appreciate it. However, the people right next to it are being compared to it.
Among the three of us, it must have been the hardest for our sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
旁人會欣賞那份美，可站在美人身邊的人就會被拿來比較。
我們三兄妹裡，姐姐一定最難受。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Imagine a plain person standing next to an angelic beauty. Despite looking completely normal, she or he would look unattractive and somber. We have been compared to you like that, all our lives.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
想像一個普通人站在天使般美麗的人旁邊。明明一切正常，卻會顯得平庸陰沉。我們一輩子都被拿來和你這樣比較。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our sister must have suffered from the stress even more. She has managed to endure it with her extraordinary patience and generosity. In fact, I think she could be an angel.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
姐姐承受的壓力一定更大。她靠著非凡的耐心和寬容熬了過來。說真的，我覺得她簡直像天使。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that... At all..
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我以前完全不知道...真的一點都不知道...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我現在該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think it is entirely your fault. It was our parents who have created you like that.
Oh, well, you are to blame for your carefreeness though.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我覺得這也不能全怪你。畢竟是父母把你養成這樣的。
不過你確實該為自己的粗心負責。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Anyway, who we need to worry about is our sister. Has she ever been mad at us? What should we do when she is upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
總之，現在該擔心的是姐姐。她以前生過我們的氣嗎？她難過的時候，我們該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, she has been mad at me once when I was young.
I guess it was somewhat similar to what has just happened. She said something about comparison then...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，我小時候她有一次生過我的氣。
好像和剛才的情況有些像，當時她也提到了被拿來比較...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was too young to remember it. However, I do remember how our sister became very quiet after arguing with you.
You have been the main culprit of it after all.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我那時太小，不記得具體情況。不過我記得她和你吵完後就變得很沉默。
說到底，你才是主要原因。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is not the time to waste time to distinguish between right and wrong. What should we do, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
現在不是浪費時間爭論誰對誰錯的時候。親愛的冒險者，我們該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know. Have you ever tried to countervail someone's anger?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也不知道。你試過想辦法平息別人的怒氣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No. No one's ever been mad at me, except our sister.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沒有。除了姐姐，從來沒人對我發過火。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please help us out here.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請幫幫我們吧。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Leave me out of it. I wasn't the one who got her mad.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
別把我扯進來，又不是我惹她生氣的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You were the cause of the problem.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這事就是因你而起。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was trying to keep it safe... Please, dear adventurer, help us!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我只是想替她保管好...親愛的冒險者，求你幫幫我們！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can you do? You'd better wait until your sister lets off steam... Or, you could try giving her something she likes...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們能做什麼？最好先等她消消氣...或者，送她一件喜歡的東西也行...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What doesn't she like? Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她喜歡什麼？你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know as much as you do.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我知道的和你一樣多。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Which means you know nothing, great!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
也就是說你什麼都不知道，真有你的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems to value experiences and memories. Don't you have any good memories with her? Trace back your memory back a little.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她似乎很珍惜經歷和回憶。你們之間有什麼美好的回憶嗎？仔細回想一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Hum... There's no such... Wait! Yes, I remember one!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...好像沒有...等等！我想起來了！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What? Is there any?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
什麼？真有嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember how we walked around the Comodo beach together during the summer vacation? We picked up some pretty stones on the shore and in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你還記得暑假時我們一起在克魔島海灘散步嗎？我們在岸邊和洞穴裡撿了些漂亮的石頭。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our sister really liked...This clear stone containing some sea water and a piece of coral inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐特別喜歡那塊透明的石頭...裡面封著海水和一片珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
大海之石？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Yes, that's it! She lined up those stones near the window and enjoyed looking at them glittering in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
對，就是它！她把那些石頭擺在窗邊，喜歡看它們在陽光下閃閃發亮。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I remember now. I remember seeing them glittering in her room.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，我想起來了。我記得那些石頭在她房間裡閃閃發光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The ^0000cdSea Stone^000000? What is it?

[Jurgen]
It is a pretty stone which can only be found in Comodo. It is called the Sea Stone because it looks as if there is the sea captured inside of it, with the sea water and corals.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那是隻能在克魔島找到的漂亮石頭。裡面彷彿封存著大海，有海水和珊瑚，因此被稱作大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Some romantics call it, the gift from a mermaid.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
有些浪漫的人把它稱為美人魚的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You may find them upon digging the ground on the Comodo beach once in a while. Our sister, Isaac and I used to dig them out whenever we are on summer vacation.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
偶爾能在克魔島海灘挖到。我們三個以前每逢暑假都會去挖。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have heard that it is not found on the beach these days. Instead, you can get it by killing the ^0000cdMedusa inside the cave in the west of Comodo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
聽說現在海灘上已經找不到了。如今得去克魔島西邊的洞穴打倒^0000cd米杜沙^000000才能獲得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What? Did the Medusa take them all?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
什麼？米杜沙把它們全拿走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Who knows? It is supposed to be the gift from a mermaid. Some say, the Mermen have given them to the Medusa. Well, this also sounds like a fairytale.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
誰知道呢？大海之石據說是美人魚的禮物。也有人說是海人族送給米杜沙的...聽起來像童話吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How do you know it so well?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你怎麼知道得這麼清楚？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have once tried to distribute them all over the continent. You used to be able to get them by just digging the ground. Tourists used to pick them up as souvenirs or gamblers used to use them as talismans for their prayers to the sea-god.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我以前想把它們推廣到大陸各地。那時只要挖土就能找到。遊客會撿來當紀念品，賭徒則把它當作向海神祈禱的護身符。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since it became hard to get them, I have given up the plan. The game is not worth the candle, having to kill the Medusa on the way.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
後來它們變得很難找，我就放棄了。為了挖石頭還得一路打倒米杜沙，實在得不償失。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that. Anyway, I remember there was something else next to the stone.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我還真不知道。對了，我記得石頭旁邊還有別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
There were some flowers, a bunch of them. What flower was that? I lasted so long that it never seemed to wither at all.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
好像有一大束花。那是什麼花來著？放了那麼久，似乎一直都沒有枯萎。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, do you have any idea what flower that would have been?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你知道那會是什麼花嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it didn't whither for so long, it could have been a Witherless Rose.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果一直沒有枯萎，可能是永恆玫瑰。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is there such a thing? Why do you need a Witherless Rose when you can just buy another flower before the older one withers?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
還有這種東西？舊花枯萎前再買一朵新的不就好了，為什麼非要永恆玫瑰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want what you like to last long. If you replace it with another flower, it is not the same flower you liked anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人總希望喜歡的東西能長久。換成另一朵花，就不是原來那朵了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Well, I guess I can imagine myself being replaced with another person. I understand it now.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...如果我被別人取代，應該也能理解這種感覺了。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
So, when are you going to get them for us?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那你打算什麼時候去幫我們找？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Isaac]
You didn't think that we would go there to get them ourselves, did you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你不會以為我們要親自去找吧？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I am busy with my business, and Jurgen attracts too many people around him.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我忙著做生意，尤爾根身邊又總圍著一大群人。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We need someone else we can trust, who happens to be right in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們正好需要一個值得信賴的人，而這樣的人就在眼前。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I was worried about it as well. Please, dear adventurer, help us. The loving relationship among us depends on you.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我也正擔心這件事呢。親愛的冒險者，請幫幫我們。我們兄妹能不能和好就靠你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so... How many of them do you need? Where can I get the Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你們這麼說...需要多少？大海之石要去哪裡找？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... I guess we need ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000 and ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000 since we want to decorate the window with them.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...我們想用它們裝飾窗邊，所以需要^0000cd1朵永恆玫瑰^000000和^0000cd10塊大海之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We are depending on you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! Did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了！帶了我們拜託的東西嗎？拜託你說帶了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I wasn't able to bring them all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒能全部帶來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Why? Did you forget what to bring by any chance? Let me tell you once more.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
為什麼？你是不是忘了要帶什麼？我再告訴你一次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000. You can get them while hunting Medusa in Comodo. They are valuable because it is difficult to kill Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
^0000cd10塊大海之石^000000。去克魔島打米杜沙時可以獲得。米杜沙很難對付，所以這些石頭很珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
And ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
還有^0000cd1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I know that's a lot of things to bring, but I believe we need them all to make our sister feel better.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我知道要帶的東西不少，但我相信只有湊齊這些，才能讓姐姐開心起來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你帶來我們拜託的東西了嗎？拜託你說帶來了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes, please tell us that you did. We tried our best to balance out her anger. However, she's been giving the cold shoulder to us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
是啊，快說帶來了吧。我們已經盡力想讓姐姐消氣，可她還是一直對我們愛理不理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought them. You'd better not to press an angry person so impatiently like that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我帶來了。對生氣的人可別這麼著急地催促，你們懂的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa, they are all here! You saved our lives. We should call our sister now. What if she is still mad at us...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哇，全都帶來了！你真是救了我們一命。我們現在就叫姐姐過來。萬一她還在生氣怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have already called her.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我已經叫她來了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why do you keep calling me? Please leave me alone for that I am not mad at you any more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你們為什麼一直叫我？讓我一個人靜一靜吧，我已經不生氣了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, forgive us. Please stop being mad at us.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，請原諒我們。別再生我們的氣了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
...Do you know what you have done wrong?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
...你們知道自己做錯了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think I am to blame, but I am sorry that I have taken your stuff without telling you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我覺得我不該受責備，不過沒告訴你就拿走你的東西，確實是我不對。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, I am sorry about it all. I haven't been considerate of your feelings. However, it wouldn't have hurt you to open up to me a little, since we are family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，這一切都是我的錯。我沒有顧及你的感受。不過我們畢竟是一家人，你也可以稍微對我敞開心扉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If we don't be honest to each other, we will just grow away. We will get our wires crossed again.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
如果我們不坦誠相待，就會漸漸疏遠，也會再次產生誤會。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right. I have given it a thought as well. I think some part of it is my fault. I should have been honest with you, at least.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你說得對。我也想過了，覺得自己也有錯。至少，我應該坦誠地告訴你們。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
When we were young, we used to talk a lot, and have some good times. Look at these. We used to run around looking for things like these. Do you remember this stone? You liked to watch them glitter in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
小時候我們常聊天，也有過很多快樂時光。看這些，我們以前總會到處找這樣的石頭。還記得這塊嗎？你喜歡看它們在陽光下閃閃發亮。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They are.. When did you get them...?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
這些是...你什麼時候找到的...？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The adventurer helped us. I guess those were the times when we were the closest to one another. Look at this.
This stone is so clear that you can see the seawater and coral reef inside right through it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
多虧冒險者幫忙。我想那時我們最親近了。看這個。
這塊石頭很透明，能直接看到裡面的海水和珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I think people are just the same. We don't need to show everything, but we do need to show some to let others know how pretty we are inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我覺得人也一樣。不必什麼都展示出來，但總該讓別人看到一些，知道我們的內心也很美好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Yes, you are right. I think you have got the point. I'll try. I'll do it to avoid any more misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你說得對。我想我明白你的意思了。我會試著改變，避免再發生誤會。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
By the way, when did you learn to talk like that? I think I am finally able to talk with you guys now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
對了，你什麼時候變得這麼會說話了？我覺得現在終於能和你們好好聊聊了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You mean, you haven't been able to talk with us?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是說以前一直沒法和我們好好說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, thanks to my effort, we brothers and sister have become close to one another again.
Thank you for your work, dear adventurer. This is not much, but I hope you take it. Sorry about all the trouble you have been through for us.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
嗯，多虧我努力，我們兄妹又親近起來了。
親愛的冒險者，謝謝你幫忙。這點謝禮不算什麼，希望你收下。讓你為我們費心了，真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Material reward has never seems to small before.
I guess what you have done for us is just that priceless.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
以前我從沒覺得物質上的謝禮如此微不足道。
你為我們做的一切實在無價。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry to cause such an embarrassing scene in front of you. If you have time, please come by again. We will make sure to receive you properly next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
很抱歉讓你看到這麼尷尬的一幕。有空請再來，下次我們一定好好招待你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I have learned new lessons and earned many things, thanks to you. If you need our help, we will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you luck!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，多虧了你，我學到了很多，也收穫良多。如果你需要我們幫忙，我們一定盡力。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen, Hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤爾根，你在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, dear adventurer, welcome.
Are you enjoying the banquet? Do you need any help by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，親愛的冒險者，歡迎。
宴會還愉快嗎？需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I just wanted to talk to you for a second.
I wonder how your sister is doing these days as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼，只是想和你聊幾句。也想問問你妹妹最近怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thanks to your help, we have never been better than this.
I've been talking to my sister much more, and..
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
多虧了你的幫忙，我們兄妹的關係比以往都好。
我現在常和姐姐聊天，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
打擾了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am sorry. I thought no one was here. I just wanted to clean the room, I am really sorry. I'll come back later.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
抱歉，我以為裡面沒人。我只是來打掃房間的，真的很抱歉。我晚點再來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not at all. Please come in. It is a nonsense that you cannot clean the room because of the people inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沒關係，請進。不能因為有人在裡面就不打掃房間。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, long time no see. Sorry about the trouble you went through last time. Fortunately, the box thing has been resolved well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，好久不見。上次讓你費心了，抱歉。幸好盒子的事已經順利解決了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh... Yes... I see...
Hello...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦...是的...我明白了...
你好...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Is this the person from the last time? Whom you asked about the box...?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這就是上次那個人嗎？就是你問過盒子事情的那位？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, she is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，就是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am sorry about that. We were desperate and in a hurry. I apologize if you were upset by it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那件事很抱歉。當時我們又急又慌。如果讓你不高興了，我向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Thank you for telling me that. Since I am a maid, there are people who suspect me or treat me like a thief.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
謝謝您告訴我這些。我只是個女僕，有些人會懷疑我，甚至把我當成小偷。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
However, you seem different, dear prince. I am a little surprised. I thought people who belong to the high society didn't know how to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
不過，王子殿下，您似乎不一樣。我有些驚訝，一直以為上流社會的人都不會道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, it was very presumptuous of me.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦，是我失禮了。
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No, that's OK.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Then, I should get going.
I am supposed to clean the room when there is no one inside anyway. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
那我先告辭了。
反正房間裡沒人時我還得來打掃，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You shouldn't have to... Well, she's gone...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不用這樣...唉，她走了...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那麼，親愛的冒險者？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
Well, I think ^0000cdI have fallen in love^000000 .
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯，我想^0000cd我墜入愛河了^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you have.

[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I have never met anyone who looks directly into my eyes like that.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我從沒遇過一個人，能那樣直視我的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I fell in love with her. I love her dignified and calm voice. Unaffected behaviors That tone of voice reflecting strong will...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我愛上她了。我喜歡她端莊沉靜的聲音、自然不做作的舉止，還有那透著堅定意志的語氣...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
All the women I have seen so far are like flowers in the greenhouse. However, she resembles a wild flower in the field.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我見過的女人都像溫室裡的花，可她就像田野中的野花。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is totally different from the ladies I have met before.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她和我以前認識的那些貴族小姐截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! How can I tell someone I have fallen in love at first sight how I feel? Should I go take her hands and say I love her?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！要怎麼向一見鍾情的人表達心意？我該不該牽起她的手，告訴她我愛她？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? You don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？你對這種事一竅不通？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is my ^0000cdfirst love^000000. My life will never be the same since I have met her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她是我的^0000cd初戀^000000。遇見她之後，我的人生就不一樣了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... Try to remember what all the people outside the door have done to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...想想門外那些人都對你做過什麼。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well... Nothing that I can recall... Hum... There have been some impressive people though. There was this person who penetrated defense and hid behind the curtain in my room...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
嗯...我想不起來有什麼特別的...不過有些人確實令人印象深刻。有人突破防守，躲到我房間的窗簾後面...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... That's impressive. However, it is a crime. You should forget it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...真厲害。不過那是犯罪，還是忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There was this person who sent me a life-size golden statue. I sent it back since I didn't need it and it didn't look as good as real me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
有人送過我一尊等身大的金像。我不需要，而且它看起來也不如真人帥，所以就退回去了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about sending her a gold statue looking exactly like me?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
要不我送她一尊和我一模一樣的金像？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She will be repelled if you try too hard like that from the very beginning. How about sending her a ^0000cdletter^000000 with a small gift?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一開始就這麼賣力，會把她嚇跑的。不如寄一封^0000cd信^000000，再附上一件小禮物？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is a good idea! Please wait a moment!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
好主意！請稍等！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Wait for what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？等什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you forget? If I take a step out of that door, I'll draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你忘了嗎？我只要一走出那扇門，就會引起大家注意。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It would cause her trouble, wouldn't it. By the way, I didn't even get the chance to ask her what her name was.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那樣反而會給她添麻煩。對了，我甚至還沒來得及問她叫什麼名字。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send this letter to her with this box containing jewelry.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把這封信和裝著珠寶的盒子一起送給她。

scripts.text: OK.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 有點困難

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult. I have other things to do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這有點困難，我還有別的事要做。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sorry about the difficult request. I guess I should go there myself. You may be able to see the news that the heir of the Wigner family has been crushed to death by his followers on Daily Rune-Midgarts tomorrow morning.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
抱歉拜託你這麼難辦的事。看來我只能親自去了。明天早上，你或許會在《盧恩·米德加茲日報》上看到維格納家族繼承人被狂熱粉絲壓死的新聞。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Or, the poor maid could be hospitalized by tomorrow. Anyway, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
或者那位可憐的女僕明天就得住院。總之，我理解。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. I should get going then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，那我這就出發。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you. How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！我一直在等你。事情怎麼樣了？她也說喜歡我了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I haven't been able to meet her yet. Let me go see her again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我還沒能見到她。我再去找她看看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you.
How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！我一直在等你。
事情怎麼樣了？她也說喜歡我了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, actually... She ^0000cdturned it down^000000. She returned what you had sent her as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，其實...她^0000cd拒絕了^000000，還把你送的東西退了回來。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She turned me down?
Why? Did she say that she didn't like my looks? Or wasn't what I had sent her enough for her?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她拒絕我了？
為什麼？她說不喜歡我的長相嗎？還是我送的東西不夠好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that... She has said she is currently not in the situation to go out with someone. She seems to have a reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是那樣...她說目前不適合和別人交往，似乎另有原因。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Does she already have a boyfriend? I am not surprised. She is so attractive after all. No wonder I have fallen for her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
她已經有男朋友了嗎？我倒不意外，畢竟她那麼迷人。難怪我會愛上她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that either... She just has said she is currently not in the situation to date someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也不是...她只是說目前不適合和別人約會。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa... ^0000cdIt is my first time to want something so badly in this life^000000. Never did I know that it would be so difficult to get.
Is living such a difficult thing?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
天哪...^0000cd這是我這輩子第一次如此渴望得到某樣東西^000000，沒想到實現起來這麼難。
人生怎麼會這麼難呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, my father has told me that I should always try at least three times.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不過父親告訴過我，無論什麼事，至少要嘗試三次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
First try to begin, second try to confirm and the third try to give up since it is not meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
第一次是為了開始，第二次是為了確認，第三次則是為了放棄，因為那註定不屬於自己。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
So, dear adventurer. Please do this one more time for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
所以，親愛的冒險者，請再幫我一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I think you should write the letter again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我想你應該重新寫一封信...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I need something special. Something pretty and shiny which reflects my feelings...
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我需要特別的東西，一件漂亮又閃亮、能表達我心意的東西...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The Sea Stone! And flower!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
大海之石！還有花！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I want to send her ^0000cdthe heart that is as wide and beautiful as the sea^000000 and ^0000cdthe amaranthine heart for her^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想送她^0000cd如大海般廣闊美麗的心^000000，以及^0000cd永不凋零的愛意^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I go get them all myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道還要我親自去把它們都找來？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, dear adventurer, be the messenger of love for me. Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，請做我的愛情信使吧。替我送上這顆比大海更廣闊、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so, I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說，那我就去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my letter with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把這封信和^0000cd15顆大海之石、1朵永恆玫瑰^000000一起送給她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
As I told you before, you can get the Sea Stone from killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
正如我之前說的，大海之石可以通過擊敗米杜沙獲得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I will never forget this and make it up to you. We, Wigners, never forget any debt.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，我不會忘記這份恩情，一定會報答你。我們維格納家族從不欠人情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am doing it expecting something in return, but I will deliver them to her since you look so desperate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可不是為了回報才幫忙的，不過看你這麼著急，我就替你送去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thank you! Oh, do you happen to get her name by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
謝謝！對了，你知道她叫什麼名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mary, her name is Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她叫瑪麗。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cdMary^000000. It is a common but pretty name. What is common means that it is well loved by many people. I'll get all my things embroidered with this name from now on.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
^0000cd瑪麗^000000。普通又好聽的名字。所謂普通，就是很多人都喜歡。從今以後，我要把這個名字繡在所有東西上。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you may set off now. Please deliver my feelings to her safely.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你可以出發了。請把我的心意平安送到她那裡。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你把我的心意平安送給瑪麗了嗎？你回來得真快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你忘了要帶什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你需要帶^0000cd15顆通過擊敗米杜沙獲得的大海之石，以及1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right? Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
瑪麗收到這些普通的禮物，應該不會覺得不自在吧？請替我送上這顆比大海更廣闊、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! You are back!
I couldn't stop thinking about her even while you were gone.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者！你回來了！
你不在的時候，我滿腦子都是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even when I eat, drink a tea, look into the mirror and talking to other people! I though about her all day. It was painful but I was in a flutter.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
無論是吃飯、喝茶、照鏡子還是和別人說話，我整天都在想著她！雖然很煎熬，心裡卻又小鹿亂撞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what falling in love is like.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是戀愛的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, then I must have been doing bad things to numerous people. There is nothing I can do for them.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，那我一定辜負過很多人的心意。我也沒辦法補償她們了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, since your hands are empty, I guess she has accepted my heart at last!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
對了，你兩手空空地回來，看來她終於接受我的心意了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, hum... She didn't react negatively, but you'd better be careful since you don't know each other yet.
Why don't you spare her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...她沒有表現出反感，但你們還不熟，最好謹慎些。不如給她一點時間？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She must have not accepted my heart completely then. I am all right though! She hasn't turned me down yet!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
看來她還沒有完全接受我的心意。不過沒關係！至少她還沒拒絕我！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know how painful it was to love someone. I did know how I would be fidgety about a word or gesture of her.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我以前不知道愛一個人會這麼痛苦，也沒想到自己會因為她的一句話、一個動作而坐立不安。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is true. Winning someone's heart is the hardest thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
確實如此。贏得一個人的心是最難的事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I guess I should be nicer to the people who like me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想我應該對那些喜歡我的人好一點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is a good idea...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得這主意不太好...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, thank you again. Would you come by again tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，再次謝謝你。明天還會再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
It seems like a good sign. Paddle as the wave approaches. That's one of the many mottos of our family.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
這似乎是個好兆頭。趁浪頭到來時划槳，這是我們家族格言之一。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to let her know of my blazing heart every day.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我想每天都讓她知道我這顆熾熱的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I have a feeling that everything will turn out great if you send it for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我覺得只要你替我送去，一切都會順利的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about allowing her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如給她一些時間？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What if she forgets about me? Then, please send her my message once a day. You wouldn't say no, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
萬一她把我忘了怎麼辦？請每天替我給她捎個口信，好嗎？你不會拒絕吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, I almost forgot. It is not much, but please accept this as my token of gratitude for the messenger of my love.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，差點忘了。禮物不算貴重，請收下這點謝意，感謝你做我的愛情信使。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I'll see you tomorrow then!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那明天再見！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你把我的心意平安送給瑪麗了嗎？你這麼快就回來了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你忘了要帶什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你需要帶^0000cd15顆通過擊敗米杜沙獲得的大海之石，以及1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
瑪麗收到這些普通的禮物，應該不會覺得不自在吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請替我送上這顆比大海更廣闊、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I'd like to call you who has delivered my message of love to her, the ^0000cdMessenger of Love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，我想稱呼你這位替我傳遞愛意的人為^0000cd愛情信使^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please don't...

[Jurgen]
^0000cdCupid of Love^000000...

[{0}]
Please stop it.

[Jurgen]
On the day Mary accepts my feelings, I would like to give you a huge pure gold statue.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
等瑪麗接受我的心意時，我要送你一座巨大的純金雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You really don't have to do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的不用了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, this is the only thing I can offer you for now. Please visit our manor later. There are some real valuable things.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
不過這就是我現在唯一能送你的東西。稍後請到我們莊園來，那裡有真正珍貴的東西。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then dear adventurer, I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
那麼，親愛的冒險者，明天再見。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, what brought you here around this time? May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，這個時間來有什麼事嗎？我能幫上忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you here to deliver my message of love to Mary?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你是來替我向瑪麗傳達愛意的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, well, it was you who had said that she would be repelled by my impatience.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
哦，對了，是你說我太著急會讓她反感。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am trying hard not to send her my love letter every minute and second. Please comeback when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我正在努力剋制自己，不每分每秒都給她寫情書。等時機到了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! It seems that something good may happen today.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，你來了！看來今天會有好事發生。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please deliver her the message of my love with deliver my message of love with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把我的愛意和^0000cd15顆大海之石、1朵永恆玫瑰^000000一起送給她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember? You can get the Sea Stone by killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
還記得嗎？擊敗米杜沙就能得到大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send them to her and tell me how Mary is doing today. I am sad that she doesn't come here to clean the room anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請把這些交給她，再告訴我瑪麗今天過得怎麼樣。她不再來這裡打掃房間，我有些失落。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to go see her myself. However, I guess she will feel uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
我也想親自去見她，可我想她會覺得不自在。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am depending on you!
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
親愛的冒險者，就拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, we are honored to have you with us. Have you met our father who is the head of the Wigner family?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，歡迎來到我們家。您見過維格納家族的家主，也就是我的父親了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
How about meeting Jurgen, the hair of the Wigner family who is participating in the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
要不要去見見正在參加皇家議會的維格納家族繼承人尤爾根？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Then, have a comfortable time in the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
那麼，請在維格納家好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am over!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我先走了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, please calm down. Where did you put it? Are you sure you have left it here?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
姐姐，先冷靜一下。你把它放在哪裡了？確定是放在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Here, I have left it right here! After talking to the adventurer, I put it here and... It was gone... Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我明明就放在這裡！和冒險者談完後，我就把它放在這兒了...怎麼不見了...到底去哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What did you lose?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們丟了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My jewelry box... Well, it is technically not a jewelry box since it doesn't hold any jewelry in it, but anyways, ^0000cda small box containing something very important is missing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的首飾盒...雖說裡面其實沒裝首飾，總之，^0000cd一個裝著重要東西的小盒子不見了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I took it out of my bag and out it here. Then it was gone. What should I do? I don't know what I should do without it... I cannot afford to let anyone see it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我從包裡拿出來放在這裡，然後就不見了。我該怎麼辦？沒有它我真不知道該怎麼辦...我不能讓任何人看到裡面的東西...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It could be the ^0000cdmaid^000000 who came here earlier to clean the room. She may have taken it.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
