會不會是剛才來打掃房間的^0000cd女僕^000000拿走了？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You haven't seen her taking it. You shouldn't doubt other people without proof.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你又沒看到她拿走。沒有證據就不該懷疑別人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am suspicious of her, but it may help to ask her. If she saw it or when was the last time she saw it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是懷疑她，不過問問她也許能有幫助。比如她有沒有看到，或最後一次看到是什麼時候...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please don't. She would be upset if she feels that she is being suspected.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請別這麼做。她會覺得我們在懷疑她，一定會很難過。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
But you are being so nervous. Isn't it an important thing to you?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
可你這麼緊張，這東西對你很重要吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
是很重要，不過...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You really need to get it back, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
你很想把它找回來，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你說得對，可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make sure to ask her about it as politely as possible. Please relax and wait here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會盡量禮貌地問她。請放鬆些，在這裡等我。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't know if is the best idea. I don't want her to feel that we are suspecting her.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我不知道這是不是個好主意。我不想讓她覺得我們懷疑她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Just wait until the adventurer comes back. The adventurer is really experienced in this kind of stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
等冒險者回來吧。冒險者很有處理這類事情的經驗。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Should I...
Then, please help me, dear adventurer. I'll go search other pleases then.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我應該...
那就拜託你了，親愛的冒險者。我去別的地方找找。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, help her. I have heard that ^0000cdthe maids are in the kitchen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤爾根]
請幫幫她。我聽說^0000cd女僕們都在廚房^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Oh, what should I do?
I should have taken better care of it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
唉，我該怎麼辦？
我應該好好保管它的...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please make sure not to hurt other people's feelings.
I would like to go find it myself, but I am not in the situation to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請別傷害其他人的感情。
我也想親自去找，但現在不方便...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't even want to imagine anyone else sees it though...
I would be embarrassed to death.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我甚至不敢想像被別人看到裡面的東西...
那會讓我羞愧得無地自容。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please leave me alone now!
Ah, it was you, dear adventurer. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
請讓我一個人靜一靜！
啊，是你啊，親愛的冒險者。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your feeling must have been hurt by your brothers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的兄弟們一定傷了你的心。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is not that.
I am... I am just angry at myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
不是那樣的。
我...我只是生自己的氣。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Something like this never would have happened if was more careful...
Moreover, I shouldn't have said such things to my brothers either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
如果我再小心一點，這種事根本不會發生...
而且我也不該對兄弟們說那樣的話。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, I couldn't take it anymore when I heard the rumors and Jurgen's attitude...
I thought I was used to those things... I guess I am not.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
可是聽到那些流言，再看到尤爾根的態度，我實在忍不下去了...
我以為自己早就習慣了...看來並沒有。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I should have given it up by now...
Oh, I am sorry. I believe you haven't come here to listen to a story like this.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我本來早就該放下了...
啊，抱歉。我想你不是特地來聽我說這些的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry, but I want to be alone for now.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
對不起，我現在只想一個人待著。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Thanks to you, we have become closer to one another now.
Now I can open up to my brothers more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
多虧了你，我們現在親近多了。
我也能更敞開心扉地和兄弟們交流了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I have tried to hide my feelings and save my words. However, I have realized that It is not the best policy.
From now own, I am going to tell them how I feel to avoid any misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我一直壓抑感受、儘量少說話，但我明白了這並不是最好的辦法。
從今以後，我會告訴他們我的想法，避免再產生誤會。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
親愛的冒險者，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I believe I haven't met you before. Are you here to see my father?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我想我們之前沒見過。您是來見我父親的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My father is over there.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我父親在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Isaac Wigner]
Dear adventurer, do you know the old saying that the emptier it is, the more you can fill it?
It is one of the many aphorisms passing down in our family.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克·維格納]
親愛的冒險者，你聽過“越空的容器，越能裝下東西”這句老話嗎？
這是我們家族代代相傳的格言之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，艾薩克·維格納。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, welcome, dear adventurer, my brother is over there...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，歡迎，親愛的冒險者。我哥哥在那邊...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I am here to see you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我是來見你的，艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it about Wolf?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
是關於狼的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. How did you know it...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。你怎麼知道...？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wolf is not here even after the time he has promised. He is the man of his word. Something must have happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
狼已經過了約定時間還沒來。他一向言而有信，一定是出了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I never expected you would come here instead though. So is he cancelling the appointment today then?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不過我沒想到你會親自來這裡。他今天是取消約定了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he is. And he asked me to get ^0000cda certain thing^000000 from you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他取消了。他讓我向你，艾薩克，取^0000cd一樣東西^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That thing...? Wolf must trust you, dear adventurer. Or it could be...
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那樣東西...？狼一定很信任你，親愛的冒險者。或者，這是...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Some kind of a test.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
某種考驗。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Don't take it the wrong way. I am just be careful. In order to do what I do, I need to know who I can trust first.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
別誤會，我只是謹慎行事。要做我正在做的事，首先得知道誰值得信任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.

[Isaac]
You can bring it to Wolf. Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你可以把東西交給狼。請小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
May I ask you for one more thing? I have heard that there is ^0000cda strange rumor^000000 circulating in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我還能再拜託你一件事嗎？我聽說普隆德拉正在流傳^0000cd奇怪的傳聞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is supposed to be about ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000. Would you investigate about the rumor and let me know the truth?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
據說和^0000cd赫爾穆特·羅根堡^000000有關。能調查一下傳聞，告訴我真相嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since I have a reputation to keep. I cannot afford to have a scandal. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我得維護自己的名聲，不能惹上醜聞。請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Have you deliver the thing to Wolf safely? You should be careful with it since it can be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你把東西安全交給狼了嗎？那東西可能很危險，要小心。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
And, don't forget to ask about the rumor as well.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
還有，別忘了打聽那個傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你回來了。東西安全交給他了嗎？他對傳聞怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the document about that. Here... It was. Wait, I must have forget to bring it with me. I am sorry. I'll be back with it soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是那件事的檔案。在這裡...咦？等等，我好像忘了帶。抱歉，我馬上回去拿。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Such things happen. Take your time. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這種事難免會發生。慢慢來，我會等你的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你回來了。東西安全交給他了嗎？他對傳聞怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the ^0000cddocument^000000 about it. It is written by Wolf Roegenburg himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是相關的^0000cd檔案^000000，出自沃爾夫·羅根堡本人之手。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Let's see... Hum... So the new business will be delayed indefinitely. The direction of the business will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我看看...嗯...看來新業務要無限期推遲，經營方向也會改變。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll see you again after taking care of the matters. - W. R.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
處理好事情後，我會再與你見面。——W. R.

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It means that he would stop the deal about the war, right? The rumor must have been quite threatening.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這意味著他要取消有關戰爭的交易，對吧？那個傳聞一定造成了很大影響。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I feel sorry. It would have been a great chance for me to impress my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
真遺憾，本來是我向家族證明自己的好機會。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, I believe Wolf would find a better direction to the business. Please tell Wolf that I support his decision. And that I am excited about his new business.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不過，我相信狼會找到更好的經營方向。請告訴他，我支援他的決定，也期待他的新業務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我會轉告他。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a shame.
It was a great opportunity for me and Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
真可惜。
這原本是我和狼的大好機會。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, since my partner wants to quit, I shouldn't force him to carry on with it.
I believe that Wolf must already have the plan about the next business item in his mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不過既然搭檔想退出，我也不該強迫他繼續。
我相信狼已經在考慮下一項生意了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why I accepted his suggestion to be partners in business.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
所以我才接受了他的提議，和他合夥做生意。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
那麼，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, since you are here to the Wigner family, why don't you go meet some other members of the family?
Like my parents, my brother who is the candidate to the throne or my sister who is the eldest child.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，既然你來到維格納家了，不妨去見見其他家人吧。
比如我的父母、作為王位候選人的哥哥，或身為長女的姐姐。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I believe that you would have more productive time with them.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我相信和他們相處會更有收穫。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what I had asked you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，你帶來我拜託的東西了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'd like to go get them myself or ask other people to do it. But, I feel a little uncomfortable since it is a family matter.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我本想自己去拿，或讓別人代勞，但這畢竟是家事，我有點不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know how it is troubling you, but please help us. You have not forgotten what to bring, have you?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我知道這讓你為難，但還是請幫幫我們。你還記得要帶什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You need to bring ^0000cd10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
你需要帶^0000cd10塊大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our fate depends on you! We may be able to get along again or we may become distant.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我們的命運就交給你了！我們可能重歸於好，也可能從此疏遠。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please bring them to us as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
請儘快把它們帶來！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Thanks to you, my brother and sister have become close to each other again.
What would they do without me?
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
多虧了你，哥哥和姐姐又親近起來了。
要是沒有我，他們可怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, I'll see you around then.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
親愛的冒險者，那我們回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it your first time to visit the Wigner family?
Then, ^0000cdyou should meet our parents^000000 over there first.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
這是你第一次來維格納家嗎？
那麼，^0000cd先去那邊見見我們的父母^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen, you are mine!
scripts.translation:
[婦女們]
尤爾根，你是我的！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I couldn't shake hands with Jurgen! Oh, it's too hot!
scripts.translation:
[單身漢]
我沒能和尤爾根握手！啊，好燙！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, you shouldn't bring too much stuff in here.
As you see there are a lot of fragile things.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦，你不該帶這麼多東西進來。
這裡有很多易碎品。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You need to leave some out. It would be a big problem if the bundle touches the dishes and breaks them.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
有些東西得放在外面。要是包裹碰到餐具把它們打碎，就麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am cleaning the kitchen now, which is the hardest place to clean. It is really difficult to get rid of all the dirt in here.
My arms are way too weak to handle it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我正在打掃廚房，這裡是最難清理的地方。要清除所有汙垢可不容易。
我的手臂實在沒力氣。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I happen to see someone with a strong set of arms... Those arms... What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我剛好看到一位手臂很有力的人...那雙手臂...你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am the adventurer invited to the royal banquet. Are you the maid who have cleaned the Wigner residence this afternoon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是受邀參加皇家宴會的冒險者。你是今天下午打掃維格納宅邸的女僕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I am. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
是的。有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you happen to see ^0000cda small box^000000 in the Wigner residence? It was supposed to be on the table next to the bed. The box belongs to Princess Katrin. Have you seen it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你有沒有在維格納宅邸看到^0000cd一個小盒子^000000？它原本放在床邊的桌上，是卡特琳公主的。你見過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I have. It was the box which looked simple but classy. I held it up for a second to clean the table and put it down. I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
見過。那是個看起來樸素卻很有格調的盒子。我擦桌子時把它拿起來過一下，之後又放回去了。我記得。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see it there when you leave the room? Wasn't there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你離開房間時還看到它嗎？當時房間裡還有別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wait a moment. I know where you are getting with this. We, maids, often get into a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
等一下，我知道你想問什麼了。我們女僕經常遇到這種情況。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Isn't the box missing and are you ^0000cdsuspecting the maid who has cleaned the room^000000? Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
盒子不見了，所以你^0000cd懷疑打掃房間的女僕^000000，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not suspecting you. I am just ^0000cdasking you about the situation^000000 to track the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有懷疑你，只是想^0000cd瞭解一下當時的情況^000000，好找到盒子。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
With an element of suspicion in your mind, right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
心裡多少還是有點懷疑吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I am not suspecting you. Please don't get me wrong. I am just asking you when you have seen it and if there haven't been anyone else there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒有，請別誤會。我只是想問你什麼時候看到它的，以及當時有沒有其他人在。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Ha, you are not being honest with me. If I say that there was no one around, I would be suspected, right?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哈，你還是不肯坦白。如果我說當時沒有別人，豈不是更讓人懷疑？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I can tell you this one though. I didn't take it. If you ask me if there was anyone in the room, well...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
不過有一點我可以告訴你：我沒有拿。如果你問當時房裡有沒有人，那...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was someone in the room, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當時房間裡有人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Was there? This kitchen is too messy that I cannot think straight. ^0000cdI may be able to recall if it is cleaned up^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
有嗎？廚房太亂了，我腦子都轉不過來。^0000cd把這裡打掃乾淨後，我或許就能想起來^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, the kitchen is messy and so are the thoughts inside my head. Oh, how dirty and messy!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
廚房亂糟糟的，我腦子裡也一團亂。真是又髒又亂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I help you clean up?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以幫你打掃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, would you do that for me? I would be so grateful. Here is a ^0000cdPoring Scrub Sponge^000000, please scrub every inch of this place clean.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哦，你願意幫我嗎？那我太感激了。這是^0000cd波利擦洗海綿^000000，請把這裡每個角落都擦乾淨。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Since it is a specially-maid Scrub Sponge, it serves multiple purposes. It coaches you on how to clean so make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這是特製的擦洗海綿，用途很多。它還會教你怎麼清潔，好好利用吧。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You may be surprised by it, but it is a safe Scrub Sponge which doesn't hurt others. Don't worry.
It is a Scrub Sponge developed by a legendary figure.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你可能會覺得奇怪，但這塊擦洗海綿很安全，不會傷到人。別擔心。
它是一位傳奇人物發明的。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, wait! You know, there is a certain protocol when it comes to cleaning. You first need to wipe off the mold on the wall. Then you have to clean up the grease. The last thing for you to do is cleaning the floor.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
等等！打掃也有順序。先擦掉牆上的黴菌，再清理油汙，最後才打掃地板。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Have you finished it already?
It doesn't seem so. The thoughts in my head haven't cleared up yet.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
已經打掃完了嗎？
看起來還沒有呢，我腦子裡的思緒還沒理清。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I think I would be able to recall when you come back after cleaning the kitchen with the Scrub Sponge I have given you.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
等你用我給的擦洗海綿把廚房打掃乾淨再回來，我應該就能想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wow... The kitchen has become so clean! You really need to clean the grease with a strong set of arms!
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哇...廚房真乾淨！清理油汙確實需要一雙有力的手臂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh... My arms... Was there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我的手臂...房間裡當時還有別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You must know what kind of family that is. It is the wealthiest family in Rune-Midgarts. Despite being a temporary residence, the room was decorated with so much care.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
你應該知道那是什麼樣的家族。他們是盧恩·米德加茲最富有的家族。雖說這裡只是臨時住所，房間還是佈置得十分用心。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
All the gorgeous pieces of furniture and carpets... I have never seen tiger skin as white and huge as that one in there.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
華麗的傢俱和地毯...我從沒見過那麼大、那麼白的虎皮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you talking about the furniture all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎麼突然說起傢俱了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, my, how are you going to deal with the members of the royal families with such slow wit?
Think. Why would I ^0000cdtalk about the furniture^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
哎呀，你反應這麼慢，怎麼應付王室成員？
想想看，我為什麼要^0000cd談傢俱^000000？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You ^0000cdcan ask the person who was delivering the furniture^000000 .

[Maid]
I cannot point it out, but I think I have given you enough clues.
By the way, is the box really missing in the first place?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我不能直接點破，不過線索已經給得夠多了。
對了，那個盒子真的不見了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
It is not my opinion, but there are these words people say. You know, the rumors.
Since the prince of the Wigner family looks so handsome...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這不是我的看法，只是大家都這麼說的...你知道，那些流言。
維格納家的王子長得那麼英俊...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
He has been the center of the attention since he was young. People say that the lady is stressed about it and does things to draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
他從小就是眾人關注的焦點。大家都說，那位小姐因此壓力很大，還會故意做些引人注目的事。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
This could be one of her tricks, they say.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
據說這可能也是她的把戲之一。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
The words haven not been spread yet, but I am sure that everyone will be talking about it even before the teatime is over.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這些話現在還沒傳開，但我敢說茶會結束前，大家就會議論紛紛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is true. She is not that kind of person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不覺得這是真的。她不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
That's what people say. You don't have to reason with me. Anyways, I should get back to my cleaning duty. If you are not going to help me, please leave me alone now.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
大家都是這麼說的，你不用跟我講道理。總之，我得回去打掃了。如果你不打算幫忙，就別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know where the man who have delivered the furniture is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道送傢俱的人在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
He must be somewhere in Prontera. Why don't you try visiting the area ^0000cdnear the district office^000000. Most stores are located there.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
他應該在普隆德拉的某個地方。去^0000cd區公所附近^000000找找吧，那邊店鋪很多。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, by the way, you didn't hear it from me. Not that I said anything to you.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
對了，剛才的話別說是我告訴你的。我可什麼都沒跟你說。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course. Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然。謝謝你配合。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Dear adventurer, didn't you say that you were going to visit the delivery man?
He must be somewhere ^0000cdnear the district office^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
親愛的冒險者，你不是說要去找送貨員嗎？
他應該在^0000cd區公所附近^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Since I need to clean up. please leave now.
You are getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我還得打掃，請你先離開。
你擋著我了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
唉，我受夠打掃了！家裡要打掃的東西已經夠多了，我不想在外面還做這些。
我乾脆辭職逃走算了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, why can't I get it off easily? I guess I won't be able to go home early.
Why should I do this?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
唉，怎麼這麼難擦？看來今天沒法早點回家了。
我為什麼要做這種工作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. Do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，有空嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes... Well... Hum.. You are...
Aren't you the adventurer who was at the Wigner residence?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
有...嗯...你是...
你就是在維格納宅邸見過的那位冒險者吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. And I have come here before, and I have helped you with cleaning.
^0000cdDon't you remember...?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是我。我之前還來幫你打掃過。
^0000cd你不記得了嗎...？^000000

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am really sorry. ^0000cdI am not good at remembering faces.^000000
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
啊，實在抱歉。^0000cd我不太擅長記人臉。^000000
你這次來有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen of the Wigner family has asked me to give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
維格納家的尤爾根讓我把這個交給你。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
What is it? Why did he give it to me? Is it an invoice? Have I done anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
這是什麼？他為什麼給我這個？是賬單嗎？我做錯什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not. Please just read it first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，請先讀一下。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Hum... I have fallen in love with you at first sight.
Well... Hum... Please accept my love for... Eh... Umm...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
嗯...我對你一見鍾情。
那個...請接受我的愛...呃...唔...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He has used some really direct languages here. How very Wigner of him for that he values efficiency... Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他寫得可真直接。真是維格納家的作風，凡事都講求效率...哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Hum... It is... It is... Well, is it what I think it is?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
嗯...這...這是...我想的那種東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is a love letter.

[Maid]
Phew... I am sorry, but you should take it back.
Well... I appreciate his feelings for me... I really do... But please just take it back.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
唉...抱歉，請把它拿回去。
我很感激他的心意...真的...但還是請你拿回去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? He has just tried to express his feelings... You may as well just keep it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？他只是想表達心意...你不妨收下吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you in a relationship or engaged? Or are you married?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你有交往物件或未婚夫了嗎？還是已經結婚了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
No, no, I am not. Just take it back with you.
I feel rather overwhelmed... And there is the social class issue as well...
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
不，不是這些。請把信帶回去吧。
我實在有些不知所措...而且我們之間還有身份差距...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Most of all, I am not in the situation to date anyone. ^0000cdIt is for a personal reason.^000000
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
最重要的是，我現在不適合和人交往。^0000cd這是個人原因。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so, I cannot force it. I'll deliver your words to him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你這麼說，我也不能勉強。我會把你的話轉告他。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes. I am really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
嗯，真的很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I get your name at least?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
至少能告訴我你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Mad... No, ^0000cdMary^000000. My name is Mary.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
瑪...不，^0000cd瑪麗^000000。我的名字叫瑪麗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Then let me deliver your words to Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道了，那我會把你的話轉告尤爾根。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Well, have you told the prince about it? Please make sure not to hurt his feelings much.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
那麼，你已經告訴王子了嗎？請儘量別讓他太傷心。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Please.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
唉，什麼時候才會結束啊。
我真的不會放棄！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，現在好像不太方便。我晚點再來可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
沒有，不是那樣。
親愛的冒險者，你的口袋破了。是不是掉了什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！什麼時候破的？^0000cd15顆大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰...^000000
都掉了！我晚點再來！我忘了帶東西！

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
唉，什麼時候才會結束啊。
我真的不會放棄！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, hello.
Is it a bad time? Should I just go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。
現在不方便嗎？我先走？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, no.
By the way, you are back. Is it about the prince of the Wigner family again?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
哦，不是。
對了，你又來了，是為了維格納家的王子嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen seems to be really serious about it.
He wants you to have these.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤爾根似乎很認真。
他想把這些送給你。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I turned it down.
Oh, this really is... So pretty. There is water inside this glass-like thing...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我已經拒絕過了。
啊，這個真的...好漂亮。像玻璃一樣的東西里面竟然有水...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen wants me to let you know about his heart as wide and beautiful as the sea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤爾根想讓你知道，他的心如大海般寬廣美麗。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I really cannot go out with him. Well, there really is a reason that I cannot accept this feelings. I wonder if I should tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
唉，我真的不能和他交往。確實有原因讓我無法接受這份心意。我不知道該不該告訴你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me. If you have a good enough reason which Jurgen can understand, he would not bother you again, Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請告訴我。如果理由足夠充分，尤爾根也能理解，就不會再打擾你了，瑪麗。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I don't think it would be a good idea. You shouldn't tell this to anyone. Please keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我覺得還是別說比較好。請不要告訴任何人，替我保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
In fact, I am ^0000cdthe younger sibling of the maid who used to work here^000000. The maid you have met before.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
其實，我是^0000cd以前在這裡工作的那位女僕的弟弟^000000。就是你之前見過的那位。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no wonder you couldn't remember my face. I found it a little strange. By the way, you two sisters must have worked here together.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，難怪您想不起我的臉。我之前還覺得有些奇怪。對了，你們姐妹倆應該曾一起在這裡工作吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, what would it matter since it is you whom he has fallen for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，既然他愛上的是您，這又有什麼關係呢？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It matters. ^0000cdBecause, I am her brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
當然有關係。^0000cd因為，我是她的弟弟^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you are...

[{0}]
Wha... What? A brother?

[Mary]
I am ashamed to work in this outfit since I am a man. However, there is a reason for me to stay here like this.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
身為男人，卻穿著這身衣服工作，我覺得很羞恥。但我留在這裡是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
My sister was very disheartened by what had happened to her and ran off with her lover saying that she couldn't work here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
姐姐因為之前發生的事深受打擊，後來帶著戀人離開了，說再也沒法在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told the person who is in charge of managing the maids at the palace, he said, he didn't care about my sister running off against the contract ^0000cdas long as I would bring someone to fill her position^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我把這件事告訴了負責管理宮廷女僕的人。他說，只要我能找人^0000cd接替姐姐的職位^000000，姐姐違反契約逃走也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
He added how ^0000cdan enormous indemnity would be imposed on us^000000 if we fail to do so.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
他還說，如果我們做不到，^0000cd就要支付鉅額賠償金^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told him that I would fill her spot, he said there were enough male chamberlains and ^0000cdhe needed a maid^000000 who would work in the kitchen and run cleaning duties.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我說我可以接替姐姐，他卻說男性侍從已經夠多了，^0000cd他需要一名女僕^000000負責廚房和清潔工作。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I tried to find a replacement for her, but I couldn't. Everyone was already busy working at the palace or supplying the things for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我試著找人替她，可找不到。大家都在宮裡忙著工作，或是為宴會準備物資。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
After consulting my mother, I decided to work here pretending as if I was my sister. Since everyone was so busy, no one paid attention to me who was working quietly in this corner.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
和母親商量之後，我決定假扮姐姐在這裡工作。大家都很忙，沒人注意到我一直安靜地在角落做事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have managed not to be busted so far.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然一直沒被發現。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Since ^0000cdI look just like my sister^000000, no one seems to notice.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
因為^0000cd我和姐姐長得一模一樣^000000，所以似乎沒人察覺。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should we do then? Jurgen really wants you to accept his love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那現在怎麼辦？尤爾根真的很希望你接受他的心意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He is in sorrow saying how difficult it is to get the first thing he has ever wanted in this entire life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他很傷心，說這是他這輩子第一次想得到什麼，卻沒想到會這麼難。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I feel sorry for that ^0000cdthe first thing he has ever wanted to get happens to be fake^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
真替他難過，^0000cd他這輩子第一次想得到的東西，竟然是假的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I assumed that the people who have all the money in the world and have seen all the good things in the world must have a keen eye. I stand corrected.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我原以為擁有世上所有財富、見過世間一切美好事物的人，眼光一定很敏銳。看來是我錯了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You get blinded when you are in love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人在戀愛時，總會變得盲目。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And, you really are doing so remarkably at what you are doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，你現在的表現確實很出色。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I should go back and tell him the truth.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想還是回去告訴他實情吧。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh! No, you shouldn't. I told you. You are the only one who knows about it.
^0000cdIf I get busted, I would be in trouble^000000. We don't have the money to pay the compensation.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
不行！我不是說過了嗎？現在只有你知道這件事。^0000cd要是我被揭穿，就會惹上大麻煩^000000。我們根本賠不起。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am keep sending the message to my sister to comeback, but it seems difficult to reach her. Would you please keep it secret until the banquet is over?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我一直在聯絡姐姐，讓她回來，可似乎很難找到她。請幫我保守秘密，直到宴會結束，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen would keep sending me to earn your love, and this means that we are deceiving him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤爾根會一直派我來爭取你的愛，這等於我們在欺騙他。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am sorry for him, but my life depends on this.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我很抱歉，可這關係到我的生計。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum, I don't feel comfortable doing this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這樣做讓我心裡不太舒服...

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It is not my fault to be here in this clothing... Please feel for me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
穿成這樣出現在這裡又不是我的錯...請體諒我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, OK. Calm down. I'll tell Jurgen that you have held off the answer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，別激動。我會告訴尤爾根，你暫時還不想答覆。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please take good care of the stuff. If you return them, he will send me down here again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請把東西保管好。如果你還回去，他會再派我過來的。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Really? Then let me return them at once on the last day of the banquet. Please explain him well so that it doesn't hurt his feelings.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
真的嗎？那就請在宴會最後一天再把東西還給我。請好好解釋，別傷了他的心。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I guess I should change my cleaning area so that I don't bump into him.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
哦，我應該換個打掃區域，這樣就不會碰見他了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I guess it would work.
Then, let me go tell him that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我覺得這樣可行。
那麼我去告訴他。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it?
I am worried about the consequences if anything goes wrong.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
你告訴王子了嗎？
我擔心萬一出了差錯會有什麼後果。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I may have to run off like my sister.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
我可能也得像姐姐一樣逃走。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it? I hope he gives up from tomorrow without sending you down here again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
你告訴王子了嗎？希望他明天就放棄，不再派你過來。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
唉，什麼時候才能結束啊。
我真的不會放棄！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，現在好像不太方便。我晚點再來可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
不，沒事。
親愛的冒險者，你的口袋破了。是不是掉了什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！口袋什麼時候破了？^0000cd15顆大海之石和1朵永恆玫瑰...^000000
都不見了！我稍後再來吧，忘了帶東西！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Adventurer? What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
冒險者？您來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen sent me here to deliver his love to you again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤爾根又派我來向您傳達他的愛意。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Again... I really hoped he would have given up by today... I guess it must have been a vain hope.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
又來了...我還以為他今天會放棄呢...看來只是我一廂情願。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Please tell him I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
請告訴他，我很感激他的心意。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I really want the banquet to be over soon. Or my sister could just come back.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
我真希望宴會快點結束，或者姐姐能回來就好了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Anyway, I am sorry to put you in the difficult situation again today.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
總之，很抱歉今天又讓您為難了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then, since I have delivered you what I have to deliver you, I should get going.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然該傳達的話已經帶到了，我就先告辭了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, please go back safely. I hope he gives up by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
好的，請平安回去。希望他明天就放棄。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
啊，我受夠打掃了！家裡已經有夠多東西要打掃，我不想在這裡還做這些。
我乾脆辭職逃走算了。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Dear human, are you the one who have waken me up?
After a long sleep, I am waken up before such a mess.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
親愛的人類，是你把我喚醒的嗎？
沉睡了這麼久，醒來面對的竟是這樣一團糟。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since you have the Mold Powder and alcohol with you, try getting rid of the mold now.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
你帶了黴菌粉末和酒精，那就試著清除黴菌吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Human, what are you doing now?
I told you! You need ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000 to clean up the mold!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
人類，你在做什麼？

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

Then twice to the left to wrap up! Start now!
scripts.translation:

最後再向左兩次收尾！開始！

scripts.text:

When did I teach you like that? Don't you dare say that you have learned it from me!
scripts.translation:

我什麼時候教過你這種方法？別說是跟我學的！

scripts.text:

Well done!
You have completed the cleaning mission beautifully!
scripts.translation:

你完美地完成了清潔任務！

scripts.text:

Wrong!
Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!
scripts.translation:

集中注意力，再來一次！

scripts.text:

Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I believe that you can handle cleaning perfectly even without me!
Old soldiers never die! They just fade away! So save the tears!
scripts.translation:

我相信沒有我，你也能把清潔工作做得很好！
老兵不死，只是漸漸凋零！所以別哭！

scripts.text:
[Shining Floor]
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
scripts.translation:

乾淨的地板讓我想起那塊外表強硬、內心柔軟的擦洗海綿。

scripts.text:

Let's go back to the maid and report that the cleaning is completed.

scripts.text:

Go!

快去！

scripts.text:

Go get them now!
Go!
scripts.translation:

快去！

Now disperse! Go!
scripts.translation:

現在解散！出發！

scripts.text:

Nice to meet you! I am the cleaning instructor sealed in the Scrub Sponge!
scripts.translation:

很高興見到你！我是封印在擦洗海綿裡的清潔指導員！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Good! It has all been prepared!
Let's start cleaning now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
很好！東西都準備齊了！
現在開始清潔吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
What are you doing now?
You cannot get rid of the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles without the lemon and powdery find sand!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
你在做什麼？
沒有檸檬和細砂，可清不掉卡在磚縫裡的黑垢！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
If you follow my lead, you can get through the most difficult cleaning mission in this world!
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
跟著我的指導，你就能完成世上最艱難的清潔任務！
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Squeeze the lemon and sprinkle the juice over the floor. Then sprinkle the powdery fine sand over it!
This will whiten and polish the floor! Not to mention the fresh scent of lemon adding something extra!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
擠出檸檬汁，灑在地板上，再撒上細砂！
這樣就能讓地板潔白光亮！還會留下檸檬的清香呢！

We have a Thor 3 situation here!
scripts.translation:

來看看今天的目標！是卡在地板縫隙裡的^0000cd惡魔黑垢^000000！
這可是托爾三樓級別的難題！

The method of scrubbing is as follows! It is not difficult if you follow me! Listen up!
scripts.translation:

擦洗方法如下！跟著我做並不難，聽好了！

You need ^0000cd1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon^000000 to get rid of the target!
scripts.translation:

總之，只要材料齊全就能解決！
清除目標需要^0000cd1份細砂和1個檸檬^000000！

scripts.translation:

Well done!

你漂亮地完成了清潔任務！

scripts.text:

Wrong!
Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
錯了！
集中精神，再重複一次！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
集中精神，再聽一次！

老兵永不死，只會漸漸消逝！所以別哭啦！

我們回去告訴女僕清潔已經完成吧。

Go get them now!
Go!

現在就去把東西拿來！
快去！

scripts.translation:
[擦洗海綿]
以後每當你看到並清理磚縫裡的黑垢時，就想想我吧！
現在解散！出發！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, my arms, legs, back and my entire body hurts. Well, I am just glad that today's work is done. I can take some rest now. I should go have some hot soup. Is it supposed to be the meat soup for today?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
哎呀，我的胳膊、腿、背，全身都疼。不過今天的工作總算完成了，可以休息了。我得去喝碗熱湯。今天應該是肉湯吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我能問你一件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Is it about furniture delivery? I am off my duty today. Unless it is really urgent, would you please come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
什麼事？是傢俱配送的事嗎？我今天已經下班了。除非特別緊急，否則明天再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I am exhausted from today's work. I almost cannot stand with my back straight now.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
今天的工作把我累壞了，現在腰都快直不起來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not about that. You are the one who has delivered the furniture to the Wigner family, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是關於傢俱的。你就是把傢俱送到維格納家的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I have... Is there any problem with the furniture? What should I do? I would never be able to afford the furniture!
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
是我送的...傢俱出問題了嗎？我該怎麼辦？那些傢俱我可賠不起！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What if there is a dent? Should I call James to fix it? Damage? Wrong delivery? What should I do? What is it about?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
如果傢俱磕壞了呢？要叫詹姆斯來修嗎？要是損壞了或送錯了怎麼辦？到底出什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing like that. Please relax.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不是那樣。別緊張。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Additional delivery? I really want to take some rest now... However, I guess I have no choice since it is the Wigners that I am dealing with. Oh, I really hate it... It is just too difficult to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
什麼事？還要追加送貨嗎？我現在真的想休息...不過既然是維格納家的事，我也只能照辦。唉，真煩...日子過得太難了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I just have a question for you. Have you seen a small box on the table in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我只是想問你一件事。你在房間的桌上看到一個小盒子了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What box? I was busy delivering the furniture... Wait, I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
什麼盒子？我當時忙著搬傢俱...等等，我想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You mean the ^0000cdsmall box^000000 on the table next to the bed, right? The locked box with no particular decoration.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你是說床邊桌上的^0000cd小盒子^000000吧？那個沒有裝飾、上了鎖的盒子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I believe so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
應該就是它。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I remember it. It was a simple box without any decoration, but it looked very classy.
The wood was of the finest quality and the locking device was exquisite. I could tell that it must have been made by a master artisan at a glance.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
嗯，我記得。那是個沒有裝飾的素淨小盒子，卻顯得很典雅。
木料上乘，鎖具也很精巧。我一眼就看出那是名匠的作品。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Since I work with furniture, a piece like that really catches my eyes. It really was a work of art.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
我畢竟是做傢俱這行的，那樣的東西特別引人注目。真是件藝術品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was the box still there after you delivered the furniture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你送完傢俱後，盒子還在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, it was. The box cannot move itself, can it?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
還在啊。盒子總不會自己長腿跑掉吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, wait? Are you telling me that it is missing? Are you implying that it has been carried out in my carriage?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
等等，你是說盒子不見了？你懷疑它被裝上我的馬車帶走了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Please calm down. I am not suspecting you. I just want to listen to your story. I am just tracking the whereabouts of the box based on the words of the people who have seen the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是。請冷靜，我沒有懷疑你。我只是想聽聽你的說法，根據見過盒子的人提供的線索追查它的去向。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If anything goes missing, it is always us, the ordinary people, who are suspected. Do you know that it is just a prejudice?
The people who have less must be hungry for money. And they are unvirtuous...
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
東西一丟，總是我們這些普通人先被懷疑。你知道這其實是種偏見嗎？
好像窮人就一定貪財、品行不端似的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is just a misunderstanding. Trust me, I am not suspecting you.... You know, you look for any witnesses when a person goes missing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這只是誤會，相信我，我沒有懷疑你...出了什麼事，總得找目擊者問問。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I don't want to hear it! Why are you scaring an innocent furniture delivery man for some missing box?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
我不想聽！一個盒子不見了，你幹嗎要嚇唬無辜的送貨員？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I am just asking everyone who has been in that room. I am not suspecting you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉讓你不舒服了。我只是在詢問進過房間的人，並沒有懷疑你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Heh, not that it makes me feel any better. I think I may be feeling even worse since I am hungry. Oh, my stomach is growling... I don't feel well...
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
哼，這話也沒讓我好受些。我現在餓得更難受了，肚子都在叫...我不舒服...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you need something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想吃點東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
It doesn't change anything even if you say that...Well, I may be able to let it go if I have some Ox Head Slices... I cannot forget the taste from 10 years ago...
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你這麼說也沒用...不過要是能吃到牛頭肉片，我也許就不計較了。我忘不了十年前吃到的味道...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it make you feel better?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
吃點東西會讓你舒服些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, not that it will... OK, good! I'll let it go for ^0000cd3 Ox Head Slices^000000! Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
嗯...也不一定...好吧！給我^0000cd3份牛頭肉片^000000，事情就算了！這才公平。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it be enough? OK, please wait for me then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些夠嗎？好，那請等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset as I get parched with thirst.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你來了。再晚一點我可真要不高興了，口都渴幹了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Your hands seem empty.
Did you forget? I said I would let it go with ^0000cd3 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你兩手空空的。
忘了嗎？我說過給我^0000cd3份{0}^000000就不計較了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't let it go without them! I won't! I'll tell people that there is an adventurer who frames an innocent person! He!
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
沒有肉片我絕不算了！絕不！我要告訴大家，有個冒險者在誣陷無辜的人！哼！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset due to my raging stomach.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你來了。再晚一點我可真要不高興了，肚子都餓得咕咕叫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it was very difficult to get them. Here you are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
弄到這些可不容易。給你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Let's see! Oh, this is it! Have you had good wine with some Ox Head Slices? You will never get over this heavenly combination!
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
讓我看看！哦，就是這個！你吃過牛頭肉片配美酒嗎？這絕妙的組合，吃過就忘不了！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
This tastes the same as it did 10 years ago! Now I feel fully recovered from the fatigue! I don't feel tired any more! All the stress is gone!
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
味道和十年前一模一樣！我現在徹底恢復精神了，一點也不累，壓力也全消了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, it sure looks delicious. I should try some later. Anyways, do you know anything else about the box?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起來真美味，我稍後也嚐嚐。對了，你還知道那個盒子的其他訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Are we still talking about it? Let's not talk about such thing while I am enjoying some wine and meat. My carriage is heavy when I get in, but it is as light as a feather when I get out.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
還在說那個盒子啊？我正享受美酒佳餚，別提那些事。我的馬車上車時很沉，下車時卻輕得像羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If you feel suspicious, ask the Gate Guard. He inspected my carriage.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你要是懷疑，可以去問城門衛兵。他檢查過我的馬車。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, well. By the way...
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
哦，對了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Have you seen the princess of the family? You must have. Doesn't she appear suspicious to you? I can tell people's character by their faces. She seems to be hiding something. She may stab you in the back.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你見過那家的公主嗎？肯定見過吧。你不覺得她很可疑嗎？我看人很準，她似乎藏著什麼秘密，說不定會在背後捅你一刀。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't it called a prejudice to judge some based on the appearance?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
僅憑外表判斷別人，不也是一種偏見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are right. I feel sorry, However, there are people talking about it. There's no smoke without fire.
No? Well. Perhaps, there could be smoke without fire.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你說得對，我不該這麼說。不過確實有人在議論她。俗話說，無風不起浪。
不是嗎？嗯...也許有時無火也會有煙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Katrin was not that kind of person as far as I observed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
據我所知，卡特琳不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, if not, that's fine. Anyways, the box was there in its place when I left the room. You may go if you don't have any business left here.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
那就好。總之我離開房間時，盒子還在原處。你沒別的事就可以走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Dear adventurer, why are you here again? Didn't you say you were heading back to the palace?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
親愛的冒險者，你怎麼又回來了？你不是說要回宮裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Do you have more things to as me? Or are you going to drink with me?
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
你還有什麼事要問我？還是想留下來陪我喝一杯？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't mind.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
我倒是不介意。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I should earn enough money to open a store of my own. The owner only lets me deliver the furniture and never teaches me how to make one.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
我得攢夠錢自己開家店。老闆只讓我送傢俱，從來不教我怎麼製作傢俱。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
All the cutting and delivery work will break my back.
Oh, my back hurts.
scripts.translation:
[傢俱送貨員]
又是切割又是搬運，簡直要把我的腰累斷了。
唉，我的背好疼。

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
I finally have the strawberry cake no one has ever touched.
The things I have been through to keep the cake in the expedition camp... I am about to burst into tears... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[良孫]
我終於拿到了沒人碰過的草莓蛋糕。
為了把它從遠征營地保下來，我吃了不少苦...我都快哭出來了...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
Strawberry! Strawberry! This strawberry cake belongs to Ryosun! I won't give it to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[良孫]
草莓！草莓！這塊草莓蛋糕是良孫的！誰也別想拿走。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Are you having a good time?
We have put a lot of efforts since it's a big event in the palace in a long while.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
玩得開心嗎？
這是宮裡難得一見的大型活動，我們為此費了不少心思。
希望您能喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always my pleasure to attend a banquet. Traveling and learning about different cultures are always interesting. It just makes it better to have good music and delicious food.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
參加宴會總是我的榮幸。旅行和了解不同的文化總是很有趣。如果有美妙的音樂和美味的食物，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always tiring to attend a banquet. I am still tired from the trip, it is just too painful to mingle with people... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
參加宴會總是很累的。我還在旅途的疲勞中，與人應酬實在太痛苦了...呼...

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The Palace of Rune Midgarts is so big and glamourous. It somewhat feels exotic too. It's been a long way, but I am glad to be here.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
盧恩·米德加茲的宮殿如此宏大華麗。它甚至帶有一點異域風情。路途遙遠，但我很高興能來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Oh, aren't you the adventurer who has saved the world? Please visit Portmalaya someday. Everyone will welcome you there! Your story is known even to a far away place from here!
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
哦，您不就是那位拯救了世界的冒險者嗎？請有一天來波塔馬拉亞。那裡的人都會歡迎您！您的故事甚至傳到了離這裡很遠的地方！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The music played by the music makes me so emotional. It is worthwhile to come here for this music alone.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
樂手演奏的音樂讓我如此感動。光是為了這音樂，來這裡就值得了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Wait, I have been looking at the flowers here. Are they blinking? How wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
等等，我一直在看這裡的花。它們在眨眼嗎？太美妙了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I visited the Palace of Rune Midgarts long time ago. It has changed a lot ever since. It has become much more glamourous and magnificent that I really enjoy being guided around this place.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
我很久以前就參觀過倫米德加特的宮殿。自那以後它變化很大，變得更加華麗宏偉，我很享受在這裡被引導參觀。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
There are a long of people here. I almost feel dizzy. However, still, I like the lively atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
這裡人真多。我幾乎要頭暈了。不過，我依然喜歡這種熱鬧的氛圍。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I have come to Prontera to attend the banquet from Amatsu. It sure feels totally different from Amatsu. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
我從天津町來普隆德拉參加宴會。感覺和天津町完全不同呢。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Grandfather, don't overtax your strength.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
爺爺，別太勉強自己了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
All the nobility who are in charge of the market in Rune Midgarts are here. We, the Cat Hand Services, shouldn't miss this chance.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
負責倫米德加特市場的所有貴族都在這裡。我們“貓爪服務”可不能錯過這個機會。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I'll score contracts as tall as my height.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
我要簽下和我身高一樣高的一摞契約。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I am an old fan of Orint of the band.
I have spent a lot of money and time not to miss any of his performance.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
我是樂隊成員奧林的資深粉絲。
我花了很多錢和時間，只為不錯過他的任何一場演出。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It was very difficult to get my hands on the invitation to this banquet.
It was so exclusive that I almost joined the expedition!
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
拿到這次宴會的邀請函非常困難。
它太專屬了，我差點就加入遠征隊了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The twin sisters of the band are of completely different characters. However, they are good at imitate each other.
When they pretend to be one person, they really looks like Doppelgangers.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳賓客]
樂隊裡的雙胞胎姐妹個性截然不同，卻很擅長模仿彼此。
她們假扮成同一個人時，簡直就像分身一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
You have been invited to the banquet as well.
Well, no wonder... If you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基納西亞]
你也受邀參加宴會了。
嗯，難怪...仔細想想也是。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, you are still alive!
I am glad to see you here. Life must be treating you well!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，你還活著！
很高興在這裡見到你。生活一定對你很好吧！

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
Come to think of it, Kid is here too.
He met the people from the guild and went to see them...
scripts.translation:
[埃基納西亞]
說起來，小孩也在這裡。
他遇到了公會的人，就過去找他們了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hum... Then he was taken by a strange guy among the bunch to the dining hall.
You may go say hi.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯...然後他被那群人中的一個奇怪的傢伙帶到了餐廳。
你可以去打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
It is a banquet in a long time. We may as well enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基納西亞]
這是很久以來的一場宴會。我們不妨好好享受一下。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, this is how the aristocrats spend their time!
Haha, let's see which lady is wearing the most beautiful dress.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
原來貴族們是這樣打發時間的！
哈哈，讓我們看看哪位女士穿著最漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Who are you...?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你是誰...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
...Oh... You have visited us to change your class, I remember.
We have recommended you as a representative of the guild.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
...哦...我記得你來過我們這裡轉職。
我們推薦你作為公會的代表。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am glad to see you all grown up.
Never forget the weight of the blood to be covered on your hands at all times.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
很高興看到你長大了。
永遠不要忘記你手上沾染的血的重量。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You must have been invited to the banquet.
So are we.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你一定是受邀參加宴會的。
我們也是。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is rare to see the palace open to public like this. Enjoy as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
像這樣向公眾開放宮殿的機會很少見。
請盡情盡興吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...I don't like a crowded place like this, but I cannot help it when I am on a mission.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
...我不喜歡這種擁擠的地方，但執行任務時身不由己。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are here too.
Well, I guess you are supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你也在這裡。
看來你本該出現在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...What a trouble.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
...真是麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, is it the first time since our last encounter for your class change?
Thanks to your contribution, the position of the guild has been strengthened.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，這是自上次為你辦理轉職以來我們第一次見面吧？
多虧了你的貢獻，公會的地位更加穩固了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I guess you will be the hero of the palace.
I am glad to see you well.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我想你將成為宮殿裡的英雄。
很高興看到你一切安好。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hum... Did we meet at Criatura?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯...我們是在克里阿圖拉見過的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I have dealt with too many people...
Your face seemed familiar...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我接觸的人太多了...
你的臉看起來很眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Well whatever.
Are you enjoying the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
算了，無所謂。
你在宴會上玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I really like banquets.
The drowsy music, the whispering people and the chamberlains carrying the refreshments. I think I am nobly born to see it.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳貴族]
我真的很喜歡宴會。
慵懶的音樂，低語的人群，還有端著點心的侍從長。我覺得自己生來就是為了欣賞這一切的。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I know this banquet is held for someone else. However, it still is a great opportunity for me to meet someone I can spend my life with.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳貴族]
我知道這場宴會是為別人舉辦的。不過，這對我來說也是一個尋找能共度一生之人的絕佳機會。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
Everyone else seems to love the banquet, but I don't. I am forced by my parents to come here. I really want to go home and take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳貴族]
其他人都似乎很享受宴會，但我並不喜歡。我是被父母逼著來的。我現在真的很想回家休息。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
This band is pretty good.
I'd like to invite them to the royal villa for my party.
scripts.translation:
[宴會廳貴族]
這支樂隊相當不錯。
我想邀請他們去皇家別墅參加我的派對。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Ellie]
Dwit! Look at the nobility over there. Aren't they beautiful?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 艾莉]
德威特！看那邊的貴族們。他們是不是很迷人？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Hum, yes they are. I think you would fit in there perfectly though.
One day, I'll play the guitar next to you dancing and singing in a blue dress.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
嗯，確實如此。不過我覺得你在那裡會非常合拍。
總有一天，我會彈著吉他，看著你穿著藍色裙子跳舞唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Haha, that woman in the blue dress, it could be me!
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧奇]
哈哈，那個穿藍裙子的女人，說不定就是我！

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
You are mistaken if you think I cannot distinguish you twin sisters, Occi. I can tell your differences from the steps you take and the sound of your breath.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
奧奇，如果你以為我分不清你們這對雙胞胎姐妹，那可就錯了。我能從步態和呼吸聲分辨出你們。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
When I first met Orint, I thought he was stoic and unconcerned. However, he turned out to be a man of extraordinary concentration and possessiveness.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
我第一次見到奧林特時，以為他沉默寡言、什麼都不在乎。後來才發現，他專注得驚人，而且佔有慾很強。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
He always tries to be the best. That's why he can play the tune like that.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
他總是力求做到最好。這就是為什麼他能演奏出那樣的旋律。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
However, he doesn't know when to concentrate. His behavior is often misread.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
然而，他不知道何時該專注。他的行為常常被誤解。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Anyways, we are invited to an honorable place like this thanks to Orint.
If you want to hear any song, ask him to play it for you.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 德威特]
總之，多虧了奧林特，我們才能受邀來到這樣尊貴的地方。
想聽什麼曲子，就請他演奏吧。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
It has been our dream to ensemble in a place like this. Am I right, Orint?
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧奇]
能在這樣的地方合奏一直是我們的夢想。我說得對吧，奧林特？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
Chatting is forbidden while working.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧林特]
工作時禁止閒聊。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Yes, I see. You are so boring. But it is part of your charm, haha.
scripts.translation:
[宮廷樂師 奧奇]
好的，我知道了。你真無趣。不過這也是你魅力的一部分，哈哈。

scripts.text: - That lazy-looking cat is sitting near the feet of the musician. It shows no interest in you. -
scripts.translation: - 那隻懶洋洋的貓坐在樂師腳邊，對你毫不在意。 -

scripts.text:
[Hiba Ajif]
Since Ashbacuum has been taken care of, I want to go home and take a nap. However, they are holding me here.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉夫]
阿什巴克姆的事既然已經處理完，我真想回家睡個午覺。可他們偏偏把我留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
It is the event to praise our contributions. Try to smile a little.
scripts.translation:
[顧問阿維達爾]
這是表彰我們貢獻的活動，稍微笑一笑吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Brother, these shoes hurt my feet. May I go back to the guest room and sleep?
scripts.translation:
[指導員伊格麗德]
哥哥，這雙鞋磨得我腳疼。我能回客房睡覺嗎？

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
I have spent too much time in the tension between the two races. It just feels like I am dreaming to be in a happy and relaxing place like this. This must be what they call peace, right?
scripts.translation:
[顧問阿維達爾]
我在兩個種族的緊張關係中待了太久。能身處這麼輕鬆愉快的地方，簡直像做夢。這就是所謂的和平吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If they really want to do something for us, they really let us take a rest.
Only the ones who don't work in the field like an event like this. It is true.
scripts.translation:
[指導員伊格麗德]
他們真想為我們做點什麼，就該讓我們休息。
只有不在一線工作的人才喜歡這種活動。確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Argh... I have never been to a place like this...
I am so nervous... I shouldn't have come...
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
啊...我從沒來過這種地方...
緊張死了...我真不該來...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Everyone dresses so fancy...
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
大家都穿得好華麗...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
By the way, where has the master gone leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
對了，師父把我一個人丟在這裡，自己去哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Banquets are fun!
Good food! Beautiful music! People talking to one another!
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
宴會真有趣！
好吃的食物！美妙的音樂！大家有說有笑！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have heard that my grandson is under indebtedness to your son these days.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
我聽說最近我的孫子欠了你兒子一筆人情。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Not at all. My son is supposed to be learning from your smart grandson. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
哪裡哪裡，我兒子才該向您聰明的孫子多學習。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please take care of our son, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
請多關照我們的兒子艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Many things have changed since the last time we were here in the palace. I want to come here more often, but we cannot find the excuse to come...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
自從上次來王宮，已經有很多變化了。我想常來看看，可我們總找不到合適的理由...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You can come here with an invitation. It is not difficult visiting here.
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
有邀請函就能來，不難的。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know that is not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[凱瑟琳]
你知道我不是這個意思...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear Roegenburg, how are your children doing? I often hear about your third grandson from Isaac/
scripts.translation:
[勒維埃爾]
羅根堡先生，您的孩子們近來如何？我常聽艾薩克提起您的三孫子。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Oh, they are doing fine. Please visit our home when you get the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬克西米利安]
哦，他們都很好。有空歡迎來我們家做客。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I have a lot of study to do... I feel terrible to be dragged to a banquet like this.
scripts.translation:
[巴蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我還有好多功課要做...被拉來參加這種宴會，真讓人難受。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I wonder if Theodor is handling the work well by himself.
scripts.translation:
[巴蓋特·蒂布萊克]
不知道西奧多一個人處理工作順不順利。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
I really like banquets. Especially the ones hosted by the palace! Everything is so glamourous and sparkly!
scripts.translation:
[伊莎貝拉]
我真的很喜歡宴會，尤其是王宮舉辦的！一切都那麼華麗閃耀！

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
In a banquet like this, we, women, study other women. About who is wearing which dress and what kind of jewelry she is wearing...
scripts.translation:
[貝阿特麗絲]
這種宴會上，女士們總會觀察彼此，看看誰穿了什麼裙子、戴了什麼首飾...

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
Those judging eyes are as sharp as those of ferocious beasts. If we find a lady who looks fabulous, we admire her looks with pure admiration.
scripts.translation:
[貝阿特麗絲]
我們審視彼此的目光像猛獸一樣銳利。遇到打扮出眾的女士，我們也會由衷地欣賞。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hahahahaha!
I should have seen the face! Please invite me to one of those events next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哈哈哈哈！
我真該看看當時的表情！下次也邀請我參加這種活動吧。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Oh, you are always so busy, Isaac. A banquet like this one is the only occasion I can see your face.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎貝拉]
哦，艾薩克，你總是那麼忙。這種宴會是我唯一能見到你的機會。

scripts.text:
[Beitrice]
Yes! You must be ranked in top 3 of the busiest people in Prontera these days, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[貝阿特麗絲]
沒錯！艾薩克，你現在肯定是普隆德拉最忙的三個人之一。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
He also comes home late after discussing business with Isaac everyday. I really don't like it.
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
他每天和艾薩克談完生意都很晚才回家。我真不喜歡這樣。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't you say such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩]
別這麼說！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh! I am sorry to keep Bryan with me. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
哦，抱歉讓布萊恩一直陪著我。失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, please understand. It is the most important time for our business. I'll tell him to devote his time to you after this time is over, dear Sophia.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
不過請理解，這是我們生意最關鍵的時期。等忙完這陣子，我會多陪陪你，親愛的索菲婭。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, you should keep those words!
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
哦，你可要說到做到！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll make sure of it. I swear in the name of Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[艾薩克]
我一定做到。我以艾薩克·維格納之名起誓。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Haha, since you have promised me in the name of your family, I guess I can trust you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎貝拉]
哈哈，既然你以家族之名起誓，我想我可以相信你，艾薩克。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't leave me alone today. I feel nervous if you are not next to me.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩]
今天別丟下我一個人。你不在身邊，我會緊張。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh dear, I want to catch up with the people whom I haven't been able to see for a long time. You may go talk to other people.
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
親愛的，我想和好久沒見的人敘敘舊。你也可以去和別人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
They only talk about business. I don't enjoy it at all. I don't want to feel like being at work when I am here.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩]
他們只談生意，我一點也不喜歡。我可不想在這裡也像在上班。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Then, you should follow me.
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
那你跟我來吧。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Well.. I don't feel comfortable... With too many ladies around...
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩]
嗯...我不太自在...周圍女士太多了...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, darling, I love to be here in the palace after a long time. There are so many friendly faces around here.
However...
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
哦，親愛的，難得來一次王宮，我真開心。這裡有好多熟悉的面孔。
不過...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Everyone else looks so nice, and I feel rather underdressed.
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
大家都穿得那麼漂亮，顯得我穿得太隨便了。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
It is not true! You are the most beautiful person in this place. You are the only one I see here.
scripts.translation:
[布萊恩]
才不是！你是這裡最美的人，我眼裡只有你。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, I am so embarrassed...
scripts.translation:
[索菲婭]
啊，我真不好意思...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you are going to borrow a book, you'd better reduce your luggage. It seems that there is no space for a book.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
要借書的話，最好先清理一下行李。看起來你沒地方放書了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Have you read the book? Did you come to return the book. Well, seeing your hands empty, it seems that you didn't finished the book yet.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
書看完了嗎？你是來還書的？看你兩手空空，應該還沒讀完吧。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
慢慢找吧。選一本你喜歡的書出來讀讀。
書本總能充實心靈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, I'm looking for a book. Would you please advice me where it is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我在找一本書。能告訴我它在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What kind of book are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
你在找什麼書？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A book about history of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一本關於盧恩·米德加茲歷史的書。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Hm... history of Rune-Midgarts.
Are you going to borrow the book?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯...盧恩·米德加茲的歷史。
你要借這本書嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
May I see your library card, please?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
請出示你的借書證。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Library card? I don't have such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
借書證？我沒有這種東西。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, I cannot borrow a book to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
那我就不能把書借給你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I have a library card?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我怎麼才能得到一張借書證？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you present your identification card, we will make you one instantly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
出示身份證明，我們就能馬上為你辦理借書證。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... I don't have it. I left all my things to attend the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我沒有。我把所有東西都留在參加宴會的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Banquet? You mean the banquet held in the palace? Are you the adventurer invited to it?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
宴會？你是說在宮殿裡舉辦的那個宴會嗎？你是受邀參加的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I am...

[Uptight Librarian]
Then you are a person guaranteed by the kingdom and I can borrow a book to you through a simple process.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
那你就是王國認可的人，我可以簡化手續把書借給你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The kingdom circulated your details and ordered to provide maximum convenience to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
王國已經傳閱了你的資料，並要求我們儘可能為你提供便利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's nice, but I feel that privacy is not protected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這倒不錯，不過感覺隱私沒有得到保護。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What is you name, sir?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
請問，先生，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Let me see...
Yes, here it is. Sir {0}...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
讓我看看...
是的，在這裡。{0}先生...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
But this book consists of 12 volumes. Only the first volume is here and the others are already borrowed.
Is it OK with you?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
不過這套書一共有12卷。現在只有第一卷在館裡，其餘都借出去了。
你覺得可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is.

[Uptight Librarian]
Hmm. Anyway, can I ask you some questions? I know nothing as I stay in the library all day long.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯。對了，我能問你幾個問題嗎？我整天待在圖書館，外面的事什麼都不知道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I tell you as long as I know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，只要我知道，我就告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
^0000cd王宮裡舉辦的是什麼宴會^000000？為什麼你和王室成員都受邀參加？

scripts.text: Birth of prince.
scripts.translation: 王子誕生

scripts.text: Birthday of king.
scripts.translation: 國王生日

scripts.text: In memory of defeating Morocc.
scripts.translation: 紀念擊敗夢羅克

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才想到別的事，說錯了。
我弄混了。你剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
^0000cd宮殿里正在舉辦什麼樣的宴會^000000？為什麼你和王室成員都被邀請了？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Ah, I see.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
啊，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
^0000cd所有王室家族^000000都出席宴會了嗎？

scripts.text: 8 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 8個王室家族都出席了

scripts.text: 7 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 7個王室家族都出席了

scripts.text: 6 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 6個王室家族都出席了

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才想到別的事，說錯了。
我弄混了。你剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
^0000cd所有王室成員^000000都參加了宴會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The palace must be crowded. It is very rare that all royal families gather like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
王宮裡一定很熱鬧。所有王室家族齊聚一堂的場面很少見，不過...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
我聽說有幾個王室家族^0000cd沒有參加皇家議會^000000。是哪幾家？

scripts.text: Wigner and Heine.
scripts.translation: 維格納家族和海涅家族

scripts.text: Roegenburg and Richard.
scripts.translation: 羅根堡家族和理查德家族

scripts.text: Geoborg and Walther.
scripts.translation: 喬博格家族和瓦爾特家族

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才想到別的事，說錯了。
我弄混了。你剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
我聽說有幾個王室家族^0000cd沒有參加皇家議會^000000。是哪幾家？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, it is understandable that the Geoborg and the Walther do not attend the assembly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯，喬博格家族和瓦爾特家族不參加議會，倒也情有可原。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
前任國王的家族^0000cd因古老的詛咒而變成這樣^000000...

scripts.text: You mean the Nerius?
scripts.translation: 你是說內裡烏斯家族？

scripts.text: You mean the Geoborg?
scripts.translation: 你是說喬博格家族嗎？

scripts.text: You mean the Richard?
scripts.translation: 你是說理查德家族嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我剛才想起別的事，說錯了。
我弄混了。你剛才說什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
前任國王的家族^0000cd因古老的詛咒而變成這樣^000000...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Yes, you are right. it is ^0000cdthe Geoborg^000000. The queen must be lonely.
Thank you very much for advising me though you are busy.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
沒錯，是^0000cd喬博格家族^000000。女王一定很孤獨。
謝謝你百忙之中提醒我。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I have been alone these days as no one has visited the library due to the banquet.
History of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
最近宴會舉辦期間，沒人來圖書館，我一直很孤單。
《盧恩·米德加茲的歷史》。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
You can borrow it for one week. There is a fee for overdue books, but I was instructed to make you exempt from it
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
你可以借一週。逾期要罰款，不過上面吩咐我免除你的罰款。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, if you make much of honor, you will not be overdue.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
嗯，重視榮譽的人自然不會逾期。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, enjoy the book!
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
祝你閱讀愉快！

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的圖書管理員]
慢慢找吧。挑一本你喜歡的書讀讀。
書本總能充實心靈。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
There are so many guests attending the banquet.
However, since we are in the library, would you keep it down?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
來參加宴會的客人真多。不過這裡畢竟是圖書館，可以小聲一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Are you attending the banquet and exchanging greeting with each family?
Then you should go see Spica Nerius, not me.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
你是來參加宴會、和各家族打招呼的嗎？那該去找斯皮卡·內裡烏斯，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Although Shedhar, the current head of the family, is not here, Spica has all the actual power.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
雖然現任家主謝德哈爾不在，但斯皮卡掌握著家族的實權。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am just participating in the Royal Assembly to fill in the place as a Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我只是代替內裡烏斯家族出席皇家議會的。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am not interested in the throne at all.
So you should go see Spica.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我對王位毫無興趣。你還是去找斯皮卡吧。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Enjoy the banquet too.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
也祝你宴會愉快。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Did you meet Spica?
She is such a cheerful girl, isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
見過斯皮卡了嗎？
她是個很開朗的女孩，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She will be the head of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
她會成為內裡烏斯家族的家主。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am treated like a prince since I was adopted against my will. However, Shedhar, the head of the family, has been nice to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我雖是被迫收養的，卻一直被當作王子看待。不過家主謝德哈爾待我很好。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She told me to do whatever I wanted.
...She even let me decide whether I should attend the ritual or not,
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
她讓我想做什麼就做什麼...甚至讓我自己決定要不要參加儀式。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I think I will be forgiven whatever I do.
I seem to have gained freedom and negligence at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我想無論做什麼，她都會原諒我。
我似乎同時得到了自由，也被放任不管。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I like the way it is now though.
I can do whatever I want to do.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
不過我喜歡現在這樣。
我可以隨心所欲。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh! This! That! This!
And there it is!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哦！這個！那個！這個！
在那裡！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, I don't have this book in my collection!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
哦，我的藏書裡沒有這本！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
How great to be in the palace! There is everything!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
待在皇宮真好！這裡什麼都有！

scripts.text:
[Alf]
Oh! This book must be the one from the legend...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
哦！這本書一定就是傳說中的那本...

scripts.text:
[Alf]
I wasn't interested in attending the royal banquet...
However, I am glad to be here!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
我本來對皇家宴會沒興趣...
不過能來這裡真好！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here either....
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
這裡也沒有...

scripts.text:
[Taunting Man]
Why do you need that book? Just go without it.
scripts.translation:
[出言挑釁的男子]
你找那本書幹什麼？沒有就算了。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
The first impression is the most important. The first greeting has a big impact! By the way, what should I speak as a greeting?
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
第一印象最重要，第一次打招呼更是關鍵！對了，我該怎麼開場才好？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
'Good morning, sir. I, an unworthy person, live in Prontera....' No. No. I cannot speak like to a person who is younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
“早上好，先生。我這不成器的人住在普隆德拉...”不行不行，我不能這樣對比我年輕的人說話。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Hi? Your brother told me to attend the banquet. No. No. this is not either. My patner is a princess!
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
“你好？是你哥哥讓我來參加宴會的。”不行，這也不對。我的舞伴可是公主啊！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Why is there no book such as ¡®Royal Etiquette - Meet Princess First Time' It's a royal library.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]
皇家圖書館怎麼會沒有《皇家禮儀：初次會見公主》這種書？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
He sent me on the excuse of being busy. Jonathan, I'll get you.
scripts.translation:
[緊張的男子]

scripts.text: - Unlike her gaze glaring at the table while being cautious about the surroundings, the speed of her eating the food on the table is so remarkable that it is almost artistic. -
scripts.translation: - 她警惕地環顧四周，目光卻緊盯著餐桌上的食物，進食速度快得驚人，簡直像一場表演。 -

scripts.text: - There is a girl with a expressionless face looking at the table. Her outfit seems rather unusual in Prontera. She could be a guest attending the banquet. -
scripts.translation: - 一個面無表情的少女盯著餐桌。她的穿著在普隆德拉顯得很特別，應該是來參加宴會的賓客。 -

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
...I am hungry.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
...我餓了。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Ah....!
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
啊...！

scripts.text:

You... At Cheshrumnir...
scripts.translation:

你...在瑟斯隆尼勒...

scripts.text:

Hum hum!
scripts.translation:

哼哼！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...I am sorry Niren...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...對不起，尼倫...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Shh! Shh! Do not call me by the name, please. We are not officially invited to be here! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
噓！噓！請不要叫我的名字。我們並沒有正式受邀來到這裡！別忘了這一點！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Eh...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
呃...

scripts.text: How did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you come here?
Is it something dangerous? Is it about the international affairs or the international situation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎麼來到這裡的？
是有什麼危險嗎？是關於國際事務還是國際局勢...

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
.....
In secret.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
偷偷進來的。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...The banquet... Something tasty.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...宴會...有好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
<Miss Lang>
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
《朗小姐》

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Woman with Glasses]
In the <Miss Lang Guide> which is written by Miss Lang who is the most prominent gourmet in Midgards, there is Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
米德加爾特最有名的美食家朗小姐，在《朗小姐指南》裡提到了普隆德拉王宮。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Good food and drink are the most enjoyable things in life. It is worth pursuing them. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
美食美酒是人生最大的享受，值得追求。你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
....
...It tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
...很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Anyways, we have managed to find this dining room where aren't many people. But we need to go back soon.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
總算找到這間沒什麼人的餐廳了。不過，我們得儘快回去。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
I have been telling people that we are in costumes. I guess our outfits are not very appropriate for this kind of occasion in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
我一直跟人說我們穿的是戲服。我們的打扮似乎不太適合普隆德拉這種場合。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Well, I guess you have looked around enough. Let's go back before anyone comes.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼鏡的女子]
好了，我想你也看夠了。趁沒人來，我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
Yes...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
是的...

scripts.text: - However the cookie plate is held tightly by the right hand of the Pope. -

scripts.text:

Oh, who is this.
You are{0}the one who would lead to the highest peaks of dark art, right?
