哦，這位是...
{0}，你就是那位要把黑暗藝術推向巔峰的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You've been invited to this banquet too?
Hum, are you the hero of the century recommended by the guild?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
你也受邀參加宴會了？
哼，你就是公會推薦的時代英雄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ha, what a nonsense to disregard me, Dumk!
I can never agree to that.
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
哈，竟敢無視我鄧克，簡直荒唐！
我絕對不能接受。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
By the way, where is Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
順便問一下，維森特在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hey, you assassin, do you know Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[鄧克]
嘿，你個刺客，你認識維森特嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
...Cut it out there, Dumk...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
...別在那兒胡說了，鄧克...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's been a long time. Did you catch up with Lin and Ekinasia?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好久不見。你追上琳和埃基納西亞了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
她們在那豪華的地方看起來很興奮...

scripts.text: ...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...
scripts.translation: ...待在一個不屬於自己的地方真讓人難受...

You may move to the northern corridor from here.
There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.
scripts.translation:

從這裡可以前往北側走廊。
北側走廊中央有通往瓦爾基里領域的入口。

scripts.text:

The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.
scripts.translation:
[守護騎士]
左邊的門通往皇家別墅。
那裡設有海涅、內裡烏斯和瓦爾特家族的住所，以及一間貴賓室。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.
scripts.translation:

從這裡沿右側走廊走到中央，會看到一扇大門，從那裡就能進入宴會廳。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
你就是大家都在談論、受邀參加宴會的冒險者嗎？
你有<榮譽勳章>嗎？能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text: Why do you need them?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要它們？

scripts.text: Give 30 Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 給予30個榮譽勳章

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
就算我一輩子在這裡拼命工作，也總是活在陰影裡。
我常對阿納爾說，男人就該有遠大的夢想，可他實在太死板了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我不夢想一夜暴富，但既然我是個男人，我就想要一些榮譽。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
貴族們絕不會讓我處理什麼大機會。不過，你可能已經獲得了一些<榮譽勳章>，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
If you give me ^FF0000 30 <Honor Marks>^000000, I'll give you something really useful.
For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
給我^FF000030枚<榮譽勳章>^000000，我就給你一件很實用的東西。
對我們這種人來說，<榮譽勳章>就是快速晉升的階梯。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我手裡有一個包裹好的盒子，那是阿納爾擁有的物品之一。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
這是專門製作給貴族的正品。不過我不知道里面是什麼，就看你的運氣了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
等我收集齊榮譽勳章，就在海邊建座城堡，和那個固執的阿納爾一起度過餘生。
那個笨蛋阿納爾，要不是有我，他就會在宮裡一直兌換東西，直到老死。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I have told you I need 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
我說過要30枚。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Thank you. This is the thing I have promised.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管 辛]
謝謝你。這就是我答應給你的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
How terrifying.
This must be Prontera in the past?
I guess we have picked the right time to be here-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
真可怕。
這裡一定是過去的普隆德拉吧？
看來我們來對了時間——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Shall we look around more?
Or go back?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
要不要再四處看看？
還是回去？

scripts.text: It that possible?
scripts.translation: 這可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, don't you underestimate me.
I am a Court Mage.
I studied in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，別小看我。
我可是宮廷魔法師。
我在埃克拉珠學習過。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have also learned a lot of things at the Cat Paw Services!
I believe that I have the most thorough knowledge when it comes to the crack of dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我也從貓爪服務學到了不少！
說到次元裂縫，我的知識可是最全面的！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As long as it is from a place on the crack of dimension,
It is a piece of care to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
只要知道次元裂縫中的位置，回去就不是什麼難事！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Since we don't belong to this time, it is much easier to get out than to enter.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
既然我們不屬於這個時代，離開這裡比進來容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So, what are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那麼，你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Let's get in.
scripts.translation: 進去看看

scripts.text: Let's go back to our time.
scripts.translation: 回到我們的時代

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you remember the gate we got out?
It is supposed to be connected to the inside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你還記得我們離開的那扇門嗎？
它應該通向宮殿內部。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, we arrived here. I guess the spaces are twisted a little so that they are connected.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
可我們卻來到了這裡。我想是空間稍微扭曲，讓兩處連線在了一起。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have already experimented this. If you enter the entrance to the palace,
It is connected to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 which we have just been to.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我已經驗證過了。只要進入宮殿入口，
就會來到我們剛才去過的^4d4dff王室往事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, shall we march in?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那麼，我們進去吧？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，現在要整理一下思路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意識之室裡原本放著的東西^000000一定是...
這肯定和現在^4d4dff襲擊普隆德拉的不死族大軍^000000有關。
一定是^4d4dff被他們帶走了^000000，沒錯吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 沒錯

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們能阻止這件事嗎？
或者把東西帶走？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
上級應該會命令我們這麼做。
無論如何都要想辦法成功。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 應該是這樣

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也許這只是我的猜測。
意識之室裡的東西被拿走了，對吧？可王室成員似乎一直在照常舉行儀式，對此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他們一定做了什麼，或者那東西已經回來了...
這或許符合條件，能讓我們看到^4d4dff王室往事^000000中被封印的部分...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是說那些知曉真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
沒錯。如果這就是解開封印的關鍵，
那我們就帶回了一條重要情報。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我們既沒能保護那東西，也沒把它帶走...
但現在我們知道了真相，這或許能解開檔案的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
隨著王室秘密揭開，缺失的線索也會補齊。
哈哈哈哈，而你就是這一切的中心，我親愛的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 別這麼叫我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
怎麼了？
從今以後我們不是天天見面嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，回去吧？
我們暫時完成這裡的任務了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
回去吧！
待在不屬於我們時代的地方太久，可沒什麼好處。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，準備！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha! This place is exciting...
...As always.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈！這裡真刺激...
...一如既往。

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 離開這裡！

scripts.text: I'll look around.
scripts.translation: 我再四處看看

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
一路平安！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go it!
Forget everything and let's get out-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
走吧！
別想那麼多，離開這裡——

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey, you need to be cured first.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿，你得先接受治療。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh... Those undead bastards... I'll kill them all...
scripts.translation:
[傷兵]
可惡...那些不死族混蛋...我要殺光它們...

scripts.text: [Soldier]
scripts.translation: [士兵]

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My friend has followed Scientist Doyeon. I am worried. I have heard that she really is an oddball.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的朋友跟著科學家道淵出去了。我很擔心，聽說她是個怪人。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The troops of immortality... They are really strong. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
不死族大軍...他們真的很強。小心點。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Scientist Doyeon... Would she be OK? How can she go out there to study in a situation like this?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
科學家道淵...她沒事吧？這種時候怎麼還跑出去做研究？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
An eccentric scientist, Doyeon, went out there with soldiers, and there has been no message from them. I am getting worried.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
古怪的科學家道淵帶著士兵出去了，之後就沒訊息了。我很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please. Don't get yourself killed by the enemy.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
拜託，別被敵人幹掉。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Humph! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哼！放馬過來！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahaha, I was supposed to have a romantic dinner with my girlfriend, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈哈，我本來要和女朋友共進浪漫晚餐的，該死！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god... The undead are not coming this way much. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
謝天謝地...不死族沒怎麼往這邊來。真是鬆了口氣。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My family live in Prontera. I wonder if they have fled safely.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的家人住在普隆德拉。不知道他們有沒有安全撤離。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We will defend the palace of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我們要守住普隆德拉王宮。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Damn it... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
該死...那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless battle against the enemies...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
和敵人的戰鬥永無止境...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll... I'll make sure to defend this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我...我一定會守住這裡。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What was it that had dropped from the sky? How could it bring the undead to the capital?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
剛才從天上掉下來的是什麼？它怎麼會把不死族帶到首都來？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My colleague who had been laughing with me just... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
剛才還和我有說有笑的同伴...唉...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh.... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可惡...那些不死族...

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Are you an adventurer? I am sorry, but I am in the middle of something. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
你是冒險者嗎？抱歉，我現在忙著處理事情，請先別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
謹代表普隆德拉衛隊向您致謝。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
We will make sure to end the battle with the undead as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我們會盡快結束與不死族的戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽派往村公所附近計程車兵說，您幫助了村民。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text: I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation: 我聽派駐在村公所附近計程車兵說，您幫助了村民。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
他是個在村裡待了一陣子的年輕人，看起來工作很勤勉...

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text: He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation: 他是個在村裡待了一陣子的年輕人，看起來工作很勤勉……

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
不過，經營普隆德拉冶煉廠的誇德羅先生似乎在混亂中丟失了一份重要檔案。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text: However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation: 不過，經營普隆德拉冶煉廠的誇德羅先生似乎在混亂中遺失了一份重要檔案。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
他負責管理衛兵使用的武器。我擔心這會影響他的工作。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text: He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation: 他負責衛兵使用的武器，我擔心這會影響他的工作。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
哦！總之，感謝您幫助了村民們。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text: Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation: 哦！總之，謝謝您幫助村民。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [衛隊長 施皮格爾]

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供豐厚的獎勵，不過這是衛兵們為您準備的謝禮。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 我們現在處境艱難，無法提供特別豐厚的報酬，不過這是衛兵們為您準備的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldiers dispatched to the Knights' building that you saved Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽派往騎士團計程車兵說，您救了洛溫。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Lowen is a spirited girl who claims that she likes the Crusaders to the Royal Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
洛溫是個活潑的女孩，她說自己從十字軍時代起就喜歡騎士團的騎士。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Rosa who is the younger sister to the girl is also popular among our soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
她的妹妹羅莎在我們士兵中也很受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
謹代表普隆德拉衛兵向您致謝。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供豐厚的獎勵，不過這是衛兵們為您準備的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the village office that a soldier on his vacation has been fled here.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽派往村公所計程車兵說，一名休假計程車兵逃到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I guess there has been a soldier on vacation during such a difficult time. I had been ignorant of it before I got the report.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
這麼艱難的時候竟然有士兵在休假。我直到收到報告才知道這件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I am faced with my inadequacies as the one in charge of the security of the capital.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
身為負責首都治安的人，我深感自己失職。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供豐厚的獎勵，不過這是衛兵們為您準備的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier in the cathedral that you saved the couple, Eryus and Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我聽大教堂計程車兵說，您救了埃裡烏斯和艾莉這對夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I think I have heard of their names. I have heard that they irritate the minds of lonely soldiers with their endless public display of affection.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我好像聽過他們的名字。聽說他們總是旁若無人地秀恩愛，讓那些孤單計程車兵很是心煩。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Everyone in Prontera must know about it. Anyways, thank you for doing this for the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
普隆德拉的人肯定都知道這件事。總之，感謝您為衛兵們做了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
目前局勢艱難，我們無法提供豐厚的獎勵，不過這是衛兵們為您準備的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我會在地圖上標出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地點。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
如果您發現有村民陷入困境，請幫助他們。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Don't stand there in the middle of our line! Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
別站在我們隊伍中間！小心點！

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
If you are hurt step back to get yourself cured. If you are recovered, get back in the line.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
受傷了就退後接受治療，恢復後再回到隊伍中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Huh? I haven't seen you before. You seem like a civilian. Why are you coming from there?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
咦？我沒見過你。你看起來像是平民。你為什麼會從那裡過來？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
What? Have the undead entered the palace already?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
什麼？不死族已經攻入宮殿了嗎？

scripts.text: No... I don't think so... I am just...
scripts.translation: 不...我想不是...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
So you are supposed to be an adventurer invited to the banquet, right?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
所以你是受邀參加宴會的冒險者，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Has there been a banquet in the palace lately? I don't remember.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
最近宮殿裡有宴會嗎？我不記得了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Well... Since we are busy dealing with
the undead invading the village, as long as the palace is safe from the undead, I won't make a big deal out of it.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
嗯...我們正忙著應對入侵村莊的不死族。只要宮殿沒有受到威脅，我就不追究了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I won't stop you from moving around the town. I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
我不會阻止你在城裡走動。我會在地圖上標出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地點。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 施皮格爾]
如果您發現有村民陷入困境，請幫助他們。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... You are not an undead, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...你不是不死族吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Haha... I am alive now.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哈哈...我現在還活著。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know how scare I have been? This place was packed with the undead, and I heard screams from everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你知道我有多害怕嗎？這裡擠滿了不死族，到處都能聽見尖叫聲。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank god... The shelter is supposed to be near the village office over there. Why don't we continue this conversation there?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
謝天謝地...避難所應該就在那邊的村公所附近。我們去那裡繼續聊吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你看得見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Huh...? What a nerve! That guy... Save a stranger from the sea, and heùéll ask for more...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哼...真敢開口！那傢伙...從海里救了個陌生人，還想得寸進尺...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I wasn't going to eavesdrop. Please don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！我並沒有在偷聽。請別誤會。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Dear adventurer. I believe that uniform is worn by the Guards of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
冒險者，那身制服應該是吉芬衛兵穿的。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Who is that soldier? He seems to enter the shelter so smoothly in a situation like this. He confuses me.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
那個士兵是誰？在這種局勢下，他進入避難所的樣子如此從容，讓我感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
這裡是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I am saved. How fortunate. I guess I am a lucky man.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...我獲救了。真幸運。看來我是個幸運的人。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Wait? Where did it go? I think I lost the Tool Bag while I was running.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
等等？它去哪了？我想我逃跑的時候把工具包弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
I can guess where it has been dropped...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
我可以猜到它掉落在哪裡了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
You must be pretty tough to roam the village in a situation like this. Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
這種時候還能在村裡四處走動，你一定很有本事。幫我個忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know where the Prontera Smelter is?
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你知道普隆德拉冶煉廠在哪兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
It is quite a famous store in Prontera. Someday, I will...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
那是普隆德拉一家很有名的店。總有一天，我也要...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! Never mind. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！算了。就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I thought I have lost it. You really found it!
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哇...我還以為弄丟了。你真的找到了！

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This is awesome. Thank you so much. You must be busy, right? I have to go take care of something now...
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
太棒了，真是謝謝你。你肯定很忙吧？我得去處理點事了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I know you are strong enough, but please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
哦！我知道你很強，但請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank you. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
謝謝。再見。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的小夥子]
你看得見我嗎？真奇怪。我不應該被看見的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
In front of the Prontera Smelter
There a bag which would be full if you put some items.
scripts.translation:
普隆德拉冶煉廠前
這裡有個袋子，裡面似乎裝滿了東西。

scripts.text: Pick up.
scripts.translation: 撿起

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: You have acquired a bag.
scripts.translation: 你獲得了一個袋子。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
這裡是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear Royal Guard... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
啊！皇家衛士大人……那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同僚所佩戴的。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear Rune Knight... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
啊！盧恩騎士大人……那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同僚所佩戴的。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
能把它交給我，讓我安撫他可憐的靈魂嗎？雖然緊急情況下服務暫停，我還是幫您騎上獅鷲吧。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
能把它交給我，讓我安撫他可憐的靈魂嗎？雖然緊急情況下服務暫停，我還是幫您騎上龍吧。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服務

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
這樣啊。那再見。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Griffon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您得先學會騎乘獅鷲。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Dragon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您得先學會騎乘龍。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經在騎乘獅鷲了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
您已經在騎乘龍了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
請先鬆開韁繩，才能騎乘獅鷲。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
請先鬆開韁繩，才能騎乘龍。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[巨獸管理員]
謝謝。如果你找到其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲技師]
這裡是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三個避難所。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh, dear Mechanic! That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲技師]
哦，親愛的機匠！那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you borrow a Cart or ride a Magical Gear.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲技師]
請把它交給我，讓我安撫同事的亡魂吧。雖然緊急情況期間服務暫停了，但我可以幫你租用手推車或騎乘魔導裝甲。

scripts.text: Borrow a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Ride a Magical Gear
scripts.translation: 騎乘魔導裝甲

scripts.text: Do not use it.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You are already using a Cart.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
您已經在騎乘手推車了。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You cannot ride another magical gear since you are already riding one.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
您已經在騎乘魔導裝甲了，無法再騎乘另一輛。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Go get a license to ride a magical gear first.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
請先去辦理騎乘魔導裝甲的許可證。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的物品，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[魔導裝甲技師]
哦...是嗎。我知道了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Hey dear, are you OK?
scripts.translation: 嘿，親愛的，你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
I was running to the church with my sister, Rosa... And I lost her... Awww...
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
我正和姐姐羅莎跑去教堂...結果把她弄丟了...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa should have held on to my hand tightly. How clumsy of her to be lost!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
羅莎本該緊緊牽著我的手才對。她怎麼這麼不小心，竟然走丟了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Would you take me to the cathedral?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
你能帶我去大教堂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
We promised to meet at the cathedral when we are lost. I believe she would be there in the church.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
我們約好走散時在大教堂碰面。我想她應該會在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
咦？你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Please take care of Lowen. She is like a mascot to us in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
請照顧好洛溫。她對我們普隆德拉來說就像吉祥物一樣。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Ellie is really fragile. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
艾莉真的很虛弱。希望她沒事。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, my... Ellie is in a critical condition. I hope a priest comes out to help her if there is one in there.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
哎呀...艾莉的情況很危急。希望裡面有牧師能出來救她。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you for your effort. We will devote our lives to protect the cathedral from the undead coming this way.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
謝謝你的幫助。我們會誓死守住大教堂，不讓不死族闖進來。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
This the cathedral which is the first shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
這裡是普隆德拉的第一個避難所——大教堂。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
That belt... It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead. Would you mind giving it to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
那條腰帶...看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事留下的。你願意把它交給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
I know it is an emergency, but I'd like to comfort the soul of my colleague.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
我知道現在情況緊急，但我想讓同事的亡魂安息。

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Do not give it him.
scripts.translation: 不給他

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, I see. Please bring them to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
哦，我明白了。改變主意的話，請把腰帶帶來。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
哦，你把那條腰帶弄丟在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you. I guess the dead may rest in peace now. This is the only thing that I can offer you... However...
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
謝謝。我想逝者現在可以安息了。這是我唯一能給你的謝禮...不過...

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
If you find more articles left by the soldiers, would you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂騎士]
如果你找到其他陣亡士兵留下的遺物，也請帶給我好嗎？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear crusader!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
哦！親愛的十字軍！
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear paladin!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
哦！親愛的聖殿十字軍！
那條腰帶？看起來像是我那位被不死族殺害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me call Pecopeco for you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
請把它交給我，讓我安撫同事的亡魂吧。雖然緊急情況期間服務暫停了，但我可以為你叫來大嘴鳥。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服務

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
哦...是嗎。我知道了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
哦！你把那條腰帶弄丟在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear crusader
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
親愛的十字軍，
哦！你把那條腰帶弄丟在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear paladin
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
親愛的聖殿十字軍，
哦！你把那條腰帶弄丟在哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... I guess you should learn how to ride a Pecopeco first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
哦...我想你得先學會騎大嘴鳥。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You are already using the Pecopeco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
你已經在騎大嘴鳥了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride it.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
你得先鬆開韁繩才能騎乘。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
謝謝。如果你發現其他陣亡士兵留下的遺物，請帶給我。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh, I am an uncle now...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
唉，我現在都成大叔了...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
If you are here to borrow a PecoPeco, I have to say I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
如果您是想借大嘴鳥，我很抱歉，恐怕不行。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Due to the emergency situation, all troops of Prontera are deployed to protect the residents of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
由於情況緊急，普隆德拉所有部隊都已出動保護居民。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Whoa, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
哇，太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa! Rosa!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
蘿莎！蘿莎！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh, Uncle Peco, did you see my sister here?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
哦，大嘴鳥叔叔，你看到我姐姐了嗎？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Cough... Uncle...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
咳...叔叔...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You mean Rosa? Do you mean Rosa? I haven't seen Rosa here. Wasn't she coming with you?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
你是說蘿莎？你是說蘿莎嗎？我沒在這裡見到蘿莎。她不是和你一起來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Aww... Rosa, where are you now?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
唉...蘿莎，你現在在哪裡呢？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
She could have gone to the Knights' building. Weren't you sisters supposed to go to the shelter there?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
她可能去了騎士團大樓。你們姐妹不是該去那裡的避難所嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Eh? It must have not been the cathedral then... Huh? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
咦？所以不是大教堂...啊？我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear adventurer, if you are not in a hurry, would you help Lowen flee to the Knights' building?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
冒險者，如果你不趕時間，能幫洛溫逃到騎士團大樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Lowen's sister is a careful girl, unlike Lowen. She must have fled to the Knights' building.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥管理員]
洛溫的姐姐很細心，不像洛溫那麼冒失。她一定逃去騎士團大樓了。

scripts.text: Since I am here already, let me keep helping her.
scripts.translation: 既然我已經在這裡了，就繼續幫幫她吧

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. Please take care of her.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鳥機械師]
謝謝你。請照顧好她。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
咦？你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
This the knight's building which is the second shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這裡是騎士團大樓，也是普隆德拉的第二個避難所。

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
Are you the one who has helped Sister Erinin? What a relief that we have someone like you?
scripts.translation:
[騎士格雷]
你就是幫助艾琳修女的人嗎？有你這樣的人幫忙，真是太好了！

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
With the honor of the knight, I'll protect the villagers inside.
scripts.translation:
[騎士格雷]
我以騎士的榮譽起誓，會保護裡面的村民。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
Are you here to hire a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
您是來僱傭傭兵的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry, but all mercenaries dispatched in this area have been hired by the palace.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
很抱歉，這個區域的所有傭兵都已被宮殿徵召。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[傭兵公會管理員]
很抱歉。

[Rosa Erinin]
Lowen, where did you go this time?
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Hehe... Thank you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
嘿嘿... 謝謝你，親愛的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Oh! Dear adventurer, thank you. She is so handful, you know.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
哦！親愛的冒險者，謝謝你。她可真讓人操心，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
She is so delicate, but she is reckless. I am worried about her.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
她很嬌弱，卻又魯莽行事，我真擔心她。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Well, we shall go hide in there so that the knights here don't need to worry about us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
好了，我們進去躲起來吧，這樣這裡的騎士們就不用再為我們擔心了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Thank you. Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
謝謝。再見！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛溫]
咦？你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Dear adventurer, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[羅莎·埃裡寧]
親愛的冒險者，你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh! The undead! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊！不死族！來啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, what would be the use of telling them to bring it on when you are hiding in there...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
自己都躲在裡面了，還喊他們來有什麼用...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You adventurer don't understand it. I am pushed to this corner after a long battle against the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
冒險者，你不懂。我和不死族激戰許久，才被逼到這個角落。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be quite courageous for walking around the town in a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這種時候還敢在鎮上走動，你一定很勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You must be as brave as I am... The hero who has subjugated the Kobolds in Geffen...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你一定和我一樣勇敢...是那個在吉芬擊退刺錘犬妖的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahahahaha
Just in time. I was getting exhausted by the attacks of the undead.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈哈哈哈，
來得正好。不死族的攻擊快把我累垮了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I am on the way to go hide in the shelter nearby. Would you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我正準備去附近的避難所躲一躲。你願意和我一起去嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, sure.

[Soldier]
Good. Since I am tired from the previous battle, please escort me to the Knight's building.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
很好。我剛經歷一場戰鬥，已經累了，請護送我去騎士團大樓。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god, you heard my voice.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
謝天謝地，你聽見我的聲音了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I was going to help the knights defending the knight's building since I heard that many residents had been fled there. However, there seem to be enough troops here.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我聽說很多居民逃到了騎士團大樓，本想去幫忙守衛的騎士。不過看來那裡人手充足。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
If I show my face, it may just disturb their concentration. I'd rather go without seeing them.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
如果我露面，可能會分散他們的注意力。我還是不去打擾他們了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I shall go join the defense on another place. I guess I can join the troops at the village office down there.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我得去別處幫忙防守。我想可以去下面的村公所加入那裡的部隊。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Since I want to save my energy for the battle, please escort me to the village office.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我想留些體力應付戰鬥，請護送我去村公所。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Haha, do you see me? Strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈，你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

There are not many people guarding this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
守在這裡的人不多。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I should go help them now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我現在該去幫他們了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is such a secluded place, and there are 3 soldiers here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡這麼偏僻，居然還有3名士兵。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Dear adventurer, you know nothing.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
冒險者，你什麼都不懂。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Oh, I wasn't going to tell you this story, because I didn't want to boast...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哦，我本來不想說這件事的，因為我不想炫耀...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Millions of Kobolds have invaded Geffen before.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
以前曾有數百萬犬妖入侵吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless march of the Kobolds...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
犬妖大軍源源不斷地行進...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh... Thinking about it makes me sweat...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
唉...一想到這事，我就冒冷汗...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Well,, from my experience, a place like this is the toughest to guard when the enemies march in out of blue.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯，根據我的經驗，敵人突然來襲時，這樣的地方最難防守。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It is a secret that it is the greatest timing for the rise of a hero.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
這是個秘密，此刻正是英雄崛起的最佳時機。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll take a rest inside, and come out to save these people when this place is in danger. You shall go save another place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我會在裡面休息；這裡有危險時，再出來救人。你去救其他地方的人吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:

哈哈，你看得見我嗎？真奇怪，我不應該被看見才對。

Are you an adventurer?
Oh, Odin... Thank you! Dear adventurer, please find my wife.

你是冒險者嗎？
奧丁啊...謝謝你！親愛的冒險者，請幫我找找妻子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
It happened in the evening, at dusk.
With a roaring sound, we heard that something dropped near the old swordsmen's guild.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
那是傍晚時分。
一聲轟鳴後，我們聽說老劍士公會附近有什麼東西墜落了。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Many residents gathered around the area to find out what had caused such a commotion.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
許多居民聚集在那片區域，想弄清楚是什麼引起了這麼大的騷動。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
I went down there with my wife Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
我和妻子艾莉也去了那裡。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
When the people gathered, and night fell, the undead which had been buried under the ground of Prontera started waking up.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
人群聚集、夜幕降臨時，埋在普隆德拉地下的不死族開始甦醒。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
People freaked. While running around, I lost hold of my wife's hand.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
人們驚慌失措，四散奔逃時，我鬆開了妻子的手。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Oh, Ellie... My wife is a very fragile woman. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
艾莉...我的妻子很虛弱，希望她平安無事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me go find her. You should go hide in the cathedral. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去找她。你先去大教堂避難，我帶你過去。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... Please help me. Please find my wife.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...求求你幫幫我，找到我的妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Awww... I need to find my wife... And I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
嗚嗚...我得找到妻子...而且我不應該被看見。

scripts.text:

Oh, Eryus... Cough... Cough...

哦，埃裡烏斯...咳...咳...

scripts.text:

Ellie, what is going on? Are you ill again? Where is your medicine?
scripts.translation:

艾莉，怎麼了？你又生病了嗎？你的藥在哪裡？

scripts.text:

Cough... Cough... I must have dropped it while running...
scripts.translation:

咳...咳...我跑動的時候可能把它弄掉了...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Ellie]
Cough... Cough... I don't know. Cough, it could be there... Cough... Cough...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
咳...咳...我不知道。咳，可能在那邊...咳...咳...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Where you were before? Wait a moment. Let me go get it for you.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你剛才待的地方嗎？等一下，我去幫你拿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is dangerous out there. I'll go. You should stay here and take care of your wife.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
外面很危險，我去吧。你留下來照顧妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Would you do that for us? Please. We are running out of time. Ellie. hold on...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
你願意幫我們嗎？拜託了，我們沒多少時間了。艾莉，堅持住...

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Please. We are running out of time.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Oh, you are here.
The priest of the cathedral is taking care of my wife in there.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
哦，你回來了。
大教堂的牧師正在裡面照顧我妻子。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Thank you for helping us. I guess I shall bring the medicine to her as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
謝謝你幫了我們。我得儘快把藥送給她。

scripts.text:
[Eryus]
Thank you so much. God bless your journey...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡烏斯]
太感謝你了。願奧丁保佑你的旅途...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Welcome to Prontera
in the heart of Rune-Midgarts!
Prontera is located
in the center of the continent,
and it is famous as the busy city
of commerce and trade.
scripts.translation:
[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都：普隆德拉]
歡迎來到盧恩·米德加茲王國的中心——普隆德拉！
普隆德拉位於大陸中央，
以繁華的商業貿易聞名。

[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都：普隆德拉]
這裡有許多重要建築：普隆德拉宮殿可進行十字軍轉職；
普隆德拉大教堂可進行服事、牧師轉職，
也會在這裡舉行婚禮；
此外還有騎士團大樓等。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
There are many people and stores
as well so make sure to look around.
scripts.translation:
[盧恩·米德加茲王國首都：普隆德拉]
這裡還有許多人和商店，
不妨四處逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Prontera, the Capital of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]
Also, in the south east of the central fountain,
there is the historic Quadro Blacksmith's Workshop.
Drop by the place if you want to get
your equipment
repaired.

scripts.text: There are too many kinds of items in possession. Reduce the type of the items and try again.
