scripts.text: It seems difficult to proceed any further since the items in your possession are too heavy. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 背包裡的物品太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
What is it? Did Dylan send you here? If you are going to deal with me, don't waste any more time. There are a lot of people watching us.
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
什麼事？是迪倫派你來的？要對付我就別浪費時間。很多人都在看著我們。

scripts.text: What's the deal?
scripts.translation: 怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Let's deal.
scripts.translation: 談談交易

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
Isn't Dylan making some strange powder whenever he breaks a thing?
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
迪倫每次弄壞東西時，都會弄出某種奇怪的粉末，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
It is ^0000ffRune Magic Powder^000000 which the magicians use for their experiments. I don't think Dylan knows this.
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
那是^0000ff盧恩魔法粉末^000000，魔法師用來做實驗的材料。我想迪倫並不知道這點。

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
I'll ^0000ffexchange 30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box^000000. How do you like that? It is such a sweet deal, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
我用^0000ff30個盧恩魔法粉末換1個神秘藍箱^000000。怎麼樣？這筆交易很划算吧？

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
30 Rune Magic Powders for 1 Mysterious Blue Box. I remind you.
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
我再說一遍：30個盧恩魔法粉末換1個神秘藍箱。

scripts.text:
[Corrupt Warder]
Good, it is a great deal.
scripts.translation:
[腐敗的看守]
好，這筆交易很划算。

scripts.text: There are too many kinds of items in possession. Reduce the type of the items and try again.
scripts.translation: 持有的物品種類過多。請減少物品種類後再試。

scripts.text: It seems difficult to proceed any further since the items in your possession are too heavy. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 背包裡的物品太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Are you a customer? I am not going to get more customers today because I am tired.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你是來買東西的？我累了，今天不想再招待客人。

scripts.text: Are you running a business in the prison?
scripts.translation: 你在監獄裡做生意？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Although I may look like this now, I used to be called the man with the hand of minus out there. It is quite dangerous stuff. You'd better stay away.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
我現在雖然落魄，以前在外頭可是有“負之手”的稱號。這行當危險得很，你最好離遠點。

scripts.text: ^0000ffUnlike his words, he really seems eager to give an explanation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他嘴上這麼說，似乎卻很想解釋一番。^000000

scripts.text: I don't want to waste time here.
scripts.translation: 我不想在這裡浪費時間

scripts.text: What kind of business you are running here.
scripts.translation: 你在這裡做什麼生意？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Don't be a chicken...
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
別膽小...

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Honor Mark, which is issued by the kingdom and not to be traded between individuals. I receive it and enhance people's equipment.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
王國頒發的榮譽徽章不能由個人交易。我收下徽章，幫人強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
As you can tell, it is against the law. That's why I used to only work for through personal contacts. However, one guy whose equipment was broken while resetting the enhancement informed on me.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你也看出來了，這是違法的。所以我以前只通過私人關係接活。不過有個傢伙重置強化時弄壞了裝備，轉頭就把我告發了。

scripts.text: It really is a crime.
scripts.translation: 這確實是犯罪

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I don't need to hear of some personal impression by you. Although I am caught, I am roaming the prison freely thanks to the warder over there.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
我不需要聽你的個人評價。雖然我被抓了，但多虧那邊的看守，我才能在監獄裡自由走動。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Of course, I cannot get out to avoid causing the real problem. That's why I stay in the prison like this. Are you interested in the deal?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
當然，為了避免惹出更大的麻煩，我不能出去，所以才一直待在監獄裡。你對這筆交易有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: The kingdom has poor public security.
scripts.translation: 王國的治安真差

scripts.text: What is the deal?
scripts.translation: 什麼交易？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
What a nerd. I told you to back off if you didn't want to get involved.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
真是個書呆子。我說過，不想惹上麻煩就離我遠點。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You are a great fellow to deal with. I want to save enough money to bail myself out. Any customers are welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你挺好打交道的。我想攢夠錢把自己保釋出去。這裡歡迎所有顧客。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I enhance the three items, Flattery Robe, Invective Robe and Prontera Badge for Honor Mark.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
我用榮譽徽章強化三件裝備：恭維法袍、辱罵法袍和普隆德拉徽章。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I guess I don't need to explain about it anymore. Just bring the equipment you want to enhance to me.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
不用我多解釋了。把想強化的裝備拿給我就行。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Are you here to deal with me? Tell me what you need now.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你是來跟我做交易的嗎？說說你要辦什麼。

scripts.text: Tell me about the deal.
scripts.translation: 告訴我交易內容

scripts.text: Enhance Robe
scripts.translation: 強化法袍

scripts.text: Enhance Badge
scripts.translation: 強化徽章

scripts.text: Reset Enhanced Robe Stats
scripts.translation: 重置強化法袍屬性

scripts.text: Reset Enhanced Badge Stats
scripts.translation: 重置強化徽章屬性

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Listen carefully. I won't say twice.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
仔細聽好，我只說一遍。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I'll enhance one of the Flattery Robe or Invective Robe slot for 20 Honor Marks. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset. Do you follow me so far?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
強化恭維法袍或辱罵法袍的一個槽位需要20枚榮譽徽章，最多可強化兩個槽位。重置需要10枚榮譽徽章。聽明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Next, for the Prontera Badge. I'll take 5 Honor Marks to enhance 1 slot. I can enhance up to 2 slots. And I take 10 Honor Marks for the reset.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
接下來是普隆德拉徽章。強化一個槽位需要5枚榮譽徽章，最多可強化兩個槽位。重置需要10枚榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I don't perform the reset anytime. I'll do it when the 2 slots are enhanced for that you cannot enhance the item anymore. And... Then...
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
我不會隨時提供重置服務。只有兩個槽位都強化完、無法繼續強化時，我才會幫你重置。還有...

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Oh, there is one problem though. There is a change that the badge can be destroyed while resetting it. The chance is about 20%. Since it is such a tiny thing, there is some side effect of removing the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
不過有件事要提醒你：重置徽章時有約20%的機率會損壞。畢竟是小物件，移除強化時可能會有些副作用。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I hope the deal goes well, buddy.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
祝我們交易順利，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You need 20 Honor Marks for each slot of Flattery Robe or Invective Robe. Do you want to enhance it?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
強化恭維法袍或辱罵法袍的一個槽位需要20枚榮譽徽章。要強化嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You need 5 Honor Marks to enhance one slot of the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body. Would you enhance it?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
強化你左側裝備欄中佩戴的普隆德拉徽章的一個槽位，需要5枚榮譽徽章。要強化嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You need 10 Honor Marks to reset Invective Robe or Flattery Robe. The equipment won't be destroyed. The bound cards and the refinement level would remain the same as well.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
重置辱罵法袍或恭維法袍需要10枚榮譽徽章。裝備不會損壞，卡片和精煉等級也會保留。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You need 10 Honor Marks to reset the Prontera Badge you are wearing in the left slot of your body.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
重置你左側裝備欄中佩戴的普隆德拉徽章需要10枚榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
As I told you, it is difficult to reset the badge, ^ff0000The chance of success is 80%.^000000 If it fails, everything will be gone. Would you reset it?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
正如我所說，重置徽章有風險，^ff0000成功率為80%。^000000失敗的話，一切都會消失。要重置嗎？

scripts.text: I quit.
scripts.translation: 我不做了

scripts.text: Let's do it now.
scripts.translation: 現在就來吧

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I am busy so please don't waste my time by talking to me for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
我很忙，沒事就別來浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You are taking it off.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你正在把它脫下來。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
別鬧了。想強化就穿著裝備來找我。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
It cannot be enhanced anymore. Do you have anything else to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
它已經無法繼續強化了。還有別的東西要強化嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嘿，夥計。沒有榮譽徽章就別想跟我交易。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Oh, I have forgotten to mention it. I only enhance the item equipped in the left slot. Enhance it while equipping it in the left slot.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
哦，我忘了說。我只強化裝備在左側槽位的物品。記得把它裝備在左側槽位再來。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the Prontera Badge.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
別鬧了。想強化就裝備著普隆德拉徽章來找我。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
It cannot be enhanced anymore. Do you have anything else to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
它已經無法繼續強化了。還有別的東西要強化嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嘿，夥計。沒有榮譽徽章就別想跟我交易。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
You are taking it off.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
你正在把它脫下來。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
別鬧了。想強化就穿著裝備來找我。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Oh, this item is not enhanced completely. I cannot reset it yet.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
哦，這件裝備還沒強化滿，現在不能重置。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嘿，夥計。沒有榮譽徽章就別想跟我交易。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Oh, I have forgotten to mention it. I only enhance the item equipped in the left slot. Enhance it while equipping it in the left slot.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
哦，我忘了說。我只強化裝備在左側槽位的物品。記得把它裝備在左側槽位再來。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Oh, this item is not enhanced completely. I cannot reset it yet.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
哦，這件裝備還沒強化滿，現在不能重置。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Stop fooling around. If you want to enhance it, come to me wearing the Prontera Badge.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
別鬧了。想強化就裝備著普隆德拉徽章來找我。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hey, buddy. You cannot deal with me if you don't have any Honor Marks.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嘿，夥計。沒有榮譽徽章就別想跟我交易。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hum, it has been processed well. Check out the item.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嗯，處理好了。看看裝備吧。

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
I guess you are out of luck. The equipment is broken. Tut tut.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
看來你運氣不好，裝備壞掉了。嘖嘖。

scripts.text: [Dylan]
scripts.translation: [迪倫]

scripts.text:
[Dylan]
Hum, it has been processed well. Check out the item.
scripts.translation:
[迪倫]
嗯，處理好了。看看裝備吧。

scripts.text: Hum, it has been processed well. Check out the item.
scripts.translation: 嗯，處理得很不錯。看看這個物品吧。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
~Laughs~ You're an adventurer.
Unauthorized access to this area is restricted. Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
~笑~ 你是位冒險者。
未經許可不得進入此區域。感謝配合。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I am sorry to say this but unauthorized access to the area you see in the front is restricted. Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
很抱歉，前方區域禁止未經授權者進入。給您帶來不便，敬請諒解。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Come to think of it...Not everyone is allowed to enter this place. Whoa!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
仔細想想...並不是誰都能進這裡。哇！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I heard the adventurer who made the significant contribution to defeating Devil King Morocc has been invited to the royal banquet.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我聽說，那位為擊敗魔王夢羅克立下大功的冒險者，受邀參加了王室宴會。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Since you're here....You must be...!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
既然您在這裡...您一定就是...！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Have you been invited, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
冒險者，您受邀了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Whoa, this is unbelievable!
I heard so much about you. I'm a huge fan!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哇，簡直難以置信！
我聽說過很多關於您的事，我是您的忠實粉絲！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Holy moly! I felt so bad having to guard here in the night of the banquet and I never expected to see you here, Adventurer. Amazing!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
天哪！宴會之夜還要在這裡站崗，我本來很鬱悶，沒想到竟然能見到您，冒險者！太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Let me introduce myself then.
I am Ellond Lawrence from the Royal Crusaders. I have so much respect for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
讓我自我介紹一下。
我是皇家十字軍的艾隆德·勞倫斯。我非常敬仰您。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, I almost forgot! Can I get your autograph?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，我差點忘了！能給我籤個名嗎？

scripts.text: Give him your autograph.
scripts.translation: 給他簽名

scripts.text: (Decline it.)
scripts.translation: （拒絕）

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Thank you so much! Now I have something to brag about to my fellows. What an honor to my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
太感謝了！這下我可以向同伴們炫耀了。真是我們家族的榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I'm sorry to hear that, but I understand you have reasons.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
聽到您拒絕，我很遺憾，不過我理解您有自己的理由。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, right! I see, right!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，對了！我明白了，沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Some discussed the idea during the meeting to ask the famous adventurer to handle the problem at the restricted area. No approval was given to it, but I'll see what I can do with my authority.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
會議上有人提議請那位著名冒險者處理限制區域的問題。提議雖未獲批准，我還是會用自己的許可權想想辦法。

scripts.text: Problem at the Restricted Area?
scripts.translation: 限制區域出了什麼問題？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, I knew this would pique your interest, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，我就知道這會引起您的興趣，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
No one will question your reputation and abilities. So I would love to cut to the chase and spill the beans, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
沒人會質疑您的名聲和本領。我本想開門見山，把詳情告訴您，但是...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I think I'll have to take a deep breath and drink a cup of water to calm myself down before I do.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我得先深呼吸、喝口水，冷靜一下再說。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Now that my thirst has been quenched, let me tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
現在我不渴了，讓我告訴您事情的經過。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
This problem has long been a pain in the neck.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
這個問題一直讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
There was zero monster in the beginning for sure, but, out of the total blue, they started to appear in the underground dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
起初那裡確實沒有魔物，但不知為何，它們突然開始出現在地下迷宮裡。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
It doesn't mean we're goofing off around here!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
這可不代表我們在這裡偷懶！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
We crusaders are doing our best to eliminate the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as we can.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我們十字軍正盡全力清除地下迷宮裡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Unfortunately, the numbers kept growing to a degree that we can't handle them all by ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
可惜魔物越來越多，單靠我們已經應付不過來了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I hate to admit, but we haven't even identified where these monsters come from.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我很不想承認，但我們甚至還沒查明這些魔物的來源。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
In the underground dungeon, they are...No. I don't think I should say it right here. You'll see once you get inside.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
地下迷宮裡的那些東西...不，還是別在這裡說了。您進去就知道了。

scripts.text: So, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 那麼，我能為您做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, I'm sorry. I think I have said too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，抱歉。我好像說得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
There is no need to submit any investigation report. We've got ours, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
不需要提交調查報告，我們也有自己的調查結果。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
What I would like to ask you to do for us is to mop out the monsters in the underground dungeon as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我想請您儘可能清除地下迷宮裡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
While you're at it, I would much appreciate it if you can let me in on what goes on inside the underground dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
另外，如果您能告訴我地下迷宮裡發生了什麼，我會非常感激。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector A.
scripts.translation: 我去過A區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Whoa, what did you just say? You've been to Sector A?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哇，您剛才說什麼？您去過A區？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I haven't met that bloke in that sector yet, but one of my fellows appointed to that area did say he can be pretty ferocious.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我還沒見過那一區的人，不過派駐那裡的同伴說，他相當兇猛。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Anyway, it is a relief to hear he hasn't caused any trouble there.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
總之，聽說他在那裡沒惹出麻煩，我就放心了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector B.
scripts.translation: 我去過B區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, have you?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
~Laughs~ He had been my junior to me.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
~笑~ 他以前是我的後輩。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
He can be pretty annoying, I know. He would ask to make a lifelike doll, and even try to hit on his female fellows.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我知道他挺煩人的。他會要求做逼真的玩偶，甚至還會搭訕女同事。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
So if he hasn't changed much, that means he's not going to make a problem. I'm relieved to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
如果他沒什麼變化，應該不會惹麻煩。聽你這麼說我就放心了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector C.
scripts.translation: 我去過C區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
~Laughs~ Have you been to Sector C, eh?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
~笑~ 您去過C區啊？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, my days! Did he really say you'll be rewarded for those chores? What an improvement!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
天哪！他真說做那些雜務會給你獎勵嗎？真是長進了！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
It's not uncommon for the Crusaders to lose something they are not supposed to...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
十字軍丟了不該丟的東西，這種事並不少見...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I can see they have improved for some reason. They probably like you a lot.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
看來他們不知為何有所改進，大概是很喜歡您吧。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector D.
scripts.translation: 我去過D區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
~Gasps~ D...Se...Sector...D...?! ~Gulps~
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
~倒吸一口氣~ D...區...D區...？！~咽口水~

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Don't ever let his looks deceive you! He can be the most dangerous one in the prison.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
千萬別被他的外表騙了！他可能是監獄裡最危險的人。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
If he doesn't try to do anything to you, it must be the best that could ever happen.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
只要他沒對你動手，那就算最好的情況了。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector E.
scripts.translation: 我去過E區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I know a few things about the Sector E, actually.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
其實，我對E區有些瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Unlike what he looks like, he has such a delicate and warm heart. Still, he can certainly go berserk if things go haywire.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
別看他外表那樣，其實他心思細膩、心地溫暖。不過事情失控時，他確實會陷入狂暴。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Just make sure he doesn't see red. Otherwise, you're going to do fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
只要別惹他發火就行。我想你應該能應付。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector F.
scripts.translation: 我去過F區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Sector F, eh? ~Laughs~ The real troublemaker is locked in there.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
F區啊？~笑~ 真正的麻煩人物就關在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
He would not even lift a finger, bossing everyone around. He thinks the world revolves around him.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
他懶得動一根手指，只會指使別人，以為全世界都圍著他轉。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
He can be a complainer but he's harmless. I think you'll be fine with him.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
他雖然愛抱怨，但沒什麼危險。我想你能應付他。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector G.
scripts.translation: 我去過G區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, Sector G you say? Hmm, that zone must be...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，G區啊？嗯，那個區域應該是...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
That prisoner is often called as the sleeping beauty in the prison. I remember he's been sleeping for quite a while.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
那個囚犯常被稱為監獄裡的睡美人。我記得他已經睡了很久。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I don't have much to say about him because all I saw about him was sleeping. Well, I think you can make good friends with him.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我對他沒什麼好說的，畢竟我只見過他睡覺。嗯，你們應該能成為朋友。

scripts.text: I've been to the Sector H.
scripts.translation: 我去過H區

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Ah, Sector H! ~Bursts into laughter~ Is he still a whiner?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
啊，H區！~大笑~ 他還是那麼愛抱怨嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I was responsible for him when I first came here and his requests were endless!
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我剛來這裡時負責照看他，他的要求沒完沒了！

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Anyway, he means well.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
總之，他心地不壞。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, I almost forgot.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，我差點忘了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
In case you forgot, you took a full tour around the underground dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
提醒您一下，您已經完整逛過地下迷宮了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Phenomenal! You are indeed worthy to be invited to the royal banquet on behalf of other numerous adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
太了不起了！您確實有資格代表眾多冒險者參加王室宴會。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
One more thing. I reported what I requested to you to the superiors.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
還有，我已經把委託您的事情報告給上級了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
They provided the special reward money for your credibility.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
上級特意撥了獎勵金，以表彰您的貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Now that you received the special reward money, please keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
既然您收到了特別獎勵金，請繼續努力。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I must say it's quite rare to see such a diligent adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
像您這樣勤勉的冒險者可不多見。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I appreciate what you do for us, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
冒險者，感謝您為我們所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Are you ready to enter the underground dungeon? Do you have anything you'd like to ask?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
您準備好進入地下迷宮了嗎？有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text: To the Underground Dungeon...
scripts.translation: 前往地下迷宮...

scripts.text: About the Underground Dungeon
scripts.translation: 關於地下迷宮

scripts.text: About Them
scripts.translation: 關於那些東西

scripts.text: I think I saw a bunch like them...
scripts.translation: 我好像見過一群類似的...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I wish you godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
祝您一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Is there something you'd like to know about the underground dungeon?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
有什麼想了解地下迷宮的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Nothing particular. What you can imagine about the dungeon of the kingdom is all there is.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
沒什麼特別的。王國的地下迷宮大致就是您想像中的那樣。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I was told it was made to lock up the menaces to peace and safety of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
聽說這裡是為了關押威脅盧恩·米德加茲王國和平與安全的危險分子而建的。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Basically, it's strongly made, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
基本上設施很堅固，不過...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
The facility there is very old so it must need some mending works here and there.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
那裡的設施很老舊，到處都需要修繕。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
But, as you can see, we can't even find the time to fix anything.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
可是您也看到了，我們連抽空修東西都做不到。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
The situation here is getting worse, so please take good care of yourself so that you won't get hurt in the dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
這裡的情況越來越糟，請多保重，別在迷宮裡受傷。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
What you saw in the dungeon are monsters, for sure. What else could they be?
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
您在迷宮裡看到的肯定是魔物。還能是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
This facility is so old and there is no document written about it. We just pass down what people say about it.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
這裡的設施太老舊，沒有留下任何文獻。我們只能聽人們口耳相傳。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
What's certain is that they were the culprit of the chaos created in Rune-Midgarts in the past.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
可以確定的是，它們過去曾在盧恩·米德加茲製造混亂。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Anyway, there is no document left about them ? for what they were charged or sentences confirmed against them.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
總之，沒有留下關於它們的文書，不論是罪名還是判決都無從查證。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Although there is a document saying that some crusader lost the document containing the charge and the sentence made...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
不過有份記錄提到，一名十字軍弄丟了記載指控和判決的檔案...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Well, I guess those in the underground dungeon don't seem to care too much about him, so it'd be alright.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
嗯，地下迷宮裡的那些傢伙似乎不太在意他，應該沒事。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Some of them must still be inside the prison even when they've done the time.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
有些人刑期已滿，卻可能仍被關在監獄裡。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Oh, I heard about that story, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
哦，我也聽說過那件事。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
The Crusaders are consisting of various bunches so some of them are adventurers like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
十字軍裡什麼人都有，其中也有像您這樣的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
A friend of mine said he saw the monsters from the underground dungeon are going about the world outside of it.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
有個朋友說，他看見地下迷宮的魔物跑到外面的世界去了。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
The Crusaders say he is bluffing a lot probably because he was an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
十字軍們說他在吹牛，大概因為他以前是個冒險者吧。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
No offense, adventurer. This is not about you. He's just full of baloney...
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
冒險者，別介意，我不是說您。他只是在胡說八道...

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I guarantee you that the monsters in the outer world and those in the dungeon must be different beings from each other.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
我敢保證，外界的魔物和迷宮裡的絕不是同一種生物。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
They must be remotely related or something.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
它們之間大概有些遙遠的關聯。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
I am sorry, but unauthorized access to this place is restricted.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
很抱歉，未經許可不得進入此地。

scripts.text:
[Ellond Lawrence]
Sorry for the inconvenience and your cooperation will be appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[艾隆德·勞倫斯]
給您帶來不便，敬請諒解。感謝配合。

scripts.text:
[Terketh]
You are out from the Past Memories of the Royal Family?
Since you know the way here, you must have got the permission to move.
scripts.translation:
[特爾凱斯]
您是從王室回憶中出來的嗎？
既然知道來這裡的路，想必已經獲准通行了。

scripts.text:
[Terketh]
Let me send you out.
If you move straight up the stairs, you'll find the Crusader's Office.
You must to where to go after that, right?
scripts.translation:
[特爾凱斯]
我送您出去。
沿著樓梯直走，就能找到十字軍辦公室。
之後該往哪走，您應該知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Terketh]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[特爾凱斯]
你想做什麼？

scripts.text: To the Past Memories of the Royal Family
scripts.translation: 前往王室回憶

scripts.text: To the outside
scripts.translation: 前往外面

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Who is it? Who's calling me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
是誰？誰在叫我？

scripts.text: The prisoner is howling. Is something happening?
scripts.translation: 囚犯正在嚎叫。發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
You must be adventurer, are you? Hmm...You seem like a beginner. I don't see much charm in you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
你是冒險者吧？嗯...看起來像個新手，沒什麼魅力。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Pleasure. It's been a while I saw a human around here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
幸會。我已經很久沒見到人類了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
You don't seem like that crusader who put me in here. From what I see, I guess you're an adventurer...Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
你看起來不像是把我關進來的十字軍。依我看，你應該是冒險者...是吧？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
It's been a while I saw an adventurer. What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
好久沒見到冒險者了。你怎麼會來這裡？

scripts.text: - I explained why I came here. -
scripts.translation: - 我解釋了來這裡的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I thought the Crusaders released them all, no? I must've thought wrong, then.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我還以為十字軍把他們全放出來了，看來是我想錯了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I just thought the Crusaders released them to disrupt the prisoners' peaceful break.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我還以為十字軍把他們放出來，故意擾亂囚犯們的清靜。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Anyway, I am sorry that I can't be of any help to you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
總之，很抱歉我幫不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Human adventurer, I couldn't be of help, but do you mind if I ask you to do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
人類冒險者，雖然我幫不上你的忙，但能請你幫我一件事嗎？

scripts.text: Let's hear what it is, shall we?
scripts.translation: 說來聽聽

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Thank you. I was once a seaman, voyaging around the sea.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
謝謝。我曾經是個水手，四處航海。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I met a whole lot of fellow seamen as much as I had been on a voyage. Pleasing fellow, bluffing fellow, chicken-hearted fellow...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
航海時我遇到過許多水手同伴，有人討喜，有人愛吹牛，也有人膽小如鼠...

scripts.text: - The prisoner seems reminiscent of his past, pounding his left chest with his fist. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯似乎陷入回憶，用拳頭捶著自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Yes, I've had a lot of fellow seamen from all walks of life. But we had to part with each other after we got here...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
是啊，我有過許多來自各行各業的水手同伴。可到了這裡之後，我們不得不分開...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I've been here for as long as I can remember but that sound...It's pretty recent around here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我在這裡待了很久，但那個聲音...最近才開始出現。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
It's indistinct but...I can hear the sound from the very far into the darkness, calling me...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
聲音很模糊...我能聽見黑暗深處傳來呼喚...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Can you find an old fellow of mine who must be locked somewhere in the prison for me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
你能幫我找找被關在監獄某處的老夥計嗎？

scripts.text: Consider it done.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Thank you. I hope it is the cry from that fellow.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
謝謝。我希望那是老夥計的呼喚。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Please. I hope it's one of my fellow men. You have no idea how long it's been.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
拜託了，希望那是我的同伴。我等這一天等了很久。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
You came, at last! So what was that sound? Did you meet my man?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
你終於來了！那個聲音是怎麼回事？你見到我的老夥計了嗎？

scripts.text: - I explained what happened to his fellow. -
scripts.translation: - 我向他說明了同伴的遭遇。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
So what I heard from darkness was indeed the voice from my fellow man. I hoped he'd be alright.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
原來黑暗中傳來的確實是同伴的聲音。我還盼著他平安無事。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
So he is no longer alive...I know it's been quite a while since that happened, but it's still a shame.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
原來他已經不在人世了...雖然那是很久以前的事，還是讓人惋惜。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Thank you so much for finding that out for me. I'm much obliged.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
非常感謝你替我查明此事。我感激不盡。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
By the way, I haven't even asked your name. What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
對了，我還沒問過你的名字。你叫什麼？

scripts.text: Tell him your name.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你的名字

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
{0}....
- The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯握緊拳頭，捶了捶自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我會把你的名字刻在這裡。希望你能繼續替我向同伴傳話。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Hello. {0} Howdy.
Can you locate an old fellow of mine, again, and deliver his story to me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
你好，{0}。
你能再幫我找找老夥計，把他的故事帶給我嗎？

scripts.text: You can count on me.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫忙

scripts.text: I've got my hands full today.
scripts.translation: 我今天抽不開身

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Is that so? That's a shame. Be sure to come back again if you have the time...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
是嗎？真遺憾。有空記得再來...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I sure am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I can't wait to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我等不及想聽訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I owe you big time. You have no idea.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我欠你一份大人情，你可不知道。

scripts.text: - The prisoner grabs a fist and pounds his left chest. -
scripts.translation: - 囚犯握緊拳頭，捶了捶自己的左胸。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
I'll inscribe your name right here. I hope you would continue to be the messenger for my fellow men.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
我會把你的名字刻在這裡。希望你能繼續替我向同伴傳話。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Now that the fellow has become freer from death, I wonder what he's up to. I wonder what kind of memory he would write in his next letter.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
那位老夥計已經逃過一劫，不知他現在怎麼樣。不知道他下一封信會寫下怎樣的回憶。

scripts.text: The prisoner started singing as if he was reminiscing about something.
scripts.translation: 囚犯像是回憶起什麼，開始哼唱。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243AD265]
Is it already that time to hear the news from the old fellow of mine?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243AD265]
是不是又到了聽老夥計訊息的時候？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. As soon as I showed an interest, it was gone nowhere.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影漂浮在暗處。我剛表現出興趣，它就消失了。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape starts to sway when it saw me. Did it mean it's delighted to see me?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影看見我後搖晃起來。它是在高興嗎？

scripts.text: Anything else to give me?
scripts.translation: 還有東西要給我嗎？

scripts.text: The Dark Shape handed you the letter and was gone.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影把信交給你後消失了。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape seems to be in a good mood, humming along.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影心情不錯，正哼著歌。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape is floating in the dark space. What should I do about it?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影漂浮在暗處。我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Ask if he's the fellow of 243AD265.
scripts.translation: 問他是不是243AD265的同伴

scripts.text:
[Dark Shape]
That ... ... you ... ... fell ... ... scen ... ... wind ... ...

[Dark Shape]
... I ... ... see ... ... the ... ... airr ... ... ough ...
You have no idea what it's talking about, but get the impression, from its response to what you say, that it must be the one of the Prisoner 243AD265's fellows.
scripts.translation: 你完全聽不懂它在說什麼，但從它的反應看來，它應該是囚犯243AD265的同伴。

scripts.text: What should you do?
scripts.translation: 你該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Just leave.
scripts.translation: 直接離開

scripts.text: Wait a little more.
scripts.translation: 再等一會兒

scripts.text: The Dark Shape handed you the letter and left. Did it mean to ask you to deliver it?
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影把信交給你後離開了。它是想讓你替它送信嗎？

scripts.text: You are becoming increasingly agitated as you can't communicate with it effectively. So you decided to leave.
scripts.translation: 你無法和它順利溝通，越來越焦躁，於是決定離開。

scripts.text: The Dark Shape must've noticed it. It's gone nowhere, too.
scripts.translation: 黑暗的身影似乎察覺到了什麼，也消失了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner here is sitting with the extremely bored look. If you talk to him at this point, you may have to sit down to hang out with him.
scripts.translation: 囚犯坐在這裡，無聊得東張西望。現在和他說話，恐怕得坐下來陪他打發時間。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Yes, I'm bored as you must've imagined, but I can't hang out with you. Why? You don't have the eyes that I want.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
正如你想的，我很無聊，但沒法陪你消遣。為什麼？因為你沒有我想要的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Hey! Yes, you outside of the steel bars. You have such pretty eyes. My cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
嘿，鐵欄杆外的你！你的眼睛真漂亮，正合我意。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Please be nice and give me either of your eyes. I'll cherish them.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
乖一點，把一隻眼睛給我吧。我會好好珍惜的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, you're being too forward.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，你也太直接了吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Am I? Because those eyes look so gorgeous.
Even if you give me one of those, you still have one left. How hard can it be?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
是嗎？你的眼睛實在太漂亮了。
就算給我一隻，你不是還剩一隻嗎？這有什麼難的？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
You're one greedy fella.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
你可真貪心。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Well, if you say so, can you just find the time to talk with me, then?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
好吧，既然你這麼說，那就抽空來陪我聊聊天吧？

scripts.text: I can do it.
scripts.translation: 我可以

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
You're pretty straightforward. If you say so...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
你倒挺直率。既然你這麼說...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Alright, then! What should we talk about first?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
好，那我們先聊什麼？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
How about this? Do you know what charge people put against me? It's the marriage scam!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
這樣吧，你知道我被控什麼罪嗎？婚姻詐騙！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Marriage scam? Ridiculous! Do I look like someone who would dupe anyone into marrying me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
婚姻詐騙？荒唐！我看起來像會騙別人跟我結婚的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, uh...

[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh? You thought so, too?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦？你也這麼覺得？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Pretty eyes don't do any good, I guess! You should open your mind to match those pretty little eyes!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
看來漂亮眼睛也沒用！你該敞開心扉，別辜負這雙漂亮眼睛！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
I was merely attracted to the woman with pretty eyes. It was pure love. People don't get me.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我只是被那個有雙漂亮眼睛的女人吸引了，那是純粹的愛情。大家都不理解我。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh, I remember. Yes, there is a bunch who's walking around the underground dungeon as freely as they desire.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦，我想起來了。有一群傢伙在地下迷宮裡想去哪就去哪。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
I thought that was weird and recently found the cheeky ones with the bat wings when they're not even bats.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我覺得這很奇怪。最近還看到一些長著蝙蝠翅膀的傢伙，可它們明明不是蝙蝠。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
They were cheeky indeed, but I thought they have pretty blue eyes.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
它們確實很無禮，不過我覺得它們有漂亮的藍眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
So I told them I would gracefully let them pass with their wings and, in return, they should give me that blue gems.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
所以我說可以放它們帶著翅膀通過，但要拿那些藍色寶石來交換。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
But they wouldn't listen.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
可它們不肯聽。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
But they might listen to you because you have pretty eyes.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
不過你有一雙漂亮眼睛，也許它們會聽你的。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Can you just go ask them to give their pretty gems? I'm not allowed to leave here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
你能去問問它們要那些漂亮寶石嗎？我不能離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
If they wouldn't listen, why don't you just take them? How about 20? I'm giving you the special grant.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
它們不肯聽的話，直接拿來不就行了？給我20個吧，我特別批准了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
It started off with a little chat, but ended up as a request. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
本來只是隨便聊聊，結果變成了提要求。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
I believe someone with pretty eyes like you should forgive me. So...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我相信你這麼漂亮的人一定會原諒我的。所以...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Go and get those pretty gems from the cheeky bunch with the bat wings.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
去把那群長著蝙蝠翅膀的無禮傢伙的漂亮寶石拿來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
You should get me at least 20, alright?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
至少給我弄來20個，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
No way! What I saw were blue eyes but these are red! That's odd!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
不可能！我看到的明明是藍眼睛，這些卻是紅色的！真奇怪！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
I'll have to take a close look. Will you hand them to me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我得仔細看看。把它們交給我吧？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Now that I have a job to do for today and you've done a good job. Maybe I should give you a present.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
今天總算有事可做了，而且你也幹得不錯。也許我該送你份禮物。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Humans who had been here before gave me this. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
以前來過這裡的人類送我的。我不喜歡這種設計，就送給你吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
This time, again, I took a close look at it.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
這次我又仔細檢查了一遍。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
But I couldn't find what turned the blue eyes into the red ones.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
可我沒找到藍眼睛變紅的原因。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
So I'm asking you ? will you take the blue gems from them again?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我再問你一次，你願意再去拿那些藍色寶石嗎？

scripts.text: Give a hand.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Refuse to help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
I thought you'd be different. So disappointing.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
我還以為你會不一樣。真讓人失望。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
You should get me at least 20, alright?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
至少給我弄來20個，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh~~ I wish I would get the pretty blue eyes this time~~
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦~~希望這次拿到的是漂亮的藍眼睛~~

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh, you indeed brought them! I'll take a close look. Let me.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦，你真的帶來了！讓我仔細看看。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh, I almost forgot. This is the thing I talked to you the last time. I don't like this kind of design, so I'll give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦，我差點忘了。這就是上次提到的東西。我不喜歡這種設計，送給你吧。

scripts.text: He's really taking the time looking closely at the red eyes you brought.
scripts.translation: 他正仔細端詳你帶來的紅色眼睛。

scripts.text: He must not be responding to whatever you say to him now.
scripts.translation: 他現在似乎聽不見你說話。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh, I have nothing else to do. I'm so bored. I should do something.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦，我沒事可做，無聊死了。得找點事幹。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 267BD184]
Oh! Human with pretty eyes! You've come at the right time.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 267BD184]
哦，眼睛漂亮的人類！你來得正好。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: The prisoner here is gazing around the corners like a hunting lion. You want to get away before you get caught.
scripts.translation: 這裡的囚犯像獵食的獅子一樣四處張望。你想趁被他發現前溜走。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Whoa, this is human!
I'm sorry to say this but I have to work now. Let me play with you later.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
哇，是人類！
抱歉，我現在得工作，待會兒再陪你玩。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Whoa, this is human!
How did you get in here? You've got some skills!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
哇，是人類！
你怎麼進來的？有兩下子嘛！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Hehe-
~Stroking~
scripts.translation: ~撫摸~

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Let me give you a compliment stamp. Here it is!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
我給你蓋個表揚章。來！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Hehe- I think it's all good since I don't have to see the menacing ones. Right?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
嘿嘿——不用看那些嚇人的傢伙，我覺得一切都挺好。對吧？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
What I learned is that the humans would do anything for a reward. Am I right or what?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
我發現人類為了獎勵什麼都肯做。對不對？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Let me give you quite a good one. Just follow one of my 'orders.'
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
我給你個不錯的獎勵。只要聽從我的一個“命令”就行。

scripts.text: Just listen anyway.
scripts.translation: 先聽聽看

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Oh, good! How nice!
You're such a good human. See? You'll know what I mean if you have eyes.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
哦，太好了！真不錯！
你真是個好人類。明白了嗎？有眼睛的話就該懂我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
This underground dungeon used to be clean and neat. Once the humans came along a while ago, it got dirty probably because they haven't done the proper cleaning.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
這個地下迷宮以前乾淨整潔。人類來了之後，大概沒好好打掃，才變得髒兮兮的。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Watch this, human. Trust my detective instinct. Do you see them wandering around here?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
看好了，人類。相信我的偵探直覺。你看到它們在這裡遊蕩了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
I have no idea how they got in, but I'm absolutely sure they're the cause of dirtiness in the prison.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
我不知道它們怎麼進來的，但我敢肯定，是它們把監獄弄髒了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to attack them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要我攻擊它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
What are you talking about, human? They're nice. I didn't know you'd be this violent. I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
你在說什麼，人類？它們很可愛。沒想到你這麼暴力，真讓我失望。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Stop harassing the innocent kids. Just go around the prison and clean up the mess.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
別欺負無辜的小傢伙。去監獄周圍把垃圾清理乾淨。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
人類！別偷懶，把這裡那裡都擦乾淨。好好做。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
You've done your cleaning? Yay! Here's your compliment stamp!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
打掃完了？太好了！這是給你的表揚章！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Now that the prison becomes clean, you must be feeling good, too, aren't you, human? We should do the cleaning more often.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
監獄變乾淨了，你心情也好多了吧，人類？我們該常打掃才對。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Oh, right! I told you I'd give you a reward, didn't I?
This is what the human who worked here before gave me. You've been such a sport so let me give you this.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
對了！我說過會給你獎勵，對吧？
這是以前在這裡工作的人類送我的。你表現不錯，就給你吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
If you come back again tomorrow and give me a hand, there will be more of this. Come back often!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
明天再來幫我，還能拿到更多。記得常來！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Now that the prison has gotten messy as I intended. So it's finally the time for cleaning.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
監獄現在變得夠亂了，終於該打掃了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Cleaning will make the day rewarding!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
打掃乾淨，這一天才算有收穫！

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出發吧！

scripts.text: No way! I will never do it. Over my dead body.
scripts.translation: 絕不！我死也不做

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Oh, you...! I knew you'd be better but I didn't know you were this lazy. Big letdown!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
哦，你...！我以為你會好些，沒想到這麼懶。太讓我失望了！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Let the cleaning begin!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
開始打掃！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Human! Don't try to cut corners ? wipe it all up here and there. Make it clean. Do it right.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
人類！別偷懶，把這裡那裡都擦乾淨。好好做。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
What a good human! You've earned another compliment stamp! Here it is!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
真是個好人類！你又得到一枚表揚章了！來！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
Now that you finished cleaning for today, let me give you this. Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
今天的清掃結束了，給你這個。明天再來！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
You don't seem to know the fun of messing things up. Messing is as fun as cleaning!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
你似乎不懂搗亂的樂趣。把東西弄亂和打掃一樣有趣！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
That's about enough now. You can do the rest tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
差不多了，剩下的明天再做。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 265CM154]
You've come at the right time. The prison has gotten properly messy, so it's time for cleaning.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 265CM154]
你來得正好。監獄已經夠亂了，該打掃了。

scripts.text: Some stuff left around the floor are lumped together.
scripts.translation: 地上的一些雜物堆在了一起。

scripts.text: Clean them.
scripts.translation: 清理

scripts.text: Just leave them.
scripts.translation: 不管它

scripts.text: You're sad but there still are much to clean. Go find something to clean up.
scripts.translation: 雖然你有些沮喪，但還有很多要打掃。去找些東西清理吧。

scripts.text: You finished cleaning. Report the result.
scripts.translation: 打掃完畢。彙報結果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What is it, human? Anything you want to say to me?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
人類，怎麼了？有什麼話要對我說？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What are you talking about? I don't have time for this. Beat it.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
你在說什麼？我沒空聽這些。滾開。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What?! Do you have anything to say to me? Spit it out, then!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
什麼？！有話就說，別磨蹭！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
{0} ? Is that it?
I was ridiculed for no reason and it really feels bad.
scripts.translation: 我無緣無故被嘲笑，心裡很不好受。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What?! Do you have a problem with me? Be gone now.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
什麼？！對我有意見？快滾。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
~Giggles~ I suddenly feel better now. Alright, what the heck. I'll send you to the sector you want for 1 Jellopy.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
~咯咯笑~ 我突然心情好多了。好吧，隨便你去哪，給我1個傑勒比結晶，我就送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What? You don't even have Jellopy with you? How useless are you?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
什麼？你連傑勒比結晶都沒帶？真沒用。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Prison Entrance it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去監獄入口吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector A it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域A吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector B it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域B吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector C it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域C吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector D it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域D吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector E it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域E吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector F it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域F吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector G it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域G吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! Sector H it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯243DV17]
謝謝你的傑勒比結晶！那就去區域H吧。快走！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Thank you for Jellopy! {0} it is, then. Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
謝了，傑勒比結晶我收下了！那就送你去{0}。走吧！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
What? Sector D is right here! Well, I've got my Jellopy so I don't care. Let me send you there.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
什麼？D區就在這裡！反正我有傑勒比結晶，不在乎。送你過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 243DV17]
Just leave me alone! Go away!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 243DV17]
別煩我！滾開！

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Zzzzzzzzz...~Snores~
scripts.translation: 呼嚕嚕...~打鼾~

scripts.text: The prisoner is breathing calmly so he must be sleeping.
scripts.translation: 囚犯呼吸平穩，看來睡著了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
What a worthless human!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
沒用的人類！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Sniffs~ This smell...Yes...It is human...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~嗅~ 這個氣味...沒錯...是人類...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Giggles~ It's been such a while since any human came along in this dark underground. Get over here, human. It's been a while so I will show mercy and let you live.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~咯咯笑~ 這片黑暗的地下已經很久沒人來了。過來吧，人類。看在好久沒人來的份上，我大發慈悲饒你一命。

scripts.text: Approach closer.
scripts.translation: 靠近

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Evil laughter~ You've got the courage, human!
I can't wait to let the dumb humans taste of my fist of terror!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~邪惡的笑聲~ 你膽子不小啊，人類！
我等不及要讓愚蠢的人類嚐嚐我恐懼之拳的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Now I can't let myself out of this dark and damp place because of the chicken-hearted human. Once I get out of here, I will never forgive the humans.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
因為那個膽小鬼，我才被困在這陰暗潮溼的地方。等我出去，絕不會放過人類。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...there is particularly no need to...

[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Evil laughter~
Talking back to me? How dare you! But I like your audacity, too. You can be my underling, then.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~邪惡的笑聲~
敢頂嘴？膽子不小！不過我也喜歡你的膽量。那你就做我的手下吧。

scripts.text: By the way, didn't you just cringe?
scripts.translation: 你剛才不是縮起來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Wa-hahaha! I think I've got myself a cocky underling.
Remember. A dark and humid place like this one is a match for a doppelganger who is blatantly wicked and doesn't even have its own face.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
哇哈哈！看來我有了個狂妄的手下。
記住，像這裡這樣陰暗潮溼的地方，正適合我這種面目猙獰、邪惡透頂的分身。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Evil laughter~
Let me give a chance to this amusing underling to prove your sense of loyalty. I'll have to brighten up this place first.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~邪惡的笑聲~
我給你這個有趣的手下一個證明忠誠的機會。首先得把這裡弄亮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haven't we just...met?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們不是才剛見面嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. This place is too dark. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
手下，去拿監獄裡最亮的火把。這裡太黑了，我要把它變得像我的故鄉一樣明亮。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Underling. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison. I'll have to turn this place bright like my own hometown.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
手下，去拿監獄裡最亮的火把。我要把這裡弄得像我的故鄉一樣明亮。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Evil laughter~
What a loyal subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~邪惡的笑聲~
真是忠心的部下！多虧你，我至少能過上一段明亮的日子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean, I am not your under...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是說，我不是你的手下...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
I would like to give you a reward, but I'm afraid I don't have much. I would've given you a world of treasures if it were my golden days.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
我想給你獎勵，可惜沒什麼好東西。要是在我的全盛時期，肯定會送你一大堆寶物。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Underling, this is a shame, but I'll give you something I took from the human who would come in here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
手下，真可惜，我只能把以前從進來的那些人類身上搶來的東西給你。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
等我重回世界之巔那天，一定給你更多獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
It's time to demonstrate your sense of loyalty. Get me the torch burning brightly in the prison.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
該證明你的忠誠了。去拿監獄裡最亮的火把。

scripts.text: Not so fast.
scripts.translation: 別急

scripts.text: Okay...
scripts.translation: 好的...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Is there anything you should do now? I'm perplexed to hear it but I will do my best to understand you.
Still, don't make me wait too long.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
現在還有什麼事嗎？雖然不太明白，我會盡量理解。
不過別讓我等太久。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
~Laughter~ Go! Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
~笑~ 去吧！把監獄裡最亮的火把拿來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Go and get the torch burning most brightly in the prison, again.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
再去把監獄裡最亮的火把拿來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
What an exemplary subordinate! Now I can lead a bright life, at least for a while, thanks to your contribution.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
真是模範部下！多虧你的幫忙，我至少能過上一段明亮的日子。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Keep this in mind. I promise you a lot more rewards the day when I stand tall in the world again.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
記住，等我重回世界之巔那天，一定給你更多獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Things haven't changed much but it still feels good to see this place has gotten brighter.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
雖然沒什麼變化，但這裡亮起來了，感覺真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 95EB72]
Just so you know, the torchlight you brought is waning. It's time to show me your sense of worth to me again.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 95EB72]
提醒你一下，你帶來的火把快熄滅了。該再向我證明你的價值了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: This is a large torch burning quite brightly.
scripts.translation: 這是一支燃燒得很亮的大火把。

scripts.text: Collect the light.
scripts.translation: 收集火光

scripts.text: You carefully collected the light and obtained the bright light.
scripts.translation: 你小心地收集了火光，獲得了明亮的光芒。

scripts.text: You carefully collected the light but it scattered.
scripts.translation: 你小心地收集火光，但火光散開了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Hey, are you that new servant?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
嘿，你是新來的僕人嗎？

scripts.text: The prisoner inside seems to be looking for a servant. I think he saw me but I'll just have to act like I didn't hear him.
scripts.translation: 裡面的囚犯似乎在找僕人。我覺得他看見我了，但還是裝作沒聽見吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Tsk, tsk. Even a servant is supposed to know manners.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
嘖嘖，連僕人也該懂點禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Are you that new servant? I guess the prisoner keeper has sent another human servant, then.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
你是新來的僕人嗎？看來獄卒又派了一個人類僕人來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I didn't like the human servant last time. He was too weak. I don't know about you.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我不喜歡上一個人類僕人，他太弱了。不知道你怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I'm worried but there is nothing else I can do.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我很擔心，可也別無他法。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Human servant. What is your name? What should I call you?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
人類僕人，你叫什麼？我該怎麼稱呼你？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
{0} What a weird and difficult name to pronounce! I wanted to call you by your name, but, I don't think I can.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
{0}？真是個奇怪又難唸的名字！我本想叫你的名字，可看來做不到。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Oh, right, you're Noyel! I like the sound of the name. Your name is Noyel from now on.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
哦，對了，你是諾耶爾！我喜歡這個名字。從現在起就叫你諾耶爾。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel, I have a question! Are the other human prisoners living in this dire environment?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，我有個問題！其他人類囚犯也生活在這種惡劣環境裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I know I'm a prisoner here, but I don't understand why they have to lock me in this place that is so dirty and humid.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我知道自己是囚犯，但不明白為什麼要把我關在這麼髒又潮溼的地方。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel, go ahead and bring that prisoner keeper. I have a bone to pick with him.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，去把獄卒叫來。我有賬要跟他算。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that's going to happen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我看這事辦不到。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I didn't know a servant has no right to meet with the prisoner keepers. My apology.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我不知道僕人不能見獄卒。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
But I can't go there myself. That means it's impossible to meet him then. We should come up with an alternative.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
可我自己也去不了那裡，看來是見不到他了。我們得想個別的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Now I remember. The servant who used to serve me gave me that. I'm not sure it's still here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我想起來了。以前服侍我的僕人給過我那個東西，不知道現在還在不在。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What item is it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
For what I remember, it was something that you humans use. It is called a dehumidifier removing humidity around you. Do you know what that is?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
我記得那是你們人類用的東西，叫除溼機，可以除去周圍的溼氣。你知道是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Maybe I should use it because I don't have any other option. Bring me about 20 of them.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
也許我該用它，反正也別無選擇。給我拿20個來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Still no dehumidifiers for me, Noyel? I don't need many. 20 dehumidifiers will do.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，除溼機還沒拿來嗎？不用很多，20個就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I start to feel the damp and soggy place is getting freshened up, Noyel.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，這潮溼陰冷的地方好像清爽多了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Good job. Go have a rest until I call you back up.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
幹得好。去休息吧，等我叫你再過來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
It's nothing. I don't need it so you take and use it.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
沒什麼，我用不著了，你拿去用吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel, the humidifier you brought for me doesn't seem to work. Will you bring another new one?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，你帶來的除溼機好像壞了。能再拿一個新的嗎？

scripts.text: Will do right away.
scripts.translation: 我馬上就去

scripts.text: Ah...I've got other business to go about now.
scripts.translation: 啊...我現在還有別的事要忙

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel! Where do you think you're going? Noel.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾！你要去哪兒？諾耶爾！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Thank you, Noyel. I will wait for you to bring me 20 dehumidifiers.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
謝謝你，諾耶爾。我等你帶20個除溼機來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel, when can I get those 20 dehumidifiers? The air feels so soggy and it's starting to feel unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，什麼時候才能拿到那20個除溼機？空氣太潮溼，真讓人難受。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
You're late, Noyel. Did you have a hard time getting the dehumidifier?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
你來晚了，諾耶爾。找除溼機很費勁嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
I was actually starting to feel displeased by the dampening air.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
潮溼的空氣已經讓我很不舒服了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
You did a good job getting the humidifier, Noyel.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，除溼機找到了，幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Noyel, the air I breathe couldn't be more fresh now!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
諾耶爾，我現在呼吸的空氣真是清新極了！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Even the prisoners deserve the pleasant environment to live. Keep that in mind, Noyel. Just in case.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
即使是囚犯，也值得擁有舒適的生活環境。諾耶爾，記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 117FM188]
Welcome, Noyel.
The dehumidifier you brought doesn't seem to function well. It's time to replace it with a new one.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 117FM188]
歡迎回來，諾耶爾。
你帶來的除溼機似乎不太管用，該換新的了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Keeps giggling~
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~不停地傻笑~

scripts.text: The prisoner here is smiling out of his pain. I don't think he's in normal condition. Should I pass him?
scripts.translation: 這裡的囚犯痛苦地笑著，狀態似乎不太正常。要繞開他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Evil laughter continues~
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~邪惡的笑聲仍在繼續~

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Giggles~ How long have I waited for a guest?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~咯咯笑~ 我等客人等了多久？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Even if your fear of me binds me here in the land of darkness, you can never bind my will. Mark my word.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
就算你因恐懼把我困在這片黑暗之地，也休想束縛我的意志。記住我的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Hahaha!! Now I remember.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
哈哈哈！我想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Ever since the cowards stopped coming to this land of darkness, I took my last sleep out of boredom.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
自從那些膽小鬼不再踏入這片黑暗之地，我就無聊得睡了過去。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
B.U.T.!

[Prisoner 103GD214]
That was my mistake. Darkness inside of me became greater during my sleep and the followers awaken by darkness changed a lot of things in this land.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
那是我的失誤。沉睡時，我體內的黑暗愈發強大，被黑暗喚醒的信徒也改變了這片土地的許多事。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Evil laughter~
I hate to admit this but darkness is stomping around. I need something to bring it under control.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~邪惡的笑聲~
我不願承認，但黑暗正在肆虐。我需要什麼東西來壓制它。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ Human...
It doesn't happen every day for a lard to ask you to do something. ~Grunts~ Bring me...some flowers...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 人類...
讓老子開口求你可不常見。~呻吟~ 給我帶些...花來...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Flowers representing the world are what not only soothes down darkness but also brings the peace of mind.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
象徵世界的花不僅能平息黑暗，也能讓人心安。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ It must be effective in calming down the growing darkness.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 它應該能安撫不斷增強的黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Aaarrgghh--!!

[Prisoner 103GD214]
Hurry. ~Grunts~ Darkness inside of me is trying to stomp around. If you don't want to see the world brought to ashes by this darkness, bring me...flowers...Now.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
快。~呻吟~ 我體內的黑暗正要肆虐。如果你不想看世界被黑暗化為灰燼，就帶花來...現在。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ I'll wait here for you. Any flowers would do. Bring me flowers.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 我會在這裡等你。什麼花都行，帶些來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
You brought the flowers, human!
~Evil laughter~ Human! You saved the world against darkness. Be glad!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
人類，你把花帶來了！
~邪惡的笑聲~ 人類！你拯救了世界，使它免於黑暗。高興吧！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
I can feel darkness inside is getting under control.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
我感覺體內的黑暗正在受到控制。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ How pathetic I have become, getting help from a human...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 我竟然要一個人類幫忙，真是狼狽...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't need to thank me. But, why the flowers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用謝我。不過，為什麼是花？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Human! Don't be so nosy.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
人類，別這麼愛管閒事。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Wait. Maybe it's alright after all since you're my savior.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
等等。你畢竟救了我，也許告訴你也無妨。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Alright, whatever. I'll let you in on it just this once.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
好吧，算了。這次就破例告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
It was around the time when I was holding sway in the world. I was conquering one of the human towns with my followers.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
那是我稱霸世界的時候。我正帶著信徒征服一個人類城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
I met a girl in that village who was different from other humans.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
我在那個村子裡遇到一個與眾不同的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Humans who got scared silly were busy running away from me and my followers but that girl was different. She reached out to me.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
其他人類嚇得魂飛魄散，忙著逃離我和信徒，只有那個女孩不一樣。她向我伸出了手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, what happened?

[Prisoner 103GD214]
You, human! Don't people often say you can be a wet blanket?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
人類！你不知道大家常說你是個掃興鬼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
This story doesn't deserve repetition.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
這故事不值得再提。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
It's true that you've been of help so let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
你確實幫了我，就把信徒留下的東西給你一件吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ If you don't want to see my darkness drags down the whole world to ashes, you'd better come often and bring me flowers.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 不想看我的黑暗把世界拖入毀滅，就常來給我帶花。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
啊——！！黑暗就要肆虐了！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
得控制住黑暗。快把花給我...啊！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Please get me one flower to calm down darkness, human...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
人類...給我一朵花，讓黑暗平息下來...

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but now...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
I'll hang in there. Just don't be too late...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
我會撐住，別來得太晚...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Please...~Grunts~ Human...

[Prisoner 103GD214]
Oh, no. It's getting out of my hand. Before this darkness goes berserk, bring me...flowers...~Grunts~
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
不...快控制不住了。黑暗狂暴起來之前，給我帶花來...~呻吟~

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Flower...? ~Grunts~ Darkness should be stable...
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
花...？~呻吟~ 黑暗應該穩定下來了...

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Aaarrgghhh--!!
- The flower you just gave has withered. -
scripts.translation: - 你剛才給的花已經枯萎了。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
This flower isn't enough to calm down darkness. Bring in more...!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
這朵花不足以平息黑暗。再多帶些來...！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
...It's working. Thank you, human. You've been a lot of help, too, this time.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
...有用。謝謝你，人類。這次你也幫了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Let me give you one of the things that the followers left for me.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
我把信徒留下的東西給你一件吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
I'll contact you again when the darkness inside of me starts to stomp around.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
等我體內的黑暗再次躁動時，會再找你。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
~Grunts~ Pray, human. Pray if you don't want my darkness flail around. You don't want to see the end of the world.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
~呻吟~ 祈禱吧，人類。若不想我的黑暗肆虐，就祈禱吧。你不會想看到世界末日的。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Aarghh!! Darkness is about to stomp around!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
啊——！！黑暗就要肆虐了！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 103GD214]
Darkness should be taken under control. Give me that flower...quick! Aargh!!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 103GD214]
得控制住黑暗。快把花給我...啊！

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Manager! Isn't there a manager?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
經理！這裡有經理嗎？

scripts.text: I wonder the prisoner here may think this prison as some kind of a hotel. He's looking for a manager. I'll just let this one pass.
scripts.translation: 我看這囚犯把監獄當成旅館了，居然在找經理。我還是別理他吧。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
I would like to talk to the manager, not some normal clerk!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我要找經理，不是普通職員！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You look like a manager to me. I have to tell you, the service here is downright poor. Don't you agree, manager? Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
你看起來像經理。我得說，這裡的服務糟透了。你說是不是，經理？嗯？！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You've come at a good time, I guess. I haven't had the time to take care of my horn and it's still hanging in there.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
你來得正好。我一直沒空打理我的角，角都快撐不住了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
My horn used to be praised by the horned bunch and...I hate to even imagine what they would say to me if they get to see this ugly horn now.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我的角以前很受那些有角的傢伙稱讚...真不敢想它們現在看到我這丑角會怎麼說。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Before my horn gets really damaged, I need to get it taken care of. But I don't see proper materials around here.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我的角徹底損壞前，得好好打理一番。但附近沒有合適的材料。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
!!

[Prisoner 55HK115]
Hey, manager. I think you're in luck. I think I've found something just right.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
嘿，經理。看來你運氣不錯，我找到合適的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
I see Taffy, the inferior species, walking around. I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper to trim down this thingies at the end of my horn.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我看到塔菲這種低等生物在四處走動。它們的皮應該能代替砂紙，磨掉我角尖上的小突起。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Look at this. This protruded area at the end of my horn. If it gets trimmed down, I would definitely get a peace of mind.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
看這裡，這是我角尖突出來的部分。磨掉之後，我就能安心了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
What are you doing? I told you to skin that Taffy and bring me 20!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
你在幹什麼？我叫你剝下塔菲的皮，給我帶20張來！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
What are you doing? Still haven't left?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
你在幹什麼？還沒出發嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You see Taffy walking around there? I think their skin should make a good alternative to the Sandpaper. Bring 20 of them.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
看到那邊的塔菲了嗎？它們的皮應該能代替砂紙。給我帶20張來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
What in the world are they taking so long? They're slow with poor service...I know my manners as knight so I can't just pick a fight. Alright. Just take this tip.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
他們怎麼這麼慢？服務真差...我身為騎士得講禮貌，總不能動手。算了，這點小費給你。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
~Sighs~ Given the condition of my horn, I don't think a couple of these won't do any good at all.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
~嘆氣~ 我的角都這樣了，幾張砂紙恐怕根本不夠用。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You've come at the right time, manager.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
經理，你來得正好。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
That thing you brought me last time was pretty good. I'm impressed by your skinning ability. How about changing your job to skin master?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
你上次帶來的東西不錯，我很佩服你的剝皮本領。要不要轉行當剝皮專家？

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
I was putting on a cool pair of shoes but something happened and I broke my toenails.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我剛穿上一雙帥氣的鞋，卻出了點意外，把腳趾甲弄斷了。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
In that spirit, why don't you bring me those 20 Sandpapers again?
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
既然這樣，再給我帶20張砂紙吧？

scripts.text: I'll be on my way.
scripts.translation: 我這就去

scripts.text: I'm tied up.
scripts.translation: 我現在沒空

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
I knew it. Talk about poor service!
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我就知道！服務真差！

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
I can't wait to see what you'll bring this time.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
我等不及想看看你這次會帶什麼來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You can't turn back time once it passes. Hurry up. You have no time to lose.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
時間一去不返。快點，別浪費時間。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Rudolph the hero of reindeers said time is gold. I think it applies to humans, too.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
馴鹿英雄魯道夫說過“時間就是金錢”。我覺得這話對人類也適用。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
This time, the service is acceptable.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
這次的服務還算過得去。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Here's your tip for your satisfactory work. Come back again.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
這點小費是給你辛苦工作的。下次再來。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
Oh, this alternative is better than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
哦，這種替代品比我想的還好。

scripts.text:
[Prisoner 55HK115]
You've come at the right time, manager.
scripts.translation:
[囚犯 55HK115]
經理，你來得正好。

scripts.text:
[Underground Dungeon Helper]
Select the service to use.
scripts.translation:
[地下城助手]
請選擇要使用的服務。

scripts.text: Reset Quest
scripts.translation: 重置任務

scripts.text: Individual quest setting
scripts.translation: 個人任務設定

scripts.text: Reset cooldown.
scripts.translation: 重置冷卻時間

scripts.text:
[Underground Dungeon Helper]
